en: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to draw up a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,
war: Hinigugma ko nga Teofilo:

en: even as they delivered them unto us, who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and ministers of the word,
war: Damo na in nagtalingoha hin pagsurat han mga butang nga nahinabo dinhe ha aton.

en: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus;
war: Iginsurat nira an ngatanan nga iginsumat ha aton hadton mga nagpakakita hini nga mga butang tikang pa ha tinikangan, ngan hadton nagpasangyaw han mensahe.

en: that thou mightest know the certainty concerning the things wherein thou wast instructed.
war: Sanglit, harangdon nga Teofilo, tungod kay gin-adman ko hin maupay an katukiban hini ngatanan nga mga butang, tikang han ira tinikangan, minaupay ko hin pagsurat hin tul-id nga sumat para ha imo.

en: There was in the days of Herod, king of Judæa, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abijah: and he had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
war: Binubuhat ko ini basi hibaroan mo an bug-os nga kamatuoran mahitungod hadton mga butang nga igintutdo ha imo.

en: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
war: Han panahon nga hi Herodes amo an hadi han tuna han Israel, may usa nga padi nga sakop han padianon nga hugpo ni Abias. Zacarias an iya ngaran ngan hi Elisabet an iya asawa nga tulin ni Aaron, nga sakop hin padianon nga banay.

en: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
war: Matadong hira nga duha ha atubangan han Dyos, ngan matinumanon han ngatanan nga mga sugo ngan mga turumanon han Ginoo.

en: Now it came to pass, while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his course,
war: Waray nira anak kay baw-as hi Elisabet, ngan mga lagas na kaupay hira nga duha.

en: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
war: Usa ka adlaw nagtuman hi Zacarias han iya katungdanan hin pagkapadi ha atubangan han Dyos, dida ha pagtuman han iya turno han kada adlaw nga iya buruhaton.

en: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the hour of incense.
war: Sumala han batasan nga ginsusunod han kapadian, napili hiya, pinaagi hin ripa, hin pagtubod han insyenso didto ha altar. Sanglit sinmulod hiya ngadto han Templo han Ginoo,

en: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
war: samtang nag-aampo ha gawas in damo nga mga tawo ha takna han pagtubod han insyenso.

en: And Zacharias was troubled when he saw him , and fear fell upon him.
war: Pinmakita ha iya in usa nga anghel han Ginoo, nga natindog didto ha tuo nga dapit han altar diin gintutubod an insyenso.

en: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: because thy supplication is heard, and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
war: Nalisang ngan nahadlok hi Zacarias han pakakita niya han anghel.

en: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
war: Kundi nagsiring ha iya an anghel, “Ayaw kahadlok, Zacarias! Pinamatian han Dyos an imo pag-ampo, ngan mag-aanak hin lalake hi Elisabet nga imo asawa. Pagngangaranan mo hiya nga Juan.

en: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and he shall drink no wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.
war: Mapupuno ka hin kalipay sugad man in damo nga mga tawo kon matawo na hiya!

en: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn unto the Lord their God.
war: Mahihimo hiya nga dako nga pagkatawo ha atubangan han Ginoo. Kinahanglan diri hiya uminom hin bino o mapintas nga irimnon. Mapupuno hiya han Espiritu Santo tikang pa han iya katawo.

en: And he shall go before his face in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to walk in the wisdom of the just; to make ready for the Lord a people prepared for him .
war: Damo in mga tawo han Israel nga bubuligan niya hin pagbalik ngadto han Ginoo nga ira Dyos.

en: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
war: Mag-uuna hiya han Ginoo, makusog ug gamhanan sugad kan Elias nga manaragna. Tatalinguhaon niya nga an mga amay ngan mga anak maghioli; nga an diri masinugtanon nga mga tawo mahibalik ngadto hin matadong nga dalan. Aandamon niya an mga tawo han Ginoo para ha iya.”

en: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and I was sent to speak unto thee, and to bring thee these good tidings.
war: Nagsiring hi Zacarias ha anghel, “Uunanhon ko hin pakasabot nga matuod ini? Lagas na ako ngan lagas na liwat an akon asawa.”

en: And behold, thou shalt be silent and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall come to pass, because thou believedst not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
war: Binmaton an anghel, “Ako amo hi Gabriel nga natindog ha atubangan han Dyos nga nagsugo ha akon hin pagyakan ngan pagsumat ha imo hini nga maupay nga sumat.

en: And the people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marvelled while he tarried in the temple.
war: Kundi waray ka tumuod han akon sumat nga matutuman ha igo nga panahon. Tungod kay waray ka tumuod, diri ka makakayakan. Mangungula ka ngada han adlaw han katuman han akon iginsaad ha imo.”

en: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: and he continued making signs unto them, and remained dumb.
war: Hito nga takna, nagpipinamulat kan Zacarias an mga tawo ngan nahipausa hira kay ano nga maiha naman hiya didto ha sulod han Templo.

en: And it came to pass, when the days of his ministration were fulfilled, he departed unto his house.
war: Han paggawas na niya, waray hiya pakakayakan ha ira; sanglit nakasabot hira nga kinmita hiya hin panan-awon didto ha Templo. Nagsenyas na la hiya ha ira kay diri naman hiya nakakayakan.

en: And after these days Elisabeth his wife conceived; and she hid herself five months, saying,
war: Katapos na han iya buruhaton ha Templo, inmoli hi Zacarias.

en: Thus hath the Lord done unto me in the days wherein he looked upon me , to take away my reproach among men.
war: Waray pag-iha, nagburod hi Elisabet nga iya asawa, ngan nakadto la hiya ha sakob han ira balay sulod hin lima ka bulan.

en: Now in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
war: Nagsiring hi Elisabet, “Yana ginbuligan gihapon ako han Ginoo dida hini nga paagi. Ginkuha na niya an akon kaarawdan ha atubangan han mga tawo!”

en: to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin’s name was Mary.
war: Han burod ni Elizabet hin unom ka bulan, ginsugo han Dyos hi Gabriel nga anghel ngadto ha Galilea, ha usa nga bungto nga Nazaret an ngaran.

en: And he came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favored, the Lord is with thee.
war: May dara hiya nga sumat para hin usa nga daraga nga sinayoran na hin lalake nga ginngaranan kan Jose, nga tulin ni Hadi David. Maria an ngaran hini nga daraga.

en: But she was greatly troubled at the saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this might be.
war: Kinmadto an anghel ha iya ngan nagsiring, “Maghimaya ka! Puno ka hin grasya! An Ginoo aada ha imo!”

en: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favor with God.
war: Dako an kagupong ni Maria han iginpasabot han anghel, ngan ginpainoino niya kon ano an kahulogan han iya mga pulong.

en: And behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
war: Nagsiring ha iya an anghel, “Ayaw kahadlok, Maria, kay ginpalabi ka han Dyos.

en: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Most High: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
war: Magbuburod ngan mag-aanak ka hin lalake, ngan pagngangaranan mo hiya nga Jesus.

en: and he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
war: Mahihimo hiya nga dako nga pagkatawo ngan tatawgon nga Anak han Gihahataasi nga Dyos. Hihimoon han Ginoo nga Dyos nga hadi hiya, sugad kan David nga iya ginikanan,

en: And Mary said unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
war: ngan mahihimo hiya nga hadi ha kadayonan han mga tulin ni Jacob; an iya ginhadian waray kataposan!”

en: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Spirit shall come upon thee, and the power of the Most High shall overshadow thee: wherefore also the holy thing which is begotten shall be called the Son of God.
war: Hi Maria nagsiring han anghel, “Uray ngan putli ako. Uunanhon man hin kahimo hini?”

en: And behold, Elisabeth thy kinswoman, she also hath conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her that was called barren.
war: Nagbaton an anghel, “Makunsad ha imo an Espiritu Santo, ngan magpapabilin ha imo an gahom han Dyos. Tungod hini, tatawgon nga Anak han Dyos ini nga santos nga bata.

en: For no word from God shall be void of power.
war: Kitaa! Hi Elisabet nga imo urupod bisan kon baw-as hiya ngan lagas na kaupay yana, burod na hin unom ka bulan.

en: And Mary said, Behold, the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
war: Kay waray butang nga diri mahihimo han Dyos.”

en: And Mary arose in these days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah;
war: Nagsiring hi Maria, “Iini ako nga surugoon han Ginoo. Matuman unta dinhe ha akon sumala han imo pulong.” Ngan binayaan hiya han anghel.

en: and entered into the house of Zacharias and saluted Elisabeth.
war: Waray pag-iha, nag-andam hi Maria ngan nagdagmit hin pagkadto ha usa nga bungto ha sagkahon nga tuna han Judea.

en: And it came to pass, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit;
war: Kinmadto hiya ha balay ni Zacarias ngan naghatag hin katalahoran kan Elisabet.

en: and she lifted up her voice with a loud cry, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
war: Han pakabati la ni Elisabet han mga pulong ni Maria, nagkiwa an bata ha sulod han iya tiyan. Napuno hi Elisabet han Espiritu Santo,

en: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come unto me?
war: ngan nagyakan hin dako nga tingog, “Ikaw an labi kabaraan han ngatanan nga kababayen-an, ngan baraan an bata nga gindadara nimo ha imo tiyan!

en: For behold, when the voice of thy salutation came into mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
war: Kay ano nga itinugot man ini nga makanhi hin pagduaw ha akon an iroy han akon Ginoo?

en: And blessed is she that believed; for there shall be a fulfilment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord.
war: Kay han pakabati ko han imo nga pulong, linmukso hin kalipay an bata ha akon tiyan.

en: And Mary said,
war: Hin kabaraan niya nga natoo nga matutuman an ginpamulong ha iya han Ginoo!”

en: My soul doth magnify the Lord,
war: Nagsiring hi Maria,

en: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
war: “Nagdadayaw an akon kalag han Ginoo;

en: For he hath looked upon the low estate of his handmaid:
war: naglilipay an akon kasingkasing dida han Dyos nga akon Manunubos,

en: For behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
war: kay nahinumdoman ako niya, an iya ubos nga surugoon!

en: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things;
war: Tikang yana tatawgon ako

en: And holy is his name.
war: nga baraan han ngatanan nga katulinan,

en: And his mercy is unto generations and generations
war: tungod han dagko nga mga butang nga ginbuhat para ha akon

en: On them that fear him.
war: han Makagarahum nga Dyos.

en: He hath showed strength with his arm;
war: Baraan an iya ngaran;

en: He hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their heart.
war: nagpapakita hiya hin kalooy hadton mga nahadlok ha iya,

en: He hath put down princes from their thrones,
war: tikang ha usa ngadto han sunod nga katulinan.

en: And hath exalted them of low degree.
war: Ginpakita niya an kusog han iya butkon,

en: The hungry he hath filled with good things;
war: ngan ginpasarang niya an mga mapahitas-on ha kasingkasing.

en: And the rich he hath sent empty away.
war: Ginpukan niya in gamhanan nga mga hadi

en: He hath given help to Israel his servant,
war: tikang han ira mga trono, ngan ginpahitaas niya an mga mapainubsanon.

en: That he might remember mercy
war: Ginbusog niya hin mag-upay nga mga butang an mga gutom,

en: (As he spake unto our fathers)
war: ngan ginpalakat niya an mga riko nga waray dara.

en: Toward Abraham and his seed for ever.
war: Gintuman niya an iya iginsaad ha aton mga kaapoy-apoyan,

en: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned unto her house.
war: ngan binuligan niya an Israel nga iya surugoon;

en: Now Elisabeth’s time was fulfilled that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
war: nahinumdom hiya hin pagkalooy kan Abraham ngan ha ngatanan

en: And her neighbors and her kinsfolk heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy towards her; and they rejoiced with her.
war: nga iya katulinan ha kadayonan!”

en: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
war: Linmungon hi Maria kan Elisabet sulod hin mga tulo ka bulan, ngan katapos, inmoli hiya.

en: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
war: Inmabot an panahon han pag-anak ni Elisabet, ngan nag-anak hiya hin lalake.

en: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
war: Nakabati an iya mga amyaw ngan kauropdan han dako nga kalooy han Ginoo ha iya, ngan dinmuyog hira ngatanan ha iya hin pagkalipay.

en: And they made signs to his father, what he would have him called.
war: Han walo na ka adlaw an bata, kinmadto hira basi buhaton nira an seremonyas hin pagtori ha iya. Ginngangaranan na unta nira nga Zacarias, an ngaran han amay han bata.

en: And he asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
war: Kundi nagsiring an iroy niya, “Diri! Juan an igngangaran ha iya.”

en: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed , and he spake, blessing God.
war: Nagsiring hira ha iya, “Kundi waray man niyo uropod nga may sugad hini nga ngaran!”

en: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judæa.
war: Niyan ginsenyasan nira hi Zacarias kon ano an iya karuyag igngaran han bata.

en: And all that heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, What then shall this child be? For the hand of the Lord was with him.
war: Nag-aro hi Zacarias hin susuratan, ngan nagsurat, “Juan an iya ngaran.” Duro gud an paghipausa nira ngatanan!

en: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,
war: Hito manta nga takna nakayakan na liwat hi Zacarias ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagdayaw han Dyos.

en: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel;
war: Kinulba gud an ngatanan nga mga amyaw, ngan nabantog ha bug-os nga katunaan han Judea an sumat mahitungod hini nga hinabo.

en: For he hath visited and wrought redemption for his people,
war: An ngatanan nga nagpakabati namalandong mahitungod hini ngan nagpakiana hira, “Ano daw la an aabutan hini nga bata?” Dayag gud nga nakada ha iya an gahom han Ginoo.

en: And hath raised up a horn of salvation for us
war: Napuno han Espiritu Santo hi Zacarias nga amay ni Juan, ngan namulong hiya han mensahe han Dyos:

en: In the house of his servant David
war: “Dayawa ta an Ginoo, an Dyos han Israel!

en: (As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets that have been from of old),
war: Kinmanhi hiya hin pagbulig ngan pagtalwas han iya katawhan.

en: Salvation from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
war: Naghatag hiya hin gamhanan

en: To show mercy towards our fathers,
war: nga Magtaralwas para ha aton, nga tulin ni David nga iya surugoon.

en: And to remember his holy covenant;
war: Nagsaad hiya ha maiha na nga panahon pinaagi han iya baraan

en: The oath which he sware unto Abraham our father,
war: nga mga manaragna:

en: To grant unto us that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies
war: nga tatalwason kita tikang han aton mga kaaway,

en: Should serve him without fear,
war: ngan tikang han gahom hadton ngatanan nga nagdudumot ha aton.

en: In holiness and righteousness before him all our days.
war: Nagsiring hiya nga malolooy hiya han aton mga ginikanan,

en: Now it came to pass in those days, there went out a decree from Cæsar Augustus, that all the world should be enrolled.
war: Hadto nga panahon nagsugo hi Emperador Augusto nga magpalista para han sensos an ngatanan nga mga sakop han Imperyo.

en: This was the first enrolment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
war: Hi Cirenio amo an gobernador han Siria han paghimoa hini nga syahan nga sensos.

en: And all went to enrol themselves, every one to his own city.
war: Sanglit kinmadto hin pagpalista an ngatanan, an kada usa ngadto han iya kalugaringon nga bungto.

en: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judæa, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David;
war: Tikang ha bungto han Nazaret ha Galilea, kinmadto hi Jose ha Judea, ngadto han bungto han Betlehem nga natawhan ni Hadi David, kay tulin man hiya ni David.

en: to enrol himself with Mary, who was betrothed to him, being great with child.
war: Kinmadto hiya hin pagpalista upod hi Maria nga sinayoran na ha iya, ngan hingarak-an na.

en: And it came to pass, while they were there, the days were fulfilled that she should be delivered.
war: Samtang nakadto hira ha Betlehem, inmabot an panahon nga mag-aanak na hi Maria.

en: And she brought forth her firstborn son; and she wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.
war: Nag-anak hiya han iya suhag nga lalake, ginputos niya hin mga lampin, ngan iginhulid ha pasungan, kay waray na man lugar para ha ira didto han balay nga pahuwayan.

en: And there were shepherds in the same country abiding in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.
war: May mga magmarangno hin karnero didto hadto nga dapit nga nag-aagma ha bug-os nga gab-i didto han kaumhan hin pagmangno han ira mga panon.

en: And an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
war: Pinmakita ha ira in usa nga anghel han Ginoo, ngan nalamragan hira han himaya han Ginoo, ngan nagkahadlok hira.

en: And the angel said unto them, Be not afraid; for behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy which shall be to all the people:
war: Kundi nagsiring ha ira an anghel, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok! Hahani ako ngan may-ada ako dara nga maupay nga sumat para ha iyo, nga maghahatag hin dako nga kalipayan han ngatanan nga katawhan.

en: for there is born to you this day in the city of David a Saviour, who is Christ the Lord.
war: Natawo yana nga adlaw didto han bungto ni David an iyo Magtaralwas nga amo an Cristo nga Ginoo.

en: And this is the sign unto you: Ye shall find a babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, and lying in a manger.
war: Amo ini an tigaman para ha iyo: hiaagian niyo in bata nga pinutos hin mga lampin ngan hinulid ha pasungan.”

en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
war: Ha gilayon pinmakita upod han anghel in dako nga hugpo hin mga anghel ha langit, nga nagkakanta hin mga pagdayaw ha Dyos:

en: Glory to God in the highest,
war: “Himaya sa Dyos ha kahitas-an,

en: And on earth peace among men in whom he is well pleased.
war: ngan kalinaw dinhe ha tuna hadton mga tawo nga maupay an kaburot-on!”

en: And it came to pass, when the angels went away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing that is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
war: Han pagbalik na han mga anghel ngadto ha langit, nagsarabot an mga magmarangno hin karnero, “Kadto kita ha Betlehem ngan kitaa ta ini nga butang nga nahinabo nga iginsumat ha aton han Ginoo.”

en: And they came with haste, and found both Mary and Joseph, and the babe lying in the manger.
war: Sanglit nagdagmit hira hin pagkalakat, ngan hin-agian nira hira Maria ug Jose, ngan hinkit-an nira an bata nga hinulid ha pasungan.

en: And when they saw it, they made known concerning the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
war: Han pakakita nira han bata, iginsumat han mga magmarangno an iginsiring han anghel mahitungod ha iya.

en: And all that heard it wondered at the things which were spoken unto them by the shepherds.
war: Nanhipausa an ngatanan nga nagpakabati hini nga iginsumat ha ira han mga magmarangno.

en: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
war: Gintipigan ni Maria ini ngatanan nga mga butang, ngan ginpamalandong niya ha iya kasingkasing.

en: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, even as it was spoken unto them.
war: Namalik an mga magmarangno nga nagkakanta hin mga pagdayaw sa Dyos, tungod han ngatanan nga ira hinbatian ngan hinkit-an; nahinabo an ngatanan sumala gud han iginsumat ha ira han anghel.

en: And when eight days were fulfilled for circumcising him, his name was called JESUS, which was so called by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
war: Pag-agi han ikawalo ka adlaw, nga amo na an pagtuman han seremonyas hin pagtori han bata, ginngaranan hiya nga Jesus, an ngaran nga iginhatag han anghel han waray pa hiya igpapanamkon.

en: And when the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord
war: Inmabot an panahon hin pagtuman nira Jose ug Maria han seremonyas han paglinis sumala han iginsugo han Balaod ni Moises. Sanglit, gindara nira an bata ngadto ha Jerusalem basi ihalad liwat hiya ngadto han Ginoo,

en: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord),
war: sumala han iginsurat dida han balaod han Ginoo: “Kinahanglan ighalad ngadto han Ginoo an tagsa nga suhag nga lalake.”

en: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
war: Naghalad liwat hira, sumala han kinahanglan han balaod han Ginoo, “Usa ka padis nga sarapati o duha nga piso nga tukmo.”

en: And behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and this man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Spirit was upon him.
war: Niyan, may-ada tawo nga nag-uokoy ha Jerusalem, nga Simeon an ngaran. Maupay ngan mainampoon hiya nga tawo, ngan naghihinulat hiya han katalwasan han Israel. Nakada ha iya an Espiritu Santo,

en: And it had been revealed unto him by the Holy Spirit, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
war: ngan ginpatapod hiya han Espiritu Santo nga diri gud hiya mapatay, kon diri anay kumita hiya han Mesiyas nga iginsaad han Ginoo.

en: And he came in the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, that they might do concerning him after the custom of the law,
war: Inaghat han Espiritu Santo kinmadto hi Simeon ha Templo. Gindara han mga kag-anak ngadto ha Templo an bata nga Jesus basi magtuman hira han sugo han Balaod.

en: then he received him into his arms, and blessed God, and said,
war: Ginkugos ni Simeon an bata ngan nagpasalamat han Dyos:

en: Now lettest thou thy servant depart, Lord,
war: “Yana, Ginoo, gintuman mo na an imo saad,

en: According to thy word, in peace;
war: ngan tugoti na pagbaya ha kamurayaw an imo surugoon.

en: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
war: Ha akon kalugaringon nga mga mata, hinkit-an ko na an imo katalwasan,

en: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all peoples;
war: nga imo gin-andam ha atubangan han ngatanan nga mga katawhan:

en: A light for revelation to the Gentiles,
war: Kapawa nga magpapadayag ha mga Hentil han imo paagi

en: And the glory of thy people Israel.
war: ngan magdadara hin kadungganan han imo katawhan nga Israel.”

en: And his father and his mother were marvelling at the things which were spoken concerning him;
war: Nanhipausa an amay ug iroy han bata han mga butang nga iginsiring ni Simeon mahitungod ha iya.

en: and Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the falling and the rising of many in Israel; and for a sign which is spoken against;
war: Ginbendisyonan hira ni Simeon, ngan nagsiring hi Simeon kan Maria nga iroy han bata, “Ginpili han Dyos ini nga bata para han pagkapukan ngan han katalwasan hin damo ha Israel. Magigin tigaman hiya tikang sa Dyos nga pagsusupakon hin damo nga mga tawo,

en: yea and a sword shall pierce through thine own soul; that thoughts out of many hearts may be revealed.
war: ngan tungod hini, ipadadayag niya an ira tinago nga mga panhunahuna. Ngan sasamaron sugad hin matarom nga espada an imo kasingkasing tungod hin kabido.”

en: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
war: May-ada manaragna nga babaye nga ginngangaranan kan Ana, nga anak ni Panuel, han tribo ni Aser. Lagas na hiya, nga nainasaw-an hin pito ka tuig,

en: and she had been a widow even unto fourscore and four years), who departed not from the temple, worshipping with fastings and supplications night and day.
war: ngan nabalo hiya ug 84 ka tuig na an iya panuigon. Waray gud hiya bumaya han Templo; adlaw gab-i nagsingba hiya han Dyos, nga nagpuasa ngan nag-ampo hiya.

en: And coming up at that very hour she gave thanks unto God, and spake of him to all them that were looking for the redemption of Jerusalem.
war: Inmabot hiya hito manta nga takna ngan nagpasalamat sa Dyos, ngan namulong hiya mahitungod han bata ha ngatanan mga naghihinulat han kanan Dyos pagtubos han Jerusalem.

en: And when they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
war: Katapos nira pagbuhat han ngatanan nga ginkikinahanglan han balaod han Ginoo, binmalik hira ngadto ha Galilea, ha ira kalugaringon nga bungto ha Nazaret.

en: And the child grew, and waxed strong, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
war: Tinmubo ngan nagmakusog an bata; puno hiya hin kinaadman, ngan nakada ha iya an mga bendisyon han Dyos.

en: And his parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the passover.
war: Kada tuig, napakadto ha Jerusalem an mga kag-anak ni Jesus para han Pyesta han Paglabay.

en: And when he was twelve years old, they went up after the custom of the feast;
war: Han dose na an edad ni Jesus, kinmadto hira han pyesta sumala han ira nababatasan.

en: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and his parents knew it not;
war: Katapos han pyesta, nagtipaoli hira, kundi nagpabilin an bata nga Jesus didto ha Jerusalem. Waray mahibaro hini an iya mga kag-anak;

en: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they sought for him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance:
war: naghunahuna hira nga upod hiya han kadam-an, sanglit naglinakat hira anay hin bug-os nga adlaw; ngan amo na an pamiling nira ha iya didto han ira kauropdan ngan kasangkayan.

en: and when they found him not, they returned to Jerusalem, seeking for him.
war: Waray hira makaagi ha iya, sanglit binmalik hira ngadto ha Jerusalem hin pagbiling ha iya.

en: And it came to pass, after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both hearing them, and asking them questions:
war: Han pag-ikatulo ka adlaw, hin-agian nira hiya didto ha Templo, nga nalingkod upod han mga magturutdo nga Judiyo, namamati ngan nagpapakiana ha ira.

en: and all that heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
war: Nahipausa gud an ngatanan nga nagpakabati han iya mag-upay nga mga baton.

en: And when they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I sought thee sorrowing.
war: Nahipausa liwat an iya mga kag-anak han pakakita ha iya, ngan ginsiring hiya han iroy niya, “Anak, kay ano nga ginbuhat mo ini ha amon? Duro na iton kabaraka ni imo tatay ngan ako hin pagpinamiling ha imo.”

en: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? knew ye not that I must be in my Father’s house?
war: Ginbaton niya hira, “Kay ano hin pagbiniling niyo ha akon? Diri ba kamo maaram nga kinahanglan hahani ako ha balay han akon Amay?”

en: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
war: Kundi waray hira makasabot han iginsiring niya ha ira.

en: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cæsar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judæa, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituræa and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
war: Ha ika-15 ka tuig han pagkahadi ni Emperador Tiberio, hi Poncio Pilato an gobernador ha Judea, hi Herodes an pangulo ha Galilea, ngan hi Felipe nga iya bugto an pangulo han katunaan ha Iturea ug Trakonite; hi Lisanias an pangulo ha Abilinia,

en: in the high-priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
war: ngan hira Anas ug Caifas an mga Labaw nga kapadian. Hini nga panahon inmabot an pulong han Dyos kan Juan nga anak ni Zacarias, didto ha kamingawan.

en: And he came into all the region round about the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance unto remission of sins;
war: Sanglit, ginsudoy ni Juan an bug-os nga katunaan nga hirani han Salog han Jordan, ngan nagwali, “Bayai an iyo mga sala ngan magpabunyag kamo, ngan pasasayloon kamo han Dyos han iyo mga sala.”

en: as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet,
war: Sumala han iginsurat ni manaragna Isaias ha iya basahan:

en: The voice of one crying in the wilderness,
war: “May naggogoliat ha kamingawan:

en: Make ye ready the way of the Lord,
war: ‘Andama an dalan han Ginoo para ha iya;

en: Make his paths straight.
war: tadonga an dalan nga iya aagian!

en: Every valley shall be filled,
war: Kinahanglan tak-upan an ngatanan nga kahamub-an,

en: And every mountain and hill shall be brought low;
war: panason an ngatanan nga kabungtoran ug kabukiran.

en: And the crooked shall become straight,
war: Kinahanglan tadongon an baliko nga mga dalan,

en: And the rough ways smooth;
war: ngan hamison an luongluong nga mga agian.

en: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
war: Ngan makakakita an ngatanan nga katawhan han katalwasan nga tikang han Dyos!’”

en: He said therefore to the multitudes that went out to be baptized of him, Ye offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
war: Kinmadto kan Juan in kadam-an nga mga tawo hin pagpabunyag ha iya. Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kamo nga mga halas, hin-o in nagsumat ha iyo nga makakalikay kamo han tiarabot nga kapungot han Dyos?

en: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
war: Buhata niyo an mga butang nga magpapakita nga binmaya na kamo han iyo mga sala. Ngan ayaw na kamo pagsiring ha iyo ngahaw, ‘Hi Abraham an amon ginikanan.’ Susumatan ko kamo nga makakahimo an Dyos hin mga tulin ni Abraham tikang hini nga mga bato!

en: And even now the axe also lieth at the root of the trees: every tree therefore that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
war: Andam na an parakol hin pagpulod han mga kahoy upod an mga gamot; pupudlon an tagsa nga kahoy nga diri nahatag hin maupay nga bunga ngan ilalabog ha kalayo.”

en: And the multitudes asked him, saying, What then must we do?
war: Nagpakiana ha iya an mga tawo, “Sanglit, ano man an amon bubuhaton?”

en: And he answered and said unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath food, let him do likewise.
war: Binmaton hiya, “kon hin-o in may duha nga bado, kinahanglan tagan niya an tawo nga waray bado, ngan kon hin-o in may pagkaon kinahanglan makigsaro hiya.”

en: And there came also publicans to be baptized, and they said unto him, Teacher, what must we do?
war: Inmabot pagpabunyag in mga parasukot hin buhis ngan nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Magturutdo, ano man an amon bubuhaton?”

en: And he said unto them, Extort no more than that which is appointed you.
war: Ginsiring niya hira, “Ayaw kamo pagsukot hin diri na igo ug kaangayan.”

en: And soldiers also asked him, saying, And we, what must we do? And he said unto them, Extort from no man by violence, neither accuse any one wrongfully; and be content with your wages.
war: Nagpakiana liwat ha iya in mga sondalo, “Hi kami, ano man in amon bubuhaton?”

en: And as the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether haply he were the Christ;
war: Ginsiring hira niya, “Ayaw kamo panikas pinaagi hin panarhog o pagbutangbutang. Ayaw kamo pag-uba han hatag ha iyo nga suhol.”

en: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but there cometh he that is mightier than I, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit and in fire:
war: Dinmugang an paglaom han mga tawo, ngan nakahunahuna hira hiunong kan Juan, nga bangin hiya na an Mesiyas.

en: whose fan is in his hand, thoroughly to cleanse his threshing-floor, and to gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.
war: Sanglit, nagsiring hi Juan ha ira ngatanan, “Nagbubunyag ako ha iyo hin tubig, kundi maabot in labaw pa ha akon. Diri ngani ako takos hin paghubad han higot han iya sandalyas. Pagbubunyagan kamo niya han Espiritu Santo ngan hin kalayo.

en: With many other exhortations therefore preached he good tidings unto the people;
war: Dara niya an igparalid nga nigo hin pagpalid han giniok nga mga inani, ngan pagtirok han trigo ngadto han iya kamalig; kundi iya susunogon an ohot didto ha kalayo nga diri gud mapaparong.”

en: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
war: Gindasig ni Juan an mga tawo hin damo kalain nga mga paagi, samtang nga nagwawali hiya han Maupay nga Sumat ha ira.

en: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
war: Kundi ginsusnan ni Juan hi Gobernador Herodes, kay pinangasawa niya hi Herodias nga asawa han iya bugto, ngan tungod hin damo pa nga iba nga magraot nga mga butang nga iya ginbuhat.

en: Now it came to pass, when all the people were baptized, that, Jesus also having been baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
war: Ginbuhat pa ni Herodes in dako nga karat-an. Iginpapriso pa niya hi Juan.

en: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form, as a dove, upon him, and a voice came out of heaven, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
war: Katapos na kabunyagi han ngatanan nga mga tawo, ginbunyagan liwat hi Jesus. Samtang nag-aampo hiya, nabuksan an langit,

en: And Jesus himself, when he began to teach , was about thirty years of age, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
war: ngan kinmunsad ngada ha iya an Espiritu Santo ha lawasnon nga dagway, sugad hin sarapati. Ngan hinbatian in tingog tikang ha langit: “Ikaw an akon hinigugma nga Anak. Nalilipay gud ako ha imo.”

en: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,
war: Mga 30 na an edad ni Jesus han pagtikang niya han iya buruhaton. Nagtoo an mga tawo nga anak hiya ni Jose nga anak ni Eli.

en: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
war: Ini hi Eli anak ni Matat nga anak ni Levi nga anak ni Melqui nga anak ni Jana nga anak ni Jose.

en: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josech, the son of Joda,
war: Hi Jose anak ni Matatias nga anak ni Amos nga anak ni Nahum nga anak ni Esli nga anak ni Nagai.

en: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
war: Hi Nagai anak ni Maat nga anak ni Matatias nga anak ni Semei nga anak ni Jose nga anak ni Juda.

en: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmadam, the son of Er,
war: Hi Juda anak ni Joan nga anak ni Resa nga anak ni Sorobabel nga anak ni Salatiel nga anak ni Neri.

en: the son of Jesus, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
war: Ini hi Neri anak ni Melqui nga anak ni Adi nga anak ni Cosam nga anak ni Elmodam nga anak ni Er.

en: the son of Symeon, the son of Judas, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,
war: Hi Er anak ni Josue nga anak ni Eliezer nga anak ni Jorim nga anak ni Matat nga anak ni Levi.

en: the son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
war: Hi Levi anak ni Simeon nga anak ni Juda nga anak ni Jose nga anak ni Jonan nga anak ni Eliakim.

en: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
war: Hi Eliakim anak ni Melea nga anak ni Mainan nga anak ni Matata nga anak ni Natan nga anak ni David.

en: the son of Amminadab, the son of Arni, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
war: Anak ini hi David ni Isai nga anak ni Obed nga anak ni Boos nga anak ni Salmon nga anak ni Naason.

en: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
war: Hi Naason anak ni Abinadab nga anak ni Admin nga anak ni Arni nga anak ni Esrom nga anak ni Fares nga anak ni Juda.

en: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
war: Hi Juda anak ni Jacob nga anak ni Isaac nga anak ni Abraham nga anak ni Tare nga anak ni Nahor.

en: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
war: Hi Nahor anak ni Serug nga anak ni Ragau nga anak ni Peleg nga anak ni Eber nga anak ni Sela.

en: And Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan, and was led in the Spirit in the wilderness
war: Binmalik tikang ha Jordan hi Jesus nga puno han Espiritu Santo, ngan gindara han Espiritu ngadto ha kamingawan,

en: during forty days, being tempted of the devil. And he did eat nothing in those days: and when they were completed, he hungered.
war: diin ginsulay hiya han Yawa sulod hin kwarenta ka adlaw. Waray hiya kumaon sakob hini nga mga adlaw, sanglit ginutom hiya.

en: And the devil said unto him, If thou art the Son of God, command this stone that it become bread.
war: Nagsiring ha iya an Yawa, “Kon Anak ka manggud han Dyos, igbuot nga ini nga bato mahimo nga tinapay.”

en: And Jesus answered unto him, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Diri mabubuhi an tawo ha tinapay la.’”

en: And he led him up, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
war: Niyan gindara hiya han Yawa ngadto ha igbaw, ngan iginpakita ha iya hin usa la kadali an ngatanan nga mga ginhadian ha kalibutan.

en: And the devil said unto him, To thee will I give all this authority, and the glory of them: for it hath been delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
war: Ginsiring hiya han Yawa, “Ihahatag ko ha imo ini ngatanan nga gahom ngan ini ngatanan nga bahandi, kay igintubyan ha akon ini ngatanan, ngan makakahatag ako hini ngatanan bisan kan kanay nga karuyagon ko.

en: If thou therefore wilt worship before me, it shall all be thine.
war: Sanglit, ihahatag ko ini ngatanan ha imo kon magsingba ka ha akon.”

en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, It is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Singbahon mo an Ginoo nga imo Dyos ngan hiya gudla an imo pagsirbehan.’”

en: And he led him to Jerusalem, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou art the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
war: Niyan gindara hiya han Yawa ngadto ha Jerusalem, iginbutang hiya didto ha gihataasi nga atop han Templo, ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Kon Anak ka manggud han Dyos, lukso tikang dinhe ngadto ha ubos.

en: for it is written,
war: Kay nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Susugoon han Dyos an iya mga anghel hin pagmangno hin maupay ha imo.’

en: He shall give his angels charge concerning thee, to guard thee:
war: Nasiring liwat, ‘Sasapnayon ka nira han ira mga kamot, basi diri mapilasan an imo mga tiil dida ha mga bato.’”

en: and,
war: Binmaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Kinahanglan diri mo pagsulayon an Ginoo nga imo Dyos.’”

en: On their hands they shall bear thee up,
war: Katapos na han Yawa pagsulay kan Jesus hin ngatanan nga paagi, ginbayaan anay hiya hin madaliay han yawa.

en: Lest haply thou dash thy foot against a stone.
war: Binmalik hi Jesus ha Galilea, ngan nakada ha iya an gahom han Espiritu Santo. Nahibantog an sumat mahitungod ha iya dida hito nga katunaan.

en: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not make trial of the Lord thy God.
war: Nagtutdo hiya ha ira mga sinagoga, ngan gindayaw hiya han ngatanan.

en: And when the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him for a season.
war: Niyan kinmadto hi Jesus ha Nazaret, diin hiya nagtubo, ngan sugad han iya nabatasan, kinmadto hiya ha sinagoga ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway. Tinmindog hiya hin pagbasa han Kasuratan,

en: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and a fame went out concerning him through all the region round about.
war: ngan iginhatag ha iya an basahan ni manaragna Isaias. Ginbuklad niya an linikid nga basahan ngan amo ini an iya nabasa:

en: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
war: “Aadi ha akon an Espiritu han Ginoo,

en: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and he entered, as his custom was, into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up to read.
war: kay ginpili ako niya hin pagwali han Maupay nga Sumat ha mga kablas.

en: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Isaiah. And he opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
war: Ginsugo ako niya pagpasangyaw han katalwasan ngadto ha mga binihag,

en: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me,
war: ngan hin pagpabalik han pakakita han mga buta; hin pagtalwas han mga tinalumpigos,

en: Because he anointed me to preach good tidings to the poor:
war: ngan hin pagpahibaro nga inmabot na an panahon nga tatalwason han Ginoo an iya katawhan.”

en: He hath sent me to proclaim release to the captives,
war: Ginlukot ngahaw ni Jesus an linikid nga basahan, iginhatag han magtiripig, ngan lumingkod. Tinmutok ha iya an ngatanan nga mga tawo ha sinagoga.

en: And recovering of sight to the blind,
war: Nagtikang hiya paghimangraw ha ira: “Natuman yana nga adlaw ini nga bahin han kasuratan samtang hinbatian niyo nga ginbabasa ko ha iyo.”

en: To set at liberty them that are bruised,
war: Nanhingalipay ha iya hira ngatanan, ngan nanhipausa han magnamit nga mga pulong nga iya iginhimangraw. Nagsiring hira, “Diri ba hiya an anak ni Jose?”

en: To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Maaram ako nga masiring kamo ha akon hini nga darahunon, ‘Doktor, tambala anay an imo kalugaringon.’ Masiring liwat kamo ha akon, ‘Buhata dinhe ha imo kalugaringon nga bungto an amo ngahaw nga mga butang nga iginsumat ha amon nga nahinabo ha Capernaum.’”

en: And he closed the book, and gave it back to the attendant, and sat down: and the eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.
war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo hini: Diri tinutuod in usa nga manaragna ha iya kalugaringon nga bungto.

en: And he began to say unto them, To-day hath this scripture been fulfilled in your ears.
war: Pamati kamo: matuod nga damo hadto in mga balo ha Israel ha panahon ni Elias, han waray umuran hin tulo ka tuig ngan tunga, ngan may dako nga kagutom ha bug-os nga tuna.

en: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the words of grace which proceeded out of his mouth: and they said, Is not this Joseph’s son?
war: Kundi waray pakadto hi Elias ha bisan kanay ha ira, kundi ngadto hin usa la nga balo ha Sarepta, ha tuna han Sidon.

en: And he said unto them, Doubtless ye will say unto me this parable, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in thine own country.
war: Ngan may hadto damo nga mga sanlahon ha Israel ha panahon ni manaragna Eliseo, kundi waray bisan usa ha ira nga ginlinisan, labot kan Naaman nga taga-Siria.”

en: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is acceptable in his own country.
war: Napungot an ngatanan nga mga tawo ha sinagoga han pakabati nira hini.

en: But of a truth I say unto you, There were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when there came a great famine over all the land;
war: Nagkabuhat hira, gindanas nira hi Jesus ha gawas han bungto ngan gindara hiya ha bawbaw han bukid nga gintukoran han ira bungto. An ira tuyo amo an paghulog ha iya ngadto han umpas.

en: and unto none of them was Elijah sent, but only to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
war: Kundi nagtarap hiya ha butnga han kadam-an ngan linmakat.

en: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, but only Naaman the Syrian.
war: Niyan kinmadto hi Jesus ha Capernaum, usa nga bungto ha Galilea, diin nagtutdo hiya han mga tawo ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: And they were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things;
war: Nahipausa hira ngatanan han paagi han iya pagtutdo, kay may gahom an iya mga pulong.

en: and they rose up, and cast him forth out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might throw him down headlong.
war: May-ada tawo ha sinagoga nga may espiritu hin mahugaw nga yawa, ngan naggoliat hin dako nga tingog:

en: But he passing through the midst of them went his way.
war: “Jesus nga taga-Nazaret, ano an imo karuyag ha amon? Kinmanhi ka ba hin pagpatay ha amon? Maaram ako kon hin-o ka: amo ka an baraan nga surugoon han Dyos!”

en: And he came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. And he was teaching them on the sabbath day:
war: Ginsugo ni Jesus an espiritu, “Hilom ngan gawas dida ha iya.” Ibinuntad han yawa an tawo ha ira atubangan; ginmawas an yawa dida han tawo ngan waray maano an tawo.

en: and they were astonished at his teaching; for his word was with authority.
war: Nanhipausa hira ngatanan ngan may hinsiring, “Ano ba ini nga mga pulong? Ini nga tawo may gahom ug kusog hin pagsugo han mga magraot nga espiritu hin paggawas, ngan nagawas hira!”

en: And in the synagogue there was a man, that had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,
war: Ngan nahibantog an sumat mahitungod kan Jesus ha ngatanan nga dapit didto hito nga tuna.

en: Ah! what have we to do with thee, Jesus thou Nazarene? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus han sinagoga, ngan kinmadto ha balay ni Simon. Hinihirantan an babaye nga ugangan ni Simon, ngan ginsumatan nira hi Jesus mahitungod ha iya.

en: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the demon had thrown him down in the midst, he came out of him, having done him no hurt.
war: Dinmuok ngan tinmindog hi Jesus ha ligid han iya higdaan. Ginpagawas niya an hiranat, ngan nalungasan hiya dayon. Binmuhat dayon hiya ngan nagdurot ha ira.

en: And amazement came upon all, and they spake together, one with another, saying, What is this word? for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
war: Han katunod na han adlaw, gindara nira ngadto kan Jesus an ira kasangkayan nga may-ada magkalainlain nga sakit. Kinamkam ni Jesus an tagsa ha ira, ngan gin-upay hira ngatanan.

en: And there went forth a rumor concerning him into every place of the region round about.
war: Nagkagawas liwat in mga yawa tikang hin damo nga mga tawo, nga naggoliat, “Ikaw amo an Anak han Dyos!”

en: And he rose up from the synagogue, and entered into the house of Simon. And Simon’s wife’s mother was holden with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
war: Kundi ginsaway hira ni Jesus, ngan waray hira tugoti hin pagyakan, kay maaram hira nga hiya amo an Mesiyas.

en: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she rose up and ministered unto them.
war: Han pagpunias han adlaw, ginmawas hi Jesus han bungto ngan kinmadto hin mamingaw nga dapit. Nagbiling ha iya an mga tawo, ngan han paghiagii nira ha iya, nagtalingoha hira hin paghawid ha iya.

en: And when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
war: Kundi nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kinahanglan igwali ko an Maupay nga Sumat han Ginhadian han Dyos ngadto liwat ha iba nga mga bungto, kay ginsugo ako han Dyos tungod hini.”

en: And demons also came out from many, crying out, and saying, Thou art the Son of God. And rebuking them, he suffered them not to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.
war: Sanglit nagwali hiya didto ha mga sinagoga han bug-os nga Judea.

en: Now it came to pass, while the multitude pressed upon him and heard the word of God, that he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret;
war: Usa ka adlaw natukdaw hi Jesus ha baybayon han Lanaw han Genesaret, samtang nagdadaisog an mga tawo ngadto ha iya, pamati han pulong han Dyos.

en: and he saw two boats standing by the lake: but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
war: Hinkit-an niya in duha nga sakayan nga iginsangya ha baybayon. Nagkahaw-as an mga mangirisda, ngan nagbulyas han ira mga pukot.

en: And he entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. And he sat down and taught the multitudes out of the boat.
war: Sinmakay hi Jesus ha usa hini nga sakayan, nga hi Simon an tag-iya, ngan ginhangyo hi Simon nga iduso niya ini hin gutiay tikang ha baybayon ngadto ha tubig. Linmingkod hi Jesus ngan nagtutdo han mga tawo tikang han sakayan.

en: And when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Put out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
war: Han katapos niya paghimangraw, nagsiring hiya kan Simon, “Palawod ngan itunod niyo an mga pukot, ngan makakadakop kamo.”

en: And Simon answered and said, Master, we toiled all night, and took nothing: but at thy word I will let down the nets.
war: Binmaton hi Simon, “Agaron, nagkabudlay kami ha bug-os nga gab-i, ngan waray gud kami makadakop. Kundi kon amo man an imo siring, tutunoron namon an mga pukot.”

en: And when they had done this, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes; and their nets were breaking;
war: Gintunod nira an mga pukot, ngan nakadakop hira hin damo nga isda, nga haros magisi an mga pukot.

en: and they beckoned unto their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the boats, so that they began to sink.
war: Sanglit ginkampay nira an ira mga kaupod didto hin lain nga sakayan basi buligan hira. Hinmarani hira ngan gintugob hin isda an duha nga sakayan, nga haros malunod na hira.

en: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
war: Pakakita ni Simon Pedro han nahinabo, linmuhod hiya ha atubangan ni Jesus ngan nagsiring, “Pahirayo ha akon, Ginoo! Makasasala ako nga tawo!”

en: For he was amazed, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken;
war: Nahipausa hi Simon ngan an iba nga mga kaupod niya han duro kadamo nga isda nga ira nadakop.

en: and so were also James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
war: Nahipausa man liwat hira Santiago ug Juan nga mga anak ni Sebedeo ngan mga kabulig ni Simon. Nagsiring hi Jesus kan Simon, “Ayaw kahadlok; tikang yana mananakop ka na hin mga tawo.”

en: And when they had brought their boats to land, they left all, and followed him.
war: Iginsangya nira an mga sakayan, ginbayaan an ngatanan, ngan sinmunod hira kan Jesus.

en: And it came to pass, while he was in one of the cities, behold, a man full of leprosy: and when he saw Jesus, he fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
war: Ha usa ka higayon, nakadto hi Jesus ha usa nga bungto diin may tawo nga lukop hin sanla. Han pakakita niya kan Jesus, hinmapa hiya ngan nakimalooy ha iya, “Kon imo karuyag, makakalinis ka ha akon!”

en: And he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou made clean. And straightway the leprosy departed from him.
war: Ginpadapat ni Jesus ngada ha iya an iya kamot, ngan sidngon, “Karuyag ko, magmalinis ka!” Ha gilayon nawara an iya sanla.

en: And he charged him to tell no man: but go thy way, and show thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
war: Gintugon hiya ni Jesus, “Ayaw ini igsumat bisan kan kanay, kundi kadto dayon ha padi ngan pausisa ha iya; ngan paghalad sugad han iginsugo ni Moises, pagpakita han ngatanan nga malinis ka na.”

en: But so much the more went abroad the report concerning him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed of their infirmities.
war: Kundi nagsarang lugod an sumat mahitungod kan Jesus, ngan inmabot in damo nga mga tawo pamati ha iya, ngan pagpabulong han ira mga sakit.

en: But he withdrew himself in the deserts, and prayed.
war: Kundi napakadto hiya ha mga dapit nga mamingaw, diin nag-ampo hiya.

en: And it came to pass on one of those days, that he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, who were come out of every village of Galilee and Judæa and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was with him to heal.
war: Usa ka adlaw han nagtututdo hi Jesus, nagkalingkod didto in mga Parisiyo ngan mga magturutdo han Balaod nga inmabot tikang han tagsa nga bungto ha Galilea, Judea, ug Jerusalem. Nakada kan Jesus an gahom han Ginoo hin pagtambal han magsakit.

en: And behold, men bring on a bed a man that was palsied: and they sought to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
war: Inmabot in mga tawo nga nagdara hin usa nga lulid ha higdaan, ngan nagtalinguha hira pagdara ha iya ha sakob han balay, pagbutang ha iya ha atubangan ni Jesus.

en: And not finding by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop, and let him down through the tiles with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
war: Kundi, tungod han kadamo han mga tawo, waray gud hira makahimo hin pagdara ha iya ha sulod. Sanglit, gindara hiya nira ngadto ha atop ngan ira gin-abrehan an atop, ngan gintunton nira an lulid nga nakada ha iya higdaan ngadto ha atubangan ni Jesus, ha butnga han mga tawo.

en: And seeing their faith, he said, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
war: Han pakakita ni Jesus han kadako han ira pagtoo, ginsiring niya an lulid, “Sangkay, ginpasaylo na an imo mga sala.”

en: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this that speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
war: Nagtikang pagngurutob an mga magturutdo han Balaod ngan an mga Parisiyo: “Hin-o ini nga tawo nga nagpapasipara han Dyos hin sugad hini nga paagi? Waray tawo nga makakagpasaylo han mga sala, kundi an Dyos gudla!”

en: But Jesus perceiving their reasonings, answered and said unto them, Why reason ye in your hearts?
war: Nakasabot ni Jesus an ira panhunahuna ngan ginsiring hira, “Kay ano nga naghunahuna kamo hin sugad nga mga butang?

en: Which is easier, to say, Thy sins are forgiven thee; or to say, Arise and walk?
war: Hain ba in masurusayon, an pagsiring, ‘Ginpasaylo an imo mga sala,’ o an pagsiring, ‘Buhat ngan lakat?’

en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath authority on earth to forgive sins (he said unto him that was palsied), I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go unto thy house.
war: Ipakikita ko ha iyo yana nga may gahom dinhe ha tuna an Anak han Tawo hin pagpasaylo han mga sala.” Sanglit ginsiring niya an lulid, “Nasiring ako ha imo, buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan, ngan oli!”

en: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his house, glorifying God.
war: Tinmukdaw dayon an tawo ha atubangan nira ngatanan, gindara an iya higdaan, ngan inmoli nga nagdadayaw han Dyos.

en: And amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God; and they were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to-day.
war: Duro gud an paghipausa nira ngatanan! Tugob hin kahadlok, nagdayaw hira han Dyos, nga nasiring, “Kaurosahon han mga butang nga aton hinkit-an yana nga adlaw!”

en: And after these things he went forth, and beheld a publican, named Levi, sitting at the place of toll, and said unto him, Follow me.
war: Katapos hini, ginmawas hi Jesus ngan hinkit-an niya in usa nga parasukot hin buhis, nga ginngangaranan kan Levi, nga nalingkod didto ha iya buhatan. Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Sunod ha akon.”

en: And he forsook all, and rose up and followed him.
war: Binmuhat hi Levi, ginbayaan an ngatanan, ngan sinmunod ha iya.

en: And Levi made him a great feast in his house: and there was a great multitude of publicans and of others that were sitting at meat with them.
war: Niyan nag-andam hi Levi hin dako nga panagtawo didto ha iya balay para kan Jesus. May damo nga parasukot hin buhis ngan iba pa nga mga tawo nga upod nira.

en: And the Pharisees and their scribes murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with the publicans and sinners?
war: Nagngurutob kontra han mga tinun-an ni Jesus in pira nga mga Parisiyo ngan ira sakop nga mga magturutdo han Balaod, nga nasiring, “Kay ano nga nakikigsaro man kamo han parasukot hin buhis ngan mga makasasala?”

en: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are in health have no need of a physician; but they that are sick.
war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Diri nagkikinahanglan hin magtarambal an mga tawo nga mag-upay an lawas, kundi adton mga magsakit la.

en: I am not come to call the righteous but sinners to repentance.
war: Waray ako kumanhi hin pagtawag nga basi magbasol an mga magtadong, kundi hin pagtawag han mga makasasala.”

en: And they said unto him, The disciples of John fast often, and make supplications; likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink.
war: May mga tawo nga nagsiring kan Jesus, “Agsob magpuasa ngan mag-ampo an mga tinun-an ni Juan, ngan sugad man an mga tinun-an han mga Parisiyo; kundi sigi la hin kaon ngan inom an imo mga tinun-an.”

en: And Jesus said unto them, Can ye make the sons of the bride-chamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Makakapugong ba kamo hin pagpakaon han mga dinapit ngada hin pagkasal, samtang kaupod pa nira an karaslon nga lalake? Diri gud kamo makakahimo!

en: But the days will come; and when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, then will they fast in those days.
war: Kundi maabot an panahon nga mabaya ha ira an karaslon nga lalake, ngan diri na ngahaw hira makaon ug mainom.”

en: And he spake also a parable unto them: No man rendeth a piece from a new garment and putteth it upon an old garment; else he will rend the new, and also the piece from the new will not agree with the old.
war: Ginsumatan liwat hira ni Jesus hini nga pananglitan: “Waray natabas hin dugnit tikang hin bag-o nga bado para hin pagtangkop hin daan nga bado. Kon buhaton niya, magigisi an bag-o nga bado, ngan diri maangay an bag-o nga dugnit dida han daan.

en: And no man putteth new wine into old wine-skins; else the new wine will burst the skins, and itself will be spilled, and the skins will perish.
war: Waray man magsusulod hin bag-o nga bino ngada hin daan nga mga surudlan nga anit. Kon buhaton niya, buburiton han bag-o nga bino an anit nga surudlan, makakarag an bino, ngan magigisi an anit nga surudlan.

en: But new wine must be put into fresh wine-skins.
war: Diri! Kinahanglan igsulod an bag-o nga bino ngada hin bag-o nga anit nga surudlan!

en: And no man having drunk old wine desireth new; for he saith, The old is good.
war: Ngan waray naruruyag hin bag-o nga bino, katapos makainom hiya hin daan nga bino, kay nasiring hiya, ‘Mauruopay an daan!’”

en: Now it came to pass on a sabbath, that he was going through the grainfields; and his disciples plucked the ears, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
war: Usa ka Adlaw nga Iparahuway, naglatas hi Jesus ha kaumhan hin trigo. Nagtikang an iya mga tinun-an pangutos hin mga uhay han trigo, ginkurukuso ha ira mga kamot, ngan nangaon han trigo.

en: But certain of the Pharisees said, Why do ye that which it is not lawful to do on the sabbath day?
war: Nagsiring in pira nga mga Parisiyo, “Kay ano nga ginbubuhat niyo an igindidiri han aton Balaod hin pagbuhat ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway?”

en: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read even this, what David did, when he was hungry, he, and they that were with him;
war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Waray ba niyo mabasa an ginbuhat ni David han paggutoma ha iya ngan an iya mga kaupod?

en: how he entered into the house of God, and took and ate the showbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat save for the priests alone?
war: Sinmulod hiya ha balay han Dyos, kinmuha hiya han tinapay nga iginhalad sa Dyos, kinmaon hiya, ngan iginpakaon liwat ini han iya mga tawo. Kundi igindidiri han aton Balaod an pagkaon han tinapay nga ginhalad ngadto sa Dyos, labot han kapadian.”

en: And he said unto them, The Son of man is lord of the sabbath.
war: Ngan gintapos ni Jesus hin pagsiring, “An Anak han Tawo amo an Ginoo han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”

en: And it came to pass on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man there, and his right hand was withered.
war: Ha lain nga Adlaw nga Iparahuway, kinmadto hi Jesus ha sinagoga ngan nagtutdo. May tawo didto nga patay an tuo nga kamot.

en: And the scribes and the Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath; that they might find how to accuse him.
war: Karuyag mangita hin pasisikaran hin pagsumbong kontra kan Jesus in pira nga mga magturutdo han Balaod ngan mga Parisiyo; sanglit gin-ininawan hiya nira kon magtatambal ba hiya ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man that had his hand withered, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
war: Kundi nahibaroan ni Jesus an ira panhunahuna, ngan nagsiring hiya ha tawo nga patay an kamot, “Buhat ngan pa kadi ha atubangan.” Binmuhat an tawo ngan tinmukdaw ha iya atubangan.

en: And Jesus said unto them, I ask you, Is it lawful on the sabbath to do good, or to do harm? to save a life, or to destroy it?
war: Niyan nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Napakiana ako ha iyo: ano an itinutogot han aton Balaod hin pagbuhat ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway? Pagbulig ba o pagdaot? Pagtalwas ba hin kinabuhi hin tawo o pagkuha ba hito?”

en: And he looked round about on them all, and said unto him, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so : and his hand was restored.
war: Sinmiplat hi Jesus ha ira ngatanan, ngan kahuman ginsiring niya an tawo, “Unata an imo kamot.” Gin-unat han tawo an iya kamot ngan naupay.

en: But they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
war: Kundi duro gud an ira kapungot, ngan nagsarabot hira kon ano an angay pagbuhaton nira kan Jesus.

en: And it came to pass in these days, that he went out into the mountain to pray; and he continued all night in prayer to God.
war: Hadto nga panahon sinmagka hi Jesus ngadto hin usa nga bukid para hin pag-ampo, ngan mag-aga an iya pag-inampo ngadto sa Dyos.

en: And when it was day, he called his disciples; and he chose from them twelve, whom also he named apostles:
war: Han pagkaaga, gintawag niya an iya mga tinun-an ngan nagpili hiya hin dose ha ira, nga ginngaranan nga mga apostoles:

en: Simon, whom he also named Peter, and Andrew his brother, and James and John, and Philip and Bartholomew,
war: hira Simon (nga iya liwat ginngaranan kan Pedro) ug Andres nga iya bugto; Santiago ug Juan, Felipe ug Bartolome,

en: and Matthew and Thomas, and James the son of Alphæus, and Simon who was called the Zealot,
war: Mateo ug Tomas, Santiago nga anak ni Alfeo, ug Simon (nga gintawag, an Bayani),

en: and Judas the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor;
war: Judas nga anak ni Santiago, ug Judas Iscariote nga naglingo han Ginoo.

en: and he came down with them, and stood on a level place, and a great multitude of his disciples, and a great number of the people from all Judæa and Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
war: Paglugsong nira tikang ha bukid, tinmukdaw hi Jesus didto hin usa nga patag nga dapit, upod in damo nga mga tinun-an niya. Nakadto didto in dako nga pundok hin mga tawo nga tikang han bug-os nga Judea, Jerusalem, ngan han mga syudad hirani han baybayon han Tiro ug Sidon.

en: and they that were troubled with unclean spirits were healed.
war: Nagkaabot hira pamati ha iya ngan pagpatambal han ira mga sakit. Nagkaabot liwat an mga sinasangkayan hin magraot nga mga espiritu ngan natambal hira.

en: And all the multitude sought to touch him; for power came forth from him, and healed them all.
war: Nagtalingoha hin pagkamkam ha iya an ngatanan nga mga tawo, kay naguwa tikang ha iya in gahom nga nagtatambal ha ira ngatanan.

en: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed are ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
war: Sinmiplat hi Jesus han iya mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring,

en: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
war: “Palaran kamo nga mga kablas,

en: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company , and reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man’s sake.
war: kay iyo an Ginhadian han Dyos!

en: Rejoice in that day, and leap for joy : for behold, your reward is great in heaven; for in the same manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
war: “Palaran kamo nga mga ginugutom yana,

en: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
war: kay pagbubusgon kamo!

en: Woe unto you, ye that are full now! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you , ye that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
war: “Palaran kamo nga mga nagtatangis yana, kay malilipay kamo!

en: Woe unto you , when all men shall speak well of you! for in the same manner did their fathers to the false prophets.
war: “Palaran kamo kon tungod han Anak han Tawo, pagdumtan, igsalikway, pagyubiton, ngan pakaraoton kamo han mga tawo!

en: But I say unto you that hear, Love your enemies, do good to them that hate you,
war: Paglipay kamo kon mahinabo ini, ngan sayaw hin kalipay kay gin-aandam para ha iyo in dako nga balos didto ha langit. Kay ginbuhat han ira nga kaapoy-apoyan an amo ngahaw nga mga butang ngadto han mga manaragna.

en: bless them that curse you, pray for them that despitefully use you.
war: “Kundi pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo nga mga riko yana,

en: To him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and from him that taketh away thy cloak withhold not thy coat also.
war: kay nagkaada na kamo han iyo himyang nga kinabuhi!

en: Give to every one that asketh thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
war: “Pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo nga mga busog yana, kay gugutomon kamo!

en: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
war: “Pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo nga nagtitinawa yana,

en: And if ye love them that love you, what thank have ye? for even sinners love those that love them.
war: kay magmamasulub-on ngan magtatangis kamo!

en: And if ye do good to them that do good to you, what thank have ye? for even sinners do the same.
war: “Pagkamakaharadlok kon pagdinayawon kamo han ngatanan nga mga tawo, kay ginsiring han ira mga kaapoy-apoyan ini ngahaw nga mga butang mahitungod han buwaon nga mga manaragna.

en: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? even sinners lend to sinners, to receive again as much.
war: “Kundi nasiring ako ha iyo nga namamati ha akon: higugmaa an iyo mga kaaway, buhata an maupay para han mga nagdudumot ha iyo.

en: But love your enemies, and do them good, and lend, never despairing; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be sons of the Most High: for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.
war: Pakaupaya an nagpapakaraot ha iyo, ngan ig-ampo an mga nagraraogdaog ha iyo.

en: Be ye merciful, even as your Father is merciful.
war: Kon tampalohon ka ha usa nga bayhon, ipatampalo liwat an luyo; kon may magkuha han imo barong, ihatag liwat an imo kamiseta.

en: And judge not, and ye shall not be judged: and condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: release, and ye shall be released:
war: Tagi adton maaro ha imo, ngan kon may magkuha han imo butang, ayaw na ipaoli ha iya.

en: give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, shall they give into your bosom. For with what measure ye mete it shall be measured to you again.
war: Buhata ha iba an imo karuyag nga ira pagbuhaton ha imo.

en: And he spake also a parable unto them, Can the blind guide the blind? shall they not both fall into a pit?
war: “Kon higugmaon la niyo an mga tawo la nga nahigugma ha iyo, kay ano nga makarawat kamo hin kaupayan? Bisan ngani an mga makasasala nahigugma han mga nahigugma man ha ira!

en: The disciple is not above his teacher: but every one when he is perfected shall be as his teacher.
war: Ngan kon buhaton niyo an maupay ngadto la han mga nagbubuhat hin maupay ha iyo, kay ano nga makarawat kamo hin kaupayan? Nagbubuhat ngani hito, bisan an mga makasasala!

en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
war: Ngan kon mapahuram kamo hadton mga makakabayad la ha iyo, kay ano nga makarawat kamo hin kaupayan? Bisan ngani an mga makasasala napahuram man han ira igkasi mga makasasala, ngan naglalaom hira nga babaydan hira!

en: Or how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me cast out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote that is in thy brother’s eye.
war: Diri! Higugmaa an iyo mga kaaway ngan buhata an maupay ha ira; pahuram ngan ayaw pagpaabot hin bayad. Mamamay-ada kamo dako nga balos, ngan magigin mga anak kamo han Gihahataasi nga Dyos. Kay maupay hiya hadton mga bungalos ngan hadton mga magraogdaog.

en: For there is no good tree that bringeth forth corrupt fruit; nor again a corrupt tree that bringeth forth good fruit.
war: Pagmaloloy-on kamo sugad nga maloloy-on an Amay niyo.

en: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
war: “Ayaw kamo paghukom han iba, ngan diri man kamo paghuhukman han Dyos. Ayaw kamo pagsirot han iba, ngan diri man kamo pagsisirotan han Dyos; pagpasaylo kamo han iba, ngan magpapasaylo an Dyos ha iyo.

en: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and the evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth that which is evil: for out of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
war: Paghatag kamo ha iba, ngan mahatag an Dyos ha iyo; makarawat kamo hin igo gud nga takos: dinasok, binay-og, ngan nagsasapay pa; kay gagamiton ha iyo han Dyos an ginagamit niyo nga taraksan para han iba.”

en: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
war: Ngan iginsumat ni Jesus ha ira ini nga pananglitan: “Diri makakagtugway in buta hin igkasi buta; kon buhaton niya ini, mahuhulog hira nga duha ngadto ha kali.

en: Every one that cometh unto me, and heareth my words, and doeth them, I will show you to whom he is like:
war: Waray tinun-an nga labaw han iya magturutdo; kundi masusugad han iya magturutdo an tagsa nga tinun-an, kon tapos na an iya pag-aram.

en: he is like a man building a house, who digged and went deep, and laid a foundation upon the rock: and when a flood arose, the stream brake against that house, and could not shake it: because it had been well builded.
war: “Kay ano nga asay mo kinikita an poling ha mata han imo bugto, kundi diri ka nanginginano han nabalabag ha imo kalugaringon nga mata?

en: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that built a house upon the earth without a foundation; against which the stream brake, and straightway it fell in; and the ruin of that house was great.
war: Uunanhon nimo pagsiring ha imo bugto, ‘Tugoti daw ako pagkuha han poling ha imo mata,’ nga diri ka ngani nakita han nabalabag ha imo kalugaringon nga mata? Salingkapaw! Kuhaa anay an nabalabag ha imo kalugaringon nga mata, ngan niyan makakakita ka na hin pagkuha han poling ha mata han imo bugto.

en: After he had ended all his sayings in the ears of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
war: Katapos ni Jesus maghimangraw hini ngatanan nga mga butang ha mga tawo, kinmadto hiya ha Capernaum.

en: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick and at the point of death.
war: May didto kapitan nga Romano, nga may-ada surugoon nga iya minahal, nga masakit ngan tikamaratay na.

en: And when he heard concerning Jesus, he sent unto him elders of the Jews, asking him that he would come and save his servant.
war: Han pakabati han kapitan hiunong kan Jesus, ginpakadto niya in katigurangan nga mga Judiyo hin paghangyo kan Jesus nga kadtoon ngan tambalon an iya surugoon.

en: And they, when they came to Jesus, besought him earnestly, saying, He is worthy that thou shouldest do this for him;
war: Dinmaop hira kan Jesus ngan nakimalooy ha iya, “Takos gud ini nga tawo han imo bulig.

en: for he loveth our nation, and himself built us our synagogue.
war: Nahigugma hiya han aton mga tawo, nga nagtindog hiya hin sinagoga para ha aton.”

en: And Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself; for I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof:
war: Sanglit inmupod hi Jesus ha ira. Han hirani na hiya han balay, nagsugo an kapitan hin iya kasangkayan pagsumat kan Jesus: “Ayaw na gad la pagginuol. Diri ako takos nga sumulod ka han akon balay,

en: wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say the word, and my servant shall be healed.
war: ngan diri man ako takos makigkita ha imo. Sanglit pagyakan na la ngan mag-uopay an akon surugoon.

en: For I also am a man set under authority, having under myself soldiers: and I say to this one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
war: Ilarom liwat ako han gahom hin labaw nga mga opisyal, ngan may mga sondalo man nga akon sakop. Nasugo ako han usa, ‘Kadto na!’ ngan nalakat hiya; nasugo ako hin iba, ‘Kadi ha akon!’ ngan nadaop hiya; ngan nasugo ako han akon oripon, ‘Buhata ini!’ ngan gintutuman niya.”

en: And when Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned and said unto the multitude that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
war: Nahipausa hi Jesus han iya pakabati hini; tinmalikod hiya ngan nagsiring ha mga tawo nga nagsusunod ha iya, “Nasiring ako ha iyo, waray pa gud ako hinkit-an nga sugad hini nga pagtoo, bisan dinhe ha Israel!”

en: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole.
war: Binmalik ha balay han kapitan an mga sinugo ngan hinkit-an nira nga maupay na an iya surugoon.

en: And it came to pass soon afterwards, that he went to a city called Nain; and his disciples went with him, and a great multitude.
war: Waray pag-iha kinmadto hi Jesus hin bungto nga Nain an ngaran. Inmupod ha iya an iya mga tinun-an ngan hin dako nga hugpo hin mga tawo.

en: Now when he drew near to the gate of the city, behold, there was carried out one that was dead, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
war: Han pag-abot niya ha ulpotan han bungto, amo man liwat an paggawas han mga tawo nga naglulubong hin minatay. An minatay amo gud la nga anak hin balo nga babaye, ngan gin-updan an babaye hin damo nga mga tawo tikang ha bungto.

en: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
war: Han pakakita ha iya han Ginoo, inalpan an Ginoo hin kalooy ha iya, ngan nagsiring an Ginoo ha iya, “Ayaw pagtangis.”

en: And he came nigh and touched the bier: and the bearers stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
war: Hinmarani hiya ngan gindun-an an lungon, ngan inmukoy an magparasag nga mga tawo. Sinmiring hi Jesus, “Ikaw nga olitawo, nasiring ako ha imo, buhat!”

en: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.
war: Linmingkod an minatay ngan nagtikang hin pagyakan, ngan iginhatag hiya ni Jesus ngadto han iroy niya.

en: And fear took hold on all: and they glorified God, saying, A great prophet is arisen among us: and, God hath visited his people.
war: Pinangulba an ngatanan, ngan nagdayaw hira han Dyos, “Nagpakita ha butnga naton in dako nga manaragna!” ngan, “Kinmanhi an Dyos hin pagtalwas han iya katawhan!”

en: And this report went forth concerning him in the whole of Judæa, and all the region round about.
war: Nahibantog ini nga sumat mahitungod kan Jesus ha bug-os nga Judea ngan ha mga higrani nga katunaan.

en: And the disciples of John told him of all these things.
war: Ginsumatan hi Juan han iya mga tinun-an hiunong hini ngatanan nga mga butang. Gintawag ni Juan in duha ha ira,

en: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to the Lord, saying, Art thou he that cometh, or look we for another?
war: ngan ginsugo hira ngadto han Ginoo hin pagpakiana ha iya kon hiya ba an tiarabot nga ginsiring ni Juan, o kon magpapaabot pa ba hira hin lain.

en: And when the men were come unto him, they said, John the Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that cometh, or look we for another?
war: Han pag-abot nira, nagsiring hira kan Jesus, “Ginsugo kami ni Juan nga Parabunyag hin pagpakiana, ‘Amo ka ba an iya ginsiring nga tiarabot, o magpapaabot pa ba kami hin lain?’”
