en: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and on many that were blind he bestowed sight.
war: Hito manta nga panahon gintambal ni Jesus in damo nga mga tawo han ira mga sakit, mga balatian, mga magraot nga mga espiritu, ngan nagpakakita in damo nga mga buta.

en: And he answered and said unto them, Go and tell John the things which ye have seen and heard; the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, the poor have good tidings preached to them.
war: Ginbaton ni Jesus an mga sinugo ni Juan, “Balik ngan pagsumati niyo hi Juan han hinkit-an ngan hinbatian niyo: nakakakita na an mga buta, nakakalakat na an mga piay, ginlinisan na an mga sanlahon, nakakabati na an mga bungol, ginbanhaw na an mga minatay, ngan iginwali na an Maupay nga Sumat ha mga kablas.

en: And blessed is he, whosoever shall find no occasion of stumbling in me.
war: Pagkapalaran hadton waray na mga pagruhaduha hiunong ha akon!”

en: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to behold? a reed shaken with the wind?
war: Pagbaya na han mga sinugo ni Juan, naghimangraw hi Jesus ha mga tawo hiunong kan Juan, “Han pagkadto niyo kan Juan didto ha kamingawan, ano man an karuyag niyo hikit-an? Usa ba nga tangbo nga ginbabarubay-og hin hangin?

en: But what went ye out to see? a man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they that are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.
war: Ano gud an iyo ginkadto hin pagkita? Usa ba ka tawo nga mahal an iya bado? Ha tinuod, adton mga nagpapanapton hin sugad aadto pag-uokoy ha mga palasyo!

en: But what went ye out to see? a prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
war: Sumati daw ako, ano gud an iyo ginkadto hin pagkita? Usa ba nga manaragna? Oo, nasiring ako ha iyo nga hinkit-an niyo in labaw pa hin manaragna.

en: This is he of whom it is written,
war: Kay amo hi Juan an iginsiring han kasuratan, ‘Iini an akon magsarangyaw, nasiring an Dyos; ipadadara ko hiya una ha imo hin pag-andam han dalan para ha imo!’”

en: Behold, I send my messenger before thy face,
war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus, “Nasiring ako ha iyo, labaw pa hi Juan kay hin bisan hin-o nga natawo; kundi labaw pa ha iya an gigugutiayi dida han Ginhadian han Dyos.”

en: Who shall prepare thy way before thee.
war: Nakabati ha iya an ngatanan nga mga tawo; hira ngan an mga parasukot hin buhis amo an nagtuman han matadong nga mga paglarang han Dyos, ngan ginbunyagan hira ni Juan.

en: I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there is none greater than John: yet he that is but little in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
war: Kundi iginsalikway han mga Parisiyo ngan han mga magturutdo han Balaod an katoyoanan han Dyos para ha ira, ngan dinmiri hira hin pagpabunyag kan Juan.

en: And all the people when they heard, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
war: “Niyan, ano man an akon ikatatanding han mga tawo hini nga panahon? Sugad hin ano hira?

en: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected for themselves the counsel of God, being not baptized of him.
war: Sugad hira hin kabataan nga nagkakalingkod ha taboan. An usa nga hugpo nagoliat ngadto han lain nga hugpo, ‘Ginpatunog na namon para ha iyo an turunggon para hin pagkasal, kundi waray kamo sumayaw! Nagkanta kami hin mga masulob-on nga kanta hin paglubong, kundi waray kamo magtangis!’

en: Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation, and to what are they like?
war: Kinmanhi hi Juan nga Parabunyag, ngan nagpuasa hiya ngan waray uminom hin bino, ngan nagsiring kamo, ‘Ginsasangkayan hiya hin yawa!’

en: They are like unto children that sit in the marketplace, and call one to another; who say, We piped unto you, and ye did not dance; we wailed, and ye did not weep.
war: Kinmanhi an Anak han Tawo, ngan kinmaon ngan inminom hiya, ngan nagsiring kamo, ‘Kitaa daw niyo ini nga tawo! Malamon ngan parahubog hiya, sangkay han mga parasukot hin buhis ngan mga makasasala!’

en: For John the Baptist is come eating no bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a demon.
war: Kundi an kinaadman han Dyos ipapakita nga matuod hadton ngatanan nga makarawat hini nga kinaadman.”

en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold, a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
war: Gindapit hi Jesus hin usa nga Parisiyo ngadto hin pangaon. Kinmadto hi Jesus ha iya balay ngan linmingkod hin pagkaon.

en: And wisdom is justified of all her children.
war: May usa nga babaye nga makasasala didto hadto nga bungto. Nakabati hiya nga nakaon hi Jesus ha balay han Parisiyo. Sanglit, nagdara hiya hin tibod nga alabastro nga puno hin talamhot.

en: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he entered into the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to meat.
war: Tinmindog hiya ha luyo ni Jesus, ha may tiilan niya, nagtinangis ngan ginhulos an mga tiil ni Jesus han iya mga luha. Ngan ginpahiran niya an mga tiil ni Jesus han iya buhok, ginharokan niya an iya mga tiil, ngan ginbuboan ini han talamhot.

en: And behold, a woman who was in the city, a sinner; and when she knew that he was sitting at meat in the Pharisee’s house, she brought an alabaster cruse of ointment,
war: Han pakakita hini han Parisiyo nga nagdapit kan Jesus, nagsiring hiya ha iya ngahaw, “Kon tinuod nga manaragna ini nga tawo, makilala unta hiya kon hin-o ini nga babaye nga nakapot ha iya; mahibabaro hiya kon ano hin kamakasasala an iya kinabuhi!”

en: and standing behind at his feet, weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
war: Nagyakan hi Jesus ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Simon, may-ada ko unta igsusumat ha imo.”

en: Now when the Pharisee that had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him, that she is a sinner.
war: Nagsiring hi Simon, “Oo, Magturutdo, sumati ako.”

en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Teacher, say on.
war: Sinmiring hi Jesus, “May duha ka tawo nga nakautang didto hin usa ka tawo nga nagpapautang hin kwarta. Nakautang hin mil pesos an usa, ngan syin pesos an ikaduha.

en: A certain lender had two debtors: the one owed five hundred shillings, and the other fifty.
war: Waray man ha ira nakakabayad, sanglit ginpara na la niya an ira mga utang. Niyan, hin-o man han duha an mahigugma ha iya hin darudako?”

en: When they had not wherewith to pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?
war: Binmaton hi Simon, “Bangin la hiya nga dako an utang.”

en: Simon answered and said, He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
war: “Igo an imo baton,” nagsiring hi Jesus.

en: And turning to the woman, he said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thy house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath wetted my feet with her tears, and wiped them with her hair.
war: Niyan limingi hiya ngadto han babaye ngan sidngon hi Simon, “Nakita ka hini nga babaye? Sinmulod ako ha imo balay, ngan waray ka maghatag hin tubig para han akon mga tiil, kundi ginpamusaan ako niya han iya mga luha ngan ginpahiran pa ini han iya buhok.

en: Thou gavest me no kiss: but she, since the time I came in, hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
war: Waray mo ako tapoa hin harok, kundi tikang han akon pag-abot, waray hiya undang hin paghinarok han akon tiil.

en: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but she hath anointed my feet with ointment.
war: Waray ka mag-andam hin lana para han akon ulo, kundi ginbub-an niya an akon mga tiil hin talamhot.

en: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
war: Sanglit, nasiring ako ha imo, an dako nga gugma nga iya iginpakita nagpapamatuod nga ginpasaylo na an iya damo nga mga sala. Kundi an ginpasaylo hin gutiay la nga sala, nagpakita hin gutiay la nga paghigugma.”

en: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
war: Niyan nagsiring hi Jesus ngadto han babaye, “Ginpasaylo na an imo mga sala.”

en: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that even forgiveth sins?
war: Nagtikang hin pagngurutob an iba nga nalingkod ha lamisa, “Hin-o ngani ini nga nagpapasaylo han mga sala?”

en: And he said unto the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus ngadto han babaye, “An imo pagtoo an nagtalwas ha imo; maupay na la nga imo paglakat!”

en: And it came to pass soon afterwards, that he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good tidings of the kingdom of God, and with him the twelve,
war: Waray pag-iha, nagsudoy hi Jesus han kabungtohan ug kabaryohan, hin pagwali han Maupay nga Sumat mahitungod han Ginhadian han Dyos. Inmupod ha iya an dose nga mga tinun-an,

en: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary that was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,
war: ngan pira nga kababayen-an nga gin-upay tikang hin magraot nga mga espiritu ngan mga sakit: hira Maria (nga ginngangaranan nga Magdalena), nga tikang ha iya ginmawas in pito nga mga yawa;

en: and Joanna the wife of Chuzas Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, who ministered unto them of their substance.
war: Juana, nga asawa ni Chuza nga usa nga opisyal han korte ni Herodes; Susana, ngan damo pa nga iba nga kababayen-an nga naggamit han ira kalugaringon nga pinakabuhian hin pagbulig kan Jesus ngan han iya mga tinun-an.

en: And when a great multitude came together, and they of every city resorted unto him, he spake by a parable:
war: Abotkiabot an mga tawo ngadto kan Jesus tikang ha usa ngadto han sunod nga bungto, ngan han pagtirok na hin dako nga hugpo hin mga tawo, iginsumat ni Jesus ini nga pananglitan:

en: The sower went forth to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden under foot, and the birds of the heaven devoured it.
war: “Ginmawas in usa ka tawo pagsabod han iya binhe. Samtang iginsasabod niya ha tuna an binhe, nagkataktak in pira han mga binhe ha ligid han dalan, diin natamakan ini, ngan pinanuktok han katamsihan.

en: And other fell on the rock; and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
war: Nagkataktak in pira han mga binhe ha batoon nga tuna, ngan han pagtubo na han mga tanom, nagkalalaya hira, kay mamara man an tuna.

en: And other fell amidst the thorns; and the thorns grew with it, and choked it.
war: Nagkataktak an iba han mga binhe ha katunokan, nga tinmubo tampo han mga tanom, ngan naambongan an mga tanom.

en: And other fell into the good ground, and grew, and brought forth fruit a hundredfold. As he said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
war: Ngan nagkataktak man an iba nga mga binhe ha maupay nga tuna; tinmubo an mga tanom, ngan nanmunga hin tag 100 ka lugas an kada usa.”

en: And his disciples asked him what this parable might be.
war: Ngan gintapos ni Jesus pagsiring, “Sanglit, pamati kamo, kon may-ada niyo mga durunggan!”

en: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to the rest in parables; that seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.
war: Nagpakiana kan Jesus an iya mga tinun-an kon ano an kahulogan hini nga pananglitan.

en: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Iginhatag ha iyo an paghibaro han mga tinago han Ginhadian han Dyos; kundi han iba, pinaagi la hin mga pananglitan, basi kon magtan-aw man hira, diri makakita; ngan kon mamati man hira, diri makasabot.

en: And those by the way side are they that have heard; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.
war: “Amo ini an kahulogan han pananglitan: an pulong han Dyos amo an binhe.

en: And those on the rock are they who, when they have heard, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, who for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
war: An mga namamati amo an binhe nga nataktak ha ligid han dalan, kundi naabot an Yawa ngan inaagaw an mensahe tikang ha ira mga kasingkasing, basi diri hira tumuo ngan matalwas.

en: And that which fell among the thorns, these are they that have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
war: An binhe nga nataktak ha batoon nga tuna amo an namamati, kundi diri gud ini nakakapanggamot; natoo hira hin madaliay la, ngan nabaya kon naabot na an panahon hin pagsulay ha ira.

en: And that in the good ground, these are such as in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it fast, and bring forth fruit with patience.
war: An binhe nga nataktak ha katunokan amo an mga namamati, kundi nalambongan ngan nalumos hira han mga karinggalan, mga manggad, ngan mga kaliawan hini nga kinabuhi, ngan natataktak dayon an ira bunga.

en: And no man, when he hath lighted a lamp, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but putteth it on a stand, that they that enter in may see the light.
war: An binhe nga nahulog ha maupay nga tuna, amo adton namamati han mensahe ngan gintitipigan nira ha maupay ngan masinugtanon nga kasingkasing, ngan nagpapadayon hira tubtob nga makapamunga.

en: For nothing is hid, that shall not be made manifest; nor anything secret, that shall not be known and come to light.
war: “Waray nadagkot hin suga ngan tinatahoban o ibinubutang ha ilarom hin higdaan. Lugod, ibinubutang ito niya ha burutangan han suga, basi makakita han kapawa an nasulod nga mga tawo.

en: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that which he thinketh he hath.
war: An bisan ano nga tinago, ipadadayag; ngan an bisan ano nga tinahoban, ipahahayag.

en: And there came to him his mother and brethren, and they could not come at him for the crowd.
war: “Sanglit, paghirot han iyo pamati; kay adton may-ada, tatagan pa hin dugang; kundi adton waray, kukuhaan pa hiya bisan han gutiay nga iya ginhuhunahuna nga iya.”

en: And it was told him, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
war: Kinmadto kan Jesus an iroy ngan kabugtoan niya, kundi waray makahirani ha iya tungod han damo nga mga tawo.

en: But he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these that hear the word of God, and do it.
war: May nagsiring kan Jesus, “Aadto ha gawas an iroy ngan kabugtoan mo, ngan karuyag makigkita ha imo.”

en: Now it came to pass on one of those days, that he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples; and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake: and they launched forth.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira ngatanan, “Adton namamati ngan nagtutuman han pulong han Dyos amo an iroy ngan kabugtoan ko.”

en: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filling with water , and were in jeopardy.
war: Usa ka adlaw sinmakay hi Jesus hin sakayan, upod han iya mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Tabok kita ngadto ha luyo han lanaw.” Sanglit pinmalawod hira.

en: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. And he awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
war: Samtang nagsasakay hira, nahingaturog hi Jesus. Nagmadlos in hangin didto han lanaw, ginsakayan hin tubig an sakayan, ngan nahingada hira ngatanan hin dako nga kataragman.

en: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And being afraid they marvelled, saying one to another, Who then is this, that he commandeth even the winds and the water, and they obey him?
war: Hinmarani kan Jesus an mga tinun-an ngan ginpukaw hiya, “Agaron, Agaron! Magkakamatay na kita!”

en: And they arrived at the country of the Gerasenes, which is over against Galilee.
war: Binmuhat hi Jesus ngan ginsaway an hangin ngan an mga balod; hinmugpoy an hangin ngan nagmalinaw hin duro.

en: And when he was come forth upon the land, there met him a certain man out of the city, who had demons; and for a long time he had worn no clothes, and abode not in any house, but in the tombs.
war: Katapos, nagsiring hiya ha mga tinun-an, “Hain naman an iyo pagtoo?”

en: And when he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the Most High God? I beseech thee, torment me not.
war: Kundi nahipausa ngan nahadlok hira ngan may hinsiring ha ira, “Hin-o ba ini nga tawo? Nasugo hiya han mga hangin ngan mga balod, ngan nasugot hira ha iya!”

en: For he was commanding the unclean spirit to come out from the man. For oftentimes it had seized him: and he was kept under guard, and bound with chains and fetters; and breaking the bands asunder, he was driven of the demon into the deserts.
war: Nagpadayon hira hin pagsakay ngadto ha tuna han mga taga-Gadara, nga tabok han lanaw tikang ha Galilea.

en: And Jesus asked him, What is thy name? And he said, Legion; for many demons were entered into him.
war: Paghaw-as ni Jesus ha baybayon, gintapo hiya hin tawo nga sinasangkayan hin yawa nga tikang ha bungto. Maiha na nga lubas hiya ngan diri naukoy hin balay, kundi ha mga lungib nga lubnganan.

en: And they entreated him that he would not command them to depart into the abyss.
war: Han pakakita niya kan Jesus, ginmoliat hiya, hinmapa ha iya atubangan, ngan ginmoliat hin pagsiring, “Jesus, Anak han Gihahataasi nga Dyos! Ano an imo karuyag ha akon? Nakikimalooy ako ha imo, ayaw gad ako pagkastigoha!”

en: Now there was there a herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they entreated him that he would give them leave to enter into them. And he gave them leave.
war: Nagsiring hiya hini, kay ginsugo ni Jesus an maraot nga espiritu hin paggawas ha iya. Nakadamo na sulonga hiya han yawa, ngan bisan kon ginpriso hiya, kinadenahan an iya mga kamot ngan mga tiil, gin-uutod niya an mga kadena ngan gindadara hiya han yawa ngadto ha kamingawan.

en: And the demons came out from the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd rushed down the steep into the lake, and were drowned.
war: Ginpakianhan hiya ni Jesus, “Ano an imo ngaran?”

en: And when they that fed them saw what had come to pass, they fled, and told it in the city and in the country.
war: Binmaton hiya, “Panon an akon ngaran,” kay damo nga mga yawa an sinmulod ha iya.

en: And they went out to see what had come to pass; and they came to Jesus, and found the man, from whom the demons were gone out, sitting, clothed and in his right mind, at the feet of Jesus: and they were afraid.
war: Nakimalooy kan Jesus an mga yawa nga diri hira tabogon ngadto ha kahiladman.

en: And they that saw it told them how he that was possessed with demons was made whole.
war: May dako nga panon hin kababoyan nga hirani didto, ngan nanginginaon ha ligid han tayod. Nakimalooy kan Jesus an mga yawa nga tugotan hira hin pagsulod ngadto han kababoyan, ngan tinmugot hiya.

en: And all the people of the country of the Gerasenes round about asked him to depart from them; for they were holden with great fear: and he entered into a boat, and returned.
war: Sanglit ginmawas han tawo an mga yawa ngan sinmulod ngadto han kababoyan; binmungkalas hin pagdadlagan an bug-os nga panon ha ligid han umpas, nagpadayon ngadto han lanaw, ngan nagkalulumos hira.

en: But the man from whom the demons were gone out prayed him that he might be with him: but he sent him away, saying,
war: Hinkit-an an nahinabo han mga tawo nga nagmamangno han kababoyan, sanglit nagdadlagan hira ngadto ha bungto ug kaumhan hin pagsumat han nahinabo.

en: Return to thy house, and declare how great things God hath done for thee. And he went his way, publishing throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done for him.
war: Ginmawas an mga tawo hin pagkita han nahinabo. Kinmadto hira kan Jesus, ngan hinkit-an nira an tawo nga iniwasan na han mga yawa nga nalingkod ha tiilan ni Jesus, may bado na, ngan maupay na an panhunahuna; ngan nahadlok hira ngatanan.

en: And as Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him; for they were all waiting for him.
war: An mga nagpakakita nagsumat han mga tawo kon gin-unan-o hin pag-upay han sinangkayan hin yawa.

en: And behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus’ feet, and besought him to come into his house;
war: Niyan ginhangyo hi Jesus han mga taga-Gadara nga bumaya hiya ha ira, kay nahadlok hira. Sanglit sinmakay hi Jesus han sakayan ngan ginmikan.

en: for he had an only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went the multitudes thronged him.
war: Nakimalooy kan Jesus an tawo nga iniwasan han mga yawa, “Paupda gad ako ha imo.”

en: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, who had spent all her living upon physicians, and could not be healed of any,
war: Kundi ginpalakat hiya ni Jesus upod ini nga tugon,

en: came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately the issue of her blood stanched.
war: “Oli ngadto ha iyo ngan igsumat an ginbuhat han Dyos ha imo.”

en: And Jesus said, Who is it that touched me? And when all denied, Peter said, and they that were with him, Master, the multitudes press thee and crush thee .
war: Linmakat an tawo nga iginsumat niya ha bug-os nga bungto an ngatanan nga ginbuhat ni Jesus ha iya.

en: But Jesus said, Some one did touch me; for I perceived that power had gone forth from me.
war: Pagbalik ni Jesus ngadto ha tabok han lanaw, gintapo hiya han mga tawo, kay naghihinulat na hira ngatanan ha iya.

en: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him declared in the presence of all the people for what cause she touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
war: Inmabot in usa ka tawo nga ginngangaranan kan Jairo nga usa nga opisyal han sinagoga. Hinmapa hiya ha tiilan ni Jesus ngan nakimalooy ha iya nga kumadto ha iya balay,

en: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
war: kay tikamaratay na an amo la nga iya anak nga babaye nga 12 an edad.

en: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house , saying, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Teacher.
war: Han nagtitipakadto na hi Jesus, gindadaisog hiya paluyoluyo han mga tawo.

en: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, Fear not: only believe, and she shall be made whole.
war: Didto in babaye nga makalilisang na an pag-antos hin pagdinugoi hin 12 na ka tuig; naubos na an iya pinakabuhian hin pagpatambal, kundi waray gud hiya mauupay.

en: And when he came to the house, he suffered not any man to enter in with him, save Peter, and John, and James, and the father of the maiden and her mother.
war: Nagpirit hiya hin pagkadto ha luyo ni Jesus, kinamkam niya an sidsid han panapton ni Jesus ngan inmukoy dayon an pagdinugoi ha iya.

en: And all were weeping, and bewailing her: but he said, Weep not; for she is not dead, but sleepeth.
war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus, “Hin-o in nagkamkam ha akon?”

en: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
war: Waray la makigbali an mga tawo, sanglit sinmiring hi Pedro, “Agaron, diri ka ba maaram nga ginlilibotan ngan gindadaisog ka han mga tawo?”

en: But he, taking her by the hand, called, saying, Maiden, arise.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus, “May-ada gud nagkamkam ha akon, kay inmabat ako nga may ginmawas nga gahom tikang ha akon.”

en: And her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately: and he commanded that something be given her to eat.
war: Nahibaro an babaye nga hinsabotan hiya, sanglit dinmaop hiya nga nangungurog, ngan hinmapa hiya ha tiilan ni Jesus. Ha atubangan han ngatanan, ginsumatan niya hi Jesus kay ano nga ginkamkam hiya niya, ngan kon naunan-o nga naupay hiya dayon.

en: And her parents were amazed: but he charged them to tell no man what had been done.
war: Ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “Anak ko, an imo pagtoo amo an nakaupay ha imo. Maupay na la nga imo paglakat.”

en: And he called the twelve together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.
war: Gintirok ni Jesus an 12 nga mga tinun-an ngan gintagan hira hin gahom hin pagpagawas han ngatanan nga mga yawa ngan pagtambal han mga sakit.

en: And he sent them forth to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
war: Niyan ginsugo niya hin pagwali han Ginhadian han Dyos ngan pagtambal han mga magsakit.

en: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staff, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money; neither have two coats.
war: Ginsiring niya hira: “Ayaw kamo pagdara hin bisan ano ha iyo paglalaktan: waray tungkod, waray supot para hin limos, waray balon nga pagkaon, waray kwarta, waray bisan usa nga liliwanan.

en: And into whatsoever house ye enter, there abide, and thence depart.
war: Kon karawaton kamo, pabilin dida hito nga balay ngada han pagbaya niyo han bungto;

en: And as many as receive you not, when ye depart from that city, shake off the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
war: kon diri kamo karawaton han mga tawo, bayai ito nga bungto, ngan padpara an tapotapo tikang han iyo mga tiil, sugad nga pahimangno ha ira?”

en: And they departed, and went throughout the villages, preaching the gospel, and healing everywhere.
war: Linmakat an mga tinun-an ngan nagsudoy han ngatanan nga kabaryohan. Nagwali hira han Maupay nga Sumat ngan nagtambal han mga tawo ha bisan diin nga dapit.

en: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done: and he was much perplexed, because that it was said by some, that John was risen from the dead;
war: Nakabati hi Herodes nga punoan ha Galilea, hiunong han ngatanan nga mga butang nga nahihinabo. Nawurok gud hiya mahitungod hini, kay may mga tawo nga nasiring, nga nabanhaw hi Juan nga Parabunyag;

en: and by some, that Elijah had appeared; and by others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
war: an iba nasiring nga nagpakita hi Elias, samtang nagsiring pa nga usa han kamaihaan na nga mga manaragna in nabanhaw.

en: And Herod said, John I beheaded: but who is this, about whom I hear such things? And he sought to see him.
war: Nagsiring hi Herodes, “Ginpapugotan ko na hi Juan; kundi hin-o ini nga tawo nga hinbabatian ko hiunong hini nga mga butang?” Ngan nagtalingoha hiya hin pag-ikinikitaan kan Jesus.

en: And the apostles, when they were returned, declared unto him what things they had done. And he took them, and withdrew apart to a city called Bethsaida.
war: Binmalik an mga apostoles ngan ira ginsumatan hi Jesus han ngatanan nga ira nabuhat. Igin-upod hira niya ngan kinmadto nga hira la, ha usa nga bungto nga ginngangaranan Betsaida.

en: But the multitudes perceiving it followed him: and he welcomed them, and spake to them of the kingdom of God, and them that had need of healing he cured.
war: Han paghibaro han mga tawo, linmanat hira ha iya, ngan ginkarawat hira ni Jesus. Naghimangraw hiya ha ira mahitungod han Ginhadian han Dyos, ngan gin-upay an mga nagkikinahanglan hin pagtambal.

en: And the day began to wear away; and the twelve came, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages and country round about, and lodge, and get provisions: for we are here in a desert place.
war: Han tikaturunod na an adlaw, dinmaop ha iya an dose nga mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring, “Palakta na la an mga tawo, basi makakadto hira ha kabaryohan ngan kaumhan nga higrani dinhe, ngan makaagi hin pagkaon ngan ira huhuronan, kay tay-aw ini nga dapit.”

en: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more than five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy food for all this people.
war: Kundi ginsiring hira ni Jesus, “Kamo ngahaw an hatag ha ira hin sadang nga pagkaon.”

en: For they were about five thousand men. And he said unto his disciples, Make them sit down in companies, about fifty each.
war: Binmaton hira, “Lilima la an aton tinapay ngan duduha an isda. Karuyag ba nimo nga makadto ngan mapalit kami hin pagkaon para hini ngatanan nga mga tawo?”

en: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
war: (May mga lima ka yukot an kalalaken-an didto.)

en: And he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake; and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Papanlingkora niyo an mga tawo hin pundokpundok nga mga tinag-50 an kada usa.”

en: And they ate, and were all filled: and there was taken up that which remained over to them of broken pieces, twelve baskets.
war: Ginbuhat ini han mga tinun-an ngan ginpalingkod hira ngatanan.

en: And it came to pass, as he was praying apart, the disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Who do the multitudes say that I am?
war: Ginkuha ni Jesus an lima nga tinapay ngan duha nga isda, hinmangad ha langit, nagpasalamat han Dyos tungod hini, ginpinitpinit ini niya, ngan ihinatag ha mga tinun-an, basi idurot ha mga tawo.

en: And they answering said, John the Baptist; but others say , Elijah; and others, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
war: Nangaon hira ngatanan ngan nagkabubusog; ngan nakatirok an mga tinun-an hin 12 pa ka basket han nahisalin han mga tawo.

en: And he said unto them, But who say ye that I am? And Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
war: Usa ka panahon han nag-uusaan hi Jesus hin pag-ampo, dinmaop an mga tinun-an ha iya. Ginpakianhan hira niya, “Hin-o man ako, sumala han siring han mga tawo?”

en: But he charged them, and commanded them to tell this to no man;
war: Binmaton hira, “May nasiring nga amo ka hi Juan nga Parabunyag. Nasiring an iba nga hi Elias ka, samtang nasiring naman an iba nga nabanhaw in usa han kamaihaan na nga mga manaragna.”

en: saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
war: Ginpakianhan hira niya, “An ha iyo, hin-o gud ako?”

en: And he said unto all, If any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
war: Binmaton hi Pedro, “Amo ka an Mesiyas han Dyos.”

en: For whosoever would save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
war: Niyan gintugon gud hira ni Jesus nga diri magsumat bisan kan kanay,

en: For what is a man profited, if he gain the whole world, and lose or forfeit his own self?
war: ngan nagpadayon, “Kinahanglan mag-antos an Anak han Tawo, ngan igsalikway han katigurangan, han mga puno han kapadian, ngan han mga magturutdo han Balaod. Papatayon hiya, ngan babanhawon ha ikatulo ka adlaw.”

en: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in his own glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.
war: Ngan ginsiring niya an ngatanan, “Kon may-ada karuyag hin pagbunyog ha akon, kinahanglan magsalikway hiya han iya kalugaringon, magpas-an han iya kros ha ngatanan nga adlaw, ngan magsunod ha akon.

en: But I tell you of a truth, There are some of them that stand here, who shall in no wise taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
war: Kay an bisan hin-o nga karuyag magtalwas han iya kalugaringon nga kinabuhi, kawawad-an ini hiya; kundi an bisan hin-o nga kawad-an han iya kinabuhi tungod ha akon, matatalwas.

en: And it came to pass about eight days after these sayings, that he took with him Peter and John and James, and went up into the mountain to pray.
war: May-ada ba kapulsanan para hin usa ka tawo, kon maangkon niya an bug-os nga kalibutan, kundi kawad-an hiya han iya kinabuhi? Waray gud!

en: And as he was praying, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment became white and dazzling.
war: Kon may-ada maawod ha akon ngan han akon pagturon-an, niyan, ikakaawod man hiya han Anak han Tawo kon kumanhi na hiya dida han iya himaya ngan han himaya han iya Amay ngan han iya baraan nga mga anghel.

en: And behold, there talked with him two men, who were Moses and Elijah;
war: Tigamni ini! Susumatan ko kamo, may-ada pipira dinhe ha iyo nga diri mapatay tubtob nga hikit-an nira an Ginhadian han Dyos.”

en: who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
war: Mga usa na ka simana an linmabay katapos ni Jesus maghimangraw hini nga mga butang. Igin-upod niya hira Pedro, Juan, ug Santiago, ngan sinmagka hira hin bukid para hin pag-ampo.

en: Now Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
war: Samtang nag-aampo hi Jesus, nag-iba an dagway han iya bayhon, ngan tungod hin kamasilaw, nagmabusag an iya panapton.

en: And it came to pass, as they were parting from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah: not knowing what he said.
war: Ha gilayon pinmakita in duha ka tawo nga nakikighimangraw ha iya. Hira Moises ug Elias adto,

en: And while he said these things, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
war: nga pinmakita dida ha langitnon nga himaya, ngan nakighimangraw kan Jesus mahitungod han paagi nga diri maiha magtutuman hiya han tuyo han Dyos, pinaagi han iya pagkamatay didto ha Jerusalem.

en: And a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my Son, my chosen: hear ye him.
war: Maupay gud an paghingaturog ni Pedro ngan han iya mga kaupod, kundi nagmata hira ngan nakakita han himaya ni Jesus ngan han duha nga mga tawo nga nagkakatukdaw upod ha iya.

en: And when the voice came, Jesus was found alone. And they held their peace, and told no man in those days any of the things which they had seen.
war: Han tibaraya na kan Jesus an mga tawo, nagsiring hi Pedro ha iya, “Agaron, maupay nga hahani kita. Maghihimo kami hin tulo nga mga tulda, usa para ha imo, usa para kan Moises, ngan usa para kan Elias.” (Waray gud hiya sabot han iya ginyiyinakan.)

en: And it came to pass, on the next day, when they were come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.
war: Samtang nagyiyinakan pa hiya, pinmakita in usa nga dampog nga nakalambong ha ira; ngan nahadlok an mga tinun-an dida han pagtungod han dampog ha ira.

en: And behold, a man from the multitude cried, saying, Teacher, I beseech thee to look upon my son; for he is mine only child:
war: Nagsiring in tingog tikang han dampog: “Amo ini an akon Anak nga akon pinili; pamatii hiya niyo!”

en: and behold, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth, and it hardly departeth from him, bruising him sorely.
war: Pag-ukoy na han tingog, nag-usaan na la hi Jesus. Ginhilom han mga tinun-an ini ngatanan, ngan hadto nga mga adlaw waray gud hira magsumat bisan kan kanay han ira hinkit-an.

en: And I besought thy disciples to cast it out; and they could not.
war: Pagkabuwas, linmugsong hira han bukid, ngan gintapo hi Jesus hin damo nga mga tawo.

en: And Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and bear with you? bring hither thy son.
war: Ginmoliat in usa ka tawo tikang han kadam-an: “Magturutdo! Nakikimalooy ako ha imo, kitaa gad an akon anak, an amo la nga akon anak!

en: And as he was yet a coming, the demon dashed him down, and tare him grievously. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
war: Sinmulod ha iya in espiritu, nga tigda la hiya hin paggoliat, ngan binubuntog hiya, sanglit nagbububura an iya baba; waray hunong in pagpakurii ha iya, ngan makuri gud bumaya ha iya!

en: And they were all astonished at the majesty of God.
war: Nakimalooy ako han imo mga tinun-an nga pagawson ini nga maraot nga espiritu, kundi diri man hira nakakahimo.”

en: But while all were marvelling at all the things which he did, he said unto his disciples,
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Pagkawaray pagtoo ngan pagkasayop niyo nga mga tawo! Tubtob pa san-o nga kinahanglan mag-upod ako ha iyo? Tubtob pa san-o an pag-antos ko upod ha iyo?” Niyan ginsiring niya an tawo, “Dad-a nganhi an imo anak.”

en: Let these words sink into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered up into the hands of men.
war: Samtang nagtitikaharani an bata, ibinuntad han yawa an bata ha tuna ngan binuntog ini hiya. Ginsaway ni Jesus an maraot nga espiritu, gintambal an bata, ngan iginbalik hiya ngadto han amay niya.

en: But they understood not this saying, and it was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it; and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
war: Nanhipausa gud an ngatanan nga mga tawo han dako nga gahom han Dyos.

en: And there arose a reasoning among them, which of them was the greatest.
war: Dako pa an paghipausa han mga tawo han ngatanan nga ginbuhat ni Jesus, han pagsiring niya ha iya mga tinun-an,

en: But when Jesus saw the reasoning of their heart, he took a little child, and set him by his side,
war: “Ayaw hingalimti ini nga akon iginsusumat ha iyo: itutubyan an Anak han Tawo ngadto ha gahom han mga tawo.”

en: and said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this little child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same is great.
war: Kundi waray hira makasabot kon ano an kahulugan hini, ngan nahadlok hira hin pagpakiana ha iya mahitungod hini nga butang.

en: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out demons in thy name; and we forbade him, because he followeth not with us.
war: Nagkaada hin lantogi an mga tinun-an kon hin-o ha ira an gilalabawi.

en: But Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against you is for you.
war: Nasabtan ni Jesus an ira ginhuhunahuna, sanglit kinmuha hiya hin bata, ginpatukdaw ha iya ligid,

en: And it came to pass, when the days were well-nigh come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
war: ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Makarawat ha akon an bisan hin-o nga makarawat hini nga bata ha akon ngaran; ngan makarawat liwat han nagsugo ha akon an bisan hin-o nga makarawat ha akon. Kay an giuubosi ha iyo ngatanan amo an gilalabawi.”

en: and sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
war: Nagyakan hi Juan, “Agaron, hinkit-an namon in tawo nga nagpapagawas hin mga yawa ha imo ngaran, ngan ginsaway hiya namon, kay diri man hiya sakop han aton hugpo.”

en: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he were going to Jerusalem.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya ngan ha iba nga mga tinun-an, “Ayaw niyo pagdid-i hiya, kay naugop ha iyo an diri nasupak ha iyo.”

en: And when his disciples James and John saw this , they said, Lord, wilt thou that we bid fire to come down from heaven, and consume them?
war: Samtang nagtitikahirani an mga adlaw nga masaka na hi Jesus ha langit, nagbuot na gud la hiya nga mapakadto hiya ha Jerusalem.

en: But he turned, and rebuked them.
war: May-ada niya mga ginsugo hin pag-una ha iya. Linmakat hira ngan kinmadto hin usa nga baryo han Samaria hin pag-andam han ngatanan para ha iya.

en: And they went to another village.
war: Kundi waray karawata hira han mga tawo didto, kay maaram hira nga tipakadto hi Jesus ha Jerusalem.

en: And as they went on the way, a certain man said unto him, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
war: Han pakasabot hini nira Santiago ug Juan nga mga tinun-an, nagsiring hira, “Ginoo, karuyag ba nimo nga ipalusad namon tikang ha langit in kalayo nga magsunog ha ira?”

en: And Jesus said unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the heaven have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
war: Linmingi hi Jesus ngan ginbusaan hira;

en: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
war: ngan nagpadayon hira ngadto hin lain nga baryo.

en: But he said unto him, Leave the dead to bury their own dead; but go thou and publish abroad the kingdom of God.
war: Samtang naglalakat hira ha dalan, nagsiring in usa ka tawo kan Jesus, “Masunod ako ha imo bisan ngain.”

en: Now after these things the Lord appointed seventy others, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself was about to come.
war: Katapos hini nagpili an Ginoo hin iba nga 72 nga kalalaken-an ngan ginsugo hira, padis padis, hin pag-una ha iya ngadto ha tagsa nga bungto ug dapit nga iya ngahaw kakadtoan.

en: And he said unto them, The harvest indeed is plenteous, but the laborers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he send forth laborers into his harvest.
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Damo an aranihon, kundi gutiay la an mga mag-arani. Sanglit pag-ampo kamo han tag-iya han aranihon nga magpadara hiya hin mga mag-arani ngadto han iya aranihon.

en: Go your ways; behold, I send you forth as lambs in the midst of wolves.
war: Kadto na! Ginsusugo ta kamo sugad hin mga karnero ha butnga hin mga lubo.

en: Carry no purse, no wallet, no shoes; and salute no man on the way.
war: Ayaw kamo pagdara hin supot o surudlan hin limos o sandalyas; ayaw kamo pakigbali bisan kan kanay dida ha dalan.

en: And into whatsoever house ye shall enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
war: Pagsulod niyo hin balay, siring anay, ‘An kalinaw maada hini nga balay.’

en: And if a son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon him: but if not, it shall turn to you again.
war: Kon naukoy didto in tawo nga murayaw an kinabuhi, ibilin ha iya an iyo ginpamulong nga kamurayaw; kon diri, bakwia an iyo ginpamulong nga kamurayaw.

en: And in that same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the laborer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
war: Pabilin dida hito ngahaw nga balay; kaon ngan inom han ira idudurot ha iyo, kay an magburudlay takos han iya suhol. Ayaw kamo pagbinurobalhin hin urokyan.

en: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
war: Kon makadto kamo hin bungto ngan karawton kamo, kaon han igdudurot ha iyo,

en: and heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
war: tambala niyo an mga magsakit didto hito nga bungto, ngan sidnga an mga tawo, ‘Haraniay na ha iyo an Ginhadian han Dyos.’

en: But into whatsoever city ye shall enter, and they receive you not, go out into the streets thereof and say,
war: Kundi kon sumulod kamo hin bungto ngan diri kamo karawaton, kadto kamo ha kadalanan ngan siring,

en: Even the dust from your city, that cleaveth to our feet, we wipe off against you: nevertheless know this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh.
war: ‘Ginpapadpad namon kontra ha iyo bisan an tapotapo han iyo bungto nga nadukot ha amon mga tiil; kundi tigamni ini, haraniay na ha iyo an Ginhadian han Dyos!’

en: I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
war: Susumatan ko kamo nga ha Adlaw han Paghukom, mas kalolooyan pa han Dyos an Sodoma kay hito nga bungto!

en: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
war: “Kamakaharadlok an mahinanabo ha imo, Corasin! Kamakaharadlok an mahinanabo ha imo liwat, Betsaida! Kon an mga milagro nga ginbuhat dinhe ha imo didto pagbuhata ha Tiro ug Sidon, maiha na unta nga linmingkod an mga tawo didto, nagbado hin sako, ngan nagsabrag hin agbon ha ira ngahaw, hin pagpakita nga nagbasol na hira han ira mga sala!

en: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment, than for you.
war: Mas kalolooyan pa han Dyos an Tiro ug Sidon, kay ha iyo, ha Adlaw han Paghukom.

en: And thou, Capernaum, shalt thou be exalted unto heaven? thou shalt be brought down unto Hades.
war: Ngan para ha imo Capernaum, karuyag mo ba mag-undong han imo kalugaringon ngadto ha langit? Ilalabog ka ngadto ha impyerno!”

en: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that rejecteth you rejecteth me; and he that rejecteth me rejecteth him that sent me.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Namamati ha akon an bisan hin-o nga namamati ha iyo; nasalikway ha akon an bisan hin-o nga nasalikway ha iyo; ngan nasalikway han nagsugo ha akon an bisan hin-o nga nasalikway ha akon.”

en: And the seventy returned with joy, saying, Lord, even the demons are subject unto us in thy name.
war: Binmalik nga puno hin kalipay an 72 nga kalalaken-an ngan nagsiring, “Ginoo, sinmugot ha amon bisan an mga yawa, han pagsugoa namon ha imo ngaran!”

en: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan fallen as lightning from heaven.
war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Hinkit-an ko hi Satanas nga nahulog sugad hin kikidlat tikang ha langit.

en: Behold, I have given you authority to tread upon serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall in any wise hurt you.
war: Pamati! Gintagan ko kamo hin gahom, basi tamakan niyo an mga halas ngan mga bungad, ngan an ngatanan nga gahom han kaaway, ngan waray bisan ano nga makakadaot ha iyo.

en: Nevertheless in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.
war: Kundi pagkalipay kamo, diri tungod nga sinusugot kamo han magraot nga espiritu; kundi lugod pagkalipay kamo, kay nahisurat na an iyo mga ngaran didto ha langit.”

en: In that same hour he rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou didst hide these things from the wise and understanding, and didst reveal them unto babes: yea, Father; for so it was well-pleasing in thy sight.
war: Hito ngahaw nga panahon nalipay hi Jesus pinaagi han Espiritu Santo, ngan nagsiring, “Amay, Ginoo han langit ug tuna! Nagpapasalamat ako ha imo, kay iginpakita mo ha mga diri mag-aram an imo gintago tikang han mga may-ada aram ug hibaro. Oo, Amay ko, natuman ini, kay amo man an imo karuyag ug pagbuot.

en: All things have been delivered unto me of my Father: and no one knoweth who the Son is, save the Father; and who the Father is, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son willeth to reveal him .
war: “Iginhatag ha akon han akon Amay an ngatanan nga mga butang. Waray nakilala han Anak labot han Amay, ngan waray nakilala han Amay labot han Anak ngan hadton mga ginpili han Anak hin pagpahayag ha iya.”

en: And turning to the disciples, he said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
war: Kahuman, inmatubang hi Jesus ha mga tinun-an ngan ginhilit hira hin pagsiring, “Kapalaran niyo hin pagkita han mga butang nga iyo hinkit-an!

en: for I say unto you, that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which ye see, and saw them not; and to hear the things which ye hear, and heard them not.
war: Susumatan ko kamo nga damo nga mga manaragna ngan mga hadi an karuyag kumita han iyo hinkit-an, kundi waray hira makakita, ngan mamati han iyo hinbabatian, kundi waray hira makabati.”

en: And behold, a certain lawyer stood up and made trial of him, saying, Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
war: Inmabot in usa nga magturutdo han Balaod ngan nagtalinguha hin pagbitik kan Jesus. Nagpakiana hiya, “Magturutdo, ano an kinahanglan ko buhaton basi maangkon ko an dayon nga kinabuhi?”

en: And he said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
war: Binmaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Ano an siring han Kasuratan? Inuunano mo hin pagsaysay ha ira?”

en: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbor as thyself.
war: Nagbaton an tawo, “‘Kinahanglan higugmaon mo an Ginoo nga imo Dyos ha bug-os mo nga kasingkasing, ha bug-os mo nga kalag, ha bug-os mo nga kusog, ngan ha bug-os mo nga hunahuna’; ngan ‘Kinahanglan higugmaon an imo igkasi-tawo sugad ha imo ngahaw.’”

en: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Igo an imo baton; buhata ini ngan mabubuhi ka.”

en: But he, desiring to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbor?
war: Kundi karuyag magpakamatadong ha iya kalugaringon an magturutdo han balaod, sanglit nagpakiana pa hiya kan Jesus, “Hin-o man an akon igkasi-tawo?”

en: Jesus made answer and said, A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho; and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus: “May-ada hadto usa ka tawo nga tipakadto ha Jerico, tikang ha Jerusalem, ngan gingamaan hiya han mga tikasan, ginhuboan, ginbalbag, ngan ginbayaan nga himaratyon.

en: And by chance a certain priest was going down that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
war: Nahinabo nga may padi nga naagi hadto nga dalan; pakakita niya han tawo, nagpadayon hiya paglakat didto ha luyo nga ligid han dalan.

en: And in like manner a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.
war: Sugad man, inmagi liwat didto in usa nga Levita; hinmarani, kinmita han tawo, ngan nagpadayon paglakat ha luyo nga ligid han dalan.

en: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he was moved with compassion,
war: Kundi in usa nga Samaritano nga naagi hadto nga dalan inmagi ha iya, kinmita hini nga tawo ngan inalpan hin kalooy an iya kasingkasing han pakapanginano niya han tawo.

en: and came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on them oil and wine; and he set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
war: Gindaop niya an tawo, ginhirugan hin lana ug bino an iya mga samad, ngan ginbutok hin dugnit. Katapos iginsakay niya an tawo han iya kalugaringon nga hayop, ngan gindara ngadto hin balay nga pahuwayan, diin ginmangnoan hiya niya.

en: And on the morrow he took out two shillings, and gave them to the host, and said, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, I, when I come back again, will repay thee.
war: Han pagkabuwas, kinmuha hiya hin duha ka salapi ngan iginhatag niya han tinaporan han balay. Ginsiring niya an tinaporan, ‘Mangnoi hiya, ngan ha pagbalik ko, babaydan ko ikaw han imo magasto ha iya.’”

en: Which of these three, thinkest thou, proved neighbor unto him that fell among the robbers?
war: Ngan gintapos ni Jesus hin pagsiring, “Ha imo paghunahuna, hain man hini nga tulo an nagpakita nga igkasi-tawo hiya han gin-gamaan han mga tikasan?”

en: And he said, He that showed mercy on him. And Jesus said unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
war: Nagbaton an magturutdo han Balaod, “Adton nalooy ha iya.”

en: Now as they went on their way, he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Sanglit, kadto na, ngan buhata sugad han ginbuhat han Samaritano.”

en: And she had a sister called Mary, who also sat at the Lord’s feet, and heard his word.
war: Samtang nagpadayon hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an ha ira paglakaton, inmabot hiya ngadto hin usa nga baryo, diin gin-abiabi hiya ngadto ha iya balay hin usa nga babaye nga ginngangaranan kan Marta.

en: But Martha was cumbered about much serving; and she came up to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister did leave me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
war: May-ada bugto hi Marta nga Maria an ngaran, nga linmingkod ha tiilan han Ginoo ngan namati han iya gintututdo.

en: But the Lord answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art anxious and troubled about many things:
war: Nalisang hi Marta han iya damo nga mga buruhaton; sanglit dinmaop hiya ngan nagsiring, “Ginoo, diri ka ba nababaraka nga ginpapabay-an la ako han akon bugto pagbuhat han ngatanan nga buruhaton ha balay? Sidnga daw nga buligan ako niya!”

en: but one thing is needful: for Mary hath chosen the good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
war: Binmaton ha iya an Ginoo, “Marta, Marta! Naguguol ngan nababaraka ka hin damo nga mga butang,

en: And it came to pass, as he was praying in a certain place, that when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, even as John also taught his disciples.
war: Usa ka panahon nag-ampo hi Jesus didto hin usa nga dapit. Kahuman na niya, nagsiring ha iya in usa han iya mga tinun-an, “Ginoo, tutdoi daw kami hin pag-ampo, sugad gud nga nagtutdo hi Juan han iya mga tinun-an.”

en: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Father, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come.
war: Ginsiring hira ni Jesus, “Sugara hini an iyo pag-ampo:

en: Give us day by day our daily bread.
war: ‘Amay:

en: And forgive us our sins; for we ourselves also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And bring us not into temptation.
war: Pagdayawon unta an imo baraan nga ngaran;

en: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say to him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
war: maghadi ka unta ha amon.

en: for a friend of mine is come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him;
war: Tagi kami adlaw-adlaw han pagkaon nga amon kinahanglan.

en: and he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee?
war: Pasayloa kami han amon nga sala, kay napasaylo man kami hadton mga makakasala ha amon.

en: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will arise and give him as many as he needeth.
war: Ngan ayaw itugot nga mahingadto kami hin makuri nga pagsulay.’”

en: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
war: Nagsiring pa hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Kon pananglitan usa ha iyo makadto ha balay hin sangkay ha katutnga hin gab-i, ngan masiring ha iya, ‘Sangkay, pahudma daw ako hin tulo ka bug-os nga tinapay.

en: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
war: Inmabot ha akon balay in usa ko nga sangkay nga naglalakaton, ngan waray ko sadang igdurot ha iya!’

en: And of which of you that is a father shall his son ask a loaf, and he give him a stone? or a fish, and he for a fish give him a serpent?
war: Ngan kon pananglit magbaton an imo sangkay tikang ha sakob, ‘Ayaw na ako pagsamoka! Trangkado na an porta, ngan nangangahigda na an akon kabataan ug ako. Diri na ako makakabuhat hin paghatag ha imo hin bisan ano.’

en: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he give him a scorpion?
war: Niyan, ano man an imo bubuhaton? Susumatan ko kamo, bisan kon waray niya tuyo hin pagbuhat ngan paghatag ha imo hin tinapay, tungod nga sangkay ka man niya, kundi mabuhat na la hiya, ngan mahatag han ngatanan nga imo ginkikinahanglan, kay diri ka man naawod hin pagpadayon hin pag-inaro.

en: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
war: Sanglit nasiring ako ha iyo: pangaro, ngan makarawat kamo; pamiling, ngan nakakaagi kamo; pagtuktok, ngan aabrehan an porta ha iyo.

en: And he was casting out a demon that was dumb. And it came to pass, when the demon was gone out, the dumb man spake; and the multitudes marvelled.
war: Kay makarawat an nangangaro, ngan makakaagi an namimiling, ngan aabrehan an porta ha iya nga nagtutuktok.

en: But some of them said, By Beelzebub the prince of the demons casteth he out demons.
war: May-ada ba usa ha iyo nga mga amay, nga mahatag han iya anak hin halas kon mangaro hiya hin isda?

en: And others, trying him , sought of him a sign from heaven.
war: O tatagan ba niyo hiya hin bungad kon mangaro hiya hin bonay?

en: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
war: Bisan kon magraot kamo, maaram kamo humatag hin mag-upay nga mga butang han iyo mga anak. Sanglit labaw pa gud nga mahatag an Amay niyo ha langit han Espiritu Santo, hadton mga maaro ha iya!”

en: And if Satan also is divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out demons by Beelzebub.
war: Ginpaiwas ni Jesus in ngula nga yawa; nakagyakan an tawo han paghigawas na han yawa. Nanhipausa an kadam-an,

en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
war: kundi nagsiring in pira han mga tawo, “Hi Beelsebul nga puno han mga yawa amo an nahatag ha iya hin gahom hin pagpagawas hin mga yawa.”

en: But if I by the finger of God cast out demons, then is the kingdom of God come upon you.
war: Karuyag han iba magbitik ha iya, sanglit nangaro hira ha iya nga magbuhat hiya hin milagro pagpakita nga hiya ginpadara han Dyos.

en: When the strong man fully armed guardeth his own court, his goods are in peace:
war: Kundi hinbaroan ni Jesus an ira panhunahuna, ngan ginsiring hira, “Diri gud mag-iiha an bisan ano nga nasod nga nagkakabahinbahin ngan nag-iinaway-away; magkabuburublag an panimalay nga nagkakabahinbahin ha iya ngahaw.

en: but when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him his whole armor wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
war: Sanglit uunanhon man nga makagpadayon an ginhadian ni Satanas, kon mag-iinaway-away an iya mga hugpo? Nasiring kamo nga nagpapagawas ako hin mga yawa, kay nahatag hi Beelsebul ha akon hin gahom hin pagbuhat hini.

en: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
war: Kon amo ini an paagi hin pagpagawas ko ha ira, inuunan-o man han iyo mga sakop hin pagpagawas han mga yawa? Nagpapakita an iyo kalugaringon nga mga sayop kamo!

en: The unclean spirit when he is gone out of the man, passeth through waterless places, seeking rest, and finding none, he saith, I will turn back unto my house whence I came out.
war: Diri, nagpapaguwa lugod ako hin yawa, pinaagi han gahom han Dyos, nga nagpapamatuod nga inmabot na ha iyo an Ginhadian han Dyos.

en: And when he is come, he findeth it swept and garnished.
war: “Kon in kusgan nga tawo nga sangkap han ngatanan niya nga hinganiban nagbabantay han iya kalugaringon nga balay, diri maano an ngatanan niya nga mga higamit.

en: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more evil than himself; and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man becometh worse than the first.
war: Kundi kon sulongon ngan madaog hiya hin makarukosog nga tawo, aagawon an ngatanan nga hinganiban nga sinasarigan han tag-iya, ngan ginbabahinbahin an iya naagaw.

en: And it came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the breasts which thou didst suck.
war: “Tinuod nga nasupak ha akon an bisan hin-o nga diri naugop ha akon; tinuod nga nagpapasarang, an bisan hin-o nga diri nabulig ha akon hin pagtirok.

en: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
war: “Kon nagawas in maraot nga espiritu tikang hin tawo, nagsusudoy ini ha mamara nga tuna, hin pamiling hin dapit nga kapapahuwayan niya. Diri ngani ini hiya makaagi, nasiring hiya ha iya ngahaw, ‘Mabalik ako ngadto han balay nga akon binayaan.’

en: And when the multitudes were gathering together unto him, he began to say, This generation is an evil generation: it seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it but the sign of Jonah.
war: Sanglit nabalik an yawa ngan nakita han balay nga malinis ngan inayad na an ngatanan.

en: For even as Jonah became a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
war: Niyan nagawas hiya ngan nagdadara hin pito nga lain nga espiritu nga labaw pa kamaraot ha iya, ngan nasulod hira ngan nag-uokoy didto. Sanglit ha kataposan, labaw pa kamaraot an kahimtang hadto nga tawo kay han una.”

en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and shall condemn them: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
war: Kahuman ni Jesus pagyakan hini, may nagyakan nga babaye dida han kadam-an ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Pagkapalaran han babaye nga nag-anak ngan nagpasuso ha imo!”

en: The men of Nineveh shall stand up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, a greater than Jonah is here.
war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus, “Lugod pagkapalaran hadton mga namamati ngan nagtutuman han pulong han Dyos!”

en: No man, when he hath lighted a lamp, putteth it in a cellar, neither under the bushel, but on the stand, that they which enter in may see the light.
war: Han nagdadaisog an mga tawo nga naglilibot kan Jesus, nagpadayon hiya hin pagsiring, “Pagkamaraot han mga tawo hini nga panahon! Nangangaro hira hin milagro, kundi waray ihahatag ha ira labot han milagro ni Jonas.

en: The lamp of thy body is thine eye: when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when it is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
war: Sugad nga nagin tigaman hi Jonas nga manaragna para han mga tawo ha Ninibe, magigin tigaman man an Anak han Tawo para han mga tawo hini nga panahon.

en: Look therefore whether the light that is in thee be not darkness.
war: Ha Adlaw han Paghukom, matindog an Rayna ha Seba, ngan isusumbong an mga tawo hini nga panahon, kay nagbaktas hiya tikang han iya natawohan nga tuna hin pamati la han makinaadmananon nga pagtutdo ni Solomon; ngan susumatan ko kamo, aanhi in labaw pa kan Solomon.

en: If therefore thy whole body be full of light, having no part dark, it shall be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining doth give thee light.
war: Ha Adlaw han Paghukom matindog an mga tawo ha Ninibe ngan igsusumbong kamo, kay binmaya hira han ira mga sala han pakabati nira han pagwali ni Jonas; ngan susumatan ko kamo, aanhi in labaw pa kan Jonas!

en: Now as he spake, a Pharisee asketh him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
war: “Waray nadagkot hin suga ngan tagoon o takloban hin makaong; lugod, ibinubutang niya ha burutangan hin suga, basi hikit-an han mga tawo an kapawa ha pagsulod nira.

en: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first bathed himself before dinner.
war: Sugad hin suga para han lawas an iyo mga mata. Puno hin kalamrag an iyo bug-os nga lawas, kon matin-aw an iyo mga mata; kundi magmamasirom an iyo bug-os nga lawas, kon maraot an iyo mga mata.

en: And the Lord said unto him, Now ye the Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter; but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
war: Sanglit paghirot nga an kapawa dida ha iyo diri mahimo nga kasisidman.

en: Ye foolish ones, did not he that made the outside make the inside also?
war: Kon puno hin kalamrag an imo bug-os nga lawas, nga waray bahin nga aada hin kamasirom, maluluob hin kamapawa an iyo lawas, sugad kon nasanag ha imo an kapawa hin suga.”

en: But give for alms those things which are within; and behold, all things are clean unto you.
war: Katapos gud ni Jesus magyakan, gindapit hiya hin usa nga Parisiyo hin pagkaon upod ha iya; sanglit sinmulod hiya ngan linmingkod hin pagkaon.

en: But woe unto you Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and every herb, and pass over justice and the love of God: but these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
war: Nahipausa an Parisiyo han pakakita niya, nga waray anay manhunaw hi Jesus san-o kumaon.

en: Woe unto you Pharisees! for ye love the chief seats in the synagogues, and the salutations in the marketplaces.
war: Sanglit nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo, “Yana, naghuhugas kamo nga mga Parisiyo han gawas han kupa ngan han plato, kundi puno kamo hin mga panlupig ngan karat-an ha sulod niyo.

en: Woe unto you! for ye are as the tombs which appear not, and the men that walk over them know it not.
war: Mga lurong! Diri ba an Dyos nga naghimo han gawas, amo liwat an naghimo han sakob?

en: And one of the lawyers answering saith unto him, Teacher, in saying this thou reproachest us also.
war: Kundi ihatag ha mga kablas an sulod han iyo mga tasa ug plato ngan magmamalinis an ngatanan para ha iyo.

en: And he said, Woe unto you lawyers also! for ye load men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
war: “Pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo, mga Parisiyo! Nahatag kamo ha Dyos han ikanapulo ka bahin han mga panakot, sugad han tanglad, kanila, ngan iba pa nga mga panakot, kundi ginpapabay-an niyo an katadongan ngan an paghigugma han Dyos. Kinahanglan unta buhaton niyo ini, hin waray pagpasibaya han iba.

en: Woe unto you! for ye build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
war: “Pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo, mga Parisiyo! Karuyag niyo an linain nga mga lingkoran ha mga sinagoga, ngan an paghatag ha iyo hin katalahoran han mga tawo didto ha mga taboan.

en: So ye are witnesses and consent unto the works of your fathers: for they killed them, and ye build their tombs .
war: Pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo! Sugad kamo hin mga lubnganan nga waray tigaman nga tinatamakan han mga tawo, kay diri man hira maaram.”

en: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send unto them prophets and apostles; and some of them they shall kill and persecute;
war: Nagsiring ha iya in usa han mga magturutdo han Balaod, “Magturutdo, kon nasiring ka hini ginpapakaalohan nimo kami!”

en: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo liwat, mga magturutdo han Balaod! Ginpapabug-atan niyo an mga tawo hin mga magkuri nga darad-on, kundi diri ngani kamo nabulig bisan han iyo tudlo hin pag-alsa han darad-on.

en: from the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary: yea, I say unto you, it shall be required of this generation.
war: Pagkamakaharadlok para ha iyo! Naghihimo kamo hin makaruruyag nga mga lubnganan para han mga manaragna—an mga manaragna ngahaw nga pinanmatay han iyo mga kaapoy-apoyan.

en: Woe unto you lawyers! for ye took away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
war: Kamo ngahaw natangdo nga nauyon kamo han ginbuhat han iyo mga kaapoy-apoyan; kay ginpatay nira an mga manaragna, ngan gintindog niyo an ira mga lubnganan.

en: And when he was come out from thence, the scribes and the Pharisees began to press upon him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things;
war: Tungod hini nga pangatadongan, nagsiring an Kinaadman han Dyos: ‘Padadad-an ko hira hin mga manaragna ngan mga magsarangyaw; papatayon nira in pira ha ira ngan pagtitimaraotan an iba.’

en: laying wait for him, to catch something out of his mouth.
war: Sanglit kakastigohon an mga tawo hini nga panahon, tungod han pagpataya han ngatanan nga mga manaragna tikang pa han paghimoa han kalibutan,

en: In the mean time, when the many thousands of the multitude were gathered together, insomuch that they trod one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
war: Han nagdadaisog an yinukotyukot nga mga tawo, sanglit nagtitinamakay na hira, nagsiring anay hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Pagbantay kamo kontra han patubo han mga Parisiyo an karuyag ko sidngon, an pagkasalingkapaw.

en: But there is nothing covered up, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
war: Mabubuksan an bisan ano nga tinahoban, ngan mahibabaroan an tagsa nga tinago.

en: Wherefore whatsoever ye have said in the darkness shall be heard in the light; and what ye have spoken in the ear in the inner chambers shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
war: Sanglit, an bisan ano nga imo iginyakan ha kasisidman, mahibabatian ha kapaw-an; ngan an bisan ano nga imo iginhoring ha sinadhan nga kuwarto igogoliat ha mga atop.

en: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
war: “Kasangkayan ko, susumatan ko kamo, ayaw kamo kahadlok hadton mga nakakamatay han lawas, kundi katapos waray na nira nahihimo.

en: But I will warn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, who after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
war: Pakikitaon ko kamo han angay kahadlokan: kahadloki an Dyos nga kahuman niya pamatay, may gahom hin paglabog ha iyo ngadto ha impyerno!

en: Are not five sparrows sold for two pence? and not one of them is forgotten in the sight of God.
war: “Diri ba iginbabaligya hin duha ka sintabo an lima nga mga tamsi nga balinsasayaw? Kundi waray gud usa ha ira nga hinngangalimtan han Dyos.

en: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
war: Gin-ihap na nga daan an ngatanan nga mga buhok han iyo ulo. Sanglit ayaw kamo kahadlok; labaw pa gud kamo hin kamahal kay hin damo nga katamsihan nga balinsasayaw!

en: And I say unto you, Every one who shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
war: “Susumatan ko kamo: an bisan hin-o nga magpadayag ha kadam-an nga akon hiya amo man an bubuhaton han Anak han Tawo ha atubangan han mga anghel han Dyos;

en: but he that denieth me in the presence of men shall be denied in the presence of the angels of God.
war: kundi an bisan hin-o nga maglirong ha kadam-an nga akon hiya iglilirong liwat han Anak han Tawo ha atubangan han mga anghel han Dyos.

en: And every one who shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Spirit it shall not be forgiven.
war: “Mapapasaylo an bisan hin-o nga magpapakaraot han Anak han Tawo, kundi diri mapapasaylo an magpapakaraot han Espiritu Santo.

en: And when they bring you before the synagogues, and the rulers, and the authorities, be not anxious how or what ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
war: “Kon dad-on nira ngan igsumbong kamo ha mga sinagoga, o ha atubangan han mga gobernador o mga punuan, ayaw kamo kabaraka kon uunanhon niyo hin pagpanalipod han iyo kalugaringon, o kon ano an iyo igyayakan.

en: for the Holy Spirit shall teach you in that very hour what ye ought to say.
war: Kay tututdoan kamo han Espiritu Santo, hito nga takna, kon ano an angay niyo igyakan.”

en: And one out of the multitude said unto him, Teacher, bid my brother divide the inheritance with me.
war: Nagsiring ha iya in tawo dida han kadam-an, “Magturutdo, sidnga gad an akon bugto pakigbahin ha akon han malon nga iginbilin han amon amay.”

en: But he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
war: Binmaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Hin-o in naghatag ha akon hin katungod hin paghukom o pagbahin han malon niyo nga duha?”

en: And he said unto them, Take heed, and keep yourselves from all covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
war: Ngan nagpadayon hiya pagsiring ha ira ngatanan: “Pagbantay, ngan paglikay kamo han bisan ano nga kahalot; kay an matuod nga kinabuhi han tawo diri la aada han mga butang nga iya gintatag-iya, bisan magkadiano hin kariko niya.”

en: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
war: Niyan iginsumat ha ira ni Jesus ini nga pananglitan: “May usa ka tawo nga riko nga may-ada uma nga kinmuha hin damo nga abot.

en: and he reasoned within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have not where to bestow my fruits?
war: Naghunahuna hiya, ‘Waray ko na dapit nga hihimosan han ngatanan nga akon mga abot. Ano ba an akon bubuhaton?

en: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my grain and my goods.
war: Amo ini an akon bubuhaton,’ nagsiring hiya ha iya la ngahaw, ‘gugub-on ko an akon mga kamalig ngan magtitindog ako hin mga darudako, diin akon hihimoson an akon mga abot ngan an ngatanan nga akon mga hiagi.

en: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, be merry.
war: Katapos, masiring ako ha akon ngahaw: palaran ka nga tawo! Naangkon mo na an ngatanan nga mag-upay nga mga butang, nga imo kinahanglan para hin damo nga katuigan. Pahuway na, kaon, inom, ngan paglipay na la!’

en: But God said unto him, Thou foolish one, this night is thy soul required of thee; and the things which thou hast prepared, whose shall they be?
war: Kundi nagsiring ha iya an Dyos, ‘Lurong ka! Kukuhaon na ha imo an imo kinabuhi hini gud nga gab-i; niyan, hin-o man in mag-aangkon hini ngatanan nga mga butang nga imo gintirok para ha imo kalugaringon?’”

en: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
war: Ngan gintapos ni Jesus hin pagsiring, “Masusugad hini adton mga nagtitirok hin mga manggad para la ha ira kalugaringon, kundi diri mga riko ha atubangan han Dyos.”

en: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Be not anxious for your life, what ye shall eat; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on.
war: Niyan nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Amo ini nga nasiring ako ha iyo: ayaw kamo kabaraka mahitungod han pagkaon nga iyo kinahanglan basi kamo mabuhi, o mahitungod han panapton nga kinahanglan han iyo lawas.

en: For the life is more than the food, and the body than the raiment.
war: Labaw pa ka importante an kinabuhi kay han pagkaon, ngan labaw pa ka importante an lawas kay han panapton.

en: Consider the ravens, that they sow not, neither reap; which have no store-chamber nor barn; and God feedeth them: of how much more value are ye than the birds!
war: Tan-awa daw an mga uwak: diri hira nagtatanom o nag-aani; waray hira hirimosan nga mga payag o mga kamalig; gintutubongan man hira han Dyos! Labi kamo hin ka minahal kay han katamsihan!

en: And which of you by being anxious can add a cubit unto the measure of his life?
war: Hin-o man ha iyo in makakadugang hin pira ka tuig han iya kinabuhi pinaagi hin pagkinabaraka?

en: If then ye are not able to do even that which is least, why are ye anxious concerning the rest?
war: Kon diri man kamo nakakahimo bisan han mga gudtiay nga butang, kay ano nga mababaraka kamo hiunong han iba nga mga butang?

en: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they toil not, neither do they spin; yet I say unto you, Even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
war: Tan-awa daw niyo kon inuunan-o an pagtubo han mga bukad ha kapatagan: diri hira nagkabubudlay o naghahablon para ha ira ngahaw, kundi susumatan ko kamo nga bisan pa ngani hi Solomon, ha butnga han iya karikohan, waray mga panapton nga sugad kamagtahom han usa hini nga mga bukad ha kapatagan.

en: But if God doth so clothe the grass in the field, which to-day is, and to-morrow is cast into the oven; how much more shall he clothe you, O ye of little faith?
war: An Dyos an nagpapanapton han mga banwa nga buhi yana nga adlaw, pagkabuwas waray na, sinusunog na ha hudno. Asay pa ba kamo nga diri kamo pagpapanaptonan niya? Pagkagutiay han iyo pagtoo!

en: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, and what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
war: Sanglit ayaw kamo pagpinangarit, nga dayuday la nababaraka hiunong han iyo kakaonon ngan iimnom.

en: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: but your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
war: (Kay dayuday la nababaraka hini ngatanan nga mga butang an mga diri dyosnon hini nga kalibutan.) Maaram an iyo Amay nga kinahanglan niyo ini nga mga butang.

en: Yet seek ye his kingdom, and these things shall be added unto you.
war: Lugod unaha niyo hin pagbiling an Ginhadian, ngan tatagan kamo niya hini nga mga butang.

en: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
war: “Ayaw kamo kahadlok, gutiay nga panon, kay nalilipay an Amay niyo hin paghatag ha iyo han Ginhadian.

en: Sell that which ye have, and give alms; make for yourselves purses which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief draweth near, neither moth destroyeth.
war: Ibaligya an ngatanan niyo nga mga garamiton, ngan ihatag an kwarta ha mga kablas. Pag-arog kamo para ha iyo ngahaw hin mga supot nga diri nadudumog, ngan tiroka an iyo mga manggad didto ha langit, diin diri gud ini maiibanan, kay waray kawatan nga makakakuha hini nga manggad ngan waray tangkob nga makakakutkot ha ira.

en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
war: Kon hain an imo mga manggad dayuday aadto man an imo kasingkasing.

en: Let your loins be girded about, and your lamps burning;
war: “Pag-andam dayuday kamo han bisan ano nga maabot, nga daan hinugtan ha hawak an iyo mga panapton, ngan daan dinagkotan an iyo mga suga,

en: and be ye yourselves like unto men looking for their lord, when he shall return from the marriage feast; that, when he cometh and knocketh, they may straightway open unto him.
war: sugad hin mga surugoon nga naghuhulat han ira agaron pagbalik tikang hin kombite han pagkasal. Aabrehan nira dayon an porta para ha iya, kon umabot ngan magtuktok hiya.

en: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them sit down to meat, and shall come and serve them.
war: Palaran adton mga surugoon nga hiabtan han agaron nga nagmamata ngan andam han iya pagbalik! Susumatan ko kamo, magbabakos hiya, palilingkoron niya hira ha pangaraonan, ngan pagdudurotan hira.

en: And if he shall come in the second watch, and if in the third, and find them so, blessed are those servants .
war: Palaran hira kon hiabtan hira nga andam, bisan kon umabot hiya ha katutnga, o ha kaagahon na!

en: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched, and not have left his house to be broken through.
war: Ngan tigamni ini: kon maaram la an tagbalay han takna han pag-abot han kawatan, diri gud hiya matugot nga sudlon an iya balay.

en: Be ye also ready: for in an hour that ye think not the Son of man cometh.
war: Ngan pag-andam man liwat kamo, kay maabot an Anak han Tawo ha takna nga diri niyo ginpapamulat hiya.”

en: And Peter said, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even unto all?
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro, “Ginoo, iginsusumat mo ba ini nga pananglitan para la ha amon, o para ba ini han ngatanan?”

en: And the Lord said, Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall set over his household, to give them their portion of food in due season?
war: Binmaton an Ginoo, “Hin-o man ngay-an an matinumanon ngan may-ada aram nga surugoon? Amo hiya an tataporan han iya agaron pagdumara han panimalay ngan paghatag ha iba nga mga surugoon han ira bahin han pagkaon, ha igo nga panahon.

en: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
war: Palaran adto nga surugoon nga hiabtan han iya agaron ha iya pagbalik, nga nagbubuhat hini!
