en: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will set him over all that he hath.
war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod, itatapod han agaron hadto nga surugoon an ngatanan nga iya mga manggad.

en: But if that servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
war: Kundi kon sumiring ha iya ngahaw adto nga surugoon, ‘Maiha pa bumalik an akon agaron,’ ngan magtikang hiya pagpinanlatob han iba nga surugoon nga kalalaken-an ug kababayen-an, ngan pagkinaon, pag-ininom, ngan paghinubog,

en: the lord of that servant shall come in a day when he expecteth not, and in an hour when he knoweth not, and shall cut him asunder, and appoint his portion with the unfaithful.
war: niyan maoli an agaron ha adlaw nga diri hiya ginpapamulat han surugoon, ngan ha takna nga diri niya hinbabaroan. Pagkakastigohon hiya han iya agaron, ngan paaangbiton hiya han sirot han mga diri magsinugtanon.

en: And that servant, who knew his lord’s will, and made not ready, nor did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes ;
war: “An surugoon nga maaram han karuyag igpabuhat ha iya han iya agaron, kundi diri nag-aandam ngan diri nagbubuhat han karuyag han iya agaron, pagkakastigohon hin damo nga paglatob;

en: but he that knew not, and did things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes . And to whomsoever much is given, of him shall much be required: and to whom they commit much, of him will they ask the more.
war: kundi an surugoon nga diri maaram han karuyag han iya agaron, ngan nagbubuhat hin butang nga angay hin paglatob, pagkakastigohon hin diri damo nga paglatob. An tawo nga gintagan hin damo aaroan hin damo; ngan an tawo nga gintagan hin darudamo aaroan liwat hin darudamo.

en: I came to cast fire upon the earth; and what do I desire, if it is already kindled?
war: “Kinmanhi ako hin pagsunog han tuna; karuyag ko unta nga magdilaab na ini!

en: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
war: May-ada bunyag nga akon kakarawaton nga diri ako mahimumutang tubtob nga matapos ini!

en: Think ye that I am come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
war: Naghunahuna ba kamo nga kinmanhi ako hin pagdara hin kalinaw nganhi ha kalibutan? Susumatan ko kamo, diri an kalinaw, kundi an pagkabahinbahin.

en: for there shall be from henceforth five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
war: Tikang yana, mababahin in panimalay nga may lima nga mga sakop, an tulo kontra han duha, ug an duha kontra han tulo.

en: They shall be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother in law against her daughter in law, and daughter in law against her mother in law.
war: Makontra an mga amay han ira mga anak nga kalalaken-an, ngan an mga anak nga kalalaken-an makontra han ira mga amay; makontra an mga iroy han ira mga anak nga kababayen-an, ngan an mga anak nga kababayen-an makontra han ira mga iroy; makontra an ugangan nga kababayen-an han ira umagad nga kababayen-an, ngan an umagad nga kababayen-an makontra han ira ugangan nga kababayen-an.”

en: And he said to the multitudes also, When ye see a cloud rising in the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it cometh to pass.
war: Nagsiring liwat hi Jesus ngadto han mga tawo, “Kon nakita kamo hin dampog nga tikang ha katundan, nasiring kamo dayon, ‘Mauran gud ada,’ ngan nauran manggud.

en: And when ye see a south wind blowing, ye say, There will be a scorching heat; and it cometh to pass.
war: Ngan kon naabat kamo nga nahangin an timog, nasiring kamo, ‘Magmamapaso ada,’ ngan nagmamapaso manggud.

en: Ye hypocrites, ye know how to interpret the face of the earth and the heaven; but how is it that ye know not how to interpret this time?
war: Mga salingkapaw! Nakita la kamo han tuna ngan han langit, ngan nababaro kamo han panahon; kay ano man nga diri kamo nakakahubad han kahulogan hini yana nga panahon?

en: And why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
war: “Kay ano nga diri man kamo magtirutimbang kon ano an angay buhaton?

en: For as thou art going with thine adversary before the magistrate, on the way give diligence to be quit of him; lest haply he drag thee unto the judge, and the judge shall deliver thee to the officer, and the officer shall cast thee into prison.
war: Kon igsumbong ka hin usa ka tawo, ngan dad-on ka ha hukmanan, talingohaa pakighusay ha iya samtang aada pa kamo ha dalan, basi diri ka danason niya ha atubangan han maghurukom, ngan itubyan ka han maghurukom ngadto han polis, ngan prisohon ka han polis.

en: Now there were some present at that very season who told him of the Galilæans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
war: Hito nga panahon may mga tawo didto nga nagsumat kan Jesus hiunong han mga taga-Galilea nga ginpamatay ni Pilato samtang naghahalad hira ngadto han Dyos.

en: And he answered and said unto them, Think ye that these Galilæans were sinners above all the Galilæans, because they have suffered these things?
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Tungod nga pinanmatay ini nga mga taga-Galilea hin sugad nga paagi, naghuhunahuna ba kamo nga nagpapamatuod ini nga mas makasasala hira kay han iba nga mga taga-Galilea?

en: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all in like manner perish.
war: Diri! Susumatan ko kamo nga kon diri kamo bumaya han iyo mga sala, mapatay kamo ngatanan sugad ha ira.

en: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and killed them, think ye that they were offenders above all the men that dwell in Jerusalem?
war: Ano man an hiunong han 18 nga nagkamatay ha Siloe, han kadat-ogi ha ira han lantawan? Naghuhunahuna ba kamo nga nagpapamatuod ini nga mas makasasala hira kay han iba nga mga tawo nga nag-uokoy ha Jerusalem?

en: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
war: Diri! Susumatan ko kamo nga kon diri kamo bumaya han iyo mga sala, mapatay kamo ngatanan sugad ha ira.”

en: And he spake this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came seeking fruit thereon, and found none.
war: Ngan nagsumat ha ira hi Jesus hini nga pananglitan: “May hadto usa ka tawo nga may kahoy nga igos nga naturok ha iya uma. Nakadto hiya hin pamiling han bunga, kundi waray makaagi.

en: And he said unto the vinedresser, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why doth it also cumber the ground?
war: Sanglit ginsiring niya an iya magbarantay han tanaman, ‘Kitaa daw, tulo na ka tuig an akon pagbinalikbalik nganhi pangita hin bunga hini nga igos, kundi waray ko hin-aagian. Gabay pudlon ini nga kahoy, kay kanugon la han katambok han tuna?’

en: And he answering saith unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
war: Kundi binmaton an magbarantay, ‘Ayaw la pagpudla; pahagosa ta anay hin usa ka tuig. Liliboton ko hin pag-ukab ngan bubutangan ko hin abuno.

en: and if it bear fruit thenceforth, well ; but if not, thou shalt cut it down.
war: Manggad nala bumunga han sunod nga tuig; kay kon diri pa, amo na in pagpudla naton.’”

en: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath day.
war: Usa ka Adlaw nga Iparahuway, nagtutdo hi Jesus didto hin usa nga sinagoga.

en: And behold, a woman that had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years; and she was bowed together, and could in no wise lift herself up.
war: Nakadto in usa nga babaye nga may maraot nga espiritu ngan 18 na ka tuig an iya kasakit. Nakaob na gud hiya, ngan makuri na gud hiya makatadong.

en: And when Jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
war: Han paghikit-i ha iya ni Jesus, ginsiring hiya, “Babaye, talwas ka na han imo sakit!”

en: And he laid his hands upon her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
war: Idinuon ni Jesus an iya mga kamot ha iya, ngan nakatadong hiya dayon, ngan nagdayaw hiya han Dyos.

en: And the ruler of the synagogue, being moved with indignation because Jesus had healed on the sabbath, answered and said to the multitude, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the day of the sabbath.
war: Nasina an opisyal han sinagoga nga nagtambal hi Jesus ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway, sanglit nagsiring hiya ha mga tawo, “May unom ka adlaw diin kinahanglan magtrabaho kita; sanglit pakanhi kamo hin pagpatambal dida hito nga mga adlaw, kundi diri ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway!”

en: But the Lord answered him, and said, Ye hypocrites, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
war: Ginbaton hiya han Ginoo hin pagsiring, “Mga salingkapaw kamo! Bisan hin-o ha iyo maghuhubad han iya baka o asno tikang ha turubongan han hayop, ngan dadad-on ini ngadto ha gawas hin pagpainom ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan had bound, lo, these eighteen years, to have been loosed from this bond on the day of the sabbath?
war: Yana, iini in tulin ni Abraham nga gingapos ni Satanas sulod hin 18 na ka tuig; diri ba hiya huhubaran han iya mga gapos ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway?”

en: And as he said these things, all his adversaries were put to shame: and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
war: Tungod hini nga iya baton naawod an mga kaaway ni Jesus, samtang an ngatanan nga mga tawo nalipay tungod han ngatanan nga urosahon nga mga butang nga iya ginbuhat.

en: He said therefore, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I liken it?
war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus, “Ano an akon itatanding han Ginhadian han Dyos?

en: It is like unto a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his own garden; and it grew, and became a tree; and the birds of the heaven lodged in the branches thereof.
war: Sugad ini hin usa nga liso hin mustasa, nga ginkuha hin usa ka tawo ngan igintanom ha iya uma. Tinmubo an tanom, ngan nahimo nga kahoy, ngan ginsalagan han mga tamsi an mga sanga hini nga kahoy.”

en: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
war: Nagpakiana liwat hi Jesus, “Ano an akon itatanding han Ginhadian han Dyos?

en: It is like unto leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till it was all leavened.
war: Sugad ini hin patubo nga kinukuha hin usa nga babaye ngan isinasakot hin usa ka takos nga harina, tubtob han pagtubo han bug-os nga minasa.”

en: And he went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and journeying on unto Jerusalem.
war: Naglatas hi Jesus ha mga bungto ngan mga baryo, ngan nagtutdo samtang tipakadto hiya ha Jerusalem.

en: And one said unto him, Lord, are they few that are saved? And he said unto them,
war: May nagpakiana ha iya, “Tinuod ba nga gutiay la an matatalwas?”

en: Strive to enter in by the narrow door: for many, I say unto you, shall seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus,

en: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, open to us; and he shall answer and say to you, I know you not whence ye are;
war: “Tilingohaa niyo hin pagsulod han haligot nga porta, kay susumatan ko kamo nga damo in karuyag sumulod, kundi diri makakahimo.

en: then shall ye begin to say, We did eat and drink in thy presence, and thou didst teach in our streets;
war: Matukdaw an agaron han balay ngan sasadhan an porta. Ngan kon tumukdaw kamo ha gawas ngan magtikang hin pagtuktok ha porta nga masiring, ‘Abrehi kami!’ Mabaton hiya, ‘Diri ako maaram kon diin kamo tikang!’

en: and he shall say, I tell you, I know not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
war: Onina mabaton kamo, ‘Nagsasaro ngani kita, ngan nagtutdo ka ngani didto han amon bungto!’

en: There shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and yourselves cast forth without.
war: Masiring liwat hiya, ‘Diri gud ako maaram kon diin kamo tikang. Iwas kamo ha akon, kamo ngatanan nga maghuka nga mga tawo!’

en: And they shall come from the east and west, and from the north and south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
war: Mananangis ngan manliligot kamo han iyo mga ngipon, kon kumita na kamo didto han Ginhadian han Dyos kanda Abraham, Isaac, ug Jacob, ngan han ngatanan nga mga manaragna, samtang ilinabog kamo ha gawas!

en: And behold, there are last who shall be first, and there are first who shall be last.
war: Maabot in mga tawo tikang ha sinirangan ug katundan, ha amihanan ug timogan, ngan matangka ha lamesa didto han Ginhadian han Dyos.

en: In that very hour there came certain Pharisees, saying to him, Get thee out, and go hence: for Herod would fain kill thee.
war: Onina may mauuna nga nauorhe yana, ngan may mauorhe nga nauuna yana.”

en: And he said unto them, Go and say to that fox, Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures to-day and to-morrow, and the third day I am perfected.
war: Hito ngahaw nga takna, kinmadto kan Jesus in mga Parisiyo ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Kinahanglan gumawas ka dinhe ngan kumadto ha iba nga dapit, kay karuyag ni Herodes hin pagpatay ha imo.”

en: Nevertheless I must go on my way to-day and to-morrow and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Kadto na, sumati ito nga miro: ‘Nagpapaguwa ako hin mga yawa, ngan nananambal ako yana ug buwas, ngan huhumanon ko an akon buruhaton han pag-ikatulo ka adlaw.’

en: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that killeth the prophets, and stoneth them that are sent unto her! how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her own brood under her wings, and ye would not!
war: Kundi kinahanglan magpadayon ako han akon paglakat yana, buwas, ngan sangbuwas; kay diri gud mahihimo nga mamatay in usa nga manaragna labot dinhe ha Jerusalem.

en: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate : and I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
war: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Ginpamatay mo an mga manaragna, ginbato mo an mga magsarangyaw nga ginpadara han Dyos nganhi ha imo! Makadamo na ako karuyag mag-agak han ngatanan mo nga mga tawo, sugad gud hin ugang nga nagtitirok han iya mga piso ha ilarom han iya mga pako, kundi diri ka man natugot ha akon!

en: And it came to pass, when he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a sabbath to eat bread, that they were watching him.
war: Usa ka Adlaw nga Iparahuway, kinmadto hi Jesus hin pagkaon ha balay hin usa nga tinahod nga Parisiyo, ngan gin-ininaw hiya han mga tawo.

en: And behold, there was before him a certain man that had the dropsy.
war: Dinmaop kan Jesus in tawo nga nanhuhubag an mga bitiis ngan mga butkon.

en: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath, or not?
war: Ngan nagyakan hi Jesus ngan nagpakiana han mga magturutdo han Balaod ngan han mga Parisiyo, “Natugot ba an aton Balaod hin pagtambal ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway?”

en: But they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go.
war: Kundi waray hira pag-aringasa. Kinaptan ni Jesus an tawo, gintambal, ngan ginpalakat hiya.

en: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a well, and will not straightway draw him up on a sabbath day?
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kon may-ada niyo anak o baka nga mahinabo hin kahulog ngadto hin atabay ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway, diri ba niyo kukuhaon dayon hito ngahaw nga Adlaw nga Iparahuway?”

en: And they could not answer again unto these things.
war: Kundi waray hira makabaton ha iya hiunong hini.

en: And he spake a parable unto those that were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief seats; saying unto them,
war: Hinkit-an ni Jesus nga an mga dinapit nagpipili han gimaupayi nga mga lingkoran, sanglit iginsumat niya ini nga pananglitan ha ira ngatanan:

en: When thou art bidden of any man to a marriage feast, sit not down in the chief seat; lest haply a more honorable man than thou be bidden of him,
war: “Kon dapiton kamo ngadto hin kombite hin pagkasal, ayaw paglingkod didto han syahan ug gimamaupayi nga lingkoran. Bangin may gindapit nga mas dungganan pa kay ha imo,

en: and he that bade thee and him shall come and say to thee, Give this man place; and then thou shalt begin with shame to take the lowest place.
war: ngan masiring ha imo an nagdapit ha iyo nga duha, ‘Asay hiya palingkora hini nga lingkoran.’ Niyan maawod ka ngan malingkod ka didto han giuubosi nga lingkoran.

en: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest place; that when he that hath bidden thee cometh, he may say to thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have glory in the presence of all that sit at meat with thee.
war: Lugod, kon dapiton ka, kadto ngan lingkod ha giuubosi nga lingkoran, basi kon dumaop an nagdapit ha imo ngan sidngon ka, ‘Sangkay, balhin ngadto han syahan ug gimamaupayi nga lingkoran.’ Mapapasidunggan ka hini ha atubangan han ngatanan nga mga dinapit.

en: For every one that exalteth himself shall be humbled; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
war: Kay adton nagpapadako han iya kalugaringon pauubson; ngan adton magpaubos han iya kalugaringon padadakoon.”

en: And he said to him also that had bidden him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, nor thy kinsmen, nor rich neighbors; lest haply they also bid thee again, and a recompense be made thee.
war: Ngan ginsiring ni Jesus an tagbalay, “Kon mananagtawo ka, ayaw asay pagdapita an imo kasangkayan, o imo kabugtoan, o imo kauropdan, o imo riko nga mga kahigrani, kay bubulson ka nira hin pagdapita, ngan dida hini, mababaydan ka han imo ginbuhat.

en: But when thou makest a feast, bid the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
war: Kundi, kon mananagtawo ka asay lugod dapita an mga kablas, an mga lulid, an mga piay, ngan an mga buta.

en: and thou shalt be blessed; because they have not wherewith to recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed in the resurrection of the just.
war: Ngan magmamalipayon ka, kay diri man hira makakabalos ha imo. Babaloson ka han Dyos kon mabanhaw na an mag-upay nga mga tawo.”

en: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
war: Nakabati hini in usa han mga nalingkod ha lamesa, ngan nagsiring kan Jesus, “Pagkapalaran hadton mga malingkod ha kombite didto han Ginhadian han Dyos!”

en: But he said unto him, A certain man made a great supper; and he bade many:
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “May-ada hadto tawo nga nagdapit hin damo nga mga tawo ngadto han iya dako nga kombite.

en: and he sent forth his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
war: Ha takna nga andam na an kombite, ginsugo niya an iya surugoon hin pagsumat han iya mga gindapit nga mapakadto na, kay andam na an ngatanan.

en: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a field, and I must needs go out and see it; I pray thee have me excused.
war: Kundi nagsunodsunod hira ngatanan hin pamaribad. Nagsiring ha surugoon an syahan, ‘Nakapalit ako hin tuna, ngan kinahanglan kadtoon nga kitaon ko anay. Pasayloa na la ako.’

en: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them; I pray thee have me excused.
war: Nagsiring an ikaduha, ‘Nakapalit ako hin lima ka padis nga baka ngan tikadto na ako kay sasarihan ko hin paggamit. Pasayloa na la ako.’

en: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
war: Nagsiring in lain pa, ‘Bag-o pa la ako nga nakaasawa, ngan tungod hini, diri ako makakakadto.’

en: And the servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor and maimed and blind and lame.
war: Inmoli an surugoon ngan iginsumat ini ngatanan ha iya agaron. Duro an kapungot han agaron han balay, ngan nagsiring ha iya surugoon, ‘Dali, pakadto ha kadalanan ngan mga aragian han bungto, ngan dad-a nganhi an mga kablas, mga lulid, mga buta, ngan mga piay.’

en: And the servant said, Lord, what thou didst command is done, and yet there is room.
war: Waray pag-iha nagsiring an surugoon, ‘Natuman na an imo sugo, kundi may mga tarangkaan pa.’

en: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and constrain them to come in, that my house may be filled.
war: Sanglit nagsiring an agaron ha iya surugoon, ‘Kadto na ha kadalanan ngan mga aragian ha gawas han bungto, ngan pakanhia gud an mga tawo, basi mapuno an akon balay.

en: For I say unto you, that none of those men that were bidden shall taste of my supper.
war: Susumatan ko kamo ngatanan, nga waray hadton mga dinapit makakatilaw han akon panagtawo!’”

en: Now there went with him great multitudes: and he turned, and said unto them,
war: Binmunyog kan Jesus in damo gud nga mga tawo. Inatubang hira ni Jesus ngan sidngon,

en: If any man cometh unto me, and hateth not his own father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
war: “Diri mahihimo nga akon tinun-an bisan hin-o nga mapakadi ha akon, labot kon an iya paghigugma ha akon labaw pa han iya paghigugma han iya mga kag-anak, iya asawa, iya mga anak, iya kabugtoan, ngan han iya kalugaringon man.

en: Whosoever doth not bear his own cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
war: Diri mahihimo nga akon tinun-an an bisan hin-o nga diri magpas-an han iya kalugaringon nga kros ngan sumunod ha akon.

en: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doth not first sit down and count the cost, whether he have wherewith to complete it?
war: Kon may-ada ha iyo nakahunahuna hin pagtindog hin lantawan, nalingkod hiya anay, paiinoinohon niya kon pira an magagasto, basi makita niya kon may igo ba niya nga kwarta nga ighuhuman han lantawan.

en: Lest haply, when he hath laid a foundation, and is not able to finish, all that behold begin to mock him,
war: Kay kon diri sugaron hini, diri niya mahuhuman an lantawan, katapos niya igpahimutang an patukoran, ngan pagtitinawaan hiya han ngatanan nga makita hini nga kasugaran.

en: saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.
war: Masiring hira, ‘Maupay la ini nga tawo hin pagtikang, diri ngay-an maaram hin paghuman!’

en: Or what king, as he goeth to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and take counsel whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
war: Kon nagawas hin pakig-away in usa nga hadi nga may napulo ka yukot nga mga sondalo, kontra hin iba nga hadi nga may baynte ka yukot nga mga sondalo, malingkod hiya anay, ngan titirutimbangon niya kon may-ada na hiya kapas hin pakig-away hadto nga hadi.

en: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and asketh conditions of peace.
war: Kay kon waray, kinahanglan magpadara hiya hin mga tinaporan hin pakigkita han pangontra nga hadi, basi samtang hirayo pa hiya magsarabot na la hin paagi nga mahusay ug malinawon.

en: So therefore whosoever he be of you that renounceth not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
war: Ha amo nga paagi,” gintapos ni Jesus, “waray ha iyo mahihimo nga akon tinun-an, gawas kon isalikway niya an ngatanan nga iya mga butang.

en: Salt therefore is good: but if even the salt have lost its savor, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
war: “Maupay an asin, kundi kon magmatab-ang na, waray nagud paagi nga mahibalik an iya kapag-ad.

en: It is fit neither for the land nor for the dunghill: men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
war: Diri na ini maupay para ha tuna o magamit para hin pag-abuno; gabay na la ilabog. Sanglit, pamati kamo kon may niyo mga durunggan!”

en: Now all the publicans and sinners were drawing near unto him to hear him.
war: Usa ka panahon hinmarani hin pamati kan Jesus in damo nga mga parasukot hin buhis ngan mga makasasala.

en: And both the Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.
war: Nagtikang pagngurutob an mga Parisiyo ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod, “Nakarawat man ini nga tawo hin mga makasasala, ngan nakikigsaro pa ngani ha ira!”

en: And he spake unto them this parable, saying,
war: Sanglit ginsumatan hira ni Jesus hini nga pananglitan:

en: What man of you, having a hundred sheep, and having lost one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
war: “Pananglit usa ha iyo may usa ka gatos nga karnero, ngan mawara in usa ha ira—ano man an iya bubuhaton? Binabayaan niya an nobentay nuybe didto han panibsiban, ngan nalakat hiya hin pamiling han nawara, tubtob nga iya ini hiagian.

en: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
war: Kon hiagian na ini niya, malipayon na hiya, ngan papas-anon ini niya,

en: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and his neighbors, saying unto them, Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost.
war: ngan dadad-on hin pag-oli ngadto ha ira. Niyan, iya dadapiton an iya kasangkayan ngan mga kahigrani, ngan sisidngon niya, ‘Pagsaurog kita! Malipayon ako hin duro nga hinagian ko an akon nawara nga karnero!’

en: I say unto you, that even so there shall be joy in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine righteous persons, who need no repentance.
war: Ha amo nga paagi, susumatan ko kamo, mas dako an kalipay ha langit tungod hin usa nga nagbabasol nga makasasala kay hin nobentay nuybe nga magtadong nga diri nagkikinahanglan hin pagbasol.

en: Or what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a lamp, and sweep the house, and seek diligently until she find it?
war: “Pananglit nawad-an in babaye hin usa han iya napulo nga mga kwarta nga sensilyo, ano man an iya sadang buhaton? Nadagkot hiya hin suga, sisilhigan niya an iya balay, ngan pinanginginano gud an ngatanan nga dapit, tubtob nga hiagian niya an usa nga kwarta nga sensilyo.

en: And when she hath found it, she calleth together her friends and neighbors, saying, Rejoice with me, for I have found the piece which I had lost.
war: Kon iya hiagian, tatawagon niya an iya kasangkayan ngan mga kahigrani ngan sisidngon niya, ‘Malipayon ako hin duro nga hin-agian ko an akon nawara nga kwarta! Pagsaurog kita!’

en: Even so, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.
war: Ha amo nga paagi, susumatan ko kamo, nalilipay an mga anghel han Dyos, tungod hin usa nga makasasala nga nabaya na han sala.”

en: And he said, A certain man had two sons:
war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring, “May hadto usa ka tawo nga may-ada duha nga anak nga lalake.

en: and the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of thy substance that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
war: Nagsiring ha iya an manghod, ‘Tatay, tagi na ako yana han akon malon han mga hiagi.’ Sanglit ginbahin han tawo an iya mga hiagi ngan ihatag ngadto han duha niya nga anak.

en: And not many days after, the younger son gathered all together and took his journey into a far country; and there he wasted his substance with riotous living.
war: Paghagos hin pira ka adlaw iginbaligya han manghod an iya bahin ngan binmaya han ira panimalay dara an kwarta. Kinmadto hiya hin hirayo nga tuna, diin iya ginkaragan an iya kwarta hin waray pulos nga kinabuhi.

en: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that country; and he began to be in want.
war: Gingasto niya an ngatanan nga iya dara. Dinmuroy nga inmabot in dako nga gutom didto hadto nga dapit, ngan nawarayan hiya bisan ano.

en: And he went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
war: Sanglit kinmadto hiya hin pagtrabaho didto hin usa han mga tuminungnong hadto nga tuna ngan ginsugo hiya ngadto ha uma para hin pagmangno hin kababoyan.

en: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
war: Karuyag unta niya hin pagkaon han itinutubong han kababoyan, kundi waray man nahatag ha iya hin ano man nga pagkaon.

en: But when he came to himself he said, How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough and to spare, and I perish here with hunger!
war: Ha kataposan, nakapanmurubuot hiya ngan nagsiring, ‘Patakas hin pagkaon an ngatanan nga surugoon ni Tatay, ngan hahani ako dinhe nga haros mamatay na hin gutom!

en: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight:
war: Mabangon ako ngan makadto han akon tatay ngan masiring, “Tatay, nakasala ako han Dyos ngan ha imo.

en: I am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.
war: Diri na ako takos nga isipon pa nga imo anak. Isipa na la ako nga usa han imo mga surugoon.” ’

en: And he arose, and came to his father. But while he was yet afar off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
war: Sanglit binmuhat hiya ngan linmakat pag-uli ngadto han amay niya.

en: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight: I am no more worthy to be called thy son.
war: “Hirayo pa hiya han balay nga hikit-an hiya han iya amay. Inalpan hin dako nga kalooy an iya tatay, nga nagdalagan hin pagtapo ha iya, ngan gin-gakos ngan ginhadkan hiya.

en: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth quickly the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
war: Ngan nagsiring an anak, ‘Tatay, nakasala ako han Dyos ngan ha imo, sanglit diri na ako takos isipon pa nga imo anak.’

en: and bring the fatted calf, and kill it, and let us eat, and make merry:
war: Kundi gintawag han amay an iya mga surugoon, ngan sidngon, ‘Dali, kuhaa an gimamaupayi nga panapton ngan isul-ot ha iya, singsingi, ngan sapatosi hiya.

en: for this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
war: Katapos, kuhaa ngan ihawa niyo an pinatambok nga nati nga baka, ngan pagkombite kita!

en: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard music and dancing.
war: Kay patay na ini nga akon anak, kundi yana buhi na hiya; nawara hiya, kundi yana hin-agian na hiya.’ Ngan nagtikang hira pagkalipay.

en: And he called to him one of the servants, and inquired what these things might be.
war: “Hito nga takna, nakadto ha uma an magurang nga anak. Han pag-uli na niya, han hiraniay na hiya han balay, hinbatian niya an tukar ngan sarayaw.

en: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
war: Gintawag niya in usa han mga surugoon ngan nagpakiana ha iya, ‘Ano ini nga rugyaw?’

en: But he was angry, and would not go in: and his father came out, and entreated him.
war: Nagbaton an surugoon, ‘Inmoli an imo bugto ngan iginpaihaw ni imo tatay an pinatambok nga nati nga baka, kay inmoli hiya nga maupay an lawas.’

en: But he answered and said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, and I never transgressed a commandment of thine; and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
war: Duro an kapungot han magurang nga bugto, sanglit waray hiya sumulod han balay; ginmawas an amay niya ngan ginhangyo nga sumulod hiya.

en: but when this thy son came, who hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou killedst for him the fatted calf.
war: Ginbaton niya hi iya Tatay, ‘Hunahunaa daw! Sulod hini nga mga katuigan nagbudlay ako sugad hin oripon para ha imo, ngan waray gud ako sumupak han imo mga sugo bisan makausa. Ano in ginhatag nimo ha akon? Waray ngani bisan naman la kanding nga igpapahalipay ko han akon kasangkayan!

en: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that is mine is thine.
war: Kundi ginkaragan hini nga imo anak an ngatanan mo nga hiagi ha maraot nga kinabuhi, ngan ha iya pag-oli, asay mo lugod gin-ihawan han pinatambok nga nati nga baka!’

en: But it was meet to make merry and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again ; and was lost, and is found.
war: Nagbaton ha iya an amay, ‘Anak ko, dayuday ko ikaw nga kaupod dinhe, ngan imo an ngatanan nga akon mga butang.

en: And he said also unto the disciples, There was a certain rich man, who had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he was wasting his goods.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “May-ada hadto usa nga riko nga may-ada niya tinaporan. Nasumatan ini nga riko nga tawo, nga ginkikinaragan la han tinaporan an kwarta han iya agaron.

en: And he called him, and said unto him, What is this that I hear of thee? render the account of thy stewardship; for thou canst be no longer steward.
war: Sanglit iginpatawag ini nga tinaporan ngan ginsiring, ‘Ano ba ini nga akon hinbabatian hiunong ha imo? Hala, tuhayi daw ako han ngatanan nga akon igintapod ha imo, kay diri ka na magigin tinaporan ko.’

en: And the steward said within himself, What shall I do, seeing that my lord taketh away the stewardship from me? I have not strength to dig; to beg I am ashamed.
war: Nagsiring ha iya ngahaw ini nga tinaporan, ‘Ta, kukuhaan na daw ako han akon agaron han akon pagkatinaporan. Ano daw an sadang ko buhaton? Diri man ako mailob hin paghornal kay maluyahon ako, ngan makaarawod in pakilimos.

en: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
war: Yana, maaram ako kon ano an akon bubuhaton, basi kon mawaray na ako trabaho, mamamay-ada ako kasangkayan nga makarawat ha akon ha ira panimalay.’

en: And calling to him each one of his lord’s debtors, he said to the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
war: Sanglit iginpatawag niya an ngatanan nga nakautang han iya agaron. Ginsiring niya an syahan, ‘Pira an imo nautang han akon agaron?’

en: And he said, A hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bond, and sit down quickly and write fifty.
war: ‘Usa ka gatos ka baril nga lana hin olibo,’ nagbaton hiya. Nagsiring ha iya an tinaporan, ‘Iya, iini an imo resibo. Lingkod ngan liwata. Ibutang nga 50 la ka baril.’

en: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, A hundred measures of wheat. He saith unto him, Take thy bond, and write fourscore.
war: Nagpakiana an tinaporan ha lain nga nakautang, ‘Ikaw, pira man an imo nautang?’ ‘Usa ka gatos ka bakid nga trigo,’ nagbaton hiya. Nagsiring ha iya an tinaporan, ‘Iya, iini an imo resibo. Lingkod ngan liwata. Ibutang nga 80 la.’

en: And his lord commended the unrighteous steward because he had done wisely: for the sons of this world are for their own generation wiser than the sons of the light.
war: Nagdayaw ha iya an agaron hini nga diri tangkod nga tinaporan tungod han iya kamaaram; kay an mga tawo hini nga kalibutan labi pa kamaaram hin pagdumara han ira mga buruhaton kay han mga tawo nga sakop han kapawa.”

en: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends by means of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when it shall fail, they may receive you into the eternal tabernacles.
war: Ngan nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring: “Sanglit susumatan ko kamo: gamit hin manggad nga kalibutanon hin pagkabig hin kasangkayan, basi kon maubos na an manggad, kakarawton kamo didto han dayon nga urokyan.

en: He that is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much: and he that is unrighteous in a very little is unrighteous also in much.
war: Adton kasasarigan hin gudti nga butang, kasasarigan man liwat hin dagko nga mga butang; adton diri tangkod hin talagudti nga butang, diri liwat tangkod ha mga dagko nga butang.

en: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches ?
war: Sanglit kon diri ka kasarigan hin pagdumara hin manggad nga kalibutanon, uunanhon hin pagtapori ha imo hin matuod nga manggad?

en: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
war: Ngan kon diri ka kasarigan han mga butang hin iba, hin-o man in mahatag ha imo han imo kalugaringon nga mga butang?

en: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
war: “Waray surugoon nga maooripon hin duha nga agaron, kay mahinanabo nga iya pagdudumtan an usa, ngan paghihigugmaon niya an ikaduha; magmamatinumanon hiya ha usa, ngan pagtatamayon niya an ikaduha. Diri mahihimo nga dunganon in pagsirbe han Dyos ngan han kwarta.”

en: And the Pharisees, who were lovers of money, heard all these things; and they scoffed at him.
war: Hinbatian han mga Parisiyo ini ngatanan, ngan gintinawaan la nira hi Jesus, kay makisalapi hira.

en: And he said unto them, Ye are they that justify yourselves in the sight of men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Amo kamo an nagpapakamatadong ha atubangan han mga tawo, kundi maaram an Dyos han iyo mga kasingkasing. Kay an gin-iisip nga mahal hin duro han mga tawo waray la pulos ha atubangan han Dyos.

en: The law and the prophets were until John: from that time the gospel of the kingdom of God is preached, and every man entereth violently into it.
war: “Tubtob la han panahon ni Juan nga Parabunyag an Balaod ni Moises ngan an mga sinurat han mga manaragna. Tikang hadto iginwawali na an Maupay nga Sumat hiunong han Ginhadian han Dyos, ngan nagpipirit hin pagsulod an ngatanan.

en: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than for one tittle of the law to fall.
war: Kundi masarusayon pa an pagpapas han langit ngan han tuna kay han pagkawara han gigugutiayi nga bahin han Balaod.

en: Every one that putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and he that marrieth one that is put away from a husband committeth adultery.
war: “Nakakasala hin panlibog an hin-o man nga lalake nga nabulag han iya asawa ngan nangangasawa hin iba nga babaye; ngan nakakasala hin panlibog an lalake nga nangangasawa hin binulagan nga babaye.

en: Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, faring sumptuously every day:
war: “May-ada hadto usa nga riko nga nagbabado han gimamahali nga mga panapton ngan nagpapatakas han iya mga bahandi ha adlaw-adlaw.

en: and a certain beggar named Lazarus was laid at his gate, full of sores,
war: May-ada man liwat usa nga makililimos nga Lazaro an ngaran, nga lukop an iya lawas hin mga katol. Agsob hiya dad-on ngadto han porta han riko,

en: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table; yea, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
war: kay hingyap niya nga makakaon hiya han mga natataktak nga pagkaon tikang han lamesa han riko. Nadaop bisan an mga ayam hin pagdilap han iya mga kaduntan.

en: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and that he was carried away by the angels into Abraham’s bosom: and the rich man also died, and was buried.
war: Namatay an makililimos ngan gindara han anghel ngadto ha sapit ni Abraham, didto han kombite ha langit. Namatay man liwat an riko ngan iginlubong,

en: And in Hades he lifted up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
war: ngan nahingadto hiya ha dako nga kasakitan ha impyerno. Paghangad niya, hinkit-an niya hi Abraham hirayo ha iya, ngan nasapit hi Lazaro ha iya.

en: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am in anguish in this flame.
war: Sanglit ginmoliat hiya, ‘Amay nga Abraham! Kalooyi gad ako, ngan ipadara ngadi hi Lazaro hin pagtunlob han iya tudlo ha tubig, basi pahagkotan an akon dila, kay ginsasakit ako dida hini nga kalayo!’

en: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and Lazarus in like manner evil things: but now here he is comforted, and thou art in anguish.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Abraham, ‘Panumdom, anak ko, nga han buhi ka pa, nahiagom ka na han ngatanan nga mag-upay nga mga butang, samtang hi Lazaro, nahiagom la han ngatanan nga magraot; kundi yana nagpapahimulos na hiya han mga kalipayan didi, samtang aada ka ha kasakitan.

en: And besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that they that would pass from hence to you may not be able, and that none may cross over from thence to us.
war: Labot la hito ngatanan, may hiluag nga wada ha butnga naton, sanglit diri makakahimo nga an karuyag tumabok didi hin pagkadto ha iyo, sugad man an karuyag tumabok didto hin pagkadi ha amon.’

en: And he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father’s house;
war: Nagsiring an riko, ‘Amay, kon amo man ito, nakikimalooy ako ha imo nga sugoon mo hi Lazaro ngadto ha balay han akon amay,

en: for I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
war: diin may-ada ko lima pa nga kabugtoan nga kalalaken-an. Pakadtoa gad hiya hin pagpahimangno ha ira, basi diri liwat hira mahinganhi hini nga dapit han kasakitan.’

en: But Abraham saith, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
war: Nagsiring hi Abraham, ‘Aadto na hira Moises ngan an mga manaragna nga magpapahimangno han imo kabugtoan. Kinahanglan mamati hira han ira igsisiring.’

en: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one go to them from the dead, they will repent.
war: Nagbaton an riko, ‘Diri pa ito igo, amay nga Abraham! Kundi kon may mabanhaw ngan kumadto ha ira, mabaya gud hira han ira mga sala.’

en: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, if one rise from the dead.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Abraham, ‘Kon diri hira mamati kan Moises ngan han mga manaragna, diri hira malulukmay, bisan pa kon may mabanhaw tikang han mga minatay.’”

en: And he said unto his disciples, It is impossible but that occasions of stumbling should come; but woe unto him, through whom they come!
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Mahinanabo manta in mga butang nga makakapasala han tawo; kundi kairo han tawo nga magigin tinikangan han sala!

en: It were well for him if a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
war: Mauruupay pa ha iya kon higtan an iya liog hin dako nga gilingan nga bato, ngan itunod hiya ngadto ha dagat, kay nga matinikangan hiya hin pakasala hini nga gudtiay nga kabataan.

en: Take heed to yourselves: if thy brother sin, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
war: Pagbantay gud kamo!

en: And if he sin against thee seven times in the day, and seven times turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.
war: “Kon makasala an imo bugto, sawaya hiya; ngan kon magbasol hiya, pasayloa.

en: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
war: Kon makasala hiya ha imo makapito ha usa ka adlaw, ngan ha kada niya pakakasala, makada ha imo ngan masiring nga nagbabasol hiya, kinahanglan pasayloon mo hiya.”

en: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye would say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou rooted up, and be thou planted in the sea; and it would obey you.
war: Nagsiring ha Ginoo an mga apostol, “Dugangi gad an amon pagtoo.”

en: But who is there of you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say unto him, when he is come in from the field, Come straightway and sit down to meat;
war: Nagbaton an Ginoo, “Kon may niyo pagtoo nga sugad kadako hin liso hin mustasa, makakasiring kamo hini nga kahoy nga sikomoro, ‘Magabot ka ngan mahitanom ka ha dagat!’ ngan masugot ito ha iyo.

en: and will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
war: “Pananglit usa ha iyo may surugoon nga nag-aarado o nagmamangno hin mga karnero. Kon naabot hiya tikang ha uma, nasiring ba kamo ha iya, ‘Dagmit ngan kaona an imo pagkaon?’

en: Doth he thank the servant because he did the things that were commanded?
war: Diri amo ito! Lugod, nasiring kamo ha iya, ‘Andama an akon panihapon, kahuman, isul-ot an imo tapis ngan sirbehi ako samtang nakaon ako ngan nainom; katapos ikaw na man an makaon ngan mainom.’

en: Even so ye also, when ye shall have done all the things that are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants; we have done that which it was our duty to do.
war: Diri angay an surugoon nga magpasalamat tungod han iya pagsugot, di ba?

en: And it came to pass, as they were on the way to Jerusalem, that he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.
war: Amo man ito ha iyo; kon ginbuhat na niyo an ngatanan nga iginpabuhat ha iyo, masiring kamo, ‘Mga surugoon la kami; gintuman la namon an amon katungdanan.’”

en: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, who stood afar off:
war: Han tipakadto hi Jesus ha Jerusalem, nag-agi hiya ha pag-ultan han Samaria ug Galilea.

en: and they lifted up their voices, saying, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
war: Tipakadto hiya hin usa nga baryo nga tapoon hiya hin napulo nga mga sanlahon. Tay-aw la ini hira.

en: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go and show yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, as they went, they were cleansed.
war: Naggoliat hira hin pagsiring, “Jesus! Agaron! Kalooyi gad kami!”

en: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, with a loud voice glorifying God;
war: Hinkit-an hira ni Jesus ngan ginsiring, “Kadto na, ngan pausisa kamo han kapadian.”

en: and he fell upon his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
war: Nalinisan hira han tipakadto pa la hira.

en: And Jesus answering said, Were not the ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
war: Usa ha ira, han pakakita nga upay na hiya, binmalik nga nagdadayaw han Dyos hin dako nga tingog.

en: Were there none found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger?
war: Hinmapa hiya ha tiilan ni Jesus hin pagpasalamat ha iya. Usa hiya nga Samaritano.

en: And he said unto him, Arise, and go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
war: Nagyakan hi Jesus, “Napulo man adto hira nga nagkalilinisan; hain naman an siyam?

en: And being asked by the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God cometh, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:
war: Kay ano nga ini la nga diri dinhianon an binmalik hin pagpasalamat han Dyos?”

en: neither shall they say, Lo, here! or, There! for lo, the kingdom of God is within you.
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Buhat ngan lakat. An imo pagtoo amo an nakaupay ha imo.”

en: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.
war: Nagpakiana kan Jesus in pira nga mga Parisiyo kon san-o maabot an Ginhadian han Dyos. Nagbaton hiya, “Diri maabot an Ginhadian han Dyos hin paagi nga makikita.

en: And they shall say to you, Lo, there! Lo, here! go not away, nor follow after them :
war: Waray masiring, ‘Kitaa, hahani na!’ o ‘Aadto na!’ kay aada ha sakob niyo an Ginhadian han Dyos.”

en: for as the lightning, when it lighteneth out of the one part under the heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall the Son of man be in his day.
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ha mga tinun-an, “Maabot in panahon nga maungara kamo nga makakita kamo hin usa han mga adlaw han Anak han Tawo, kundi diri kamo makakakita hini.

en: But first must he suffer many things and be rejected of this generation.
war: May-ada ha ira masiring ha iyo, ‘Kitaa, aadto didto!’ o, ‘Kitaa, aadi didi!’ Kundi ayaw kamo pagkadto hin pamiling hito.

en: And as it came to pass in the days of Noah, even so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
war: Sugad han kikidlat nga naidlap pataboktabok han langit tikang ha usa nga bahin hini ngadto han luyo, amo man liwat ini an pag-abot han Anak han Tawo.

en: They ate, they drank, they married, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
war: Kundi kinahanglan mag-antos hiya anay ngan igsalikway han mga tawo hini nga panahon.

en: Likewise even as it came to pass in the days of Lot; they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
war: Sugad an nahinabo han panahon ni Noe amo man an mahinanabo kon umabot na an Anak han Tawo.

en: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all:
war: Nagpadayon an ngatanan hin pagpinangaon ug pag-ininom, nag-aragsawa an kalalaken-an ug kababayen-an, ngada han adlaw han pagsulod ni Noe han arka; ngan inmabot an lunop, nga amo an nakamatay ha ira ngatanan.

en: after the same manner shall it be in the day that the Son of man is revealed.
war: Masusugad liwat ini han panahon ni Lot. Nagpadayon an ngatanan hin pagpinangaon ug pag-ininom; pagpinamalit ngan pagpinamaligya, pagpinananom ngan pagpinanmalay.

en: In that day, he that shall be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away: and let him that is in the field likewise not return back.
war: Ha adlaw han paggawas ni Lot ha Sodoma, inmuran hin kalayo ug asupre tikang ha langit, nga amo an nakamatay ha ira ngatanan.

en: Remember Lot’s wife.
war: Amo liwat ini an mahinanabo kon magpadayag na an Anak han Tawo.

en: Whosoever shall seek to gain his life shall lose it: but whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
war: “Hadto nga adlaw an aadto ha atop han iya balay kinahanglan diri na lumusad hin pagkuha han iya mga garamiton nga aadto ha sakob han iya balay. Sugad man, kinahanglan diri na umoli ha balay an aadto ha uma.

en: I say unto you, In that night there shall be two men on one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
war: Hinumdomi niyo an asawa ni Lot!

en: There shall be two women grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
war: An nagtitingoha hin pagtalwas han iya kalugaringon nga kinabuhi ini mawawara ha iya; kundi adton kawad-an han iya kinabuhi matatalwas.
Susumatan ko kamo: hito nga gab-i, makaturog in duha ka tawo ha usa nga higdaan kukuhaon an usa ngan ibibilin an ikaduha.

en: And they answering say unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Where the body is , thither will the eagles also be gathered together.
war: Magbubulig hin paggiling in duha nga babaye; kukuhaon an usa ngan ibibilin an ikaduha.”

en: And he spake a parable unto them to the end that they ought always to pray, and not to faint;
war: Niyan, nagsumat hin pananglitan hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an hin pagtutdo ha ira nga kinahanglanon an dayuday nga pag-ampo, ngan diri gud magturaw.

en: saying, There was in a city a judge, who feared not God, and regarded not man:
war: “May-ada hadto usa nga maghurukom hin usa nga bungto, nga waray pagkahadlok han Dyos ngan waray pagtahod han mga tawo.

en: and there was a widow in that city; and she came oft unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
war: Ngan may-ada balo nga babaye hito ngahaw nga bungto, nga nagkikinadto hin pakimalooy ha iya: ‘Buligi gad ako kontra han akon kaaway!’

en: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
war: Hin maiha nga panahon ginpasibay-an la ini han maghurukom, kundi ha kataposan nagsiring an maghurukom ha iya ngahaw, ‘Bisan kon waray ako pagkahadlok han Dyos o pagtahod han mga tawo,

en: yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest she wear me out by her continual coming.
war: kundi tungod kay nakakasamok man ha akon ini nga balo nga babaye, tatalingohaon ko nala nga katagan hiya han iya katungod; kay kon diri ko ini sugaron, magbibinalikbalik hiya nganhi ngan bangin ako kaubosan hin pag-ilob, tungod han iya padayon nga pagbinalikbalik!’”

en: And the Lord said, Hear what the unrighteous judge saith.
war: Ngan nagpadayon an Ginoo, “Paghunahunaa daw an iginsiring hadto nga maraot nga maghurukom.

en: And shall not God avenge his elect, that cry to him day and night, and yet he is longsuffering over them?
war: Niyan, kon maghukom an Dyos diri ba hiya maugop han iya kalugaringon nga mga tawo nga nasangpit ha iya adlaw gab-i hin pakibulig? Maglalangan ba hiya hin pagbulig ha ira?

en: I say unto you, that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless, when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
war: Susumatan ko kamo, maugop hiya ha ira, ngan bubuhaton ito dayon niya. Kundi kon bumalik na an Anak han Tawo, makakaagi ba hiya hin pagtoo dinhe ha tuna?”

en: And he spake also this parable unto certain who trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and set all others at nought:
war: Iginsumat liwat ni Jesus ini nga pananglitan ha mga tawo nga natapod ha ira kalugaringon nga kamaupay, ngan nagtatamay han iba:

en: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
war: “Kinmadto ha Templo hin pag-ampo in duha ka tawo; Parisiyo an usa, ngan parasukot hin buhis an ikaduha.

en: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as the rest of men, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
war: Tinmukdaw nga tay-aw an Parisiyo, ngan nag-ampo: ‘Nagpapasalamat ako ha imo, Dyos, nga diri ako halot, malimbong, o malibog sugad han iba. Nagpasalamat ako ha imo nga diri ako sugad hito nga parasukot hin buhis.

en: I fast twice in the week; I give tithes of all that I get.
war: Nagpupuasa ako duha ka adlaw kada semana, ngan nahatag ako ha imo han ikanapulo nga bahin han ngatanan ko nga hiagi.’

en: But the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote his breast, saying, God, be thou merciful to me a sinner.
war: Kundi tinmukdaw an parasukot hin buhis, hirayo han iba, ngan waray ngani humangad ha langit, kundi nagpukpok han iya dughan ngan nagsiring, ‘O Dyos, kalooyi gad ako nga makasasala!’”

en: I say unto you, This man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be humbled; but he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo, an parasukot hin buhis, diri an Parisiyo an gin-isip nga matadong ha atubangan han Dyos, han pag-oli niya. Kay an magpahitaas han iya kalugaringon pauubson, ngan an magpaubos pahihitas-on.”

en: And they were bringing unto him also their babes, that he should touch them: but when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
war: May mga tawo nga nagdara ngadto kan Jesus han ira mga gudtiay nga kabataan, basi pandongan hira han iya mga kamot. Kundi hinkit-an hira han mga tinun-an, ngan nasinahan hira tungod han ira ginbubuhat.

en: But Jesus called them unto him, saying, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for to such belongeth the kingdom of God.
war: Kundi gintawag ni Jesus an kabataan ngada ha iya, ngan nagsiring, “Padaopa ha akon an kabataan, ngan ayaw hira pagdid-i, kay an Ginhadian han Dyos para la hadton sugad ha ira.

en: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall in no wise enter therein.
war: Tigamni ini: an diri kumarawat han Ginhadian han Dyos sugad hin bata, diri gud makakasulod han Ginhadian.”

en: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
war: Nagpakiana kan Jesus in usa nga pangulo nga Judiyo, “Maupay nga Magturutdo, ano an sadang ko buhaton basi makakarawat ako han dayon nga kinabuhi?”

en: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, even God.
war: Nagpakiana man hi Jesus, “Kay ano hin pagtawga mo ha akon nga maupay? Waray iba nga maupay labot han Dyos.

en: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honor thy father and mother.
war: Maaram ka man han mga sugo: ‘Diri ka manlibog; diri ka magpatay; diri ka mangawat; diri ka magbuwa; tahoron mo an imo mga kag-anak.’”

en: And he said, All these things have I observed from my youth up.
war: Nagbaton an tawo, “Gintuman ko na ini ngatanan nga mga sugo tikang pa han akon kabata.”

en: And when Jesus heard it, he said unto him, One thing thou lackest yet: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
war: Han pakabati ni Jesus hini, nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Kinahanglan buhaton mo in usa pa nga butang. Ibaligya an ngatanan mo nga hiagi, ngan ihatag an kwarta ha mga kablas, ngan makakaangkon ka hin mga manggad ha langit; katapos, balik ngan sunod ha akon.”

en: But when he heard these things, he became exceeding sorrowful; for he was very rich.
war: Kundi han pakabati niya hini, duro an iya kasubo, kay riko hiya hin duro.

en: And Jesus seeing him said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
war: Hinkit-an ni Jesus nga nagmabidoon hiya, ngan nagsiring, “Kamakuri para hin riko nga mga tawo hin pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos!

en: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
war: Labaw pa kamakuri para hin riko pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos, kay hin kamelyo pagsuhot ha tanogan hin dagom.”

en: And they that heard it said, Then who can be saved?
war: Nagpakiana an mga tawo nga nagpakabati ha iya, “Kon amo ini, hin-o man ngay-an in matatalwas?”

en: But he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Nahihimo han Dyos an diri nahihimo han mga tawo.”

en: And Peter said, Lo, we have left our own, and followed thee.
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Pedro, “Kitaa! Ginbayaan na namon an amon mga panimalay ha pagsunod ha imo.”

en: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or wife, or brethren, or parents, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,
war: 29-30 Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Maupay, ngan susumatan ko kamo hini: makarawat hin labaw pa kadamo hini nga panahon, ngan dayon nga kinabuhi ha panahon nga tiarabot, an bisan hin-o nga mabaya hin puroy-anan, o asawa, o kabugtoan, o mga kag-anak, o mga anak, tungod han Ginhadian han Dyos.”

en: who shall not receive manifold more in this time, and in the world to come eternal life.
war: Iginlain ni Jesus an dose nga mga tinun-an ngan sidngon hira, “Pamati! Tikadto kita ha Jerusalem diin matutuman an ngatanan nga iginsurat han mga manaragna mahitungod han Anak han Tawo.

en: And he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets shall be accomplished unto the Son of man.
war: Itutubyan hiya ha mga Hentil nga magbibiaybiay ha iya, magyuyubit, ngan maglulura ha iya.

en: For he shall be delivered up unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and shamefully treated, and spit upon:
war: Paglalatobon ngan pagpapatayon hiya nira, kundi mababanhaw hiya ha ikatulo ka adlaw.”

en: and they shall scourge and kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
war: Kundi waray makasabot an mga tinun-an hin bisan usa hini nga mga butang. An kahulogan han mga pulong gintago ha ira, ngan waray hira makasabot kon ano an ginyinakan ni Jesus.

en: And they understood none of these things; and this saying was hid from them, and they perceived not the things that were said.
war: Tikahirani na hi Jesus ha Jerico, ngan nakada ha ligid han dalan in usa nga buta nga nalingkod hin pakilimos.

en: And it came to pass, as he drew nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
war: Han pakabati niya han kadam-an nga nalabay, nagpakiana hiya, “Ano ba ini?”

en: and hearing a multitude going by, he inquired what this meant.
war: Ginsumatan hiya nga nalabay hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.

en: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
war: Naggoliat hiya, “Jesus! Anak ni David! Kalooyi gad ako!”

en: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.
war: Nasinahan hiya han mga tawo nga nag-uuna, ngan ginpahilom hiya. Kundi dinmugang lugod hiya hin paggoliat, “Anak ni David! Kalooyi gad ako!”

en: And they that went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried out the more a great deal, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.
war: Sanglit inmukoy hi Jesus ngan nagsugo nga dad-on an buta ngada ha iya. Han pagdaop na han buta, nagpakiana hi Jesus ha iya,

en: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
war: “Ano an imo karuyag nga buhaton ko ha imo?”

en: What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
war: Nagbaton hiya, “Karuyag ko nga makakita na liwat ako.”

en: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath made thee whole.
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Makakakita ka na! An imo pagtoo amo an nakaupay ha imo.”

en: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
war: Nakakita hiya dayon, nagsunod hiya kan Jesus, ngan nagpasalamat han Dyos. Han pakakita hini han kadam-an, nagdayaw hira ngatanan han Dyos.

en: And he entered and was passing through Jericho.
war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus pagsulod ha Jerico, ngan naglatas hiya han bungto.

en: And behold, a man called by name Zacchæus; and he was a chief publican, and he was rich.
war: May didto riko nga labaw nga parasugot hin buhis, nga Saqueo an ngaran.

en: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the crowd, because he was little of stature.
war: Nagtingoha hiya hin pagkita kon hin-o hi Jesus, kundi habuboay hiya nga tawo, sanglit waray hiya makakita kan Jesus tungod han damo nga mga tawo.

en: And he ran on before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
war: Sanglit nagdalagan hiya hin pag-una han mga tawo ngan nagsaka hiya hin kahoy nga sikomoro, basi makakita hiya kan Jesus nga malabay.

en: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to-day I must abide at thy house.
war: Han pag-abot ni Jesus ngadto hito nga dapit, hinmangad hiya ngan nagsiring kan Saqueo, “Dagmit hin paglusad, Saqueo, kay kinahanglan humapit ako ha imo balay yana nga adlaw.”

en: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
war: Nagdagmit hi Saqueo hin paglusad ngan ginkarawat niya nga malipayon hi Jesus.

en: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, He is gone in to lodge with a man that is a sinner.
war: Nagtikang hin pagngurotob an ngatanan nga nakakita hini, “Sinmulod ini nga tawo sugad nga bisita ha balay hin makasasala!”

en: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord, Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have wrongfully exacted aught of any man, I restore fourfold.
war: Tinmindog hi Saqueo ngan nagsiring han Ginoo, “Pamati, akon ihahatag ha mga pubre an katunga han akon manggad, ngan babaydan ko hin upat ka pilo kon may nalimbongan ko nga bisan hin-o.”

en: And Jesus said unto him, To-day is salvation come to this house, forasmuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Inmabot an katalwasan ngada hini nga balay yana nga adlaw, kay tulin man liwat ni Abraham ini nga tawo.

en: For the Son of man came to seek and to save that which was lost.
war: Kay kinmanhi an Anak han Tawo hin pagbiling ngan pagtalwas han mga nagkawawara.”

en: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they supposed that the kingdom of God was immediately to appear.
war: Samtang nanmamati hini an mga tawo, nagpadayon hi Jesus pagsumat ha ira hin pananglitan. Hirani na hiya yana ha Jerusalem ngan naghunahuna an mga tawo nga diri na maiha mapakita na an Ginhadian han Dyos.

en: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country, to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
war: Sanglit nagsiring hiya, “May-ada hadto usa nga harangdon nga tawo nga kinmadto ha hirayo nga tuna basi himoon nga hadi, ngan kahuman, nakahunahuna hin pag-oli liwat.

en: And he called ten servants of his, and gave them ten pounds, and said unto them, Trade ye herewith till I come.
war: Ugsa hiya lumakat, gintawag anay niya an iya napulo nga mga surugoon, ngan gintagan an tagsa ha ira hin kwarta nga bulawan, ngan gintugon hira, ‘Igpatigayon niyo ini tubtob han akon pagbalik.’

en: But his citizens hated him, and sent an ambassage after him, saying, We will not that this man reign over us.
war: Kundi, dinmiri gud ha iya an iya mga taghimungto, sanglit nagpalanat hira hin mga sinugo nga masiring, ‘Diri namon karuyag nga ini nga tawo an maghadi ha amon.’

en: And it came to pass, when he was come back again, having received the kingdom, that he commanded these servants, unto whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by trading.
war: “Nahimo gihapon nga hadi adto nga harangdon nga tawo, ngan binmalik ngahaw. Ginpasugoan niya dayon an mga surugoon nga gintagan niya han kwarta nga umatubang ha iya, basi hisabtan kon pira an ira naganansya.

en: And the first came before him, saying, Lord, thy pound hath made ten pounds more.
war: Inmabot an syahan ngan nagsiring, ‘Agaron, nakaganansya ako hin napulo nga kwarta nga bulawan tikang han usa nga iginhatag mo ha akon.’

en: And he said unto him, Well done, thou good servant: because thou wast found faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
war: Nagsiring hiya, ‘Maupay nga buhat, maupay ka nga surugoon. Itatapod ko ha imo an pagdumara hin napulo nga mga syudad, kay matinumanon ka han gudti nga mga butang.’

en: And the second came, saying, Thy pound, Lord, hath made five pounds.
war: Inmabot an ikaduha nga surugoon ngan nagsiring, ‘Agaron, nakaganansya ako hin lima nga kwarta nga bulawan tikang han usa nga iginhatag mo ha akon.’

en: And he said unto him also, Be thou also over five cities.
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ha iya, ‘Itatapod ko ha imo an pagdumara hin lima nga mga syudad.’

en: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I kept laid up in a napkin:
war: Inmabot in lain pa nga surugoon ngan nagsiring, ‘Agaron, iini an imo kwarta nga bulawan. Ginputos ko ini hin panyo.

en: for I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that which thou layedst not down, and reapest that which thou didst not sow.
war: Nahadlok ako ha imo kay makuri ka nga tawo. Kinukuha mo an diri imo, ngan nag-aani ka han waray mo igtanom.’

en: He saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I am an austere man, taking up that which I laid not down, and reaping that which I did not sow;
war: Nagsiring hiya hini nga surugoon, ‘Maraot ka nga surugoon! Gagamiton ko an imo kalugaringon nga mga pulong hin pagsirot ha imo! Maaram ka man unta nga makuri ako nga tawo, nga nakuha ako han diri akon, ngan nag-aani han waray ko igtanom.

en: then wherefore gavest thou not my money into the bank, and I at my coming should have required it with interest?
war: Niyan, kay ano nga waray mo lugod ibutang an akon kwarta ha bangko? Pagbalik ko, makakarawat ko unta an kwarta upod na an patubo.’

en: And he said unto them that stood by, Take away from him the pound, and give it unto him that hath the ten pounds.
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ha mga nagkakatukdaw didto, ‘Kuhaa ha iya an kwarta nga bulawan, ngan ihatag ha surugoon nga may napulo nga kwarta.’

en: And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.
war: Nagsiring hira ha iya, ‘Agaron, may-ada na hiya napulo nga kwarta.’

en: I say unto you, that unto every one that hath shall be given; but from him that hath not, even that which he hath shall be taken away from him.
war: Nagbaton hiya, ‘Susumatan ko kamo nga tatagan hin labaw pa an ngatanan nga may-ada na; kundi kukuhaon tikang ha iya nga waray, bisan pa an gutiay nga aada ha iya.

en: But these mine enemies, that would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
war: Niyan, mahitungod hini nga akon mga kaaway, nga waray maruyag nga maghadi ako ha ira: dad-a hira nganhi, ngan pamataya hira ha akon atubangan!’”

en: And when he had thus spoken, he went on before, going up to Jerusalem.
war: Nagsiring hini hi Jesus, ngan nagpadayon hiya ngadto ha Jerusalem, ngan nag-una hiya ha ira.

en: And it came to pass, when he drew nigh unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount that is called Olivet, he sent two of the disciples,
war: Han pag-abot niya hirani ha Betfage ug Betania, ha bukid han mga Olibo, ginpauna niya in duha nga mga tinun-an,

en: saying, Go your way into the village over against you ; in which as ye enter ye shall find a colt tied, whereon no man ever yet sat: loose him, and bring him.
war: upod ini nga mga tugon: “Kadto kamo ha baryo nga natatadong niyo; pagsulod niyo, makikita niyo in ihinigot nga nati nga asno nga waray pa kasakyi. Hubara ito ngan dad-a nganhi.

en: And if any one ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say, The Lord hath need of him.
war: Kon may magpakiana ha iyo, ‘Kay ano nga iyo man ito ginhuhubaran?’ sidnga hiya, ‘Ginkikinahanglan ini han Agaron.’”

en: And they that were sent went away, and found even as he had said unto them.
war: Nagkalakat hira ngan nakita nira sugad gud han iginsiring ni Jesus ha ira.

en: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
war: Han ginhuhubad na nira an nati nga asno, nagpakiana ha ira an mga tag-iya, “Kay ano nga iyo man ito ginhuhubaran?”

en: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
war: Nagbaton hira, “Ginkikinahanglan ini han Agaron,”

en: And they brought him to Jesus: and they threw their garments upon the colt, and set Jesus thereon.
war: ngan gintugwayan nira an nati ngadto kan Jesus. Niyan, iginhapin nira an ira mga kurugpos ha bungkog han hayop, ngan ginbuligan nira hi Jesus hin pagsakay.

en: And as he went, they spread their garments in the way.
war: Han pagtipaunhan niya, pinanmitad nira ha dalan an ira mga kurugpos.

en: And as he was now drawing nigh, even at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen;
war: Han pag-abot nira hirani ha Jerusalem, ha dapit nga tipalugsong an dalan ha bukid han mga Olibo, nagtikang an kadam-an han iya mga tinun-an hin pagpasalamat ngan pagdayaw han Dyos hin dagko nga mga tingog, tungod han ngatanan nga dagko nga mga butang ngan ira hinkit-an:

en: saying, Blessed is the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
war: “Dayawon han Dyos an hadi nga makanhi ha ngaran han Ginoo! Kalinaw ha langit, himaya sa Dyos ha kahitas-an!”

en: And some of the Pharisees from the multitude said unto him, Teacher, rebuke thy disciples.
war: Niyan nagsiring kan Jesus in pira nga mga Parisiyo tikang dida han kadam-an nga tawo, “Magturutdo, sawaya an imo mga tinun-an nga diri hira mag-inaringasa.”

en: And he answered and said, I tell you that, if these shall hold their peace, the stones will cry out.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo: kon maghilom ngani hira, an mga bato ngahaw an mangongogliat.”

en: And when he drew nigh, he saw the city and wept over it,
war: Han hirani na hi Jesus ngan han pakakita niya han syudad han Jerusalem, nagtangis hiya,

en: saying, If thou hadst known in this day, even thou, the things which belong unto peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
war: ngan nagsiring, “Kon maaram ka la yana, kon ano an kinahanglan para han kalinaw! Kundi yana diri ka hini makakakita.

en: For the days shall come upon thee, when thine enemies shall cast up a bank about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
war: Maabot in panahon nga paglilibotan ka han imo mga kaaway, pag-uulangon ka, ngan susulongon ka nira ha ngatanan nga dapit.

en: and shall dash thee to the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
war: Uuboson ka gud hin pagrub-a nira, ngan papatayon an ngatanan nga mga tawo ha sakob han imo mga padir. Papanason gud an ngatanan nga mga bato, tungod kay waray ka makasabot han panahon han pag-abot han Dyos hin pagtalwas ha imo!”

en: And he entered into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold,
war: Sinmulod hi Jesus han Templo ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtabog han mga nanmamaligya,

en: saying unto them, It is written, And my house shall be a house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of robbers.
war: ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Nahisurat ha Kasuratan nga nagsiring an Dyos, ‘Tatawgon nga balay hin pag-ampo an akon balay.’ Kundi ginhimo niyo ito nga tagoan hin mga kawatan!”

en: And he was teaching daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the principal men of the people sought to destroy him:
war: Nagtutdo hi Jesus ha Templo adlaw-adlaw. Karuyag nga patayon hiya han mga puno han kapadian, han mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan han mga pangulo han mga tawo.

en: and they could not find what they might do; for the people all hung upon him, listening.
war: Kundi waray hira makakaagi hin higayon hin pagbuhat han ira karuyag, kay naawil pagpinamati ha iya an ngatanan nga mga tawo nga diri gud nira karuyag hilikatan in bisan usa ka pulong.

en: And it came to pass, on one of the days, as he was teaching the people in the temple, and preaching the gospel, there came upon him the chief priests and the scribes with the elders;
war: Usa ka adlaw, han nagtututdo hi Jesus han mga tawo ha Templo, ngan nagwawali han Maupay nga Sumat, inmabot an mga puno han kapadian ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod, kaupod han katigurangan,

en: and they spake, saying unto him, Tell us: By what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
war: ngan nagsiring ha iya, “Sumati daw kami, ano an imo katungod hin pagbuhat hini nga mga butang? Hin-o an naghatag ha imo hin katungod hin pagbuhat hini?”

en: And he answered and said unto them, I also will ask you a question; and tell me:
war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Mapakiana man ako ha iyo. Sumati daw ako,

en: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?
war: tikang ba sa Dyos an katungod ni Juan hin pagbunyag, o tikang ba han mga tawo?”

en: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why did ye not believe him?
war: Ira ini anay gintirutimbang hin pagsiring, “Ano man an aton igsisiring? Kon magsiring kita, ‘Tikang sa Dyos,’ masiring hiya, ‘Kay ano man nga waray kamo tumoo kan Juan?’

en: But if we shall say, From men; all the people will stone us: for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.
war: Kundi kon sumiring kita, ‘Tikang han mga tawo,’ pagbabatohon kita hini nga mga tawo dinhe, kay natoo gud hira nga manaragna hi Juan.”

en: And they answered, that they knew not whence it was .
war: Sanglit nagbaton hira, “Diri kami maaram kon diin adto tikang.”

en: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
war: Ngan nagbaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Sanglit, diri man ako magsusumat ha iyo, kon ano nga katungod an pagbuhat ko hini nga mga butang.”

en: And he began to speak unto the people this parable: A man planted a vineyard, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into another country for a long time.
war: Ngan iginsumat ni Jesus ini nga pananglitan ngadto han mga tawo: “May usa ka tawo nga nag-uma hin urubasan. Ginpaagsahan niya hin mga saop, ngan kinmadto ha iba nga dapit hin maiha nga panahon.

en: And at the season he sent unto the husbandmen a servant, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
war: Pag-abot na han panahon hin panguha han mga ubas, nagsugo hiya hin oripon pagkadto han mga saop hin pagkarawat han iya bahin han mga ubas. Kundi gintubal han mga saop an oripon, ngan ginpaoli nga waray dara.

en: And he sent yet another servant: and him also they beat, and handled him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
war: Sanglit nagsugo hiya hin lain nga oripon, kundi gintubal liwat ini, ginpakaalohan pa, ngan ginpaoli nga waray liwat dara.

en: And he sent yet a third: and him also they wounded, and cast him forth.
war: Niyan nagsugo hiya hin ikatulo nga oripon; ginkastigo liwat ini han mga saop, ngan iginlabog ha gawas.

en: And the lord of the vineyard said, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son; it may be they will reverence him.
war: Nagsiring an tag-iya han urubasan, ‘Ano ba an akon bubuhaton? Asay ko pakakadtoon an akon kalugaringon nga hinigugma nga anak; maaram ako nga tatahoron hiya nira!’

en: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned one with another, saying, This is the heir; let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
war: Kundi han pakakita han mga saop ha iya, nagsarabot hira, ‘Amo ini an anak han tag-iya. Pataya ta hiya, ngan kita na an tag-iya han urubasan!’

en: And they cast him forth out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
war: Sanglit iginlabog hiya nira ha gawas han urubasan, ngan ginpatay hiya.

en: He will come and destroy these husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.
war: “Niyan, ano man an bubuhaton han magtatag-iya han urubasan hini nga mga saop?” nagpakiana hi Jesus.

en: But he looked upon them, and said, What then is this that is written,
war: “Maabot hiya ngan pamamatayon adto nga mga tawo, ngan itatapod an urubasan ha iba nga mga saop.”

en: The stone which the builders rejected,
war: Han pakabati hini han mga tawo, nagsiring hira, “Diri la unta ini mahinabo!”

en: The same was made the head of the corner?
war: Gintutokan hira ni Jesus ngan ginpakianhan, “Ano man ngay-an an kahulogan hini nga bahin han kasuratan?

en: Every one that falleth on that stone shall be broken to pieces; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will scatter him as dust.
war: ‘An bato ngahaw nga iginsalikway

en: And the scribes and the chief priests sought to lay hands on him in that very hour; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he spake this parable against them.
war: han mga magtirindog nga waray gamit

en: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, who feigned themselves to be righteous, that they might take hold of his speech, so as to deliver him up to the rule and to the authority of the governor.
war: amo lugod an nagin labi ka importante nga bato.’

en: And they asked him, saying, Teacher, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, and acceptest not the person of any , but of a truth teachest the way of God:
war: An ngatanan nga mahulog ngada hini nga bato magkakasasamad, ngan mapipisa an kahulogan hini nga bato.”

en: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cæsar, or not?
