war: Didto hito manta nga dapit ug hito nga takna nagtalingoha hin pagdakop kan Jesus an mga magturutdo han Balaod ngan an mga puno han kapadian, kay nakasabot hira nga iginsumat niya ini nga pananglitan kontra ha ira; kundi nahadlok hira han mga tawo.

en: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them,
war: Sanglit nagbiling hira han igo nga higayon. Ginhukipan nira in pira nga mga tawo nga mapasangil nga mga tangkod hira, ngan ginsugo hira hin pagbitik kan Jesus pinaagi hin mga pakiana, basi itubyan hiya nira ngadto ha gahom ngan pagburut-an han Gobernador.

en: Show me a denarius. Whose image and superscription hath it? And they said, Cæsar’s.
war: Nagsiring kan Jesus ini nga mga espiya, “Magturutdo, maaram kami nga matadong an imo mga pulong ngan pagturon-an. Maaram kami nga diri ka nagtatagad han kahimtang hin tawo, kundi nagtututdo ka han kamatuoran mahitungod han kaburut-on han Dyos para han tawo.

en: And he said unto them, Then render unto Cæsar the things that are Cæsar’s, and unto God the things that are God’s.
war: Sumati daw kami, supak ba ha aton Balaod an pagbayad ta hin buhis han Emperador ha Roma, o diri?”

en: And they were not able to take hold of the saying before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
war: Kundi nahisabtan ni Jesus an ira bitik ngan ginsiring hira,

en: And there came to him certain of the Sadducees, they that say that there is no resurrection;
war: “Pakitaa daw ako niyo hin kwarta nga salapi. Kanay man ini bayhon ug ngaran nga aanhi hini nga kwarta?”

en: and they asked him, saying, Teacher, Moses wrote unto us, that if a man’s brother die, having a wife, and he be childless, his brother should take the wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
war: “Kanan Emperador,” nagbaton hira.

en: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died childless;
war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kon amo ito, ibayad ha Emperador an kanan Emperador, ngan ibayad man sa Dyos an kanan Dyos.”

en: and the second:
war: Waray gud hira makabitik ha iya hin bisan ano ha atubangan han mga tawo, sanglit hinmilom nala hira, nga nahipausa hira han iya baton.

en: and the third took her; and likewise the seven also left no children, and died.
war: Dinmaop kan Jesus in pira nga mga Sadusiyo. (Amo ini hira an nasiring nga waray na pagkabanhaw.) Nagpakiana hira ha iya,

en: Afterward the woman also died.
war: “Magturutdo, nagsurat hi Moises hini nga balaod para ha amon: ‘Kon mamamatay in usa nga lalake ngan mahibilin an asawa nga waray mga anak, kinahanglan asawahon han iya bugto nga lalake an nabalo, basi mag-anak hira para han namatay.’

en: In the resurrection therefore whose wife of them shall she be? for the seven had her to wife.
war: Niyan, may-ada hadto pito nga magburugto nga kalalaken-an. Nangasawa an gimagugurangi, ngan namatay nga waray anak.

en: And Jesus said unto them, The sons of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
war: Ngan pinangasawa han sunod nga manghod an nabalo nga babaye

en: but they that are accounted worthy to attain to that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
war: ngan niyan han ikatulo nga manghod. Amo gihapon an nahinabo ha ngatanan nga pito—nagkamatay hira nga waray anak.

en: for neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are sons of God, being sons of the resurrection.
war: Ha kataposan namatay an babaye.

en: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed, in the place concerning the Bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
war: Niyan ha adlaw kon mabanhaw na an mga minatay, kanay man hiya asawa? Kay an pito nga magburugto nangasawa man ha iya.”

en: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Nag-aasawa an kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an hini nga panahon,

en: And certain of the scribes answering said, Teacher, thou hast well said.
war: kundi an kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an nga takos hin pagkabanhaw ha mga minatay ngan pag-ukoy ha panahon nga tiarabot diri na mag-aasawa.

en: For they durst not any more ask him any question.
war: Sugad hira hin mga anghel, ngan diri na mapatay. Mga anak hira han Dyos, kay nabanhaw na hira.

en: And he said unto them, How say they that the Christ is David’s son?
war: Ngan nagpamatuod hi Moises hin dayag nga may pagkabanhaw an mga minatay. Dida han sinurat nga nagsaysay mahitungod han naglalaga nga tanom, naghinabe hiya hiunong han Ginoo, nga amo ‘an Dyos ni Abraham, Dyos ni Isaac, ngan Dyos ni Jacob.’

en: For David himself saith in the book of Psalms,
war: Karuyag sidngon hini nga Dyos hiya han mga buhi, diri han mga minatay, kay ha iya buhi an ngatanan.”

en: The Lord said unto my Lord,
war: Nagyakan in pira nga mga magturutdo han Balaod, “Maupay nga pagkabaton, Magturutdo!”

en: Sit thou on my right hand,
war: Ngan waray na hira mangahas hin pagpakiana ha iya hin bisan ano.

en: Till I make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Uunanhon hin pakasiring nira nga magigin tulin ni David an Mesiyas?

en: David therefore calleth him Lord, and how is he his son?
war: Kay nasiring man hi David ngahaw, ha basahan han mga Salmo:

en: And in the hearing of all the people he said unto his disciples,
war: ‘Nagsiring an Ginoo ngadto han akon Ginoo:

en: Beware of the scribes, who desire to walk in long robes, and love salutations in the marketplaces, and chief seats in the synagogues, and chief places at feasts;
war: Lingkod didi ha akon tuo,

en: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater condemnation.
war: tubtob nga ibutang ko an imo mga kaaway nga taramakan ha ilarom han imo mga tiil.’

en: And he looked up, and saw the rich men that were casting their gifts into the treasury.
war: An ngatanan siniplatan ni Jesus, ngan kinmita hiya nga an mga riko naghulog han ira mga halad didto han surudlan ha Templo.

en: And he saw a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
war: Hinkit-an liwat niya in kablas nga balo nga babaye nga naghulog hin duha la nga sensilyo nga kwarta nga bronse.

en: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, This poor widow cast in more than they all:
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo, nga larulabaw an ginhatag hini nga kablas nga balo kay ha ira ngatanan.

en: for all these did of their superfluity cast in unto the gifts; but she of her want did cast in all the living that she had.
war: Kay naghalad an iba han sobra la han ira karikohan; kundi hiya, bisan kon kablas hiya, naghatag han ngatanan nga iya kinabubuhian.”

en: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and offerings, he said,
war: Naghiruhimangraw in pira han mga tinun-an, hiunong han pagkatahom han Templo nga rinayandayanan hin hamili nga mga bato, ngan han mga halad ngadto han Dyos. Nagsiring hi Jesus,

en: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in which there shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
war: “Mahitungod hini ngatanan nga mga butang nga iyo nakikita, maabot in panahon nga waray ngani bisan usa nga bato dinhe nga mahibibilin dida han iya hinmumutangan; titimpagon ini ngatanan.”

en: And they asked him, saying, Teacher, when therefore shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when these things are about to come to pass?
war: Nagpakiana hira, “Magturutdo, san-o man ini mahinanabo? Ngan ano man an mga tigaman nga magpapasabot ha amon nga maabot na an panahon nga ini ngatanan matutuman?”

en: And he said, Take heed that ye be not led astray: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am he ; and, The time is at hand: go ye not after them.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Pagbantay, ngan ayaw kamo palimbong. Kay damo in maabot ngan masiring ha akon ngaran, ‘Ako amo hi Cristo!’ ngan ‘Inmabot na an panahon!’ Kundi ayaw kamo pagsunod ha ira.

en: And when ye shall hear of wars and tumults, be not terrified: for these things must needs come to pass first; but the end is not immediately.
war: Ayaw kahadlok kon bumati kamo hin mga aragway ngan mga kasamokan; kinahanglan mahinabo anay in sugad nga mga butang, kundi diri buot sidngon nga hirani na an kataposan.”

en: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom;
war: Nagpadayon hiya hin pagsiring, “Mag-aaruaraway an mga nasod, ngan maggigipasulongsulong an mga ginhadian.

en: and there shall be great earthquakes, and in divers places famines and pestilences; and there shall be terrors and great signs from heaven.
war: Magkakaada magpakalilisang nga mga linog, mga kagutom, ngan mga piste ha magkalainlain nga mga dapit; magkakaada magpakaharadlok nga mga butang, ngan dagko nga mga orosahon ha kalangitan.

en: But before all these things, they shall lay their hands on you, and shall persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.
war: Kundi ha diri pa manhihinabo ini ngatanan, pagdadakpon ngan pagpapakurian kamo; igtutubyan kamo ngadto ha mga sinagoga, ngan pagpriprisohon kamo; pagdadad-on kamo ha atubangan hin mga hadi ngan mga punoan tungod ha akon.

en: It shall turn out unto you for a testimony.
war: Iyo ini higayon hin pagpasangyaw han Maupay nga Sumat.

en: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate beforehand how to answer:
war: Padig-ona ngadaan an iyo mga hunahuna basi diri kamo mabaraka kon uunanhon niyo hin pagpanalipod han iyo kalugaringon;

en: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to withstand or to gainsay.
war: kay tatagan ko kamo hin mga pulong ngan kinaadman nga waray han iyo mga kaaway makakabaton o makakariwa han iyo igyayakan.

en: But ye shall be delivered up even by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolk, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
war: Igtutubyan kamo han iyo mga kag-anak, kabugtoan, kauropdan, ngan kasangkayan; papatayon ngani an iba ha iyo.

en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.
war: Pagdudumtan kamo han ngatanan tungod ha akon.

en: And not a hair of your head shall perish.
war: Kundi waray mawawara bisan usa nga buhok han iyo mga ulo.

en: In your patience ye shall win your souls.
war: Pagpadayon kamo hin kamakusog, kay hini nga paagi matatalwas an iyo mga kinabuhi.

en: But when ye see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that her desolation is at hand.
war: “Kon kitaon niyo nga ginlilibotan na an Jerusalem hin kasondalohan, hibabaroan niyo nga hirani na an iya pagkapukan.

en: Then let them that are in Judæa flee unto the mountains; and let them that are in the midst of her depart out; and let not them that are in the country enter therein.
war: Niyan kinahanglan kumalagiw ngadto ha kabukiran an mga aadto ha Judea; kinahanglan gumawas na han syudad an aadto ha sakob, ngan kinahanglan diri na sumulod ha syudad an aadto ha huron.

en: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
war: Kay amo na ini ‘An mga Adlaw han Pagkastigo’ basi matuman an ngatanan nga iginsiring han Kasuratan.

en: Woe unto them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days! for there shall be great distress upon the land, and wrath unto this people.
war: Kamakaharadlok hadto nga mga adlaw para han mga burod ngan mga iroy nga may-ada mga minasus-an! Maabot hini nga tuna in makarimadima nga kakurian, ngan maabot hini nga mga tawo an kapungot han Dyos.

en: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led captive into all the nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
war: Papatayon in pira pinaagi hin espada, ngan bibihagon an iba ngan ighahalen ngadto ha ngatanan nga mga nasod, ngan pagyayapakyapakan an Jerusalem han mga Hentil tubtob nga matapos an ira panahon han pagmando han mga Hentil han Jerusalem.

en: And there shall be signs in sun and moon and stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the billows;
war: “Magkakamay-ada mga orosahon nga tigaman han adlaw, han bulan, ngan han mga bitoon. Magtuturaw in bug-os nga mga nasod ha tuna, ha kahadlok han dinaguhob han kadagatan ngan han mga humatol han mga balod.

en: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens shall be shaken.
war: Manhihiraptay hin kahadlok an mga tawo samtang naghuhulat hira kon ano an mapaabot han bug-os nga tuna; kay masimang ha ira mga agianan an mga kagamhanan ha kahitas-an.

en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
war: Katapos, mapakita na an Anak han Tawo nga maabot dida hin dampog, may gahom ug himaya.

en: But when these things begin to come to pass, look up, and lift up your heads; because your redemption draweth nigh.
war: Kon makakita na kamo nga mahinabo ini nga mga butang, tindog ngan hangad, kay hirani na an iyo katalwasan.”

en: And he spake to them a parable: Behold the fig tree, and all the trees:
war: Ngan ginsumatan hira ni Jesus hini nga pananglitan: “Hinumdomi an kahoy nga igos ngan an ngatanan nga iba nga mga kahoy.

en: when they now shoot forth, ye see it and know of your own selves that the summer is now nigh.
war: Kon hikit-an na niyo nga nananaringsing, maaram kamo nga hirani na an panahon han kamapaso.

en: Even so ye also, when ye see these things coming to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh.
war: Ha sugad nga kaagi, kon kumita kamo nga nahinanabo na ini nga mga butang, hibaroi niyo nga tiarabot na an Ginhadian han Dyos.

en: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all things be accomplished.
war: “Tigamni ini! Mahinanabo ini ngatanan nga mga butang nga diri pa mapatay an ngatanan nga mga tawo nga buhi yana.

en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
war: Nagpapapas pa an langit ngan an tuna, kundi magpapabilin an akon mga pulong.

en: But take heed to yourselves, lest haply your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day come on you suddenly as a snare:
war: “Pagbantay kamo! Ayaw itugot nga magpatakas kamo hin pagkinaon ngan pag-ininom, ngan magkinabaraka kamo hini nga kinabuhi, kay bangin kamo hikalitan kon umabot ito nga adlaw.

en: for so shall it come upon all them that dwell on the face of all the earth.
war: Kay maabot ini sugad hin bitik ha ngatanan nga mga tawo ha bug-os nga tuna.

en: But watch ye at every season, making supplication, that ye may prevail to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
war: Pagbantay ngan dayuday pag-ampo kamo nga maangkon niyo an kusog hin pagilob hini ngatanan nga mga butang nga mahinanabo, ngan pagtindog ha atubangan han Anak han Tawo.”

en: And every day he was teaching in the temple; and every night he went out, and lodged in the mount that is called Olivet.
war: Ginamit ni Jesus adto nga mga adlaw hin pagtutdo didto ha Templo, nga ha pagkagab-i, naguwa hiya hin pagpahuway didto ha Bukid han mga Olibo.

en: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, to hear him.
war: Timprano pa ha kada aga napakadto na ha Templo an ngatanan nga mga tawo hin pamati ha iya.

en: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
war: Hirani na an Pyesta han Tinapay nga Waray Patubo nga ginngangaranan nga Paglabay.

en: And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death; for they feared the people.
war: An mga puno han kapadian ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod nahadlok han mga tawo, sanglit nagtinguha hira hin pagbiling hin paagi hin pagpatay kan Jesus.

en: And Satan entered into Judas who was called Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
war: Ngan sinmulod hi Satanas kan Judas nga gintatawag nga Iscariote, usa han dose nga mga tinun-an.

en: And he went away, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might deliver him unto them.
war: Sanglit kinmadto hiya ngan nakighimangraw han mga puno han kapadian ngan han mga opisyal han gwardya han Templo kon uunanhon niya hin pagtubyan kan Jesus ha ira.

en: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
war: Nalipay hira ngan nagsaad hin paghatag ha iya hin kwarta.

en: And he consented, and sought opportunity to deliver him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
war: Inmuyon hi Judas ha ira, ngan nagtikang hiya pamiling hin maupay nga higayon hin paglingo kan Jesus, nga diri hibabaroan han mga tawo.

en: And the day of unleavened bread came, on which the passover must be sacrificed.
war: Inmabot an adlaw nga ig-iihaw han nati nga mga karnero para han Paglabay nga panihapon ha panahon han Pyesta han Tinapay nga Waray Patubo.

en: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and make ready for us the passover, that we may eat.
war: Ginsugo ni Jesus hira Pedro ug Juan upod ini nga mga tugon: “Kadto ngan andama niyo an aton Paglabay nga panihapon basi mangaon kita.”

en: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we make ready?
war: Nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Diin an karuyag mo nga pag-aandaman namon?”

en: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house whereinto he goeth.
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Pamati! Pagsulod niyo han syudad, matapo ha iyo in lalake nga nagpapas-an hin tibod nga may tubig. Sunda hiya ngadto han balay nga iya susudlan,

en: And ye shall say unto the master of the house, The Teacher saith unto thee, Where is the guest-chamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
war: ngan sidnga an tagbalay: ‘Napakiana ha imo an Magturutdo kon hain an kwarto nga kakaonan niya han Paglabay nga panihapon kaupod han iya mga tinun-an?’

en: And he will show you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
war: Ipapakita niya ha iyo in dako nga kwarto ha igbaw nga sangkap na. Andama niyo didto an ngatanan.”

en: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
war: Nagkalakat hira ngan ira hin-agian an ngatanan sugad han iginsumat ha ira ni Jesus, ngan gin-andam nira an Paglabay nga panihapon.

en: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the apostles with him.
war: Han pag-abot na han takna, linmingkod hi Jesus ha iya dapit ha lamesa upod han mga apostoles.

en: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Karuyag ko gud hin pakigsaro ha iyo hini nga Paglabay nga panihapon ugsa ako mag-antos!

en: for I say unto you, I shall not eat it, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
war: Kay susumatan ko kamo: diri na ako makaon hini tubtob nga matuman an kahulogan hini didto han Ginhadian han Dyos.”

en: And he received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
war: Ngan ginkuha ni Jesus an kupa, nagpasalamat sa Dyos, ngan nagsiring, “Kuhaa niyo ini ngan pagbahinbahina ha iyo ngahaw,

en: for I say unto you, I shall not drink from henceforth of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
war: kay susumatan ko kamo nga diri na ako mainom hini nga bino tikang yana tubtob han pag-abot han Ginhadian han Dyos.”

en: And he took bread, and when he had given thanks, he brake it, and gave to them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
war: Ngan ginkuha niya an tinapay, nagpasalamat sa Dyos, ginpinitpinit ini, ngan iginhatag ha ira nga nagsiring, “Amo ini an akon lawas [nga ihinahatag ha iyo. Buhata ini niyo nga hinumdoman ha akon.”

en: And the cup in like manner after supper, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood, even that which is poured out for you.
war: Ha sugad man nga paagi, iginhatag niya ha ira an kupa katapos han panihapon nga nagsiring, “Amo ini nga kupa an bag-o nga ginsaaran han Dyos, nga gintigamnan han akon dugo nga gin-ula para ha iyo.]

en: But behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
war: “Kundi kitaa! Aanhi kaupod ko ha lamesa an naglilingo ha akon!

en: For the Son of man indeed goeth, as it hath been determined: but woe unto that man through whom he is betrayed!
war: Kay mapatay an Anak han Tawo sumala han pagbuot han Dyos; kundi kairo hito nga tawo nga maglilingo ha akon!”

en: And they began to question among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
war: Ngan nagtikang hira hin paggiparupakiana kon hin-o ha ira an magbubuhat hini.

en: And there arose also a contention among them, which of them was accounted to be greatest.
war: Nagtikang dida han mga tinun-an in lantugi kon hin-o ha ira an angay kilalahon nga gilalabawi.

en: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles have lordship over them; and they that have authority over them are called Benefactors.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “May gahom an mga hadi hini nga kalibutan hin pagbuot han ira mga sakop, ngan ginngangaranan an mga pangulo nga ‘Mga Sangkay han mga tawo.’

en: But ye shall not be so: but he that is the greater among you, let him become as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
war: Kundi diri amo ini nga paagi ha iyo; lugod an gilalabawi ha iyo kinahanglan masugad han gimamanghuri, ngan an pangulo kinahanglan masugad han surugoon.

en: For which is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am in the midst of you as he that serveth.
war: Hin-o an larulabaw, an nalingkod ba hin pagkaon o an nagsisirbe ha iya? Ada, an nalingkod. Kundi kaupod ako niyo sugad hin usa nga nagsisirbe.

en: But ye are they that have continued with me in my temptations;
war: “Nagpabilin kamo upod ha akon ha ngatanan ko nga mga pag-antos;

en: and I appoint unto you a kingdom, even as my Father appointed unto me,
war: ngan sugad nga gintagan ako han akon Amay han katungod hin paghadi, tatagan ko man kamo han amo ngahaw nga katungod.

en: that ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom; and ye shall sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
war: Makaon ngan mainom kamo ha akon lamesa didto han akon Ginhadian, ngan malingkod kamo ha mga trono hin paghukom han dose nga mga tribo han Israel.

en: Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have you, that he might sift you as wheat:
war: “Simon, Simon! Pamati! Gintugotan hi Satanas hin pagsulay ha iyo ngatanan, sugad han paglaina hin mag-uroma han trigo ngan han uhot.

en: but I made supplication for thee, that thy faith fail not; and do thou, when once thou hast turned again, establish thy brethren.
war: Kundi nag-ampo ako para ha imo, Simon, nga diri mapakyas an imo pagtoo. Ngan kon mahibalik ka na ha akon, kinahanglan padig-onon mo an imo kabugtoan.”

en: And he said unto him, Lord, with thee I am ready to go both to prison and to death.
war: Nagbaton hi Pedro, “Ginoo, andam ako hin pag-upod ha imo ha bilanggoan, ngan hin pagpakamatay pa upod ha imo!”

en: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, until thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko ikaw, Pedro, diri matugaok an manok yana nga gab-i tubtob nga magsiring ka hin makatulo nga diri ka nakilala ha akon.”

en: And he said unto them, When I sent you forth without purse, and wallet, and shoes, lacked ye anything? And they said, Nothing.
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Han pagsugoa ko ha iyo hadto nga waray pitaka, supot nga surudlan hin limos, o sandalyas, nagkulang ba kamo hin bisan ano?”

en: And he said unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise a wallet; and he that hath none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.
war: “Waray,” nagbaton hira.

en: For I say unto you, that this which is written must be fulfilled in me, And he was reckoned with transgressors: for that which concerneth me hath fulfilment.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kundi kon hin-o ha iyo nga may-ada supot o surudlan hin limos kinahanglan nga dad-on niyo yana; ngan an waray espada, kinahanglan magbaligya han iya bado ngan pumalit hin usa.

en: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
war: Kay susumatan ko kamo hini: kinahanglan matuman an Kasuratan nga nasiring mahitungod ha akon, ‘Igintampo hiya han mga kriminal.’ Kay natutuman na an nahisurat mahitungod ha akon.”

en: And he came out, and went, as his custom was, unto the mount of Olives; and the disciples also followed him.
war: Nagsiring an mga tinun-an, “Kitaa, Ginoo! Iini in duha nga espada.”

en: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
war: “Igo na ito!” nagbaton hiya.

en: And he was parted from them about a stone’s cast; and he kneeled down and prayed,
war: Ginmawas hi Jesus han syudad, ngan sugad han iya nahiaraan, kinmadto hiya ha Bukid han mga Olibo; ngan inmupod ha iya an iya mga tinun-an.

en: saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
war: Han pag-abot niya didto, nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Pag-ampo nga diri kamo masulay.”

en: And there appeared unto him an angel from heaven, strengthening him.
war: Ngan inmuruonhan hiya ha ira hin kahirayo nga kanan usa ka labay hin bato, ngan linmuhod ngan nag-ampo,

en: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly; and his sweat became as it were great drops of blood falling down upon the ground.
war: “Amay ko, kon imo pagbuot, kuhaa gad ini nga kupa ha akon. Diri an akon, kundi an imo pagbuot an matuman.” [

en: And when he rose up from his prayer, he came unto the disciples, and found them sleeping for sorrow,
war: Pinmakita ha iya in usa nga anghel tikang ha langit, nga nagpakusog ha iya.

en: and said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, that ye enter not into temptation.
war: Ha dako gud nga kasakit nag-ampo hiya hin huruhugot pa nga pangamuyo, an iya balhas sugad na hin mga turo hin dugo nga natabigis ha tuna.]

en: While he yet spake, behold, a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them; and he drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
war: Han pagbangon niya tikang ha pag-ampo, binmalik hiya ngadto han iya mga tinun-an, ngan iya hira hin-agian nga nangangaturog na, nga rutay na tungod han ira kabidoon.

en: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kay ano nga nangangaturog kamo? Pagmata kamo ngan pag-ampo nga diri kamo masulay.”

en: And when they that were about him saw what would follow, they said, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
war: Nagyayakan pa hi Jesus han pag-abot hin mga tawo. Nag-uuna ha ira hi Judas nga usa han dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan dinmaop hiya kan Jesus hin pagharok ha iya.

en: And a certain one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and struck off his right ear.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus, “Judas, lilingoon mo ba an Anak han Tawo pinaagi hin harok?”

en: But Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye them thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
war: Pakasabot han mga tinun-an nga kaupod ni Jesus han mahinanabo, nagsiring hira, “Ginoo, gagamiton na ba namon an amon mga espada?”

en: And Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and elders, that were come against him, Are ye come out, as against a robber, with swords and staves?
war: Ngan gintigbas han usa ha ira an oripon han Labaw nga Padi, ngan napalong an iya tuo nga talinga.

en: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched not forth your hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus, “Igo na ini!” Ginkamkam niya an talinga han tawo, ngan gin-upay niya.

en: And they seized him, and led him away , and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed afar off.
war: Niyan ginsiring ni Jesus an mga puno han kapadian, an mga opisyal han gwardya han Templo, ngan an katigurangan nga kinmadto pagdakop ha iya, “Kinmanhi ba kamo hin pagdakop ha akon nga daw sugad hin tikasan, nga may mga espada ngan mga balbag man kamo?

en: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the court, and had sat down together, Peter sat in the midst of them.
war: Kaupod man ako niyo adlaw-adlaw ha Templo, ngan waray kamo magtalinguha hin pagdakop ha akon. Kundi amo na ini an iyo takna, nga diin naghahadi na an gahom han kasisidman.”

en: And a certain maid seeing him as he sat in the light of the fire , and looking stedfastly upon him, said, This man also was with him.
war: Gindakop nira hi Jesus, ngan gindara hiya ngadto han balay han Labaw nga Padi; ngan inmantaw la hi Pedro hin pagsunod ha iya.

en: But he denied, saying, Woman, I know him not.
war: May ginharing nga tap-ong ha butnga han bungsaran, ngan tinmampo hi Pedro han mga nagkakalingkod palibot han kalayo.

en: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou also art one of them. But Peter said, Man, I am not.
war: Han paghikit-i ha iya han usa han mga surugoon nga kababayen-an nga tinmampo hiya hin paglingkod, tinutokan hiya niya ngan sidngon, “Kaupod liwat niya ini nga tawo!”

en: And after the space of about one hour another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this man also was with him; for he is a Galilæan.
war: Kundi naglirong hi Pedro hin pagsiring, “Babaye, diri ngani ako nakilala ha iya!”

en: But Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
war: Waray pag-iha hinkit-an hi Pedro hin usa ka tawo ngan ginsiring, “Kausa ka liwat nira!”

en: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how that he said unto him, Before the cock crow this day thou shalt deny me thrice.
war: Kundi nagbaton hi Pedro, “Sangkay, diri ako kausa nira!”

en: And he went out, and wept bitterly.
war: Ngan naglabay hin mga usa ka oras, ug may lain nga tawo nga nangusog hin pagsiring, “Waray ruhaduha upod gud ini nga tawo ha iya, kay taga-Galilea liwat hiya!”

en: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and beat him.
war: Kundi nagbaton hi Pedro, “Sangkay, diri ako maaram han imo ginyayakan!”

en: And they blindfolded him, and asked him, saying, Prophesy: who is he that struck thee?
war: Samtang nagyayakan pa hiya, tinmugaok dayon in usa nga manok.

en: And many other things spake they against him, reviling him.
war: Linmingi an Ginoo ngan tinmutok kan Pedro, ngan nahinumdom hi Pedro han mga pulong han Ginoo, han iya pagsiring, “Diri pa matugaok an manok yana nga gab-i, masiring ka na hin makatulo nga diri ka nakilala ha akon.”

en: And as soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people was gathered together, both chief priests and scribes; and they led him away into their council, saying,
war: Ginmawas hi Pedro ngan nagtangis nga duro an kabido.

en: If thou art the Christ, tell us. But he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
war: Ginyubitan ngan gintubal hi Jesus han mga tawo nga nagbabantay ha iya.

en: and if I ask you , ye will not answer.
war: Gintahoban nira an iya mga mata, ngan ginpakianhan, “Tigoha! Hin-o an nagsuntok ha imo?”

en: But from henceforth shall the Son of man be seated at the right hand of the power of God.
war: Ngan damo la nga mga pagyubit an ira ginyakan ha iya.

en: And they all said, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
war: Pagkaadlaw na, nagtirok an katigurangan han mga Judiyo, an mga puno han kapadian, ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan gindara hi Jesus ngadto han ira Labaw nga Hukmanan.

en: And they said, What further need have we of witness? for we ourselves have heard from his own mouth.
war: Nagsiring hira, “Sumati kami, amo ka ba an Mesiyas?”

en: And the whole company of them rose up, and brought him before Pilate.
war: Binmuhat an bug-os nga hugpo ngan gindara hi Jesus ngadto kan Pilato,

en: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this man perverting our nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cæsar, and saying that he himself is Christ a king.
war: diin nagtikang hira hin pagsumbong ha iya, “Hindakpan namon ini nga tawo nga naglilimbong han amon mga tawo. Ginsiring hira nga diri hira magbayad hin mga buhis ngadto han Emperador, ngan nagtug-an hiya nga amo hiya an Cristo nga usa nga hadi.”

en: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest.
war: Nagpakiana ha iya hi Pilato, “Amo ka ba an hadi han mga Judiyo?”

en: And Pilate said unto the chief priests and the multitudes, I find no fault in this man.
war: “Ikaw an nagyakan hito,” nagbaton hi Jesus.

en: But they were the more urgent, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Judæa, and beginning from Galilee even unto this place.
war: Niyan ginsiring ni Pilato an mga puno han kapadian ngan an mga tawo, “Waray ako hin-aagian nga pangatadongan hin pagsirot hini nga tawo.”

en: But when Pilate heard it, he asked whether the man were a Galilæan.
war: Kundi nagpirit gud hira hin pagsiring, “Pinaagi han iya pagtutdo hiya an tinikangan han kasamokan han mga tawo ha bug-os nga Judea. Inmuna hiya ha Galilea, nga yana aanhi na hiya.”

en: And when he knew that he was of Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him unto Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem in these days.
war: Pakabati ni Pilato hini, nagpakiana hiya, “Taga-Galilea ba ini nga tawo?”

en: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was of a long time desirous to see him, because he had heard concerning him; and he hoped to see some miracle done by him.
war: Paghibaro niya nga tikang hi Jesus ha dapit nga ginhahadian ni Herodes, iginpadara niya hiya ngadto kan Herodes, nga nakadto liwat ha Jerusalem hadto nga panahon.

en: And he questioned him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
war: Nalipay gud hi Herodes han pakakita niya kan Jesus, kay damo na an iya hinbatian hiunong ha iya, ngan maiha na nga karuyag gud hiya kumita kan Jesus. Naglalaom hiya hin pagkita kan Jesus nga magbuhat hin milagro.

en: And the chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.
war: Sanglit damo an iya pakiana kan Jesus, kundi waray magbaton hi Jesus bisan usa ka pulong.

en: And Herod with his soldiers set him at nought, and mocked him, and arraying him in gorgeous apparel sent him back to Pilate.
war: Dinmaop ha atubangan an mga puno han kapadian ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan nagpasaka hin makusog nga mga sumbong kontra kan Jesus.

en: And Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
war: Ginyubitan hi Jesus ni Herodes ngan han iya mga sondalo, ngan ginpakaalohan hiya nira. Ginbistehan hiya nira hin kanan hadi panapton, ngan iginbalik ngadto kan Pilato.

en: And Pilate called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
war: Hadto manta nga adlaw nagkasangkay hira Herodes ug Pilato; magkontra hira hadto anay han waray pa ini mahinabo.

en: and said unto them, Ye brought unto me this man, as one that perverteth the people: and behold, I, having examined him before you, found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
war: Gintirok ni Pilato an mga puno han kapadian, an mga pangulo, ngan an mga tawo,

en: no, nor yet Herod: for he sent him back unto us; and behold, nothing worthy of death hath been done by him.
war: ngan ginsiring hira, “Gindara niyo ini nga tawo nganhi ha akon, ngan nagsiring kamo nga ginlilipatlipat niya an mga tawo. Yana, gin-usisa ka na hiya ha iyo atubangan, ngan waray ko hin-agian nga sala bisan usa han mga sumbong nga iyo iginpasaka kontra ha iya.

en: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
war: Waray gihapon makaagi hin sala ha iya bisan ngani hi Herodes, kay iginbalik man hiya ha aton. Waray ginbuhat hini nga tawo nga angay sirotan han kamatayon.
Sanglit ipalalatob ko nala hiya ngan pabubuhian.” [

en: But they cried out all together, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:—
war: Ha kada Pyesta han Paglabay nababatasan ni Pilato in pagbuhi hin usa nga priso nga karuyag han mga tawo.]

en: one who for a certain insurrection made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.
war: Naggoliat an bug-os nga hugpo, “Pataya hiya! Buhii hi Barabas para ha amon!” (

en: And Pilate spake unto them again, desiring to release Jesus;
war: Napriso hi Barabas tungod hin karibok nga nahinabo ha syudad, ngan tungod hin pagpatay.)

en: but they shouted, saying, Crucify, crucify him.
war: Karuyag ni Pilato nga buhian hi Jesus, sanglit gintawag liwat niya an mga tawo.

en: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath this man done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him and release him.
war: Kundi naggogliat hira, “Igraysang hiya ha kros! Igraysang ha kros!”

en: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. And their voices prevailed.
war: Nagsiring ha ira hi Pilato hin ikatulo na, “Kundi ano nga sala an iya nabuhat? Waray ko hin-agian nga ano man nga iya nabuhat nga angay sirotan hin kamatayon! Ipalalatob ko nala hiya ngan pabubuhian.”

en: And Pilate gave sentence that what they asked for should be done.
war: Kundi dinmuroy lugod hira hin pagtikadako han ira gogliat nga kinahanglan igraysang hi Jesus ha kros; ngan ha kataposan tinugotan hira ni Pilato.

en: And he released him that for insurrection and murder had been cast into prison, whom they asked for; but Jesus he delivered up to their will.
war: Sanglit iginpahamtang ni Pilato kan Jesus an sirot nga ira ginpangaro.

en: And when they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to bear it after Jesus.
war: Ginbuhian ni Pilato an tawo nga ira kinaruyag, an napriso tungod hin pagribok ngan pakamatay, ngan igintubyan hi Jesus ha ira, basi buhaton nira an ira karuyag.

en: And there followed him a great multitude of the people, and of women who bewailed and lamented him.
war: Igin-gawas nira hi Jesus. Han paglakat na nira, iginkatapo nira in usa ka tawo nga Simon an ngaran, nga taga-Cirene, nga tisulod ha syudad tikang ha huron. Gindakop hiya nira, iginpapas-an ha iya an kros, ngan iginpadara ha iya ha luyo ni Jesus.

en: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
war: Nagsunod ha iya in kadam-an nga mga tawo, ngan upod ha ira in pira nga kababayen-an nga nagtitinangis ngan nagngunguugoy tungod ha iya.

en: For behold, the days are coming, in which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the breasts that never gave suck.
war: Linmingi hi Jesus ha ira ngan nagsiring, “Kababayen-an han Jerusalem! Ayaw kamo pagtangis tungod ha akon, kundi pagtangis lugod kamo tungod ha iyo ngahaw ngan tungod han iyo mga anak.

en: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
war: Kay maabot an mga adlaw, nga masiring an mga tawo, ‘Kapalaran han kababayen-an nga mga baw-as, nga waray mga anak, nga waray magpasuso!’

en: For if they do these things in the green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
war: Amo ito an panahon nga masiring ha kabukiran an mga tawo, ‘Tabuni kami!’ ngan ha kapungtoran, ‘Tagoa kami!’

en: And there were also two others, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
war: Kay kon pagbuhaton in sugad nga mga butang kon hilaw pa an kahoy, ano in mahinanabo kon uga na ito?”

en: And when they came unto the place which is called The skull, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand and the other on the left.
war: Nagdara liwat hira hin duha nga mga kriminal, nga papatayon nira upod kan Jesus.

en: And Jesus said, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And parting his garments among them, they cast lots.
war: Han pag-abot nira ha dapit nga gintatawag “An Klabera,” didto iginraysang nira ha kros hi Jesus, ngan an duha nga mga kriminal, an usa ha iya tuo, ngan an usa ha iya wala.

en: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also scoffed at him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Amay ko, pasayloa hira! Kay diri hira maaram han ira ginbubuhat.”

en: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, offering him vinegar,
war: Ginbahinbahin nira an iya mga panapton pinaagi hin ripa.

en: and saying, If thou art the King of the Jews, save thyself.
war: Natindog didto an mga tawo nagkikinita, samtang nagbibiaybiay ha iya an mga pangulo nga Judiyo: “Nagtalwas hiya han iba; papagtalwasa hiya han iya kalugaringon, kon tinuod nga amo hiya an Mesiyas nga ginpili han Dyos!”

en: And there was also a superscription over him, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
war: Ginyubitan liwat hiya han mga sondalo. Kinmadto hira ha iya hin paghatag ha iya hin maaslom nga bino,

en: And one of the malefactors that were hanged railed on him, saying, Art not thou the Christ? save thyself and us.
war: ngan nagsiring, “Talwasa an imo kalugaringon, kon tinuod manggud nga ikaw amo an hadi han mga Judiyo!”

en: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, Dost thou not even fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
war: Iginsurat ini nga mga pulong ha igbaw niya: “Amo ini an Hadi han mga Judiyo.”

en: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
war: Ginyubitan liwat hiya han usa han mga kriminal nga nabitay didto, “Diri ka ba amo an Mesiyas? Talwasa an imo kalugaringon ngan talwasa kami!”

en: And he said, Jesus, remember me when thou comest in thy kingdom.
war: Kundi ginsaway hiya han usa nga kriminal, “Diri ka ba nahadlok han Dyos? Aanhi kita ginsirotan hin sugad nga sirot nga ihinatag ha iya.

en: And he said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To-day shalt thou be with me in Paradise.
war: Matadong ini nga sirot para ha aton, kay nakarawat kita han angay nga sirot han aton ginbuhat; kundi waray hiya ginbuhat nga maraot.”

en: And it was now about the sixth hour, and a darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour,
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya kan Jesus, “Jesus, hinumdomi gad ako kon makanhi ka na nga hadi.”

en: the sun’s light failing: and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Susumatan ko ikaw: yana ngahaw nga adlaw, maupod ka ha akon ngadto ha Paraiso.”

en: And Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said this, he gave up the ghost.
war: May mga alas dose an takna nga waray na pagsirak an adlaw, ngan nalukop hin kasirom an bug-os nga tuna tubtob ha alas tres han kulop;

en: And when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
war: ngan napikas an biray han Templo.

en: And all the multitudes that came together to this sight, when they beheld the things that were done, returned smiting their breasts.
war: Ginmoliat hi Jesus hin makusog nga tingog, “Amay ko! Ha imo mga kamot itinutubyan ko an akon espiritu!” Katapos pagyakan niya hini, nabunosan hiya han iya kinabuhi.

en: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed with him from Galilee, stood afar off, seeing these things.
war: Hinkit-an han kapitan han mga sondalo an nahinabo, ngan gindayaw niya an Dyos, hin pasiring, “Matuod gud nga maupay hiya nga tawo!”

en: And behold, a man named Joseph, who was a councillor, a good and righteous man
war: An mga tawo nga nagtirok hin pagtan-aw hini nga kiritaon, kinmita han nahinabo. Nanguli hira nga nagpupukpok han ira mga dughan tungod han ira kabidoan.

en: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), a man of Arimathæa, a city of the Jews, who was looking for the kingdom of God:
war: Natindog ha antaw hin pagkita hini nga mga butang an ngatanan nga kakilala ni Jesus upod an kababayen-an nga nagsunod ha iya tikang pa ha Galilea. Inmantaw la hira hin pagtindog basi makakita hira tikang ha hirayo.

en: this man went to Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus.
war: 50-51 May usa ka tawo nga Jose an ngaran, nga tikang ha Arimatea nga bungto han mga Judiyo. Maupay ngan dungganan hiya nga tawo, ngan nagpapaabot hiya han Ginhadian han Dyos. Bisan kon kaapi hiya han Labaw nga Hukmanan, waray hiya umuyon han ira larang ug buhat.

en: And he took it down, and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was hewn in stone, where never man had yet lain.
war: Kinmadto hiya kan Pilato ngan gin-aro niya an lawas ni Jesus.

en: And it was the day of the Preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
war: Ngan gintanggal an lawas, ginputos hin dugnit nga lino ngan ibinutang ha lubnganan nga inukab ha bato—usa nga lubnganan nga waray pa gud gamita.

en: And the women, who had come with him out of Galilee, followed after, and beheld the tomb, and how his body was laid.
war: Adlaw adto ha pag-andam ngan bisperas na han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they came unto the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.
war: Maagahon pa gud han Domingo kinmadto na ha lubnganan an kababayen-an dara an mga pahamot nga ira gin-andam.

en: And they found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
war: Hinkit-an nira nga nakadto na ha ligid an bato nga igintaklob han porta han lubnganan,

en: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
war: sanglit sinmulod hira; kundi waray nira hiagii an lawas han Ginoo nga Jesus.

en: And it came to pass, while they were perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling apparel:
war: Samtang natindog hira didto nga nagugupong mahitungod hini, tinmindog dayon tupad ha ira in duha nga kalalaken-an nga magsilaw an mga panapton.

en: and as they were affrighted and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
war: Tugob hin kahadlok yinmukbo ha tuna an kababayen-an, samtang ginsiring hira han kalalaken-an, “Kay ano nga ginbibiling niyo an buhi dinhe han mga minatay?

en: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
war: Waray na hiya dinhe, nabanhaw na hiya. Panumdoma an iginsiring niya ha iyo han nakadto pa hiya ha Galilea:

en: saying that the Son of man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
war: ‘Kinahanglan itubyan an Anak han Tawo ngadto han mga makasasala, igraysang ha kros, ngan mabanhaw ha ikatulo ka adlaw.’”

en: And they remembered his words,
war: Niyan nahinumdom an kababayen-an han iya mga pulong,

en: and returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven, and to all the rest.
war: inmoli hira tikang han lubnganan, ngan iginsumat ini ngatanan nga mga butang ngadto han onse nga mga tinun-an ngan han iba pa.

en: Now they were Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James: and the other women with them told these things unto the apostles.
war: An kababayen-an amo hira Maria Magdalena, Juana, ug Maria nga iroy ni Santiago. Hira ngan an iba pa nga kababayen-an nga kaupod nira nagsumat han mga apostoles hini nga mga butang.

en: And these words appeared in their sight as idle talk; and they disbelieved them.
war: Kundi naghunahuna an mga apostoles nga kalurongan la an iginsiring han kababayen-an ngan waray tumuod ha ira.

en: But Peter arose, and ran unto the tomb; and stooping and looking in, he seeth the linen cloths by themselves; and he departed to his home, wondering at that which was come to pass.
war: Kundi binmuhat hi Pedro ngan nagdalagan ngadto ha lubnganan. Inmubo hiya hin paghiling, ngan hinkit-an niya an lino nga mga dugnit ngan waray na iba nga iya hinkit-an. Ngan inmoli hiya nga dako an paghipausa hiunong han nahinabo.

en: And behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was threescore furlongs from Jerusalem.
war: Hadto manta nga adlaw duha han kan Jesus mga tinun-an napakadto ha usa nga baryo nga Emmaus an ngaran, mga onse ka kilometro tikang ha Jerusalem.

en: And they communed with each other of all these things which had happened.
war: Naghihinimangraw hira mahitungod han ngatanan nga mga butang nga nanhinabo.

en: And it came to pass, while they communed and questioned together, that Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
war: Samtang naghihimangraw hira, dinmaop hi Jesus ngan binmunyog ha ira.

en: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
war: Hinkit-an hiya nira, kundi ambot kon ano nga waray man hira pakakilala ha iya.

en: And he said unto them, What communications are these that ye have one with another, as ye walk? And they stood still, looking sad.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Mahitungod hin ano an iyo ginkakarukayakan samtang naglalakat kamo?”

en: And one of them, named Cleopas, answering said unto him, Dost thou alone sojourn in Jerusalem and not know the things which are come to pass there in these days?
war: Inmukoy hira nga mabidoon an ira mga bayhon.

en: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
war: Nagpakiana ha iya an usa ha ira nga Cleopas an ngaran, “Ikaw gud la an umurukoy ha Jerusalem nga waray mahibaro han mga butang nga nanhinabo didto hini nga pira ka mga adlaw nga naglabay?”

en: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.
war: “Ano nga mga butang?” nagpakiana hiya.

en: But we hoped that it was he who should redeem Israel. Yea and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things came to pass.
war: Nagbaton hira, “An mga butang nga nahinabo kan Jesus nga taga-Nazaret. Manaragna ini nga tawo, ngan gin-iisip han Dyos ngan han ngatanan nga mga tawo nga may gahom ha ngatanan nga iya ginyakan ug ginbuhat.

en: Moreover certain women of our company amazed us, having been early at the tomb;
war: Igintubyan hiya han amon mga puno han kapadian ngan mga punoan nga sirotan han kamatayon ngan iginraysang hiya ha kros.

en: and when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.
war: Ngan naglaom gud kami nga amo hiya an magtutubos han Israel! Labot pa hini ngatanan, amo na yana an ikatulo ka adlaw tikang mahinabo ini.

en: And certain of them that were with us went to the tomb, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
war: Nanhipausa kami han sumat hin pira nga kababayen-an han amon hugpo. Kinmadto hira ha lubnganan han maagahon pa,

en: And he said unto them, O foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
war: kundi waray hiagii nira an iya lawas. Binmalik hira hin pagsumat nga nakakita hira hin panan-awon hin mga anghel nga nagsumat ha ira nga buhi hiya.

en: Behooved it not the Christ to suffer these things, and to enter into his glory?
war: Kinmadto ha lubnganan in pira han amon hugpo, ngan hinsabotan nira sumala han iginsiring ha kababayen-an, kundi waray hira makakita ha iya.”

en: And beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he interpreted to them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Hin ka mga lurong niyo, hin kahinay niyo tumoo han ngatanan nga iginsiring han mga manaragna!

en: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they were going: and he made as though he would go further.
war: Diri ba kinahanglan mag-antos anay an Mesiyas hini nga mga butang san-o hiya makasulod han iya himaya?”

en: And they constrained him, saying, Abide with us; for it is toward evening, and the day is now far spent. And he went in to abide with them.
war: Niyan iginsaysay ha ira ni Jesus an iginsiring mahitungod ha iya ha ngatanan nga Kasuratan, tikang han mga basahan ni Moises ngan han mga sinurat han ngatanan nga mga manaragna.

en: And it came to pass, when he had sat down with them to meat, he took the bread and blessed; and breaking it he gave to them.
war: Inmabot hira hirani han baryo nga ira kinakadtoan, ngan nagpakita hi Jesus nga sugad hin magpapadayon pa hiya ngadto ha unhan;

en: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
war: kundi ginhawiran hiya nira, “Pabilin na la upod ha amon kay kulopay na man ngan tikasirom na.” Sanglit sinmulod hiya ngan nagpabilin upod ha ira.

en: And they said one to another, Was not our heart burning within us, while he spake to us in the way, while he opened to us the scriptures?
war: Linmingkod hiya ha lamesa upod ha ira, kinmuha han tinapay, ngan ginbendisyonan ini niya; katapos, ginpinitpinit niya an tinapay ngan iginhatag ha ira.

en: And they rose up that very hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
war: Nabuksan an ira mga mata ngan kinmilala hira ha iya; kundi napara hiya dayon ha ira mga mata.

en: saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
war: Naggipasiringsiring hira, “Diri ba sugad hin kalayo nga nagdidilaab dinhe ha aton, han nagyayakan hiya ha aton dida ha dalan, ngan nagsasaysay ha aton han Kasuratan?”

en: And they rehearsed the things that happened in the way, and how he was known of them in the breaking of the bread.
war: Nagkabuhat hira dayon ngan binmalik ha Jerusalem, diin ira hin-agian nga nagkakatirok an onse nga mga tinun-an, kaupod han iba

en: And as they spake these things, he himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
war: nga nagsiring, “Tinuod gud nga nabanhaw an Ginoo! Nagpakita hiya kan Simon!”

en: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they beheld a spirit.
war: Niyan iginsaysay nira nga duha ha ira an nahinabo ha dalan ngan kon naunan-o an ira pakakilala han Ginoo dida han pagpinitpinit niya han tinapay.

en: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and wherefore do questionings arise in your heart?
war: Samtang nagsusumat hira hini ha ira, tigda la nga tinmindog an Ginoo ngahaw ha butnga nira ngan ginsiring hira, “An kalinaw maada ha iyo.”

en: See my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye behold me having.
war: Tugob hira hin kahadlok ngan kakulba. An ira hunahuna nga kinmita hira hin kalag.

en: And when he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
war: Kundi nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kay ano nga nababaraka man kamo? Kay ano nga nagruruhaduha man kamo ha iyo mga hunahuna?

en: And while they still disbelieved for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here anything to eat?
war: Panginanoa an akon mga kamot ngan mga tiil, ngan kitaa, hi ako gud ini. Kapti ako niyo ngan masabot kamo, kay waray unod ngan mga tul-an an usa nga kalag, sugad han iyo nakikita nga aanhi ha akon.”

en: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish.
war: Iginsiring niya ini ngan iginpakita niya ha ira an iya mga kamot ngan mga tiil.

en: And he took it, and ate before them.
war: Waray la gihapon hira makakatoo tungod han ira dako nga kalipay ngan paghipausa, sanglit nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “May-ada ba niyo sadang makaon dinhe?”

en: And he said unto them, These are my words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must needs be fulfilled, which are written in the law of Moses, and the prophets, and the psalms, concerning me.
war: Gintagan hiya nira hin sinugba nga isda,

en: Then opened he their mind, that they might understand the scriptures;
war: ngan kinarawat ini ni Jesus ngan ginkaon ha ira atubangan.

en: and he said unto them, Thus it is written, that the Christ should suffer, and rise again from the dead the third day;
war: Niyan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Amo gud ini an mga butang nga iginsumat ko ha iyo han kaupod pa ako niyo: kinahanglan matuman an ngatanan nga nahisurat mahitungod ha akon dida han Balaod ni Moises, han mga sinurat han mga manaragna, ngan han mga Salmo.”

en: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name unto all the nations, beginning from Jerusalem.
war: Ngan ginbuksan niya an ira mga hunahuna basi makasabot hira han Kasuratan,

en: Ye are witnesses of these things.
war: ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Amo ini an nahisurat: kinahanglan mag-antos an Mesiyas ngan mabanhaw ha ikatulo ka adlaw,

en: And behold, I send forth the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city, until ye be clothed with power from on high.
war: ngan ha iya ngaran kinahanglan igwali ha ngatanan nga mga nasod, tikang ha Jerusalem, an mensahe mahitungod han pagbasol ngan pagpasaylo han mga sala.

en: And he led them out until they were over against Bethany: and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
war: Mga saksi kamo hini nga mga butang.

en: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he parted from them, and was carried up into heaven.
war: Ngan ako ngahaw an magpapadara nganhi ha iyo han iginsaad han akon Amay. Kundi kinahanglan maghulat kamo didto ha syudad tubtob nga kumunsad ha iyo an gahom nga tikang ha igbaw.”

en: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
war: Niyan gindara hira niya ha gawas han syudad tubtob ha Betania diin gin-alsa niya an iya mga kamot ngan ginbendisyonan hira.

en: and were continually in the temple, blessing God.
war: Samtang nagbebendisyon hiya ha ira, binmaya hiya ha ira ngan ginbayaw hiya ha langit.

en: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
war: Amo ini an pagkasunodsunod han mga kaapoy-apoyan ni Jesu-Cristo nga tulin ni David, nga tulin ni Abraham.

en: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judah and his brethren;
war: 2-6a Tikang kan Abraham ngadto kan Hadi David, amo ini an mga kaapoy-apoyan: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Juda, ngan an iya kabugtoan; Fares ug Sara (an iroy nira amo hi Tamar), Esrom, Aram, Aminadab, Naason, Salmon, Boos (an iroy niya amo hi Rahab), Obed (an iroy niya amo hi Rut), Isai, ngan hi Hadi David.

en: and Judah begat Perez and Zerah of Tamar; and Perez begat Hezron; and Hezron begat Ram;
war: 6b-11 Tikang kan David ngadto han panahon han pagbalhina nga mga bihag han mga tawo han Israel ngadto ha Babilonia, amo ini an mga kaapoy-apoyan: David, Solomon (an iroy niya amo an asawa anay ni Urias), Roboam, Abias, Asa, Josafat, Joram, Usias, Jotam, Acas, Ezequias, Manases, Amon, Josias, ngan hi Jeconias ngan an iya kabugtoan.

en: and Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon; and Nahshon begat Salmon;
war: 12-16 Tikang han panahon kahuman han kabalhin nira nga mga bihag ha Babilonia ngadto han katawo ni Jesus, amo ini an mga kaapoy-apoyan: Salatiel, Sorobabel, Abiud, Eliaquim, Asor, Sadoc, Aquim, Eliud, Eleasar, Matan, Jacob, ngan Jose nga nangasawa kan Maria, an iroy ni Jesus nga ginngaranan nga Mesiyas.

en: and Salmon begat Boaz of Rahab; and Boaz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
war: Sanglit, may-ada katorse ngatanan nga katulinan tikang kan Abraham ngadto kan David, katorse man nga katulinan tikang kan David ngadto han kabalhin nira nga mga bihag ha Babilonia, ngan katorse liwat nga katulinan tikang han kabalhin nira nga mga bihag ha Babilonia ngadto han katawo han Mesiyas.

en: and Jesse begat David the king.
war: Sugad hini an katawo ni Jesu-Cristo. Han karaslon pa la hi Maria nga iroy niya ngan hi Jose, nahibaroan ni Maria nga burod na hiya ha larang han Espiritu Santo.

en: And David begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Uriah;
war: Diri karuyag magpakaalo kan Maria hi Jose kay matadong hiya nga tawo. Sanglit, nakahunahuna hiya hin pagbaya kan Maria hin hilom la.

en: and Solomon begat Rehoboam; and Rehoboam begat Abijah; and Abijah begat Asa;
war: Kundi samtang ginhunahuna niya ini, pinmakita ha iya in usa nga anghel han Ginoo pinaagi hin inop, ngan nagsiring, “Jose, tulin ni David, ayaw pag-alang hin pagkarawat kan Maria nga imo asawa kay nagburod hiya ha larang han Espiritu Santo.

en: and Asa begat Jehoshaphat; and Jehoshaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Uzziah;
war: Mag-aanak hiya hin lalake, ngan pagngangaranan mo hiya nga Jesus, kay magtatalwas hiya han iya katawhan tikang han ira mga sala.”

en: and Uzziah begat Jotham; and Jotham begat Ahaz; and Ahaz begat Hezekiah;
war: Nahinabo ini ngatanan basi matuman an iginyakan han Ginoo pinaagi han manaragna nga nasiring,

en: and Hezekiah begat Manasseh; and Manasseh begat Amon; and Amon begat Josiah;
war: “Magbuburod in usa nga uray nga daraga ngan mag-aanak hin lalake, ngan tatawgon hiya nga Emmanuel” (nga karuyag sidngon, “An Dyos aanhi upod ha aton”).

en: and Josiah begat Jechoniah and his brethren, at the time of the carrying away to Babylon.
war: Sanglit, han pagmata ni Jose, gintuman niya an iginsugo ha iya han anghel han Ginoo, ngan pinangasawa niya hi Maria.

en: And after the carrying away to Babylon, Jechoniah begat Shealtiel; and Shealtiel begat Zerubbabel;
war: Kundi hi Jose waray makighilawas kan Maria tubtob nga nag-anak hi Maria. Ngan Jesus an iginngaran ni Jose han bata.

en: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judæa in the days of Herod the king, behold, Wise-men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,
war: Natawo hi Jesus ha bungto han Betlehem, ha tuna han Judea, han panahon nga hi Herodes an hadi. Waray pag-iha, nagkaabot ha Jerusalem, tikang ha sinirangan, in mga tawo nga batid hin kamaaram bahin han kabitun-an,

en: Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we saw his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
war: ngan nagpakiana hira, “Hain ba an natawo nga bata nga hadi han mga Judiyo? Hinkit-an namon ha sinirangan an iya bituon, ngan kinmanhi kami hin pagsingba ha iya.”

en: And when Herod the king heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
war: Han pakabati hini ni Hadi Herodes, nabaraka hiya pati an bug-os nga Jerusalem.

en: And gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the Christ should be born.
war: Gintirok niya an ngatanan nga mga puno han kapadian ngan mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan ginpakianhan hira, “Diin ba matatawo an Mesiyas?”

en: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judæa: for thus it is written through the prophet,
war: “Didto ha bungto han Betlehem, ha Judea,” nagbaton hira. “Amo ini an iginsurat han manaragna:

en: And thou Bethlehem, land of Judah,
war: ‘Ikaw Betlehem, ha tuna han Juda,

en: Art in no wise least among the princes of Judah:
war: diri ka gud amo an giuubosi han mga bungto han Juda;

en: For out of thee shall come forth a governor,
war: kay magawas tikang ha imo in usa nga pangulo

en: Who shall be shepherd of my people Israel.
war: nga magpapakaupay han akon katawhan nga Israel.’”

en: Then Herod privily called the Wise-men, and learned of them exactly what time the star appeared.
war: Sanglit, iginpatawag ni Herodes hin hilom an mga kamag-araman nga tikang ha sinirangan. Hinbaroan niya tikang ha ira an untop nga takna han pagpakita han bitoon.

en: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search out exactly concerning the young child; and when ye have found him , bring me word, that I also may come and worship him.
war: Ngan ginpakadto hira ha Betlehem ngan gintugon hira: “Pakadto kamo, ngan pamilnga niyo hin maupay an bata. Kon hiagian niyo, pahibaroa ako dayon, basi kumadto man ako hin pagsingba ha iya.”

en: And they, having heard the king, went their way; and lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
war: 9-10 Ngan nagkalakat hira. Nakita nira an amo ngahaw nga bitoon nga hinkit-an nira ha sinirangan. Nalipay hira han pakakita nira han bitoon. Nag-una ini ha ira tubtob nga tinmungod ngan hinmunong ha dapit nga hinmumutangan han bata.

en: And when they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
war: Sinmulod hira han balay ngan hinkit-an nira an bata upod hi Maria nga iroy niya. Linmuhod hira, ngan nagsingba ha iya. Binuksan nira an ira mga dara ngan naghalad hira ha iya hin bulawan, insyenso ug mira.

en: And they came into the house and saw the young child with Mary his mother; and they fell down and worshipped him; and opening their treasures they offered unto him gifts, gold and frankincense and myrrh.
war: Ginpahimangno hira han Dyos pinaagi hin inop nga diri na bumalik hira ngadto kan Herodes; sanglit nangoli hira ngan lain nga dalan an ira gin-agian.

en: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
war: Han paghilakat na nira, pinmakita kan Jose ha inop in usa nga anghel han Ginoo ngan nagsiring, “Buhat, dad-a an bata ngan an iroy niya, ngan palagiw kamo ngadto ha Ehipto. Pabilin kamo didto ngada han pagsidnga ko ha iyo, kay magbibiling han bata hi Herodes basi patayon niya.”

en: Now when they were departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I tell thee: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
war: Binmuhat hi Jose, gindara niya an bata ngan an iroy, ngan pinmalagiw hira ngadto ha Ehipto hadto ngahaw nga gab-i.

en: And he arose and took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt;
war: Nagpabilin hira didto ngada han kamatay ni Herodes. Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginsiring han Ginoo pinaagi han manaragna, “Gintawag ko an akon Anak tikang ha Ehipto.”

en: and was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt did I call my son.
war: Duro an kapungot ni Herodes han pakasabot niya nga gintuyaw la hiya han mga kamag-araman nga tikang ha sinirangan. Nagsugo hiya nga pamatayon an ngatanan nga kabataan nga kalalaken-an ha Betlehem ngan ha higrani nga mga dapit nga may duha ka tuig an panuigon ug bisan diri pa duha ka tuig sumala han iya nahibaroan tikang han mga bisita han takna han pagpakita han bitoon.

en: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the Wise-men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the male children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the borders thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had exactly learned of the Wise-men.
war: Dida hini natuman an iginsurat ni Jeremias nga manaragna nga nasiring:

en: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
war: “Binati in tingog ha Rama,

en: A voice was heard in Ramah,
war: tingog hin mapait nga pagnguyngoy ngan pagtangis.

en: Weeping and great mourning,
war: Nagtangis hi Raquel tungod han iya mga anak,

en: Rachel weeping for her children;
war: nagtangis hiya ngan waray makakaliaw ha iya,

en: And she would not be comforted, because they are not.
war: kay patay na hira ngatanan.”

en: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,
war: Han kamatay na ni Herodes, pinmakita kan Jose pinaagi hin inop didto ha Ehipto in usa nga anghel han Ginoo.

en: Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead that sought the young child’s life.
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Buhat, dad-a an bata ngan an iroy niya, ngan balik ngadto ha tuna han Israel, kay patay na an mga nagdudumot han bata.”

en: And in those days cometh John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judæa, saying,
war: Hadto nga panahon hi Juan nga Parabunyag kinmadto ha kamingawan han Judea ngan nagtikang hin pagwali.

en: Repent ye; for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Magbasol ngan bayai an iyo mga sala kay hirani na an Ginhadian han langit.”

en: For this is he that was spoken of through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
war: Hi Juan amo an hinabihan ni Isaias nga manaragna han pagsiring niya:

en: The voice of one crying in the wilderness,
war: “May nagoliat ha kamingawan,

en: Make ye ready the way of the Lord,
war: ‘Andama niyo an dalan para han Ginoo;

en: Make his paths straight.
war: tadonga an dalan nga iya aagian!’”

en: Now John himself had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his food was locusts and wild honey.
war: Hinimo hin buhok hin kamelyo an kan Juan panapton, anit an iya bakos ha hawak, ngan mga duron ngan dugos ha kagurangan an karaonon niya.

en: Then went out unto him Jerusalem, and all Judæa, and all the region round about the Jordan;
war: Kinmadto ha iya an mga tawo tikang ha Jerusalem, tikang ha bug-os nga lalawigan han Judea ngan tikang han ngatanan nga katunaan nga harani han Salog Jordan.

en: and they were baptized of him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
war: Iginkumpisal nira an ira mga sala ngan ginbunyagan hira ni Juan didto ha Salog Jordan.

en: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said unto them, Ye offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
war: Han pakakita ni Juan han damo nga mga Parisiyo ngan mga Sadusiyo nga nadaop pagpabunyag ha iya, nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kamo nga mga halas—hin-o ngani an nagsumat ha iyo nga makakalikay kamo han tiarabot nga kasina han Dyos?

en: Bring forth therefore fruit worthy of repentance:
war: Ipakita ha iyo mga buhat nga nagbasol na kamo han iyo mga sala.

en: and think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
war: Ayaw kamo tapod nga mga anak kamo ni Abrahan. Nasiring ako ha iyo nga ini nga mga bato mahihimo han Dyos nga mga anak ni Abraham.

en: And even now the axe lieth at the root of the trees: every tree therefore that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
war: Andam na an parakol hin pagpulod han kahoy ha iya mga gamot; pupudlon ngan susunogon an tagsa nga kahoy nga diri nahatag hin maupay nga bunga.

en: I indeed baptize you in water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit and in fire:
war: Nagbubunyag ako ha iyo hin tubig, tigaman han iyo pagbasol; kundi magbubunyag ha iyo han Espiritu Santo ngan hin kalayo hiya nga masunod ha akon. Labaw gud hiya ha akon; diri ngani ako takos magbitbit han iya mga sandalyas.

en: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing-floor; and he will gather his wheat into the garner, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.
war: Dara niya an iya nigo hin pagpalid basi an uhot mahilain han tipasi. Pagtitirokon niya an trigo didto ha iya kamalig, kundi an uhot pagsusunogon ha kalayo nga diri napaparong.”

en: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to the Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
war: Hadto nga panahon, inmabot hi Jesus tikang ha Galilea, ngan kinmadto kan Juan didto ha Jordan basi bunyagan hiya ni Juan.

en: But John would have hindered him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
war: Gintalinguha ni Juan nga magbalhin hi Jesus han iya nahuhunahunaan ngan iya ginsiring, “Ako kunta an angay pagbunyagan mo, kundi ikaw lugod an napakanhi ha akon!”

en: But Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffereth him.
war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Pabay-i la anay ini yana. Kay dida hini nga paagi mahihimo naton an ngatanan nga ginkikinahanglan han Dyos.” Ngan tinmangdo hi Juan.

en: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway from the water: and lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming upon him;
war: Han kabunyagi na kan Jesus, hinmawas hiya han tubig. Nabuksan an langit ngan hinkit-an ni Jesus an Espiritu han Dyos nga nakunsad sugad hin sarapati ngan hinmugdon dida ha iya.

en: and lo, a voice out of the heavens, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
war: Ngan nagsiring in tingog tikang ha langit, “Amo ini an akon hinigugma nga Anak nga nakakalipay gud ha akon.”

en: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
war: Niyan gindara hi Jesus han Espiritu ngadto han kamingawan basi pagsulayon han Yawa.

en: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he afterward hungered.
war: Katapos hin 40 ka adlaw ngan 40 ka gab-i nga pagpuasa, ginutom hi Jesus.

en: And the tempter came and said unto him, If thou art the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.
war: Dinmaop ha iya an Yawa ngan nagsiring, “Kon Anak ka manggud han Dyos, himoa nga tinapay ini nga mga bato.”

en: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus, “Nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Nabubuhi an tawo diri la hin tinapay, kundi han tagsa nga pulong nga ginyayakan han Dyos.’”

en: Then the devil taketh him into the holy city; and he set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
war: Niyan gindara hiya han Yawa ngadto han Baraan nga Syudad, ngan ibinutang hiya didto han gihahataasi nga atop han Templo,

en: and saith unto him, If thou art the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written,
war: ngan ginsiring hiya, “Kon Anak ka manggud han Dyos, patinhulog ngadto ha tuna kay nasiring an kasuratan,

en: He shall give his angels charge concerning thee:
war: ‘Magsusugo an Dyos han iya mga anghel mahitungod ha imo;

en: and,
war: sasapnayon ka nira han ira mga kamot,

en: On their hands they shall bear thee up,
war: basi diri mapilas an imo mga tiil ha mga bato.’”

en: Lest haply thou dash thy foot against a stone.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Kundi nasiring man liwat an kasuratan, ‘Kinahanglan diri mo pagsulayon an Ginoo nga imo Dyos.’”

en: Jesus said unto him, Again it is written, Thou shalt not make trial of the Lord thy God.
war: Niyan gindara hiya han Yawa ngadto hin gihahataasi nga bukid ngan iginpakita ha iya an ngatanan nga mga ginhadian han kalibutan, ngan an ira kagamhanan.

en: Again, the devil taketh him unto an exceeding high mountain, and showeth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
war: “Ihahatag ko ha imo ini ngatanan,” nagsiring an Yawa, “kon humapa ka ngan magsingba ka ha akon.”

en: and he said unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Iwas dida, Satanas! Kay nasiring an kasuratan,

en: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
war: ‘Singbahon mo an Ginoo nga imo Dyos,

en: Then the devil leaveth him; and behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
war: ngan hiya la an pag-alagdon nimo!’”

en: Now when he heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee;
war: Ngan binmaya an Yawa kan Jesus, ngan nagkaabot in mga anghel ug nagtimangno kan Jesus.

en: and leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the borders of Zebulun and Naphtali:
war: Han pakabati ni Jesus nga napriso hi Juan, kinmadto hiya ha Galilea.

en: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
war: Waray na hiya pag-ukoy ha Nazaret kundi ha Capernaum. Aada ini nga bungto ha ligid han Lanaw Galilea, ha katunaan han Zabulon ug Neftali.

en: The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali,
war: Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginsurat ni Isaias nga manaragna nga nasiring:

en: Toward the sea, beyond the Jordan,
war: “Galilea han mga Hentil!

en: Galilee of the Gentiles,
war: An tuna ha Zabulon ngan an tuna ha Neftali,

en: The people that sat in darkness
war: aragian tipakadto ha dagat, ha tabok han Jordan.

en: Saw a great light,
war: An mga tawo nga nag-uukoy ha kasisidman

en: And to them that sat in the region and shadow of death,
war: makita hin dako nga kapawa.

en: To them did light spring up.
war: Ha ira nga nag-uokoy ha masirom nga tuna han kamatayon

en: From that time began Jesus to preach, and to say, Repent ye; for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
war: malamrag an kapawa!”

en: And walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brethren, Simon who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishers.
war: Tikang hadto nagtikang hi Jesus hin pagwali, “Bayai niyo an iyo mga sala, kay hirani na an Ginhadian han langit!”

en: And he saith unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you fishers of men.
war: Samtang naglalakat hi Jesus ha baybayon han Lanaw han Galilea, hinkit-an niya in duha nga magbugto nga mangirisda, hi Simon nga tinatawag nga Pedro ngan an iya bugto nga hi Andres, nga nagtutunod han ira pukot didto han lanaw.

en: And they straightway left the nets, and followed him.
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Upod kamo ha akon ngan tututdoan ko kamo pagdakop hin mga tawo.”

en: And going on from thence he saw two other brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
war: Ira binayaan dayon an ira mga pukot ngan binmunyog hira ha iya.

en: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into the mountain: and when he had sat down, his disciples came unto him:
war: Han pakakita ni Jesus han damo nga mga tawo, sinmagka hiya hin pungtod ngan didto linmingkod hiya. Gin-alirongan hiya han iya mga tinun-an,

en: and he opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
war: ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtutdo ha ira:

en: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
war: “Palaran adton nakilala nga kablas hira ha espiritu,

en: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
war: kay ira an Ginhadian han langit!

en: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
war: “Palaran adton masulob-on,

en: Blessed are they that hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
war: kay pagliliawon hira han Dyos!

en: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
war: “Palaran adton mapinaubsanon,

en: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
war: kay kakarawaton nira an iginsaad han Dyos!

en: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called sons of God.
war: “Palaran adton may dako nga tinguha pagtuman han kaburut-on han Dyos,

en: Blessed are they that have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
war: kay patutungahon gud hira han Dyos!

en: Blessed are ye when men shall reproach you, and persecute you, and say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
war: “Palaran adton maloloy-on ha iba,

en: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets that were before you.
war: kay malolooy man an Dyos ha ira!

en: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost its savor, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under foot of men.
war: “Palaran adton maglinis in kasingkasing,

en: Ye are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hid.
war: kay makakakita hira han Dyos!

en: Neither do men light a lamp, and put it under the bushel, but on the stand; and it shineth unto all that are in the house.
war: “Palaran adton nagbubuhat para hin kamurayaw ha mga tawo,

en: Even so let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
war: kay tatawgon hira nga mga anak han Dyos!

en: Think not that I came to destroy the law or the prophets: I came not to destroy, but to fulfil.
war: “Palaran adton ginpapakurian tungod nga nagtutuman hira han kaburut-on han Dyos,

en: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass away, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass away from the law, till all things be accomplished.
