en: And he that was sown among the thorns, this is he that heareth the word; and the care of the world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
war: Adton nakabati han mensahe mahitungod han Ginhadian sugad hira han binhe nga nahulog ha dalan, kundi waray makasabot hini. Inmabot an Yawa ngan gin-agaw an iginsabod dida ha ira.

en: And he that was sown upon the good ground, this is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; who verily beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
war: An binhe nga nahulog ha batoon nga tuna, amo an mga tawo nga nakarawat nga malipayon han mensahe ha pakakabati nira hini.

en: Another parable set he before them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man that sowed good seed in his field:
war: Kundi waray ini makagamot hin maupay dida ha ira, ngan diri nag-iiha. Sanglit ha pag-aabot hin mga kakurian ngan mga kasakitan tungod han mensahe, nabaya dayon hira.

en: but while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares also among the wheat, and went away.
war: An binhe nga nahulog ha tunokon nga kabanwaan amo an mga tawo nga namamati han mensahe, kundi nalulumos ini nga mensahe han mga kabaraka mahitungod hini nga kinabuhi ngan han paghigugma han mga manggad, ngan diri hira nabunga.

en: But when the blade sprang up and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
war: Ngan an binhe nga iginpugas ha maupay nga tuna amo an mga tawo nga namamati ngan nakakasabot han mensahe. Namumunga hira, may nabunga hin 100 ka pilo, 60 ka pilo an iba, ngan an iba, 30 ka pilo.”

en: And the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst thou not sow good seed in thy field? whence then hath it tares?
war: Naghimangraw liwat hi Jesus ha ira hin lain nga pananglitan: “An Ginhadian han langit sugad hin tawo nga nagsabod hin maupay nga binhe ha iya uma.

en: And he said unto them, An enemy hath done this. And the servants say unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
war: Usa ka gab-i, han nangangaturog na an ngatanan, kinmadto an kaaway ngan nagsabod hin mga liso hin banwa tampo han mga humay, ngan linmakat hiya.

en: But he saith, Nay; lest haply while ye gather up the tares, ye root up the wheat with them.
war: Han pagtubo na han mga tanom ngan pagtikang na panguhay, tinmubo liwat an mga banwa.

en: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of the harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather up first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.
war: An mga surugoon kinmadto han agaron hin pagpakiana ha iya, ‘Agaron, diri ba maupay nga binhe an iginsabwag mo ha imo uma? Diin man tikang an mga banwa?’

en: Another parable set he before them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like unto a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
war: ‘Usa nga kaaway an nagbuhat hini,’ binmaton hiya. Nagpakiana hira ha iya, ‘Karuyag ba nimo nga panggaboton namon an mga banwa?’

en: which indeed is less than all seeds; but when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the heaven come and lodge in the branches thereof.
war: Binmaton hiya, ‘Ayaw! Kay bangin ha paggabot niyo han mga banwa mahiupod an iba nga humay.

en: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till it was all leavened.
war: Pabay-i niyo nga tumubo an humay ngan an banwa ngada han pag-ani, kay sisidngon ko na la an mga mag-arani: gabota anay niyo an mga banwa, pamutka niyo, ngan sunoga; katapos, tiroka an humay ngan isulod ha akon kamalig.’”

en: All these things spake Jesus in parables unto the multitudes; and without a parable spake he nothing unto them:
war: 31-32 Naghimangraw liwat hi Jesus ha ira hin lain nga pananglitan: “An Ginhadian han langit sugad hin liso hin mustasa. Kinukuha ini hin usa ka tawo ngan iginpupugas ha iya uma. Amo ini an gigutiayi han ngatanan nga liso, kundi kon natubo na, nahihimo nga gidadakoi han ngatanan nga mga tanom. Nahihimo ini nga kahoy, ngan napakada an katamsihan ngan nagsasalag dida han iya mga sanga.”

en: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,
war: Naghimangraw liwat hi Jesus ha ira hin lain pa nga pananglitan: “An Ginhadian han langit sugad hin patubo. Kinukuha ini hin babaye ngan iginmamasa ha usa ka takos nga harina, tubtob han pagtubo han bug-os nga minasa.”

en: I will open my mouth in parables;
war: Ginmamit hi Jesus hin mga pananglitan pagsumat hini ngatanan nga mga butang ha mga tawo; waray hiya maghimangraw hin bisan ano ha ira nga diri pinaagi hin pananglitan.

en: I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.
war: Ginbuhat niya ini basi matuman an iginsiring han manaragna:

en: Then he left the multitudes, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Explain unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
war: “Magamit ako hin mga pananglitan

en: And he answered and said, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
war: kon magyayakan ako ha ira,

en: and the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the sons of the kingdom; and the tares are the sons of the evil one ;
war: pagsusumatan ko hira hin mga butang

en: and the enemy that sowed them is the devil: and the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are angels.
war: nga waray pa nira hibaroi tikang mahimo an kalibutan.”

en: As therefore the tares are gathered up and burned with fire; so shall it be in the end of the world.
war: Niyan binmaya hi Jesus han mga tawo ngan sinmakob hin balay. Hinmarani ha iya an iya mga tinun-an, ngan nagsiring ha iya; “Sumati daw kami han kahulogan han pananglitan han mga banwa ha uma.”

en: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that cause stumbling, and them that do iniquity,
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “An Anak han Tawo amo an tawo nga nagpugas han maupay nga binhe;

en: and shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
war: an kalibutan amo an uma; an mga tawo nga sakop han Ginhadian amo an maupay nga binhe; an mga tawo nga sakop han Yawa amo an mga banwa.

en: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He that hath ears, let him hear.
war: Ngan an Yawa ngahaw amo an kaaway nga nagsabwag han mga banwa. An katapos han kalibutan amo an pag-ani; ngan an mga anghel amo an mga mag-arani.

en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a treasure hidden in the field; which a man found, and hid; and in his joy he goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
war: Sugad nga gintitirok an mga banwa ngan ginsusunog ha kalayo, amo man ini ha katapos han kalibutan.

en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is a merchant seeking goodly pearls:
war: Magsusugo an Anak han Tawo han iya mga anghel, ngan titirokon nira tikang han iya Ginhadian an ngatanan nga nakadarahig han mga tawo hin pakasala ngan an ngatanan nga magbuhat hin maraot,

en: and having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
war: ngan ilalabog hira ngadto han naglalaga nga hudno. Magtatangis hira didto ngan manliligot an ira mga ngipon.

en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
war: Niyan, masanag an mga tawo han Dyos pareho han adlaw didto han Ginhadian han Amay nira. Sanglit pamati, kon may-ada niyo mga durunggan!

en: which, when it was filled, they drew up on the beach; and they sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but the bad they cast away.
war: “An Ginhadian han langit sugad hin tinago nga manggad didto hin uma. Nahinabo nga hin-agian ini hin usa ka tawo, ngan iya liwat ini ginlubong. Duro an iya kalipay, ngan malakat hiya hin pagbaligya han ngatanan niya nga mga butang, ngan unina, mabalik hiya ngan papaliton niya an uma.

en: So shall it be in the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the righteous,
war: “An Ginhadian han langit sugad liwat hin usa ka tawo nga namimiling hin makaruruyag nga mga perlas.

en: and shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
war: Kon nakakaagi hiya hin usa nga talagsaon la an kaanyag, nalakat hiya ngan iginbabaligya an ngatanan niya nga mga butang, ngan pinapalit niya an perlas.

en: Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea.
war: “An Ginhadian han langit sugad liwat hin pukot nga gintunod ha lanaw, nga nakadakop hin magkalainlain nga isda.

en: And he said unto them, Therefore every scribe who hath been made a disciple to the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is a householder, who bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
war: Kon puno na an pukot, binubutong an pukot han mga mangirisda ngadto ha baybayon, ngan nalingkod hira hin pagpili han mga isda: isinusulod an mag-upay nga isda ha ira mga alat ngan ilinalabog an waray pulos.

en: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
war: Pareho hini an mahinanabo ha katapos han kalibutan: magawas an mga anghel ngan paglalainon an magraot nga mga tawo tikang han mga mag-upay

en: And coming into his own country he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
war: ngan ilalabog hira ngadto han naglalaga nga hudno. Mananangis hira didto ngan manliligot an ira mga ngipon.

en: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joseph, and Simon, and Judas?
war: “Nakasabot ba kamo hini nga mga butang?” nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira.

en: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
war: “Oo,” nagbaton hira.

en: At that season Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
war: Hadto nga panahon nakabati hi Herodes, nga hadi ha Galilea mahitungod kan Jesus.

en: and said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore do these powers work in him.
war: “Amo gud hiya hi Juan nga Parabunyag nga nabanhaw,” ginsiring niya an iya mga sakop. “Sanglit may-ada niya hini nga gahom hin pagbuhat hin mga milagro.”

en: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
war: Kay iginpadakop, iginpagapos, ngan iginpapriso ni Herodes hi Juan. Ginbuhat niya ini tungod kan Herodias nga asawa han iya ngahaw bugto nga hi Felipe.

en: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
war: Ginsiniring hi Herodes ni Juan nga Parabunyag, “Diri tugot nga pangasaw-on mo an asawa han imo bugto!”

en: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
war: Karuyag ni Herodes patayon hi Juan, kundi nahadlok hiya han mga Judiyo, kay gin-isip nira nga manaragna hi Juan.

en: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced in the midst, and pleased Herod.
war: Dida han kaadlawan ni Herodes sinmayaw an anak nga babaye ni Herodias ha atubangan han ngatanan. Duro an kalipay ni Herodes,

en: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she should ask.
war: sanglit nagsaad hiya ha iya: “Nagsusumpa ako nga akon ihahatag ha imo an bisan ano nga imo pangaroon!”

en: And she, being put forward by her mother, saith, Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.
war: Ha paglarang han iroy niya, nagsiring hiya kan Herodes, “Ihatag ha akon yana dayon sinalod ha plato an ulo ni Juan nga Parabunyag!”

en: And the king was grieved; but for the sake of his oaths, and of them that sat at meat with him, he commanded it to be given;
war: Nabido an hadi, kundi tungod han panumpa nga ginhimo niya ha atubangan han iya mga dinapit, nagsugo hiya nga tumanon an pinangangaro han daragita.

en: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
war: Sanglit pinapugotan niya hi Juan didto ha bilanggoan.

en: And his head was brought on a platter, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
war: Gindara an ulo nga sinalod ha plato ngan iginhatag ngadto han daragita, ngan gindara han daragita ngadto han iroy niya.

en: And his disciples came, and took up the corpse, and buried him; and they went and told Jesus.
war: Niyan inmabot an mga tinun-an ni Juan, ginkuha nira an iya lawas, ngan iginlubong; pagkatapos, napakadto hira hin pagsumat kan Jesus.

en: Now when Jesus heard it , he withdrew from thence in a boat, to a desert place apart: and when the multitudes heard thereof , they followed him on foot from the cities.
war: Han pakabati ni Jesus nga ginpatay hi Juan, binmaya hiya ngadto nga dapit, ngan nagsakay hiya. Kinmadto hiya nga waray niya upod, hin dapit nga mamingaw. Hinbaroan ini han mga tawo. Binayaan nira an ira mga bungto, ngan nagbaktas hira hin pagsunod ha iya.

en: And he came forth, and saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, and healed their sick.
war: Paghaw-as ni Jesus han sakayan hinkit-an niya an kadam-an nga mga tawo, ngan inalpan hiya hin dako nga kalooy ha ira, ngan gintambal niya an ira mga magsakit.

en: And when even was come, the disciples came to him, saying, The place is desert, and the time is already past; send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.
war: Hadto ngahaw nga kulop, dinmaop ha iya an mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring, “Tikasirom na, ngan tay-aw ini nga dapit. Palakta na an mga tawo ngan pakadtoa hira ha mga kabaryohan, basi makapalit hira hin pagkaon.”

en: But Jesus said unto them, They have no need to go away; give ye them to eat.
war: “Diri kinahanglan nga magkalakat hira,” binmaton hi Jesus. “Hi kamo ngahaw in pagpakaon ha ira.”

en: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
war: Nagbaton hira, “Lilima la ka bug-os an aton tinapay ngan duduha an isda.”

en: And he said, Bring them hither to me.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Dad-a niyo ngadi.”

en: And he commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake and gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.
war: Pinapanlingkod niya an mga tawo ha kabanwaan; kinuha niya an lima nga tinapay ngan duha nga isda, ngan hinmanggad hiya ha langit pagpasalamat han Dyos. Ginpinitpinit niya an tinapay ngan iginhatag ha mga tinun-an, ngan igindorot ini ngadto han mga tawo.

en: And they all ate, and were filled: and they took up that which remained over of the broken pieces, twelve baskets full.
war: Nangaon an ngatanan ngan nagkabubusog. Katapos, gintirok han mga tinun-an an mga salin nga nakapuno hin dose ka alat.

en: And they that did eat were about five thousand men, besides women and children.
war: Lima ka yukot nga kalalaken-an an nangaon, labot han kababayen-an ngan han kabataan.

en: And straightway he constrained the disciples to enter into the boat, and to go before him unto the other side, till he should send the multitudes away.
war: Niyan ginpasakay hin sakayan ni Jesus an mga tinun-an ngan ginpauna niya ngadto ha tabok han lanaw, samtang ginpalakat niya an mga tawo.

en: And after he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain apart to pray: and when even was come, he was there alone.
war: Kahuman niya palakta an mga tawo, sinmagka hiya hin bukid nga usa la hiya, basi hiya mag-ampo. Han pagkagab-i na nag-usaan la didto hi Jesus.

en: But the boat was now in the midst of the sea, distressed by the waves; for the wind was contrary.
war: Hini nga takna nakadto na an sakayan ha lawod, gindadasmagan han mga balod kay sungsong adto han hangin.

en: And in the fourth watch of the night he came unto them, walking upon the sea.
war: Ha may mga alas tres ngadto ha alas seis na han kaagahon kinmadto ha ira hi Jesus nga naglalakat ha bawbaw han tubig.

en: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a ghost; and they cried out for fear.
war: Han pakakita han mga tinun-an ha iya nga naglalakat hiya ha bawbaw han tubig, duro an ira kahadlok. “Iini in murto,” nagsiring hira, ngan ginmoliat hira tungod hin kahadlok.

en: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
war: Nagyakan dayon hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok! Ako gad ini!”

en: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee upon the waters.
war: Niyan nagsiring hi Pedro, “Ginoo, kon tinuod nga ikaw, palakata man ako ha bawbaw han tubig ngada ha imo.”

en: And he said, Come. And Peter went down from the boat, and walked upon the waters to come to Jesus.
war: “Pakadi!” binmaton hi Jesus. Sanglit hinmaw-as hi Pedro han sakayan ngan nagtikang hin paglakat ha bawbaw han tubig ngadto kan Jesus.

en: But when he saw the wind, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, Lord, save me.
war: Kundi han pakasabot niya nga makusog an hangin, nahadlok hiya ngan nagtikang hiya hin paglunod. “Tabagi ako, Ginoo!” ginmoliat hiya.

en: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and took hold of him, and saith unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
war: Kinaptan ngan binutong hiya dayon ni Jesus ngan sidngon, “Pagkagutiay han imo pagtoo! Kay ano nga nagruhaduha ka?”

en: And when they were gone up into the boat, the wind ceased.
war: Sinmakay hira han sakayan ngan hinmugpoy an hangin.

en: And they that were in the boat worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
war: Nagsingba kan Jesus an mga tinun-an nga nakada han sakayan ngan nagsiring hira, “Matuod gud nga ikaw amo an Anak han Dyos!”

en: And when they had crossed over, they came to the land, unto Gennesaret.
war: Tinmabok hira han lanaw ngan inmabot ha Genesaret,

en: And when the men of that place knew him, they sent into all that region round about, and brought unto him all that were sick;
war: diin kinmilala kan Jesus an mga tawo. Sanglit iginpakuha nira an mga magsakit didto hito nga katunaan ngan gindara nira ngadto kan Jesus.

en: and they besought him that they might only touch the border of his garment: and as many as touched were made whole.
war: Nakimalooy hira ha iya nga tugotan niya an mga magsakit hin pagkapot bisan na manla han sidsid han iya bado; ngan nagkauupay an ngatanan nga nakakapot.

en: Then there come to Jesus from Jerusalem Pharisees and scribes, saying,
war: Niyan dinmaop kan Jesus in mga Parisiyo ngan mga magturutdo han Balaod nga tikang ha Jerusalem, ngan nagpakiana ha iya:

en: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
war: “Kay ano nga diri nagtutuman an imo mga tinun-an han pagturon-an nga igintutdo han aton mga kaapoy-apoyan? Diri anay hira nanhuhunaw han angay nga paagi nga diri pa hira nakaon!”

en: And he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God because of your tradition?
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Kay ano man liwat nga diri niyo ginsusugot an sugo han Dyos, kundi asay lugod niyo ginsusunod an iyo kalugaringon nga pagturon-an?

en: For God said, Honor thy father and thy mother: and, He that speaketh evil of father or mother, let him die the death.
war: Kay nagsiring an Dyos, ‘Tahora an amay ngan an iroy niyo,’ ngan ‘Kinahanglan patayon adton nagpapakaraot han amay o iroy niya.’

en: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, That wherewith thou mightest have been profited by me is given to God ;
war: Kundi nagtututdo kamo nga kon in tawo may-ada niya sadang magamit hin pagbulig han amay o iroy niya, kundi kon sumiring ha ira, ‘Kanan Dyos na ini,’

en: he shall not honor his father. And ye have made void the word of God because of your tradition.
war: diri na kinahanglan tumahod pa hiya han iya kag-anak. Amo ini an paagi han pagsalikway niyo han pulong han Dyos basi la niyo pagsundon an iyo kalugaringon nga pagturon-an.

en: Ye hypocrites, well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
war: Mga salingkapaw kamo! Waray gud pagsayop an igintagna ni Isaias mahitungod ha iyo!

en: This people honoreth me with their lips;
war: ‘Gintatahod ako hini nga katawhan

en: But their heart is far from me.
war: pinaagi han ira la mga pulong, nasiring an Dyos,

en: But in vain do they worship me,
war: kundi hirayo ha akon an ira kasingkasing.

en: Teaching as their doctrines the precepts of men.
war: Kawang la an pagsingba nira ha akon,

en: And he called to him the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
war: kay nagtututdo hira

en: Not that which entereth into the mouth defileth the man; but that which proceedeth out of the mouth, this defileth the man.
war: hin mga hinimo la hin tawo

en: Then came the disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, when they heard this saying?
war: nga mga turumanon sugad nga akon mga sugo!’”

en: But he answered and said, Every plant which my heavenly Father planted not, shall be rooted up.
war: Niyan gintawag ni Jesus an mga tawo ngan ginsiring hira: “Pamati, ngan sabota niyo!

en: Let them alone: they are blind guides. And if the blind guide the blind, both shall fall into a pit.
war: Diri an nasulod ha baba han tawo an nakakahugaw ha iya; an nagawas lugod ha baba an nakakahugaw ha iya.”

en: And Peter answered and said unto him, Declare unto us the parable.
war: Niyan hinmarani ha iya an mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring, “Maaram ka ba nga napungot an mga Parisiyo han imo iginyakan?”

en: And he said, Are ye also even yet without understanding?
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Gagaboton an tagsa nga tanom nga waray igtanom han akon Amay ha langit.

en: Perceive ye not, that whatsoever goeth into the mouth passeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
war: Ayaw kabaraka ha ira! Mga buta hira nga mga pangulo; ngan kon magtutugway in buta hin igkasi buta, mahuhulog hira nga duha ngadto hin kali.”

en: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come forth out of the heart; and they defile the man.
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro, “Sumati daw kami han kahulogan hini nga pananglitan.”

en: For out of the heart come forth evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, railings:
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Diri pa ngay-an kamo labaw hin kamaaram kay han iba.

en: these are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not the man.
war: Diri ba kamo nasabot? An bisan ano nga nasulod ha baba hin tawo napasingadto ha tiyan ngan katapos nagawas ha iya lawas?

en: And Jesus went out thence, and withdrew into the parts of Tyre and Sidon.
war: Kundi natikang ha kasingkasing an mga butang nga nagawas ha baba; amo ini nga mga butang an nakakahugaw han tawo.

en: And behold, a Canaanitish woman came out from those borders, and cried, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a demon.
war: Kay nagawas tikang ha kasingkasing hin tawo an magraot nga panhunahuna nga nag-aaghat ha iya hin pagpatay, panlibog, ngan pagbuhat hin iba nga maglaw-ay nga mga butang, panikas, pagbuwa, ngan pagpakaraot han iba.

en: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
war: Amo ini an nakakahugaw han tawo. Kundi diri nakakahugaw hin tawo an pagkaon nga diri anay nanhuhunaw sumala han isinisiring nira ha iyo.”

en: But he answered and said, I was not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus hadto nga dapit ngan kinmadto ha katunaan hirani han mga syudad han Tiro ug Sidon.

en: But she came and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
war: Hinmarani ha iya in babaye nga taga Canaan nga nag-ukoy didto nga dapit ngan nakimalooy, “Ginoo, Anak ni David! Kalooyi gad ako! Sinasangkayan hin maraot nga espiritu an akon anak nga babaye ngan makuri gud an iya kamutangan.”

en: And he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread and cast it to the dogs.
war: Kundi waray magbaton hi Jesus ha iya. Dinmaop an iya mga tinun-an ngan naghangyo kan Jesus, “Paiwasa hiya! Nagsusunodsunod hiya ha aton ngan maaringasa hiya!”

en: But she said, Yea, Lord: for even the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.
war: Niyan binmaton hi Jesus, “Ginpadara ako ngadto la han mga nagkawawara nga karnero han katawhan han Israel!”

en: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it done unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was healed from that hour.
war: Kundi hinmarani an babaye ngan hinmapa ha tiilan ni Jesus ngan nagsiring, “Buligi gad ako, Ginoo!”

en: And Jesus departed thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Diri angay kuhaon an pagkaon han mga anak ngan ilabog ngadto han mga ayam.”

en: And there came unto him great multitudes, having with them the lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and they cast them down at his feet; and he healed them:
war: Binmaton an babaye, “Matuod gud an imo siring. Kundi bisan ngani an mga ayam nangangaon han mga salin nga natataktak tikang ha lamesa han ira agaron.”

en: insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb speaking, the maimed whole, and the lame walking, and the blind seeing: and they glorified the God of Israel.
war: Sanglit binmaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Babaye, pagkadako han imo pagtoo! Matutumanan ka han imo pinangangaro!” Ngan naupay an iya anak hito ngahaw nga takna.

en: And Jesus called unto him his disciples, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days and have nothing to eat: and I would not send them away fasting, lest haply they faint on the way.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus hadto nga dapit ngan nagligid hiya han baybayon han lanaw ha Galilea.

en: And the disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so many loaves in a desert place as to fill so great a multitude?
war: Sinmagka hiya hin pungtod ngan linmingkod. Hinmarani ha iya in kadam-an nga mga tawo nga nagdara hin mga piay, mga buta, mga lulid, mga ngula, ngan damo pa nga mga magsakit, ngan gindara nira ha tiilan ni Jesus; ngan gintambal hira niya.

en: And Jesus said unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few small fishes.
war: Nahipausa an mga tawo han pakakita nira nga nagpakayakan na an mga ngula, nagkauupay na an mga lulid, nagpakalakat na an mga piay, ngan nagpakakita na an mga buta; ngan gindayaw nira an Dyos han Israel.

en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;
war: Gintawag ni Jesus an iya mga tinun-an ngan ginsiring, “Nalolooy ako hini nga mga tawo kay kaupod hira nakon hin tulo na ka adlaw, ngan waray na hira pagkaon yana. Diri ko karuyag paolion hira kon diri anay magpakakaon, kay bangin mahiraptay hira dida ha dalan ha ira pangoli.”

en: and he took the seven loaves and the fishes; and he gave thanks and brake, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.
war: Nagpakiana an mga tinun-an ha iya, “Diin man kita pakakaagi hin igo nga pagkaon dinhe hini nga kamingawan basi ipakaon hini nga mga tawo?”

en: And they all ate, and were filled: and they took up that which remained over of the broken pieces, seven baskets full.
war: “Pipira pa man an iyo tinapay?” nagpakiana hi Jesus.

en: And they that did eat were four thousand men, besides women and children.
war: Binmaton hira, “Pipito na la ka bug-os ngan hin pipira nga gudtiay nga mga isda.”

en: And he sent away the multitudes, and entered into the boat, and came into the borders of Magadan.
war: Pinapanlingkod ni Jesus ha tuna an mga tawo.

en: And the Pharisees and Sadducees came, and trying him asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
war: May pira nga mga Parisiyo ngan mga Sadusiyo nga dinmaop kan Jesus. Karuyag nira pagbitik ha iya, sanglit nangaro hira nga magpakita hiya ha ira hin milagro nga tikang ha langit basi hira makasabot nga tikang hiya sa Dyos.

en: But he answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the heaven is red.
war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus, “Kon tikaturunod na an adlaw, nasiring kamo, ‘Magmamaupay an panahon kay mapula an langit.’

en: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to-day: for the heaven is red and lowering. Ye know how to discern the face of the heaven; but ye cannot discern the signs of the times.
war: Niyan ha kaagahon nasiring kamo, ‘Mauran yana kay mapula ngan madalumdom an langit.’ Nakakatagna kamo han panahon pinaagi hin pagtan-aw la han langit; kundi diri kamo nakakahubad han mga tigaman hini nga mga panahon!

en: An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of Jonah. And he left them, and departed.
war: Pagkamaraot ngan pagkawaray pagtoo han Dyos han mga tawo hini nga panahon! Naaro ba kamo ha akon hin milagro? Diri ako mahatag! An milagro la ni Jonas an ihahatag ha iyo.”

en: And the disciples came to the other side and forgot to take bread.
war: Kahuman, binayaan niya hira ngan linmakat.

en: And Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
war: Han pagtabok han mga tinun-an ngadto ha luyo han lanaw, nahingalimot hira pagdara hin tinapay.

en: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, We took no bread.
war: Ginsiring hira ni Jesus, “Pagbantay ngan paghirot kamo han patubo han mga Parisiyo ngan mga Sadusiyo.”

en: And Jesus perceiving it said, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have no bread?
war: Naghiruhimangraw an mga tinun-an, “Nasiring hiya hini kay waray man kita magdara hin tinapay.”

en: Do ye not yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
war: Nahibaroan ni Jesus an ira ginkarukayakan, sanglit nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “Kay ano nga naghinabe man kamo mahitungod han kawaray niyo tinapay? Pagkagutiay han iyo pagtoo!

en: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
war: Diri la gihapon kamo nasabot? Diri ba kamo nahinunumdom han pagpinitpinit ko han lima ka bug-os nga tinapay para han lima ka yukot nga mga tawo? Pira ka alat an napuno niyo han nanhisalin?

en: How is it that ye do not perceive that I spake not to you concerning bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
war: Ngan mahitungod han pito ka bug-os nga tinapay para han upat ka yukot nga mga tawo, pira ka alat an napuno niyo han nanhisalin?

en: Then understood they that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
war: Kay ano nga waray kamo makasabot nga waray ako maghinabe hin tinapay ha iyo? Pagbantay kamo han patubo han mga Parisiyo ngan mga Sadusiyo!”

en: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Cæsarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Who do men say that the Son of man is?
war: Niyan nakasabot an mga tinun-an nga waray hiya maghinabe ha ira mahitungod hin paglikay han patubo nga ginagamit ha tinapay, kundi hin paglikay han pagturon-an han mga Parisiyo ngan mga Sadusiyo.

en: And they said, Some say John the Baptist; some, Elijah; and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.
war: Niyan kinmadto hi Jesus ha katunaan hirani han bungto han Cesarea Filipo, ngan didto ginpakianhan niya an iya mga tinun-an, “Sumala han siring han mga tawo, hin-o man kono an Anak han Tawo?”

en: He saith unto them, But who say ye that I am?
war: Nagbaton hira, “May nasiring nga hiya amo hi Juan nga Parabunyag; nasiring an iba nga hiya amo hi Elias; ngan nasiring na man liwat an iba nga hiya amo hi Jeremias o usa han mga manaragna.”

en: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira, “An ha iyo, hin-o man ako?”

en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-Jonah: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father who is in heaven.
war: Binmaton hi Simon Pedro, “Ikaw amo an Mesiyas, an Anak han Dyos nga buhi.”

en: And I also say unto thee, that thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it.
war: Ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “Palaran ka, Simon nga anak ni Juan, kay waray umabot ha imo ini nga kamatuoran tikang hin bisan hin-o nga tawo, kundi iginhatag ini ha imo han akon Amay ha langit.

en: I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven; and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
war: Sanglit nasiring ako ha imo: ikaw hi Pedro ngan ha bawbaw hini nga bato titindogon ko an akon singbahan, ngan diri makakadaog hini an gahom han kamatayon.

en: Then charged he the disciples that they should tell no man that he was the Christ.
war: Ihahatag ko ha imo an mga yawi han Ginhadian han Langit; an imo diri hubaran dinhe ha tuna diri man liwat huhubaran dinhe ha langit; ngan an imo hubaran dinhe ha tuna huhubaran man liwat didto ha langit.”

en: From that time began Jesus to show unto his disciples, that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
war: Niyan gintugon ni Jesus an iya mga tinun-an nga diri magsumat bisan kan kanay nga hiya amo an Mesiyas.

en: And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall never be unto thee.
war: Tikang hadto ginsiring ni Jesus an iya mga tinun-an: “Kinahanglan kumadto ako ha Jerusalem ngan mag-antos hin damo nga mga kakurian tikang ha kamot han katigurangan, mga puno han kapadian, ngan mga magturutdo han Balaod. Papatayon ako, kundi mababanhaw liwat ako ha ikatulo ka adlaw.”

en: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art a stumbling-block unto me: for thou mindest not the things of God, but the things of men.
war: Ilinain anay hiya ni Pedro han iba, ngan sidngon hiya, “Diri unta itugot han Dyos nga mahinabo ini ha imo!”

en: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
war: Linmingi hi Jesus ngan sidngon hi Pedro, “Iwas dida, Satanas! Nakakaulang ka ha akon, kay an imo hunahuna, hunahuna la hin tawo, diri kanan Dyos!”

en: For whosoever would save his life shall lose it: and whosoever shall lose his life for my sake shall find it.
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Kon may-ada karuyag umupod ha akon, kinahanglan nagsalikway hiya han iya kalugaringon, magpas-an han iya kros, ngan magsunod ha akon.

en: For what shall a man be profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and forfeit his life? or what shall a man give in exchange for his life?
war: Kay adton karuyag magtalwas han iya kinabuhi mawawara ini ha iya; kundi adton kawad-an han iya kinabuhi tungod ha akon, hiaagian ini niya.

en: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then shall he render unto every man according to his deeds.
war: Ano ba an makukuha han tawo kon maangkon niya an bug-os nga kalibutan, kundi kawad-an hiya han iya kinabuhi? Waray gud! Waray niya sadang mahatag basi mabawi an iya kinabuhi.

en: Verily I say unto you, There are some of them that stand here, who shall in no wise taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
war: Kay maabot na an Anak han Tawo dida han himaya han iya Amay, upod an iya mga anghel, ngan tatagan niya hin balos an ngatanan sumala han ira mga buhat.

en: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into a high mountain apart:
war: Pag-agi hin unom ka adlaw igin-upod ni Jesus hi Pedro ngan an magbugto, hira Santiago ug Juan. Gindara niya hira ngadto hin hitaas nga bukid ug hira la didto.

en: and he was transfigured before them; and his face did shine as the sun, and his garments became white as the light.
war: Samtang nagkikinita hira kan Jesus, nabalhin an iya panagway; nagmasilaw an iya bayhon sugad han adlaw ngan nagbusag an iya panapton sugad han kapawa.

en: And behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elijah talking with him.
war: Niyan an tulo nga mga tinun-an kinmita kanda Moises ug Elias nga nakikighimangraw kan Jesus.

en: And Peter answered, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, I will make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro kan Jesus, “Ginoo, maupay nga hahani na la kita; kon maruyag ka, maghihimo ako dinhe hin tulo nga tulda: usa para ha imo, usa para kan Moises, ngan usa para kan Elias.”

en: While he was yet speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold, a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
war: Han nagyiyinakan pa hiya, linambongan hira hin masilaw nga dampog, ngan nagsiring in tingog tikang han dampog, “Amo ini an akon kalugaringon nga Anak nga hinigugma, nga akon ikinalilipay. Pamatii niyo hiya!”

en: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
war: Nagkahadlok gud an mga tinun-an han pakabati nira han tingog, ngan hinmapa hira ha tuna.

en: And Jesus came and touched them and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
war: Dinmaop hi Jesus ngan ginkaptan hira. Nagsiring hiya, “Buhat! Ayaw kamo kahadlok!”

en: And lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, save Jesus only.
war: Han paghangad nira, waray na nira hinkit-an labot kan Jesus.

en: And as they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen from the dead.
war: Han paglugsong nira han bukid, gintugon hira ni Jesus, “Ayaw kamo pagsumat bisan kan kanay mahitungod hini nga iyo hinkit-an tubtob han kabanhaw han Anak han Tawo.”

en: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elijah must first come?
war: Nagpakiana kan Jesus an mga tinun-an, “Kay ano nga nasiring an mga magturutdo han Balaod nga makanhi anay hi Elias?”

en: And he answered and said, Elijah indeed cometh, and shall restore all things:
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Makanhi man ngani anay hi Elias ngan aandamon niya an ngatanan.

en: but I say unto you, that Elijah is come already, and they knew him not, but did unto him whatsoever they would. Even so shall the Son of man also suffer of them.
war: Kundi nasiring ako ha iyo, kinmanhi na hi Elias, ngan waray kumilala an mga tawo ha iya, kundi ginbuhat nira ha iya an ira karuyag. Ha amo man nga paagi, pagpapakurian man liwat nira an Anak han Tawo.”

en: Then understood the disciples that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
war: Niyan, nakasabot an mga tinun-an nga naghimangraw hiya ha ira mahitungod kan Juan nga Parabunyag.

en: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a man, kneeling to him, and saying,
war: Pagbalik nira ngadto han mga tawo, dinmaop kan Jesus in tawo, linmuhod ha iya atubangan,

en: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is epileptic, and suffereth grievously; for oft-times he falleth into the fire, and oft-times into the water.
war: ngan nagsiring, “Kalooyi gad an akon anak! Buntogon hiya ngan makalilisang an gin-aantos kon tinutulos, ngan agsob hiya mahulog ha kalayo ngan ha tubig.

en: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
war: Gindara ko na hiya ngadto han imo mga tinun-an, kundi waray man hira makaupay ha iya.”

en: And Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I bear with you? bring him hither to me.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Pagkawaray pagtoo ngan pagkasayop niyo nga mga tawo! Tubtob pa san-o an akon pag-inupod-upod ha iyo? Tubtob pa san-o an akon pag-inalagad ha iyo? Dad-a nganhi ha akon an bata!”

en: And Jesus rebuked him; and the demon went out of him: and the boy was cured from that hour.
war: Ginpaiwas ni Jesus an yawa ngan ginmawas ini, sanglit hito ngahaw nga takna naupay dayon an bata.

en: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast it out?
war: Niyan dinmaop hin hilit kan Jesus an mga tinun-an ngan nagpakiana ha iya, “Kay ano nga waray man kami makapaiwas han yawa?”

en: And he saith unto them, Because of your little faith: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Tungod kay kulang kamo hin pagtoo. Tigamni ini: kon may niyo pagtoo nga sugad kadako hin liso hin mustasa, makakasiring kamo hini nga bukid, ‘Balhin ngadto hin iba nga dapit!’ Ngan mabalhin ito. Mahihimo niyo an ngatanan. (
Waray iba nga makakapaiwas hin sugad hini, kundi an pag-ampo ngan an pagpuasa la.)”

en: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be delivered up into the hands of men;
war: Dida nga nagkatirok na an ngatanan nga mga tinun-an didto ha Galilea, nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “An Anak han Tawo diri na maiha itutubyan ngadto han mga tawo,

en: and they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised up. And they were exceeding sorry.
war: nga magpapatay ha iya; kundi mababanhaw hiya ha ikatulo ka adlaw.”

en: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received the half-shekel came to Peter, and said, Doth not your teacher pay the half-shekel?
war: Nagmabidoon an mga tinun-an.

en: He saith, Yea. And when he came into the house, Jesus spake first to him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? the kings of the earth, from whom do they receive toll or tribute? from their sons, or from strangers?
war: Han pag-abot ni Jesus ngan han iya mga tinun-an ha Capernaum, hinmarani kan Pedro an mga parasukot hin buhis han Templo ngan nagpakiana, “Nagbabayad ba an iyo magturutdo han buhis han Templo?”

en: And when he said, From strangers, Jesus said unto him, Therefore the sons are free.
war: “Oo, nagbabayad!” binmaton hi Pedro. Han pagsulod ni Pedro han balay, nag-una hin pagyakan hi Jesus, “Simon, ano man an imo paghunahuna? Hin-o in nagbabayad hin mga kabaraydan o buhis ngadto han mga hadi hini nga kalibutan? An mga bungtohanon ba o an mga lumalangyaw?”

en: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go thou to the sea, and cast a hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a shekel: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
war: “An mga lumalangyaw,” binmaton hi Pedro.

en: In that hour came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who then is greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
war: Hadto nga takna kinmadto kan Jesus an mga tinun-an ngan nagpakiana, “Hin-o man an gidadakoi didto han Ginhadian han langit?”

en: And he called to him a little child, and set him in the midst of them,
war: Gintawag ni Jesus in usa nga bata ngan ginpatukdaw niya ha atubangan nira,

en: and said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye turn, and become as little children, ye shall in no wise enter into the kingdom of heaven.
war: ngan nagsiring, “Tigamni ini: kon diri kamo magbalhin ngan masugad hin kabataan diri gud kamo makakasulod han Ginhadian han langit.

en: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
war: An gidadakoi didto han Ginhadian han langit amo adton nagpapaubos ngan nasusugad hini nga bata.

en: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me:
war: Ngan adton nakarawat hin sugad hini nga bata ha akon ngaran nakarawat man ha akon.

en: but whoso shall cause one of these little ones that believe on me to stumble, it is profitable for him that a great millstone should be hanged about his neck, and that he should be sunk in the depth of the sea.
war: “Mahitungod hin mga gudtiay nga kabataan nga natoo ha akon, maupay pa para hin usa ka tawo nga higtan an iya liog hin dako nga gilingan nga bato, ngan itunod hiya ngadto ha kahiladman han dagat, kon hiya an tinikangan hin pakasala hini nga kabataan.

en: Woe unto the world because of occasions of stumbling! for it must needs be that the occasions come; but woe to that man through whom the occasion cometh!
war: Pagkaraot hini nga kalibutan kay aada an mga butang nga nagsusulay han tawo hin pakasala! Mahinanabo gud gihapon ini nga mga butang, kundi kairo han tawo kon hiya an tinikangan hini nga mga pakasala!

en: And if thy hand or thy foot causeth thee to stumble, cut it off, and cast it from thee: it is good for thee to enter into life maimed or halt, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.
war: “Kon an imo kamot o imo tiil amo an tinikangan han imo pakasala, gabay utdon nimo ngan ilabog! Maupay pa nga sumulod ka ha kinabuhi nga utod an imo kamot o tiil kay hin sangkap ka hin duha nga kamot ngan duha nga tiil kundi ilalabog ka ngadto ha dayon nga kalayo.

en: And if thine eye causeth thee to stumble, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is good for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the hell of fire.
war: Ngan kon matinikangan an imo mata hin pakasala, gabay lukaton ito ngan ilabog! Maupay pa nga sumulod ka ha kinabuhi nga usa la an imo mata kay hin sangkap ka hin duha nga mata kundi ilalabog ka ngadto ha kalayo han impyerno.

en: See that ye despise not one of these little ones: for I say unto you, that in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father who is in heaven.
war: “Bantayi nga diri kamo magtamay han usa hini nga mga gudtiay nga kabataan. Nasiring ako ha iyo nga dayuday aada an ira mga anghel ha atubangan han akon Amay ha langit. [
Kay kinmanhi an Anak han Tawo hin pagtalwas hadton mga nawara.]

en: How think ye? if any man have a hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and go unto the mountains, and seek that which goeth astray?
war: “Ha iyo paghunahuna, ano an bubuhaton hin usa ka tawo kon mawad-an hiya hin usa han iya 100 nga mga karnero? Babayaan niya an 99 nga nananabsab ha ligid han pungtod, ngan malakat hin pamiling han nawara.

en: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth over it more than over the ninety and nine which have not gone astray.
war: Nasiring ako ha iyo, kon hiagian niya ini, labaw kamalipayon hiya tungod hini nga usa nga karnero kay han 99 nga waray mawara.

en: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
war: Ha amo gud nga pagkaagi, diri karuyag han Amay niyo ha langit nga may mawara hini nga mga gudtiay nga kabataan.

en: And if thy brother sin against thee, go, show him his fault between thee and him alone: if he hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
war: “Kon makasala ha imo in imo bugto, kadtoa ngan sumati hiya han iya sayop. Kundi buhata ini hin hilom, nga kamo la nga duha. Kon mamati hiya ha imo, mahibabalik an iyo nga duha maupay nga kaburut-on.

en: But if he hear thee not, take with thee one or two more, that at the mouth of two witnesses or three every word may be established.
war: Kundi kon diri hiya mamati ha imo, pagdara hin duha o tulo ka tawo, basi an tagsa nga sumbong pagmatuoron pinaagi hin duha o tulo nga mga testigo sumala han iginsiring han kasuratan.

en: And if he refuse to hear them, tell it unto the church: and if he refuse to hear the church also, let him be unto thee as the Gentile and the publican.
war: Kon diri hiya mamati ha ira, igsumat na ngahaw an ngatanan ngadto han singbahan. Ngan kon diri pa hiya mamati han singbahan, hunahuna na hiya sugad nga usa nga diri natoo han Dyos o usa nga parasukot hin buhis.

en: Verily I say unto you, What things soever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven; and what things soever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
war: “Sanglit nasiring ako ha iyo ngatanan: kon ano an iyo igdiri ha tuna igdidiri didto ha langit; kon ano an iyo itugot ha tuna itutugot didto ha langit.

en: Again I say unto you, that if two of you shall agree on earth as touching anything that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father who is in heaven.
war: “Ngan igsisiring ko pa ha iyo: kon in duha ha iyo dinhe ha tuna magka-uyon hin pangaro hin bisan ano nga butang, ihahatag ito ha iyo han akon Amay ha langit.

en: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
war: Kay kon may duha o tulo nga magkatirok hin pag-ampo ha akon ngaran, aadto ako upod ha ira.”

en: Then came Peter and said to him, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? until seven times?
war: Dinmaop hi Pedro kan Jesus ngan nagpakiana, “Ginoo, kon an akon bugto magpinakasala ha akon, makakapira ko ba hiya pasasayloa? Makapito ba?”

en: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times; but, Until seventy times seven.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Diri la makapito, kundi makakapitoan kag pito.

en: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, who would make a reckoning with his servants.
war: Kay an Ginhadian han langit sugad hin hadi nga nakigtuhay han mga utang han iya mga surugoon.

en: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, that owed him ten thousand talents.
war: Nagtikang pa la hiya pagtuhay, nga dad-on ha iya in usa nga makalilisang kadako han iya utang.

en: But forasmuch as he had not wherewith to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
war: Tungod nga waray man hiya igo nga igbarayad han iya utang, nagsugo an iya agaron nga igbaligya hiya sugad nga usa nga oripon, upod an iya asawa ngan an iya kabataan, ngan an ngatanan nga iya hiagi, basi makabayad han utang.

en: The servant therefore fell down and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
war: Linmuhod an surugoon ha atubangan han iya agaron ngan nakimalooy hin pagsiring, ‘Agaron, angan-angana gad ako, ngan babayaran ko ikaw han ngatanan!’

en: And the lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him, and forgave him the debt.
war: Nalooy ha iya an agaron, sanglit ginpara na la an iya utang, ngan ginpalakat hiya.

en: But that servant went out, and found one of his fellow-servants, who owed him a hundred shillings: and he laid hold on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay what thou owest.
war: “Ginmawas an tawo ngan iginkita hin iya igkasi surugoon nga nakautang hin pira la ka pesos ha iya. Ginrabot hiya, ginkaptan ha liog, ngan ginsiring, ‘Baydi ako han imo nautang!’

en: So his fellow-servant fell down and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee.
war: Linmuhod ha iya an iya igkasi—surugoon ngan nakimalooy intawon, ‘Angan-angana gad ako ngan babayaran ko ikaw!’

en: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay that which was due.
war: Kundi waray hiya pabaribad; iginpapriso lugod niya ngada han pakabayad han utang.

en: So when his fellow-servants saw what was done, they were exceeding sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
war: Han pakakita han iba nga mga surugoon han nahinabo, duro an ira kabido, ngan kinmadto hira ha ira agaron hin pagsumat han ngatanan nga nahinabo.

en: Then his lord called him unto him, and saith to him, Thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou besoughtest me:
war: Sanglit iginpatawag han agaraon an surugoon ngan ginsiring hiya, ‘Waray ka pulos nga oripon! Ginpasaylo ko ikaw han bug-os mo nga utang, kay nakimalooy ka ha akon.

en: shouldest not thou also have had mercy on thy fellow-servant, even as I had mercy on thee?
war: Unta imo kinakalooyan an imo igkasi—surugoon sugad nga nalooy ako ha imo.’

en: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due.
war: Duro gud an kapungot han agaron, ngan iginpapriso an surugoon basi sirotan ngada han pakabayad niya han ngatanan nga iya mga utang.”

en: And it came to pass when Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judæa beyond the Jordan;
war: Katapos ni Jesus pagyakan hini nga mga butang, binmaya hiya han Galilea ngan kinmadto han katunaan han Judea, ha tabok han Salog Jordan.

en: and great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
war: Sinmunod ha iya in kadam-an nga mga tawo ngan didto gintambal niya hira.

en: And there came unto him Pharisees, trying him, and saying, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
war: Kinmadto ha iya in mga Parisiyo ngan nagsari hin pagbitik ha iya pinaagi hin pagpakiana, “Natugot ba an aton Balaod nga in lalake makigbulag han iya asawa, hin bisan ano la nga pasangil?”

en: And he answered and said, Have ye not read, that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Waray ba niyo mabasa ini nga bahin han kasuratan, ‘Ha tinikangan, an Magburuhat naghimo hin lalake ngan babaye?’

en: and said, For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh?
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya, ‘Tungod hini mabaya an lalake han amay ngan iroy niya ngan makikigtampo han iya asawa, ngan hira nga duha mauusa na la nga lawas.’

en: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
war: Sanglit diri na hira duduha kundi uusa nala. Kinahanglan diri han tawo pagbulagon an gin-usa han Dyos.”

en: They say unto him, Why then did Moses command to give a bill of divorcement, and to put her away?
war: Nagpakiana ha iya an mga Parisiyo, “Kay ano nga tinmugot man hi Moises nga an lalake magsurat hin pagpahibaro hin pakigbulag ha iya asawa ngan makakabulag na hiya?”

en: He saith unto them, Moses for your hardness of heart suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it hath not been so.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Tinmugot hi Moises nga makigbulag kamo han iyo asawa kay makuri man kamo pagtutdoan. Kundi diri amo ito ha tinikangan.

en: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and he that marrieth her when she is put away committeth adultery.
war: Sanglit nasiring ako ha iyo, an bisan hin-o nga makigbulag han iya asawa labot kon an asawa naglalake, nakakasala hin panlibog, kon mangasawa hiya hin iba nga babaye.”

en: The disciples say unto him, If the case of the man is so with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.
war: Nagsiring ha iya an iya mga tinun-an, “Kon amo man ini an mahinanabo hiunong han bana ngan han iya asawa, maupay na la nga diri mangasawa.”

en: But he said unto them, Not all men can receive this saying, but they to whom it is given.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Diri para han ngatanan ini nga pagturon-an, kundi para la hadton gintagan hini han Dyos.

en: For there are eunuchs, that were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are eunuchs, that were made eunuchs by men: and there are eunuchs, that made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
war: Kay damo ka lain an pangatadongan kon kay ano nga may mga lalake nga diri mahimo hin pag-asawa: may-ada diri makakahimo hin pangasawa tungod kay natawo hira nga daan sugad; an iba kay ginkaponan hira hin mga tawo; ngan an iba tungod han Ginhadian han langit. Hiya nga nakakahimo hin pagkarawat hini nga pagturon-an, tugotan hin pagbuhat.”

en: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should lay his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
war: May mga tawo nga nagdara hin kabataan ngadto kan Jesus basi agbayan hira han iya mga kamot, ngan mag-ampo para ha ira, kundi ginsaway han mga tinun-an ini nga mga tawo.

en: But Jesus said, Suffer the little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for to such belongeth the kingdom of heaven.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Tugoti niyo an kabataan hin pagdaop ha akon ngan ayaw niyo pagdid-i hira. Kay an Ginhadian han langit para la hin sugad ha ira.”

en: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
war: Gin-agbayan hira niya ngan linmakat hiya.

en: And behold, one came to him and said, Teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
war: May hadto usa ka tawo nga dinmaop kan Jesus. Nagpakiana hiya, “Magturutdo, ano an maupay nga butang nga kinahanglan ko buhaton basi maangkon ko an kinabuhi nga dayon?”

en: And he said unto him, Why askest thou me concerning that which is good? One there is who is good: but if thou wouldest enter into life, keep the commandments.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Kay ano nga napakiana ka man ha akon kon ano in maupay? An Dyos la an maupay. Tumana an mga sugo kon buot ka makasulod ha kinabuhi.”

en: He saith unto him, Which? And Jesus said, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
war: “Ano nga mga sugo?” nagpakiana hiya.

en: Honor thy father and thy mother; and, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Diri ka magpatay; diri ka manlibog; diri ka mangawat; diri ka magbuwa;

en: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I observed: what lack I yet?
war: tahora an amay ug iroy nimo, ngan higugmaa an imo igkasi tawo sugad ha imo ngahaw.”

en: Jesus said unto him, If thou wouldest be perfect, go, sell that which thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
war: Binmaton an batan-on, “Gintuman ko na ini ngatanan nga mga sugo, ano pa man an akon sadang buhaton?”

en: But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sorrowful; for he was one that had great possessions.
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Jesus, “Kon karuyag mo mahingpit, kadto na, ngan ipamaligya an ngatanan nga imo mga butang, ngan ihatag an kwarta ha mga kablas, ngan maaangkon mo in mga manggad ha langit; ngan kahuman, balik ngan sunod ha akon.”

en: And Jesus said unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, It is hard for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of heaven.
war: Han pakabati hini han batan-on, linmakat hiya nga mabidoon, kay riko hiya.

en: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
war: Niyan nagsiring hi Jesus han iya mga tinun-an, “Nasiring ako ha iyo, magkukuri in riko hin pagsulod han Ginhadian han Langit.

en: And when the disciples heard it, they were astonished exceedingly, saying, Who then can be saved?
war: May-ada pa ako lain nga igsisiring ha iyo: mas makuri para hin riko hin pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos kay hin kamelyo hin pagsuhot ha taranogan hin dagom.”

en: And Jesus looking upon them said to them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
war: Han pakabati han iya mga tinun-an, nahipausa hira. Nagpakiana hira, “Hin-o man ngay-an in matatalwas?”

en: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee; what then shall we have?
war: Gintutokan hira ni Jesus ngan ginbaton, “Diri ini nahihimo hin mga tawo; kundi para han Dyos, nahihimo an ngatanan.”

en: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, that ye who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit on the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
war: Niyan nagyakan hi Pedro, “Ginoo, kitaa, ginbayaan namon an ngatanan ngan sinmunod kami ha imo. Ano man in amon maangkon?”

en: And every one that hath left houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive a hundredfold, and shall inherit eternal life.
war: Nagsiring ha ira hi Jesus, “Nasiring ako ha iyo hini: kon lumingkod na an Anak han Tawo didto han langitnon niya nga trono didto han Bag-o nga kalibutan, malingkod ha trono liwat kamo nga dose nga akon mga tinun-an hin paghukom han dose nga mga tribo han Israel.

en: But many shall be last that are first; and first that are last.
war: Ngan an ngatanan nga binmaya hin mga balay, kabugtoan o mga kag-anak, o kabataan, o mga uma, tungod ha akon, makarawat hin labaw pa hin 100 ka pilo ngan tatagan pa han kinabuhi nga dayon.

en: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that was a householder, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers into his vineyard.
war: “An Ginhadian han langit sugad han tag-iya hin uma hin mga ubas nga timprano pa ha aga linmakat pangita hin mga tawo nga iya susuholan hin pagtrabaho ha iya urubasan.

en: And when he had agreed with the laborers for a shilling a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
war: Nakigsabot hiya pagbayad ha ira han nahiaaraan nga suhol nga usa ka salapi an usa ka adlaw, ngan ginsugo hira ngadto han iya urubasan.

en: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing in the marketplace idle;
war: Ginmawas liwat hiya ngadto ha merkado ha may alas nuybe han aga ngan nakakita hiya hin mga tawo nga nagkakatukdaw didto ngan waray mga trabaho.

en: and to them he said, Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
war: Sanglit ginsiring niya hira, ‘Pagtrabaho man kamo ha akon urubasan, ngan tatagan ko kamo hin angay nga suhol.’

en: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.
war: Ngan kinmadto hira. Niyan ha pagka-alas dose, ngan liwat ha alas tres, amo gihapon an ginbuhat niya.

en: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing; and he saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
war: May mga alas singko na han kulop han pagkadto niya liwat ha merkado. Hinkit-an niya in iba pa nga mga tawo nga nagkakatukdaw la gihapon didto. ‘Kay ano nga kinakaragan niyo an bug-os nga adlaw dinhe nga waray ginbubuhat?’ nagpakiana hiya ha ira.

en: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard.
war: Binmaton hira, ‘Kay waray man nagpatrabaho ha amon.’ Ginsiring hira niya, ‘Kon amo ito, kadto liwat kamo pagtrabaho ha akon urubasan.’

en: And when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the laborers, and pay them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
war: “Han pagkakulop na, ginsiring han tag-iya an iya tinaporan, ‘Tawga an mga nagtrabaho ngan tagi hira han ira suhol. Unaha pagbayad adton mga urhe magtrabaho, ngan urhe adton mga una magtrabaho.

en: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a shilling.
war: Gintagan hin tag-usa ka salapi an mga tawo nga nagtrabaho ha alas singko na han kulop.

en: And when the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise received every man a shilling.
war: Sanglit han pagdaop na hin pagkarawat han suhol an mga tawo nga una magtrabaho, naghunahuna hira nga darudako an ira kakarawaton, kundi tinagan liwat hira hin tag-usa ka salapi an kada usa.

en: And when they received it, they murmured against the householder,
war: Ginkarawat nira an ira suhol, ngan nagtikang hira hin pagngurutob kontra han tag-iya han urubasan.

en: saying, These last have spent but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat.
war: Nagsiring hira, ‘Iini nga mga tawo nga orhe magtrabaho, nagtrabaho sulod hin usa ka oras la, samtang kami nagtrabaho ha bug-os nga adlaw, ngan nag-antos han kapaso han adlaw. Kay ano nga gintagan mo hira pareho han iginhatag mo ha amon?’

en: But he answered and said to one of them, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a shilling?
war: Ngan ginbaton han tag-iya an usa ha ira, ‘Sangkay, pamati daw! Waray ako maglimbong ha imo. Di' ba inmuyon ka hin usa ka salapi nga suhol hin usa ka adlaw nga pagtrabaho?

en: Take up that which is thine, and go thy way; it is my will to give unto this last, even as unto thee.
war: Yana, karawta an imo suhol, ngan oli ha iyo. Karuyag ko tagan an orhe na magtrabaho hin pareho nga suhol han akon iginhatag ha imo.

en: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? or is thine eye evil, because I am good?
war: Waray ba ngay-an ako katungod paggamit han akon kwarta sugad han akon karuyag? O nauba ka ba tungod han akon kamahinatagon?’”

en: So the last shall be first, and the first last.
war: Ngan gintapos ini ni Jesus hin pagsiring, “Sanglit, mahiuuna adton mga orhe, ngan mauorhe adton mga nahiuna.”

en: And as Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples apart, and on the way he said unto them,
war: Samtang nasagka hi Jesus tipakadto ha Jerusalem, ginlain niya an dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan ginhilit hira hin pagsiring,

en: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests and scribes; and they shall condemn him to death,
war: “Pamati kamo: matukad kita ngadto ha Jerusalem, diin igtutubyan an Anak han Tawo ngadto han mga kamot han mga puno han kapadian ngan mga magturutdo han Balaod. Ira paghuhukman hiya ha kamatayon,

en: and shall deliver him unto the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify: and the third day he shall be raised up.
war: ngan igtutubyan hiya ha mga Hentil. Pagbibiaybiayon, paglalatobon, ngan igraraysang hiya ha kros; kundi mababanhaw hiya ha ikatulo ka adlaw.”

en: Then came to him the mother of the sons of Zebedee with her sons, worshipping him , and asking a certain thing of him.
war: Niyan, kinmadto kan Jesus an iroy han mga anak ni Sebedeo, upod an iya mga anak nga lalake, ngan yinmukbo ha iya ngan may-ada niya pinangaro.

en: And he said unto her, What wouldest thou? She saith unto him, Command that these my two sons may sit, one on thy right hand, and one on thy left hand, in thy kingdom.
war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus ha iya, “Ano an imo karuyag?” Binmaton hiya, “Igsaad gad ha akon nga palilingkoron mo ini nga duduha ko nga mga anak, ha imo tuo ngan ha imo wala kon maghadi ka na.”

en: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink the cup that I am about to drink? They say unto him, We are able.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Diri kamo maaram kon ano an iyo pinangangaro. Makakainom ba kamo han kupa han mga pag-antos nga ha diri maiha akon iimnan?”

en: He saith unto them, My cup indeed ye shall drink: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left hand, is not mine to give; but it is for them for whom it hath been prepared of my Father.
war: “Makakahimo kami,” binmaton hira.

en: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation concerning the two brethren.
war: Ginsiring hira ni Jesus, “Matuod, makakainom kamo han akon kupa, kundi waray ako katungod hin pagpili kon hin-o an malingkod ha akon tuo ngan ha akon wala. Ini nga mga dapit para ini hadton gin-andaman han akon Amay.”

en: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
war: Han pakabati hini han iba nga napulo nga mga tinun-an, nagkasisina hira han duha nga magbugto.

en: Not so shall it be among you: but whosoever would become great among you shall be your minister;
war: Sanglit gintirok ni Jesus hira ngatanan ngan ginsiring, “Maaram kamo nga an mga punoan han mga pagano may gahom han ira mga tawo, ngan an ira mga pangulo naghahadi ha ira.

en: and whosoever would be first among you shall be your servant:
war: Kundi diri ini amo nga paagi an angay niyo sundon. Kon may usa ha iyo nga karuyag magin labaw, kinahanglan magin surugoon hiya han iba;

en: even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
war: ngan kon may usa ha iyo nga karuyag magin gilalabawi, kinahanglan magin oripon hiya niyo—

en: And as they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
war: sugad han Anak han Tawo nga waray makanih hin pagpaataman, kundi hin paghatag han iya kinabuhi para hin pagtubos hin damo nga mga tawo.”

en: And behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, saying, Lord, have mercy on us, thou son of David.
war: Han nabaya na hi Jesus ug an iya mga tinun-an han Jerico, ginsunod hi Jesus hin damo nga mga tawo.

en: And the multitude rebuked them, that they should hold their peace: but they cried out the more, saying, Lord, have mercy on us, thou son of David.
war: May duha nga buta nga nalingkod ha ligid han dalan nga nakabati nga hi Jesus nalabay, sanglit nagtikang hira paggoliat, “Anak ni David! Kalooyi gad kami!”

en: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I should do unto you?
war: Ginbusaan hira han mga tawo ngan ginpahilom hira, kundi dinmugang la lugod hira paggoliat, “Anak ni David! Kalooyi kami!”

en: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
war: Hinmunong hi Jesus ngan gintawag hira. “Ano an iyo karuyag nga buhaton ko ha iyo?” nagpakiana hiya.

en: And Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and straightway they received their sight, and followed him.
war: Binmaton hira, “Ginoo, karuyag namon nga makakita kami!”

en: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and came unto Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
war: Han tikahirani na hi Jesus ug an iya mga tinun-an han Jerusalem, inmabot hira ha Betfage, ha Bukid han mga Olibo. Ginpauna ni Jesus in duha han iya mga tinun-an

en: saying unto them, Go into the village that is over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them , and bring them unto me.
war: upod ini nga tugon: “Kadto kamo ha baryo nga inaatubang niyo, ngan hiaagian dayon niyo in hinigtan nga asno upod an iya nati. Hubari niyo ngan dad-a nganhi.

en: And if any one say aught unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
war: Ngan kon may-ada magpakiana ha iyo, sidnga niyo hiya, ‘Ginkikinahanglan ini han Ginoo,’ ngan ipadadara dayon ha iyo.”

en: Now this is come to pass, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,
war: Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginsiring han manaragna:

en: Tell ye the daughter of Zion,
war: “Sumati an syudad han Sion,

en: Behold, thy King cometh unto thee,
war: maabot yana ngada ha imo an imo hadi.

en: Meek, and riding upon an ass,
war: Mapinaubsanon hiya ngan nasakay hin asno,

en: And upon a colt the foal of an ass.
war: ug han iya nati.”

en: And the disciples went, and did even as Jesus appointed them,
war: Sanglit linmakat an mga tinun-an ngan gintuman nira an iginsugo ni Jesus ha ira.

en: and brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their garments; and he sat thereon.
war: Gindara nira an asno ngan an nati, ngan ginhapinan nira han ira mga kurugpos, ngan sinmakay hi Jesus.

en: And the most part of the multitude spread their garments in the way; and others cut branches from the trees, and spread them in the way.
war: An dako nga hugpo hin mga tawo nagbitad dida ha dalan han ira mga kurugpos, samtang an iba nangutod hin mga sanga hin mga kahoy ngan iginkatag nira ha dalan.

en: And the multitudes that went before him, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
war: Naggoliat an mga tawo nga nag-uuna kan Jesus ngan an mga nagsusunod ha iya: “Dayawon an Anak ni David! Dayawon han Dyos hiya nga nakanhi ha ngaran han Ginoo! Dayawon an Dyos!”

en: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred, saying, Who is this?
war: Han pagsulod na ni Jesus han Jerusalem, narigumok an bug-os nga syudad. Nagpakiana an mga tawo, “Hin-o man ini hiya?”

en: And the multitudes said, This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.
war: Binmaton an hugpo han mga tawo, “Amo ini hi Jesus, an manaragna nga taga-Nazaret, ha Galilea.”

en: And Jesus entered into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money-changers, and the seats of them that sold the doves;
war: Sinmulod hi Jesus han Templo ngan gintabog niya an ngatanan nga namamalit ngan nagbabaligya didto, ngan pinamalintong niya an mga lamesa han mga magbaralyo hin kwarta ngan an mga bangkilyo han mga nagbabaligya hin mga sarapati.

en: and he saith unto them, It is written, My house shall be called a house of prayer: but ye make it a den of robbers.
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Iginsurat ha Kasuratan nga an Dyos nagsiring, ‘Tatawgon an akon Templo nga balay hin pag-ampo.’ Kundi ginhimo niyo ini nga tagoan hin mga tikasan!”

en: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
war: Gindara ngada ha iya didto ha templo an mga buta ngan an mga lulid, ngan gintambal niya hira.

en: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children that were crying in the temple and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were moved with indignation,
war: Nasina an mga puno han kapadian ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod han pakakita nira han mga orosahon nga mga butang nga iya ginbuhat, ngan han kabataan nga naggogoliat ha sakob han Templo, “Dayawon an Anak ni David!”

en: and said unto him, Hearest thou what these are saying? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea: did ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
war: Sanglit nagsiring hira kan Jesus, “Nabati ka ba han ira ginyayakan?”

en: And he left them, and went forth out of the city to Bethany, and lodged there.
war: “Oo, nabati ako,” binmaton hi Jesus. “Waray ba niyo mabasa an kasuratan nga nagsiring, ‘Gintutdoan nimo an kabataan ngan an mga minasus-an paghalad hin hingpit nga pagdayaw?’”

en: Now in the morning as he returned to the city, he hungered.
war: Binayaan hira ni Jesus ngan ginmawas hiya han syudad ngadto ha Betania, ngan didto magpalabay hiya han gab-i hin pagpahuway.

en: And seeing a fig tree by the way side, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only; and he saith unto it, Let there be no fruit from thee henceforward for ever. And immediately the fig tree withered away.
war: Han pagkaaga na, han pagbalik ni Jesus ngadto ha syudad, ginutom hiya.

en: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How did the fig tree immediately wither away?
war: Nakakita hiya hin kahoy nga igos ha ligid han dalan, ngan gindaop ini niya, kundi waray niya hin-agian nga bunga, kundi mga dahon la. Sanglit ginsiring niya an kahoy, “Diri ka na gud mamumunga!” Ngan nalaya dayon an kahoy.

en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do what is done to the fig tree, but even if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou taken up and cast into the sea, it shall be done.
war: Nakakita hini an mga tinun-an ngan nahipausa hira. Nagpakiana hira, “Kay ano nga nalaya man dayon an igos?”

en: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
war: “Tigamni niyo ini!” binmaton hi Jesus. “Kon matoo la kamo, ngan diri magruruhaduha, makakahimo kamo han akon ginbuhat hini nga igos; ngan diri la ini kundi makakasiring pa ngani kamo ngada hini nga bukid, ‘Magabot ka, ngan patinhulog ngadto ha dagat,’ ngan mahihimo ini.

en: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
war: Kon natoo kamo, kakarawaton niyo an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon dida hin pag-ampo.”

en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one question, which if ye tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto han Templo. Han nagtututdo hiya, hinmarani ha iya an mga puno han kapadian ngan an katigurangan nga mga Judiyo, ngan nagpakiana, “Ano an imo katungod hin pagbuhat hini nga mga butang? Hin-o an naghatag ha imo hini nga katungod?”

en: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven or from men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why then did ye not believe him?
war: Binmaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Mapakiana man ako ha iyo hin makausa la, ngan kon makabaton kamo, pagsusumatan ta kamo kon ano an akon katungod hin pagbuhat hini nga mga butang.

en: But if we shall say, From men; we fear the multitude; for all hold John as a prophet.
war: Diin man tikang an katungod ni Juan hin pagbunyag? Tikang ba sa Dyos o tikang ba han mga tawo?”

en: And they answered Jesus, and said, We know not. He also said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
war: Nagtikang hira hin paglarolantugi, “Ano man an aton igbabaton? Kon bumaton kita, ‘Tikang sa Dyos,’ masiring hiya ha aton, ‘Kay ano man nga waray kamo tumoo kan Juan?’

en: But what think ye? A man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to-day in the vineyard.
war: Kundi kon sumiring kita, ‘Tikang han mga tawo,’ mahadlok kita han pagbubuhaton han mga tawo ha aton kay maaram an ngatanan nga manaragna hi Juan.”

en: And he answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented himself, and went.
war: Sanglit ginbaton nira hi Jesus, “Diri kami maaram.”

en: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go , sir: and went not.
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Diri ko man liwat kamo pagsusumatan kon ano an katungod ko hin pagbuhat hini nga mga butang.

en: Which of the two did the will of his father? They say, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, that the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
war: “Yana, ano man an iyo paghunahuna? May-ada hadto tawo nga may duha nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an. Ginkadto niya an magurang ngan ginsiring, ‘Anak, pagtrabaho yana nga adlaw ha urubasan.’

en: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not; but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye saw it, did not even repent yourselves afterward, that ye might believe him.
war: Binmaton ini hiya, ‘Diri ako magtratrabaho!’ kundi naliwat an iya hunahuna, ngan kinmadto hiya ha urubasan.

en: Hear another parable: There was a man that was a householder, who planted a vineyard, and set a hedge about it, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into another country.
war: Niyan an amay kinmadto han manghod nga anak ngan amo gihapon an iya iginsiring, ‘Oo, makadto ako,’ binmaton hiya, kundi waray hiya makadto.

en: And when the season of the fruits drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, to receive his fruits.
war: Hin-o man ha ira nga duha an nagtuman han karuyag han amay nira?”

en: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
war: Binmaton hira, “An magurang.”

en: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them in like manner.
war: “Susumatan ta kamo,” nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira. “An mga parasukot hin buhis ngan an magraot nga kababayen-an mahiuuna pa ha iyo hin pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos.

en: But afterward he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
war: Kay kinmanhi ha iyo hi Juan nga Parabunyag hin pagtutdo ha iyo han matadong nga aragian, ngan waray kamo tumoo ha iya; kundi tinmoo ha iya an mga paragsukot hin buhis ngan an magraot nga kababayen-an. Bisan ngani kamo, kahuman niyo pakakita, waray gihapon kamo magbasol ngan magtoo ha iya.”

en: But the husbandmen, when they saw the son, said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and take his inheritance.
