war: Kundi nagsiring an iba, “Hulat anay, kikitaon ta kon kumanhi manggud hi Elias hin pagtalwas ha iya!”

en: And many women were there beholding from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
war: Hin makusog nga tingog ginmuliat hi Jesus, ngan nabunosan hiya han iya kinabuhi.

en: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
war: Tigda la nga nagisi ha butnga an biray han Templo, tikang ha igbaw ngadto ha ubos. Nabay-og an tuna, nagkabubuka an mga bato,

en: And when even was come, there came a rich man from Arimathæa, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus’ disciple:
war: nagkaabre an mga lubnganan, ngan damo nga mga patay na nga magtinuohon han Dyos an nabanhaw.

en: this man went to Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded it to be given up.
war: Ginmawas hira han mga lubnganan; ngan katapos mabanhaw hi Jesus, kinmadto hira han Syudad nga Baraan, ngan didto hinkit-an hira hin damo nga mga tawo.

en: And Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
war: Nahadlok an kapitan ngan an mga sondalo nga kaupod niya nga nagbabantay kan Jesus, han pag-abat nira han linog ngan pagkita nira han ngatanan nga nahinabo. Nagsiring hira, “Matuod gud nga hiya amo an Anak han Dyos!”

en: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, and departed.
war: Damo in kababayen-an nga nagkikinita tikang ha hirayo. Nagsinunod ini hira kan Jesus tikang pa ha Galilea, ngan nagbulig ha iya.

en: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
war: Upod ha ira, amo hira Maria Magdalena, Maria nga iroy nira Santiago ug Jose, ngan an asawa ni Sebedeo.

en: Now on the morrow, which is the day after the Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together unto Pilate,
war: Han kulopay na, inmabot in usa nga taga-Arimatea nga ginngaranan kan Jose. Usa hiya nga tinun-an ni Jesus.

en: saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said while he was yet alive, After three days I rise again.
war: Nakigkita hiya kan Pilato ngan gin-aro niya an lawas ni Jesus. Nagsugo hi Pilato nga ihatag an lawas kan Jose.

en: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest haply his disciples come and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: and the last error will be worse than the first.
war: Sanglit gindara ni Jose an lawas ngan ginputos hin bag-o nga taklap nga lino.

en: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a guard: go, make it as sure as ye can.
war: Iginbutang ini niya didto han iya kalugaringon nga lubnganan nga bag-o pa la nga gin-ukab dida hin bato. Niyan ginpakaliding niya in dako nga bato ngadto han ganggang hin pagtakop han porta han lubnganan, ngan linmakat hiya.

en: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, the guard being with them.
war: Nakadto hira Maria Magdalena ngan an usa pa nga Maria, nalingkod ha atubangan han lubnganan.

en: Now late on the sabbath day, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
war: Katapos han Adlaw nga Iparahuway, han nagmamanagbanag na ha aga han Domingo nga adlaw, kinmadto hin panginano han lubnganan hira Maria Magdalena ngan usa pa nga Maria.

en: And behold, there was a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled away the stone, and sat upon it.
war: Tigda la nga linminog hin makusog; kinmunsad tikang ha langit in usa nga anghel han Ginoo, ginkaliding niya an sada nga bato, ngan iya ini ginlingkoran.

en: His appearance was as lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
war: Sugad hin kikidlat an iya dagway, ngan duro kamabusag an iya panapton.

en: and for fear of him the watchers did quake, and became as dead men.
war: Duro an pangurog tungod hin kahadlok an mga bantay, ngan waray hira makakiwa, sugad hira hin mga patay.

en: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye; for I know that ye seek Jesus, who hath been crucified.
war: Ginsiring han anghel an kababayen-an, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok. Maaram ako nga ginbibiling niyo hi Jesus nga iginraysang ha kros.

en: He is not here; for he is risen, even as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
war: Waray hiya dinhe; nabanhaw hiya sugad han siring niya. Kadi ngan kitaa niyo an dapit nga ginhigdaan niya.

en: And go quickly, and tell his disciples, He is risen from the dead; and lo, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
war: Kadtoa niyo dayon yana an iya mga tinun-an ngan sumati, ‘Nabanhaw hiya ngan mag-uuna hiya ha iyo ngadto ha Galilea; makakakita kamo ha iya didto!’ Hinumdomi an akon iginsumat ha iyo.”

en: And they departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
war: Sanglit ha kadagmitan, binmaya hira han lubnganan. Nakada pa ha ira an kahadlok, kundi puno hin kalipay, ngan nagdadlagan hira hin pagsumat han iya mga tinun-an.

en: And behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and took hold of his feet, and worshipped him.
war: Tigda la nga gintapo hira ni Jesus ngan ginsiring, “An kalinaw maada ha iyo.” Dinmaop hira ha iya, kinaptan an iya mga tiil, ngan nagsingba ha iya.

en: Then saith Jesus unto them, Fear not: go tell my brethren that they depart into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok. Kadtoa niyo an akon kabugtoan ngan sumati hira nga mapakadto hira ha Galilea, ngan didto makita hira ha akon.”

en: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guard came into the city, and told unto the chief priests all the things that were come to pass.
war: Han pagkalakat na han kababayen-an, binmalik ha syudad in pira han mga sondalo nga nagbantay han lubnganan, ngan nagsumat han mga puno han kapadian han ngatanan nga nahinabo.

en: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave much money unto the soldiers,
war: Nakigkita han katigurangan an mga puno han kapadian ngan nagsarabot hira kon ano an maupay buhaton. Ginhukipan nira an mga sondalo hin damo nga kwarta,

en: saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
war: ngan ginsiring, “Igsumat niyo nga kinmadto an iya mga tinun-an kagab-i ngan ginkawat an iya lawas, samtang nangangaturog kamo.

en: And if this come to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him, and rid you of care.
war: Ngan kon makabati hini an Gobernador, kami na an labi nga maaram hin pagbaton ha iya ngan waray niyo sadang kabarak-an.”

en: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continueth until this day.
war: Ginkarawat han mga sondalo an kwarta, ngan ginbuhat nira an iginsugo ha ira. Amo ini nga sumat an iginpabantog han mga Judiyo tubtob ngada yana nga adlaw.

en: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, unto the mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
war: Kinmadto ha Galilea an onse nga mga tinun-an, ha bukid nga ginpakadtoan ha ira ni Jesus.

en: And when they saw him, they worshipped him ; but some doubted.
war: Han pakakita nira ha iya, ginsingba hiya nira, bisan kon may-ada ha ira nagruhaduha.

en: And Jesus came to them and spake unto them, saying, All authority hath been given unto me in heaven and on earth.
war: Hinmarani hi Jesus ngan ginsiring hira, “Iginhatag ha akon an ngatanan nga gahom ha langit ngan ha tuna.

en: Go ye therefore, and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit:
war: Sanglit pakadto kamo ha ngatanan nga mga katawhan ha bug-os nga kalibutan ngan himoa niyo hira nga akon mga tinun-an. Bunyagi hira ha ngaran han Amay, ngan han Anak, ngan han Espiritu Santo,

en: teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I commanded you: and lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world.
war: ngan tutdoi hira hin pagtuman han ngatanan nga akon iginsugo ha iyo. Ngan hinumdomi! Dayuday ako maupod ha iyo ha ngatanan nga katuigan tubtob ha katapos han kalibutan.”

en: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
war: Amo ini an Maupay nga Sumat mahitungod kan Jesu-Cristo nga Anak han Dyos.

en: Even as it is written in Isaiah the prophet,
war: Nagtikang ini sumala han iginsurat ni Isaias nga manaragna:

en: Behold, I send my messenger before thy face,
war: “Nagsiring an Dyos, ‘Iini an akon magsarangyaw, nga akon ipadadara hin pag-una ha imo,

en: Who shall prepare thy way;
war: basi andamon niya an imo aagian.’

en: The voice of one crying in the wilderness,
war: May-ada usa nga naggiginoliat ha kamingawan,

en: Make ye ready the way of the Lord,
war: ‘Andama an dalan para han Ginoo;

en: Make his paths straight;
war: ngan tadonga an iya aagian!’”

en: John came, who baptized in the wilderness and preached the baptism of repentance unto remission of sins.
war: Pinmakita hi Juan didto ha kamingawan, diin namunyag hiya hin mga tawo ngan nagwali. Ginsiring niya an mga tawo, “Bayai an iyo mga sala ngan pabunyag kamo, ngan mapasaylo an Dyos ha iyo.”

en: And there went out unto him all the country of Judæa, and all they of Jerusalem; and they were baptized of him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
war: Kinmadto an ngatanan nga mga tawo tikang ha katunaan han Judea ngan ha syudad han Jerusalem pamati kan Juan. Nagkompisal hira han ira mga sala ngan nabunyagan hira didto han Salog Jordan.

en: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and had a leathern girdle about his loins, and did eat locusts and wild honey.
war: Hinimo hin buhok hin kamelyo an bado ni Juan, ngan anit an iya bakos ha hawak. Mga duron ug dugos ha kagurangan an pagkaon niya.

en: And he preached, saying, There cometh after me he that is mightier than I, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
war: Ginsiring niya an mga tawo, “Labaw pa hin gahom ha akon an tawo nga masunod ha akon. Diri ngani ako takos maghubad han higot han iya mga sandalyas.

en: I baptized you in water; but he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
war: Nagbubunyag ako ha iyo hin tubig, kundi magbubunyag hiya ha iyo han Espiritu Santo.”

en: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in the Jordan.
war: Waray pag-iha, inmabot hi Jesus tikang ha Nazaret nga bungto ha Galilea, ngan ginbunyagan hiya ni Juan didto ha Salog han Jordan.

en: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens rent asunder, and the Spirit as a dove descending upon him:
war: Paghaw-as ni Jesus tikang ha tubig, kinmita hiya nga nabuksan an langit ngan kinmunsad an Espiritu Santo sugad hin sarapati.

en: and a voice came out of the heavens, Thou art my beloved Son, in thee I am well pleased.
war: Hinbatian in tingog tikang ha langit nga nasiring, “Ikaw an akon hinigugma nga Anak. Nalilipay gud ako ha imo.”

en: And straightway the Spirit driveth him forth into the wilderness.
war: Ha gilayon hi Jesus ginpakadto han Espiritu ha kamingawan.

en: And he was in the wilderness forty days tempted of Satan; and he was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
war: Nag-ukoy hiya didto hin 40 ka adlaw ngan didto ginsulay hiya ni Satanas. Didto hito nga dapit damo in ihalas nga kamanampan, kundi inmabot in mga anghel ngan nagtimangno ha iya.

en: Now after John was delivered up, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of God,
war: Han kabilanggo ni Juan, kinmadto hi Jesus ha Galilea ngan nagwali hiya didto han Maupay nga Sumat tikang sa Dyos.

en: and saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe in the gospel.
war: “Inmabot na an igo nga panahon,” nasiring hiya, “ngan haraniay na an Ginhadian han Dyos. Bayai an iyo mga sala ngan tuohi niyo an Maupay nga Sumat.”

en: And passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net in the sea; for they were fishers.
war: Samtang nalabay hi Jesus ha tabi han Lanaw Galilea, hinkit-an niya in duha nga mangirisda, hi Simon ngan an iya bugto, hi Andres nga nagtutunod han ira pukot hin pagdakop hin isda.

en: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Bunyog kamo ha akon ngan tututdoan ta kamo hin pangisda hin mga tawo.”

en: And straightway they left the nets, and followed him.
war: Binayaan nira dayon an ira mga pukot ngan binmunyog hira kan Jesus.

en: And going on a little further, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the boat mending the nets.
war: Nagtipaunhan hiya ngan hinkit-an niya in duha pa nga magbugto, hira Santiago ug Juan, an mga anak ni Sebedeo. Nakadto hira han sakayan, nag-aandam han ira mga pukot.

en: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
war: Pakakita ni Jesus ha ira, gintawag hira. Ginbayaan nira an ira amay, hi Sebedeo, nga nakadto ha sakayan upod in mga sinuholan nga mga tawo, ngan binmunyog hira kan Jesus.

en: And they go into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
war: Inmabot hira ha bungto han Capernaum ngan han pagkasunod nga Adlaw nga Iparahuway, sinmakob hi Jesus han ira sinagoga ngan nagtikang hin pagtutdo.

en: And they were astonished at his teaching: for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
war: Nahipausa an mga tawo han iya pagtutdo, kay diri man hiya sugad han mga magturutdo han Balaod ni Moises; lugod, an iya pagtutdo may-ada gahom.

en: And straightway there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
war: Hito nga takna, sinmakob han sinagoga in tawo nga may maraot nga espiritu ngan ginmoliat,

en: saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus thou Nazarene? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
war: “Ano an imo karuyag buhaton ha amon, Jesus nga taga-Nazaret? Pupuohon mo ba kami? Nakilala ako kon hin-o ka: Ikaw an baraan nga sinugo han Dyos!”

en: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
war: Ginsaway ni Jesus an maraot nga espiritu, “Ayaw hin aringasa. Gawas dida hito nga tawo!”

en: And the unclean spirit, tearing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
war: Binuntog an tawo, ginmoliat hin dako nga tingog, ngan ginmawas an maraot nga espiritu dida ha iya.

en: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What is this? a new teaching! with authority he commandeth even the unclean spirits, and they obey him.
war: Nahipausa an ngatanan, ngan may hinsiring, “Ano ini nga nahinabo? Usa ba ini nga bag-o nga pagturon-an? May gahom ini nga tawo hin pagsugo han mga magraot nga espiritu ngan nasugot hira ha iya!”

en: And the report of him went out straightway everywhere into all the region of Galilee round about.
war: Nahisangyaw dayon ha bisan diin nga dapit han katunaan ha Galilea ini nga hinabo nga ginbuhat ni Jesus.

en: And straightway, when they were come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
war: Ginmawas han sinagoga hira Jesus ug an iya mga tinun-an, upod hira Santiago ug Juan ngan nagpadayon hira ngadto han balay nira Simon ug Andres.

en: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever; and straightway they tell him of her:
war: Nahigda an ugangan nga babaye ni Simon kay hinihirantan. Pag-abot ni Jesus, ginsumatan hiya mahitungod hini nga masakit.

en: and he came and took her by the hand, and raised her up; and the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
war: Gindaop ni Jesus an masakit, kinaptan an kamot, ngan binuligan niya hin pagbuhat. Nalungasan an masakit han iya hiranat ngan nagdurot ha ira hin pagkaon.

en: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were sick, and them that were possessed with demons.
war: Pagkagab-i, katunod na han adlaw, gindara han mga tawo ngadto kan Jesus an mga magsakit ngan an mga sinasangkayan hin yawa.

en: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
war: Nagtirok an mga tawo ha atubangan han balay.

en: And he healed many that were sick with divers diseases, and cast out many demons; and he suffered not the demons to speak, because they knew him.
war: Gintambal ni Jesus in damo kalain nga mga sakit ngan ginpagawas niya in damo nga mga yawa. Waray niya tugoti nga makagyakan an mga yawa, kay nakilala ini nga mga yawa kon hin-o hiya.

en: And in the morning, a great while before day, he rose up and went out, and departed into a desert place, and there prayed.
war: Han temprano pa han aga, han waray pa sisidlit an adlaw,, binmuhat hi Jesus ngan linmakat. Ginmawas hiya han bungto ngan kinmadto hin mamingaw nga dapit ngan didto nag-ampo hiya.

en: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him;
war: Kundi ginmawas liwat han bungto hi Simon ngan an iya mga kaurupod hin pamiling kan Jesus.

en: and they found him, and say unto him, All are seeking thee.
war: Paghiagii nira ha iya, ginsiring nira hiya, “An mga tawo nagpipinamiling ha imo.”

en: And he saith unto them, Let us go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also; for to this end came I forth.
war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus, “Pakadto kita ha iba nga mga baryo nga hiraniay dinhe hini nga dapit. Kinahanglan magwali liwat ako didto, kay amo ini an tuyo han akon pagkanhi.”

en: And he went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
war: Sanglit nagsudoy hiya han bug-os nga Galilea, nagwali hiya ha mga sinagoga ngan nagpagawas hiya hin mga yawa.

en: And there cometh to him a leper, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
war: Dinmaop kan Jesus in usa nga sanlahon, linmuhod ha iya atubangan, ngan nakimalooy nga buligan hiya. “Kon imo karuyag,” nagsiring an sanlahon, “makakalinis ka ha akon.”

en: And being moved with compassion, he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou made clean.
war: Nalooy hi Jesus ha iya. Gindun-an hiya ni Jesus ngan sidngon, “Karuyag ko. Magmalinis ka!”

en: And straightway the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.
war: Nakuha dayon an sanla ngan naupay an tawo.

en: And he strictly charged him, and straightway sent him out,
war: Ginpaoli hiya upod an hugot nga pagtugon ha iya,

en: and saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go show thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
war: “Pamati, ayaw pagsumat bisan kan kanay. Pakadto dayon ha padi ngan pakita ha iya; kahuman, paghalad sugad han sugo ni Moises basi hisabtan nga upay ka na.”

en: And when he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was noised that he was in the house.
war: Paglabay hin pira ka adlaw, binmalik hi Jesus ha Capernaum ngan nahibantog nga inmoli na hiya.

en: And many were gathered together, so that there was no longer room for them , no, not even about the door: and he spake the word unto them.
war: Damo in mga tawo nga kinmadto, sanglit napuno an balay, bisan pa ngani an bungasaran ha atubangan han portahan. Han nagwawali hi Jesus ha ira,

en: And they come, bringing unto him a man sick of the palsy, borne of four.
war: gindara ngada ha iya in usa nga lulid nga ginpasag hin upat ka tawo.

en: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the crowd, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed whereon the sick of the palsy lay.
war: Tungod han kadamo han mga tawo, waray hira makahirani kan Jesus. Sanglit gin-ukban nira an atop nga tungod ni Jesus. Ira gintonton tikang ha atop an lulid nga nakada ha iya higdaan.

en: And Jesus seeing their faith saith unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins are forgiven.
war: Nakasabot hi Jesus han ira dako nga pagtoo, ngan ginsiring niya an lulid, “Anak, ginpasaylo na an imo mga sala.”

en: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
war: May-ada mga magturutdo han Balaod nga nagkakalingkod didto nga nagsiring ha ira ngahaw,

en: Why doth this man thus speak? he blasphemeth: who can forgive sins but one, even God?
war: “Kay ano nga ginmahom man hiya pagyakan hin sugad hini? Usa ini nga pagpanamastamas han Dyos? Waray tawo nga makakapasaylo hin sala; an Dyos la in makakahimo.”

en: And straightway Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, saith unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
war: Nakasabot dayon hi Jesus han ira mga ginhuhunahuna. Sanglit nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kay ano nga nakahunahuna man kamo hin sugad?

en: Which is easier, to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins are forgiven; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
war: Hain in masarosayon: an pagsiring ngada hini nga lulid, ‘An imo sala ginpasaylo,’ kon an pagsiring, ‘Buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan ngan lakat?’

en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath authority on earth to forgive sins (he saith to the sick of the palsy),
war: Ipapakita ko ha iyo nga may gahom dinhe ha tuna an Anak han Tawo hin pagpasaylo han mga sala.” Sanglit ginsiring niya an lulid,

en: I say unto thee, Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thy house.
war: “Nasiring ako ha imo, buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan ngan uli ha iyo balay!”

en: And he arose, and straightway took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
war: Ha atubangan han mga tawo, binmuhat an lulid, gindara an iya higdaan, ngan linmakat dayon. Nahipausa hira ngatanan, ngan nagdayaw hira han Dyos hin pagsiring, “Waray pa kami kumita hin sugad hini nga hinabo!”

en: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha baybayon han Lanaw Galilea. Dinmaop in mga tawo ha iya ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtutdo ha ira.

en: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphæus sitting at the place of toll, and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
war: Samtang naglalakat hiya, nakita niya in usa nga parasukot hin buhis, hi Levi, nga anak ni Alfeo, nga nalingkod didto han iya buhatan. Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Sunod ha akon.” Binmuhat hi Levi nga sinmunod kan Jesus.

en: And it came to pass, that he was sitting at meat in his house, and many publicans and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
war: Tinmangka hi Jesus hin pagkaon didto han balay ni Levi. Damo an mga parasukot hin buhis ngan mga tinamay nga nagsunodsunod kan Jesus. Damo ha ira in nakigsaro ha iya ngan han iya mga tinun-an.

en: And the scribes of the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and publicans, said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
war: Pinmakiana hira han mga tinun-an ni Jesus, “Kay ano nga nakikigsaro man hiya han mga parasukot hin buhis ngan han mga tinamay?”

en: And when Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of a physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners.
war: Nakabati hi Jesus ha ira ngan ginbaton hira niya, “Diri nagkikinahanglan hin magtarambal an waray sakit nga tawo, kundi adton may-ada la sakit. Waray ako makanhi hin pagtawag hadton mga magtadong, kundi hadton mga magpakasasala.”

en: And John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting: and they come and say unto him, Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
war: Ha usa ka higayon, nagpuasa an mga tinun-an ni Juan nga Parabunyag ngan an mga Parisiyo. May-ada mga tawo nga kinmadto kan Jesus ngan pinmakiana ha iya, “Kay ano nga nagpupuasa an mga tinun-an ni Juan nga Parabunyag ngan an mga Parisiyo, kundi diri man an imo mga tinun-an?”

en: And Jesus said unto them, Can the sons of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Matugot ba kamo nga diri mangaon an mga dinapit ngadto hin pakasal? Maaram ako nga diri kamo matugot. Samtang nga upod pa an kinasal ha ira, mangangaon manta hira.

en: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then will they fast in that day.
war: Kundi maabot an panahon nga mabaya ha ira an kinasal; ngan amo na an ira diri pagkaon.

en: No man seweth a piece of undressed cloth on an old garment: else that which should fill it up taketh from it, the new from the old, and a worse rent is made.
war: “Waray tawo nga nagamit hin bag-o nga dugnit hin pagtangkop hin daan nga bado. Kay kon iya ini buhaton, magigisi an dumog nga bado ngan mahiluag an tarangkopan.

en: And no man putteth new wine into old wine-skins; else the wine will burst the skins, and the wine perisheth, and the skins: but they put new wine into fresh wine-skins.
war: Waray liwat naipis hin bag-o nga bino ngada hin daan na nga anit nga surudlan. Kon iya ini buhaton, mabuburit an surudlan kay magigisi an anit ngan makakarag an bino.”

en: And it came to pass, that he was going on the sabbath day through the grainfields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears.
war: Nahinabo nga naglatas hi Jesus ha kaumhan hin trigo ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway. Samtang naglalakat hira, nangutos hin mga uhay an mga tinun-an nga upod niya.

en: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
war: Nagsiring an mga Parisiyo kan Jesus, “Diri tugot han aton Balaod nga mangutos an imo mga tinun-an ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”

en: And he said unto them, Did ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was hungry, he, and they that were with him?
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Waray ba kamo makabati han ginbuhat ni David han nagkikinahanglan hiya hin pagkaon? Ginutom hi David ngan an iya mga sakop;

en: How he entered into the house of God when Abiathar was high priest, and ate the showbread, which it is not lawful to eat save for the priests, and gave also to them that were with him?
war: sanglit, sinmulod hiya han balay han Dyos ngan kinmaon han tinapay nga iginhalad ha Dyos. Nahinabo ini ha panahon nga hi Abiatar amo an Labaw nga padi. Subay han aton Balaod, an makakakaon la hini nga tinapay amo an mga padi, kundi kinmaon hi David ngan tinagan niya an iya mga sakop.”

en: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Ginhimo an Adlaw nga Iparahuway tungod han tawo; diri an tawo tungod han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: so that the Son of man is lord even of the sabbath.
war: Sanglit an Anak han Tawo Ginoo bisan han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”

en: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there who had his hand withered.
war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha sinagoga diin nakadto in tawo nga patay an kamot.

en: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
war: May-ada didto mga tawo nga karuyag magbutangbutang hin sayop kan Jesus, sanglit nag-inaw hira kon magtambal ba hiya ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: And he saith unto the man that had his hand withered, Stand forth.
war: Ginsiring ni Jesus an tawo nga patay an kamot, “Pakadi ha atubangan.”

en: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful on the sabbath day to do good, or to do harm? to save a life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
war: Pinmakiana hi Jesus han mga tawo, “Ano an tugot han aton Balaod nga sadang buhaton ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway? Pagbulig ba, o pagdaot? Pagtalwas ba hin kinabuhi, o pagkuha ba hin kinabuhi?”

en: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their heart, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he stretched it forth; and his hand was restored.
war: Kundi waray hira mag-aringasa.

en: And the Pharisees went out, and straightway with the Herodians took counsel against him, how they might destroy him.
war: Nangalas hi Jesus han pagkita niya hini nga mga tawo, kundi inalpan hiya hin kalooy tungod han katig-a han ira kasingkasing ngan kasayop nira. Ginsiring niya an tawo, “Unata an imo kamot.” Gin-unat han tawo an iya kamot ngan naupay.

en: And Jesus with his disciples withdrew to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed; and from Judæa,
war: Sanglit ginmawas an mga Parisiyo han sinagoga, ngan nakigkita dayon han iba nga mga kaapi han hugpo ni Herodes. Ngan nagkasarabot hira hin pagpatay kan Jesus.

en: and from Jerusalem, and from Idumæa, and beyond the Jordan, and about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came unto him.
war: Kinmadto hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an ha lanaw han Galilea. Binmunyog ha iya in damo nga mga tawo nga tikang ha Galilea, ha Judea,

en: And he spake to his disciples, that a little boat should wait on him because of the crowd, lest they should throng him:
war: ha Jerusalem, ha tuna han Idumea, ha tuna tabok han Jordan ngan ha mga higrani nga dapit han mga bungto han Tiro ug Sidon. Nagsinunod kan Jesus ini nga mga tawo kay nakabati hira han mga ginbuhat niya.

en: for he had healed many; insomuch that as many as had plagues pressed upon him that they might touch him.
war: Damo kaupay an mga tawo, sanglit ginsugo niya an iya mga tinun-an nga mag-andam hin sakayan basi diri hiya mapiit han mga tawo.

en: And the unclean spirits, whensoever they beheld him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
war: Damo an iya mga gintambal, sanglit nagpirit gud an mga magsakit nga makaduok kan Jesus, basi la makakamkam ha iya.

en: And he charged them much that they should not make him known.
war: Nahapa ha iya atubangan an mga tawo nga sinasangkayan hin yawa kon nakita ha iya, ngan nagoliat, “Ikaw an Anak han Dyos!”

en: And he goeth up into the mountain, and calleth unto him whom he himself would; and they went unto him.
war: Gintugon hin maupay ni Jesus an mga yawa nga diri magsumat kon hin-o hiya.

en: And he appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
war: Sinmagka hi Jesus hin pungtod ngan ginpadaop niya an mga kalalaken-an nga kinaruyag niya. Dinmaop hira

en: and to have authority to cast out demons:
war: ngan nagpili hiya hin dose nga iya ginngaranan nga mga apostoles. “Ginpili ko kamo basi umupod kamo ha akon,” nagsiring hiya, “ngan susugoon ko kamo hin pagwali

en: and Simon he surnamed Peter;
war: ngan tatagan ko kamo hin gahom hin pagpaiwas hin mga yawa.”

en: and James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and them he surnamed Boanerges, which is, Sons of thunder:
war: Amo ini an dose nga ginpili niya: hi Simon (ginngaranan hiya ni Jesus nga Pedro);

en: and Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphæus, and Thaddæus, and Simon the Cananæan,
war: hi Santiago ngan an iya bugto, hi Juan, mga anak ni Sebedeo (ginngaranan hira ni Jesus nga “Boanerges,” an karuyag sidngon, “Mga Tawo hin Dalugdog”);

en: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
war: hira Andres, Felipe, Bartolome, Mateo, Tomas, Santiago nga anak ni Alfeo, Tadeo, Simon, an bayani,

en: And he cometh into a house.
war: ngan hi Judas Iscariote nga naglingo kan Jesus.

en: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
war: Inmuli hi Jesus ngan gin-alirongan na liwat hiya hin damo nga mga tawo nga waray na ngani hiya ngan an iya mga tinun-an panahon hin pagkaon.

en: And when his friends heard it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
war: Pakabati han iya kauropdan mahitungod hini, kinmadto hira hin pagkuha ha iya, kay nasumatan hira nga nawad-an na hiya hin maupay nga panmurubuot.

en: And the scribes that came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and, By the prince of the demons casteth he out the demons.
war: May-ada mga magturutdo han Balaod nga tikang ha Jerusalem nga nagsiring: “Hinkakaptan hiya ni Beelsebul!”

en: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
war: Nagsiring an iba, “Naghatag ha iya hin gahom an puno hin mga yawa hin pagpagawas ha ira.”

en: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
war: Sanglit gintawag ni Jesus an mga tawo ngan nagsumat hiya hin mga pananglitan: “Uunanhon man ni Satanas hin pagpaiwas ha iya ngahaw?

en: And if a house be divided against itself, that house will not be able to stand.
war: Kon magkabahinbahin in usa nga nasod ngan mag-aruaraway hira, mapupukan ito nga nasod.

en: And if Satan hath risen up against himself, and is divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
war: Kon makabahinbahin in usa nga panimalay ngan mag-aruaraway hira, mabubungkag ito nga panimalay.

en: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man , and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man ; and then he will spoil his house.
war: Sanglit kon magkabahinbahin an ginhadian ni Satanas, diri ito mag-iiha, kundi mabubungkag ngan mapupukan.

en: Verily I say unto you, All their sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and their blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
war: “Waray makakasulod hin balay hin kusgan nga tawo hin pangawat, kon diri anay niya gaposon an kusgan nga tawo. Kon magapos na niya, amo na an pakapangawat niya.

en: but whosoever shall blaspheme against the Holy Spirit hath never forgiveness, but is guilty of an eternal sin:
war: “Tigamni ini niyo: Mapapasaylo an mga tawo han ira mga sala ngan han magraot nga ira mga ginyakan.

en: because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
war: Kundi diri mapapasaylo an tawo nga magpasipara hin pagyakan supak han Espiritu Santo.” (

en: And there come his mother and his brethren; and, standing without, they sent unto him, calling him.
war: Ginyakan ini ni Jesus kay may-ada nasiring nga may-ada hiya maraot nga espiritu.)

en: And a multitude was sitting about him; and they say unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
war: Inmabot an iroy ni Jesus ngan an iya kabugtoan. Waray hira sumakob han balay, kundi nagpatugon la hira nga may-ada tuyo nira ha iya.

en: And he answereth them, and saith, Who is my mother and my brethren?
war: Nabubutnga hi Jesus hin mga nagkakalingkod nga mga tawo, ngan nagsiring hira ha iya, “Aadto ha gawas an iroy ngan kabugtoan mo, may-ada tuyo ha imo.”

en: And looking round on them that sat round about him, he saith, Behold, my mother and my brethren!
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Hin-o an akon iroy? Hin-o an akon kabugtoan?”

en: And again he began to teach by the sea side. And there is gathered unto him a very great multitude, so that he entered into a boat, and sat in the sea; and all the multitude were by the sea on the land.
war: Nagtikang liwat hi Jesus hin pagtutdo didto ha tabi han Lanaw han Galilea. Damo kaupay an mga tawo nga nag-alirong ha iya; sanglit sinmakay hiya hin sakayan ngan linmingkod hiya. Nakadto ha dagat an sakayan ngan nagkakatukdaw an mga tawo didto ha tabi.

en: And he taught them many things in parables, and said unto them in his teaching,
war: Damo an igintutdo niya pinaagi hin mga pananglitan. Dida han iya pagtutdo nagsiring hiya ha ira:

en: Hearken: Behold, the sower went forth to sow:
war: “Pamati kamo! May-ada tawo nga kinmadto han iya uma hin pagsabod.

en: and it came to pass, as he sowed, some seed fell by the way side, and the birds came and devoured it.
war: Han nagsasabod hiya, may mga binhe nga nagkataktak ha dalan ngan pinanuktok han mga tamsi.

en: And other fell on the rocky ground , where it had not much earth; and straightway it sprang up, because it had no deepness of earth:
war: May-ada nahulog ngada hin batoon nga tuna. Tinmurok gad an binhe kay may-ada man manipis nga tuna.

en: and when the sun was risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
war: Kundi han pagsirak han adlaw, nalaya an mga tanom kay waray makagamot hin maupay, ngan nagkauuga.

en: And other fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
war: May mga binhe nga nahulog ha mga tunokon nga kabanwaan. Han pagtubo han kabanwaan, naambongan an mga tanom; sanglit waray mamunga.

en: And others fell into the good ground, and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing; and brought forth, thirtyfold, and sixtyfold, and a hundredfold.
war: Kundi may mga binhe nga nahulog ha maupay nga tuna. Tinmurok an binhe, tinmubo ngan namunga: may-ada namunga hin 30 ka pilo, 60 ka pilo an iba, ngan 100 ka pilo an iba liwat.”

en: And he said, Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kon hin-o ha iyo an may durunggan, mamati hin maupay!”

en: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parables.
war: Han nag-uusaan na la hi Jesus, dinmaop ha iya adton iba nga nakabati ha iya upod an dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan naghangyo nga igsaysay niya an mga pananglitan.

en: And he said unto them, Unto you is given the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all things are done in parables:
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Iginhatag ha iyo an pakasabot han mga natatago nga butang han Ginhadian han Dyos; kundi nakakasabot la adton diri kausa niyo pinaagi hin mga pananglitan,

en: that seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest haply they should turn again, and it should be forgiven them.
war: basi

en: And he saith unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how shall ye know all the parables?
war: ‘Ha ira paniguro hin pagkita, diri lugod hira nakakakita,

en: The sower soweth the word.
war: ha ira paniguro hin pamati, diri lugod hira makakasabot;

en: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; and when they have heard, straightway cometh Satan, and taketh away the word which hath been sown in them.
war: kay kon makahimo hira, bangin hira bumalik sa Dyos

en: And these in like manner are they that are sown upon the rocky places , who, when they have heard the word, straightway receive it with joy;
war: ngan pasasayloon hira niya.’”

en: and they have no root in themselves, but endure for a while; then, when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, straightway they stumble.
war: Ngan nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira, “Diri ba kamo nakakasabot hini nga pananglitan? Uunanhon man ngay-an niyo hin pakasabot hin bisan ano nga pananglitan?

en: And others are they that are sown among the thorns; these are they that have heard the word,
war: An magsarabod nagsabod han mensahe han Dyos.

en: and the cares of the world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
war: May-ada mga tawo nga sugad han mga binhe nga nahulog ha dalan. Pakakabati nira han mensahe, naabot dayon hi Satanas ngan inaagaw an mensahe ha ira.

en: And those are they that were sown upon the good ground; such as hear the word, and accept it, and bear fruit, thirtyfold, and sixtyfold, and a hundredfold.
war: An iba nga mga tawo sugad hin mga binhe nga nataktak ha batoon nga tuna. Pakakabati nira han mensahe, kinakarawat dayon nira nga malipayon.

en: And he said unto them, Is the lamp brought to be put under the bushel, or under the bed, and not to be put on the stand?
war: Kundi diri gud napabilin ha ira kasingkasing, ngan diri nag-iiha. Sanglit kon naabot in kakurian ngan pag-antos tungod han mensahe, nabaya hira dayon.

en: For there is nothing hid, save that it should be manifested; neither was anything made secret, but that it should come to light.
war: An iba nga mga tawo sugad hin mga binhe nga ginsabod dida hin tunokon nga kabanwaan. Nakakabati ini hira han mensahe,

en: If any man hath ears to hear, let him hear.
war: kundi natatabonan an mensahe han mga kabaraka hiunong hin nga kinabuhi, an paghigugma han manggad, ngan an iba nga mga karuyagon, sanglit diri nakakabunga.

en: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete it shall be measured unto you; and more shall be given unto you.
war: Kundi an iba nga mga tawo sugad hin mga binhe nga ginsabod ha maupay nga tuna. Namamati hira han pulong, ira kinakarawat ngan namumunga. May-ada nabunga hin 30 ka pilo, an iba 60 ka pilo, ngan an iba na man, 100 ka pilo.”

en: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken away even that which he hath.
war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus, “Kon may-ada nagdadara hin suga, tinatakloban ba niya ini, o ibinubutang ba ha sirong hin higdaan? Diri ba ikinakadto ha iya burutangan?

en: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed upon the earth;
war: Ipadadayag an natatago; bubuksan an natatahoban.

en: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, he knoweth not how.
war: Kon hin-o an may mga durunggan, mamati hin maupay!”

en: The earth beareth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
war: Nagsiring pa hiya ha ira, “Tigamni an iyo hinbabatian. An amo ngahaw nga mga lagda nga ginagamit niyo hin paghukom han iba, amo man an gagamiton han Dyos hin paghukom ha iyo, ngan bangin labaw pa hin kamakuri.

en: But when the fruit is ripe, straightway he putteth forth the sickle, because the harvest is come.
war: Tatagan pa adton may-ada na; kukuhaan adton waray, bisan han gutiay nga aada ha iya.”

en: And he said, How shall we liken the kingdom of God? or in what parable shall we set it forth?
war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring: “Alid-agid an Ginhadian han Dyos hin tawo nga nagsabod hin binhe ha iya uma.

en: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown upon the earth, though it be less than all the seeds that are upon the earth,
war: Kahuman niya pagsabod han binhe, nagpapadayon hiya han iya ikina-adlaw nga mga buruhaton, samtang naturok ngan natubo an binhe. Kundi diri hiya maaram kon ano an kasugad hini.

en: yet when it is sown, groweth up, and becometh greater than all the herbs, and putteth out great branches; so that the birds of the heaven can lodge under the shadow thereof.
war: An tuna ngahaw an nakakapatubo ngan nakakapabunga: syahan, nananahon; niyan, namumukad; kahuman, namumunga.

en: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it;
war: Kon hinog na an bunga, gin-aani han tag-iya, kay inmabot na an takna hin panguha.

en: and without a parable spake he not unto them: but privately to his own disciples he expounded all things.
war: “Ano ba an aton ikatatanding han Ginhadian han Dyos?” nagpakiana hi Jesus. “Ano nga pananglitan an sadang naton gamiton hin pagsaysay hini?

en: And on that day, when even was come, he saith unto them, Let us go over unto the other side.
war: Amo ini nga pananglitan: Usa ka tawo nagtanom ha tuna hin liso hin mustasa, an gigugutiayi nga liso dinhe ha tuna.

en: And leaving the multitude, they take him with them, even as he was, in the boat. And other boats were with him.
war: Natubo ini ngan nahihimo nga gidadakoi nga kahoy. Narampag an iya mga sanga ngan nahapon an katamsihan ngan dito nagsasalag.”

en: And there ariseth a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the boat, insomuch that the boat was now filling.
war: Nagwali hi Jesus ha mga tawo pinaagi hin alid-agid hini nga mga pananglitan. Ginsumatan niya hira sugad han ira hinsasabotan.

en: And he himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion: and they awake him, and say unto him, Teacher, carest thou not that we perish?
war: Waray gud hiya magyakan ha ira kon diri pinaagi hin mga pananglitan; kundi kon an iya mga tinun-an la an iya kahimangraw, iya iginsasaysay an ngatanan ha ira.

en: And he awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
war: Han pagkagab-i hito manta nga adlaw, nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Talabok kita ngadto ha luyo han lanaw.”

en: And he said unto them, Why are ye fearful? have ye not yet faith?
war: Sanglit binayaan nira an kadam-an nga mga tawo. Sinmakay han sakayan an mga tinun-an diin nakadto na hi Jesus, ngan tinmalabok hira. May iba nga mga sakayan didto.

en: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
war: Inmabot in makusog nga alipuros ngan ginsasakayan na an ira sakayan hin mga balod nga haros mapuno na hin tubig an sakayan.

en: And they came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gerasenes.
war: Inmabot hira ha tabok han Lanaw han Galilea, didto han tuna han mga taga-Gadara.

en: And when he was come out of the boat, straightway there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
war: Han paghaw-as gud la ni Jesus han sakayan, gintapo hiya hin tawo nga tikang ha mga lungib nga lubnganan.

en: who had his dwelling in the tombs: and no man could any more bind him, no, not with a chain;
war: May-ada ini nga tawo maraot nga espiritu, ngan didto hiya pag-iinukoy han mga lubnganan. Waray na gud nakakagapos ha iya hin kadena.

en: because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been rent asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: and no man had strength to tame him.
war: Makadamo na gaposa an iya mga kamot ngan mga tiil, kundi nauutod la an mga kadena ha kamot ngan an pandog ha iya tiil. Makusog hiya hin duro nga waray gud nakakahawid ha iya.

en: And always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.
war: Adlaw gab-i nagsusudoysudoy hiya han mga linubngan ngan han mga pungtod, naggiginoliat ngan nag-uunay hin pagsamad ha iya ngahaw pinaagi han mga bato.

en: And when he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and worshipped him;
war: Tay-aw hiya han pakakita niya kan Jesus. Sanglit dinmalagan hiya, hinmapa ha atubangan ni Jesus,

en: and crying out with a loud voice, he saith, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the Most High God? I adjure thee by God, torment me not.
war: ngan ginmoliat hin dako nga tingog: “Jesus, Anak han Gilalabawi nga Dyos! Ano an imo karuyag buhaton ha akon? Nakikimalooy ako ha imo, ayaw ako pagkastigoha!” (

en: For he said unto him, Come forth, thou unclean spirit, out of the man.
war: Ginyakan ini niya kay nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya: “Maraot nga espiritu, gawas dida hini nga tawo!”)

en: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he saith unto him, My name is Legion; for we are many.
war: Sanglit ginpakianhan hiya ni Jesus, “Hin-o an imo ngaran?”

en: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
war: Binmaton an tawo, “‘Panon’ an akon ngaran, kay damo kami.”

en: Now there was there on the mountain side a great herd of swine feeding.
war: Waray hiya humunong pakimalooy kan Jesus nga diri pagawson an maraot nga mga espiritu dida hito nga tuna.

en: And they besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
war: May-ada dako nga panon hin kababoyan nga naniningaon dida hin hirani nga pungtod.

en: And he gave them leave. And the unclean spirits came out, and entered into the swine: and the herd rushed down the steep into the sea, in number about two thousand; and they were drowned in the sea.
war: Naghangyo kan Jesus an magraot nga mga espiritu, “Pasudla kami ngadto han kababoyan.”

en: And they that fed them fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they came to see what it was that had come to pass.
war: Gintugotan hira ni Jesus. Ginmawas han tawo an maraot nga mga espiritu ngan kinmadto han kababoyan. May mga duha ka yukot an mga baboy nga nandadlagan ngadto han umpas; nahulog ngadto han lanaw ngan nagkalulumos.

en: And they come to Jesus, and behold him that was possessed with demons sitting, clothed and in his right mind, even him that had the legion: and they were afraid.
war: Nandadlagan dayon an magmarangno han kababoyan ngadto ha bungto ngan kaumhan hin pagsumat han nahinabo. Kinmadto an mga tawo pagkita han nahinabo.

en: And they that saw it declared unto them how it befell him that was possessed with demons, and concerning the swine.
war: Dinmaop hira kan Jesus ngan kinmita hira han tawo nga may-ada anay mga yawa. Nalingkod hiya, diri na lubas ngan maupay na igkahimangraw. Ngan nahadlok hira ngatanan.

en: And they began to beseech him to depart from their borders.
war: Nagsumat han mga tawo adton nakakita kon ano an nahinabo han tawo nga sinangkayan hin yawa ngan han kababoyan.

en: And as he was entering into the boat, he that had been possessed with demons besought him that he might be with him.
war: Sanglit ginhangyo nira hi Jesus nga gumawas han ira tuna.

en: And he suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go to thy house unto thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and how he had mercy on thee.
war: Han naisarakay na hi Jesus, nakimalooy an tawo nga iniwasan hin mga yawa, nga paupdon hiya.

en: And he went his way, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men marvelled.
war: Kundi waray tumugot hi Jesus. Lugod, ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “Uli ngadto ha imo panimalay ngan sumati hira han ginbuhat ha imo han Ginoo ngan han iya kalooy ha imo.”

en: And when Jesus had crossed over again in the boat unto the other side, a great multitude was gathered unto him; and he was by the sea.
war: Inmoli an tawo ngan nagsudoy hiya han Decapolis nga nagsinumat han ginbuhat ni Jesus ha iya. Dako an paghipausa hadton nagpakabati ha iya.

en: And there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jaïrus by name; and seeing him, he falleth at his feet,
war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha tabok han lanaw. Nag-alirong ha iya in damo nga mga tawo didto ha ligid han lanaw.

en: and beseecheth him much, saying, My little daughter is at the point of death: I pray thee , that thou come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be made whole, and live.
war: Dinmaop ha iya hi Jairo, usa nga tinaporan han sinagoga. Pakakita niya kan Jesus hinmapa hiya

en: And he went with him; and a great multitude followed him, and they thronged him.
war: ngan duro an iya pakimalooy ha iya hin pagsiring, “Masakit hin duro an akon anak nga babayehay. Kadtoa gud ngan ipadapat an imo kamot ha iya basi maupay hiya ngan diri mamatay!”

en: And a woman, who had an issue of blood twelve years,
war: Ngan inmupod hi Jesus ha iya. Damo liwat nga mga tawo an binmunyog kan Jesus ngan gindadaisog hiya han mga tawo.

en: and had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
war: May-ada babaye nga makalilisang na an gin-antos tungod hin duro nga pagdinugoi ha iya hin dose na ka tuig,

en: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came in the crowd behind, and touched his garment.
war: bisan kon damo na in nagtambal ha iya. Naubos na an iya kwarta, kundi waray hiya mag-upay; magtikadugang la lugod an iya sakit.

en: For she said, If I touch but his garments, I shall be made whole.
war: Nasumatan hiya mahitungod kan Jesus; sanglit nagpirit hiya hin pagtampo han kadam-an, ngan pinmaluyo hiya kan Jesus.

en: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of her plague.
war: Nagsiring hiya ha iya ngahaw, “Kon makakapot la ako bisan la han iya bado, mauupay gud ako.”

en: And straightway Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power proceeding from him had gone forth, turned him about in the crowd, and said, Who touched my garments?
war: Kinaptan niya an bado ni Jesus, ngan inmukoy dayon an pagdinugoi ha iya; inabat niya nga naupay hiya han iya sakit.

en: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
war: Nakasabot dayon hi Jesus nga ginmawas ha iya in gahom. Linmingi hiya hin pagkita han kadam-an nga mga tawo ngan nagpakiana, “Hin-o in nagkapot han akon bado?”

en: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
war: Nagbaton an iya mga tinun-an, “Nakita ka nga ginlilibotan ka han mga tawo. Kay ano nga nagpapakiana ka pa man?”

en: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
war: Kundi gin-osisa gud ni Jesus kon hin-o an kinapot han iya bado.

en: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
war: Nakasabot an babaye han nahinabo ha iya; sanglit dinmaop hiya kan Jesus nga nangungurog hin kahadlok. Hinmapa hiya ha atubangan ni Jesus ngan nagsumat han bug-os nga kamatuoran.

en: While he yet spake, they come from the ruler of the synagogue’s house , saying, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Teacher any further?
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Anak ko, nakaupay ha imo an imo pagtoo. Lakat nga malinawon, ngan mauupay ka han imo sakit.”

en: But Jesus, not heeding the word spoken, saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Fear not, only believe.
war: Han nagyiyinakan pa hi Jesus, may-ada mga surugoon nga inmabot tikang ha balay ni Jairo. Ginsumatan nira hi Jairo, “Patay na an imo anak nga babaye. Ayaw na pagsinamoka an Magturutdo.”

en: And he suffered no man to follow with him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
war: Waray la makigbali hi Jesus han ira ginsumat, kundi ginsiring hi Jairo, “Ayaw kahadlok. Too la.”

en: And they come to the house of the ruler of the synagogue; and he beholdeth a tumult, and many weeping and wailing greatly.
war: Ngan waray ginpaupod ni Jesus, labot kan Pedro ngan han magbugto, hira Santiago ug Juan.

en: And when he was entered in, he saith unto them, Why make ye a tumult, and weep? the child is not dead, but sleepeth.
war: Inmabot hira ha balay ni Jairo diin hinkit-an ni Jesus an kasamok ngan hinbatian niya an mga pagnguyngoy ngan pagtangis.

en: And they laughed him to scorn. But he, having put them all forth, taketh the father of the child and her mother and them that were with him, and goeth in where the child was.
war: Sinmakob hiya ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Ano ini nga kasamok? Kay ano nga nagtitinangis man kamo? Diri patay an bata; nakaturog la hiya.”

en: And taking the child by the hand, he saith unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, Arise.
war: Gintinawaan la hiya han mga tawo; sanglit, ginpagawas niya hira. Pinaupod ni Jesus an amay ngan an iroy han bata ngan an iya tulo nga mga tinun-an, ngan kinmadto hira han sulod diin naghigda an bata.

en: And straightway the damsel rose up, and walked; for she was twelve years old. And they were amazed straightway with a great amazement.
war: Kinaptan ni Jesus an kamot han bata ngan sidngon, “Talitha, koum,” kon ha aton pa, “Babayehay, pinapabuhat ko ikaw!”

en: And he went out from thence; and he cometh into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus hito nga dapit ngan inmoli ngadto han iya kalugaringon nga bungto ngan an iya mga tinun-an sinmunod ha iya.

en: And when the sabbath was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, Whence hath this man these things? and, What is the wisdom that is given unto this man, and what mean such mighty works wrought by his hands?
war: Nagtutdo hiya ha sinagoga ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway. Damo an nakadto nga mga tawo, ngan nanhipausa hira han pakabati nira ha iya. “Diin ba hiya kuha hini nga hibaro?” nagpakiana hira. “Ano ini nga hibaro nga ihinatag ha iya? Inuunan-o ba niya hin pagbuhat hin mga milagro?

en: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, and Joses, and Judas, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended in him.
war: Diri ba hiya an panday nga anak ni Maria ngan bugto nira Santiago, Jose, Judas ug Simon? Diri ba nag-uokoy dinhe an kababayen-an nga iya kabugtoan?” Sanglit iginsalikway hiya nira.

en: And Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honor, save in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Tinatahod an manaragna bisan diin nga dapit labot la dida han iya kalugaringon nga bungto, han iya kauropdan ngan han iya panimalay.”

en: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
war: Waray hiya makahimo hin pagbuhat hin mga milagro didto, labot la nga gindun-an ngan gintambal niya in pira nga mga magsakit.

en: And he marvelled because of their unbelief.
war: Dako an iya paghipausa tungod han kawaray nira pagtoo.

en: And he went round about the villages teaching.
war: Nagsudoy hi Jesus han mga baryo didto hito nga dapit ngan nagtutdo han mga tawo.

en: And he calleth unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits;
war: Gintirok niya an dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan iya ginsugo hin padispadis. Tinagan niya hira hin gahom hin pakadaog han mga yawa

en: and he charged them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse;
war: ngan gintugon hira niya, “Ayaw kamo pagdara hin bisan ano ha iyo paglakaton, labot hin tungkod; ayaw pagdara hin pagkaon, hin supot ngan hin kwarta ha iyo mga bulsa.

en: but to go shod with sandals: and, said he , put not on two coats.
war: Pagsul-ot kamo hin sandalyas kundi ayaw pagdara hin liliwanan.”

en: And he said unto them, Wheresoever ye enter into a house, there abide till ye depart thence.
war: Gintugon pa hira, “Kon diin kamo nga balay karawata ngan pasak-a pabilin kamo dida ngahaw tubtob han iyo pagbaya hito nga dapit.

en: And whatsoever place shall not receive you, and they hear you not, as ye go forth thence, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony unto them.
war: Kon diri kamo karawaton ha usa nga dapit o diri kamo pamatian, bayai ito nga dapit katapos niyo padpara an tapotapo ha iyo mga tiil. Usa ini nga pahimangno ha ira.”

en: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
war: Sanglit nagkalakat ngan nagwali hira nga kinahanglan bumaya an mga tawo han ira mga sala.

en: And they cast out many demons, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
war: Nagpaiwas hira hin damo nga mga yawa, ngan nagdihog hira hin lana ha damo nga mga magsakit, ngan gin-upay nira hira.

en: And king Herod heard thereof ; for his name had become known: and he said, John the Baptizer is risen from the dead, and therefore do these powers work in him.
war: Niyan nakabati hi Hadi Herodes hiunong hini ngatanan kay nahisamwak man an bantog ni Jesus ha ngatanan nga dapit. May-ada mga tawo nga nasiring, “Nabuhi na liwat hi Juan nga Parabunyag! Sanglit nakikita ta ini nga mga gahom dida ha iya.”

en: But others said, It is Elijah. And others said, It is a prophet, even as one of the prophets.
war: Kundi nagsiring an iba, “Hi Elias hiya.”

en: But Herod, when he heard thereof , said, John, whom I beheaded, he is risen.
war: Nagsiring liwat an iba, “Manaragna hiya sugad hin usa nga bantogan nga manaragna hadton mga una pa nga panahon.”

en: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife; for he had married her.
war: Han pakabati hini ni Herodes, nagsiring hiya, “Amo hiya hi Juan nga Parabunyag! Ginpapugotan ko na hiya, kundi nabuhi liwat!”

en: For John said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife.
war: Hi Herodes ngahaw an nagpadakop kan Juan; iya iginpagapos ngan iginsulod ha bilanggoan. Ginbuhat ini ni Herodes tungod kan Herodias nga iya gin-asawa. Hi Herodias asawa ni Felipe nga bugto ngahaw ni Herodes.

en: And Herodias set herself against him, and desired to kill him; and she could not;
war: Waray hunong hin pagsinaway ni Juan kan Herodes, “Diri matadong nga buhat an pag-asawa mo han asawa han imo bugto!”

en: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. And when he heard him, he was much perplexed; and he heard him gladly.
war: Sanglit nagdumot hi Herodias kan Juan ngan karuyag niya patayon, kundi waray hiya makahimo tungod kan Herodes.

en: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, and the high captains, and the chief men of Galilee;
war: Nahadlok hi Herodes kan Juan kay maaram hiya nga maupay ngan baraan nga tawo hi Juan, sanglit ginpabantayan hiya niya. Karuyag niya mamati kan Juan, bisan kon nagugupong hiya ha kada pakakabati niya kan Juan.

en: and when the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and them that sat at meat with him; and the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
war: Ha kataposan nakahigayon hi Herodias hin pagpatay kan Juan. Naghatag hi Herodes hin dako nga kombite dida han iya kaadlawan, han mga punoan han kasondalohan, ngan han mga dagko nga pagkatawo ha Galilea.

en: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
war: Sinmakob ngan sinmayaw an anak nga babaye ni Herodias Nakalipay hiya kan Herodes ngan han mga dinapit ngada han kombite. Nagpakiana han daragita an hadi, “Ano an imo karuyag aroon? Ihahatag ko ha imo in bisan ano nga imo karuyag.”

en: And she went out, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptizer.
war: Pinaagi hin damo nga panumpa, nagsiring ha iya na hadi, “Nagsasaad ako nga tatagan ta ikaw han imo karuyag aroon, bisan pa an katunga han akon ginhadian.”

en: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou forthwith give me on a platter the head of John the Baptist.
war: Ginmawas an daragita ngan pinmakiana han iroy niya kon ano an iya aaroon.

en: And the king was exceeding sorry; but for the sake of his oaths, and of them that sat at meat, he would not reject her.
war: Binmaton an iroy niya, “An ulo ni Juan nga Parabunyag.”

en: And straightway the king sent forth a soldier of his guard, and commanded to bring his head: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
war: Kinmadto dayon han hadi an daragita ngan nangaro, “Karuyag ko nga ihatag mo ha akon an ulo ni Juan nga Parabunyag nga sinangga hin plato!”

en: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the damsel; and the damsel gave it to her mother.
war: Nabido kaupay an hadi; kundi waray hiya makabaribad, kay nagsaad hiya ha atubangan han iya nga dinapit.

en: And when his disciples heard thereof , they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
war: Sanglit ginsugo niya in gwardya han bilanggoan nga dad-on an ulo ni Juan. Linmakat an gwardya, kinmadto ha bilanggoan, ngan ginpugotan hi Juan.

en: And the apostles gather themselves together unto Jesus; and they told him all things, whatsoever they had done, and whatsoever they had taught.
war: Gindara niya an ulo nga sinangga hin plato, ngan iginhatag niya han daragita, ngan ihinatag han daragita ngadto han iroy niya.

en: And he saith unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while. For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
war: Pakabati hini han mga tinun-an ni Juan, kinmadto hira pagkuha han iya lawas ngan iginlubong nira.

en: And they went away in the boat to a desert place apart.
war: Binmalik ngan nakigkita kan Jesus an mga apostoles ngan ginsumatan hiya nira han ngatanan nga ira ginbuhat ngan gintutdo.

en: And the people saw them going, and many knew them , and they ran together there on foot from all the cities, and outwent them.
war: Abotkiabot an mga tawo, sanglit waray na ngani panahon pagkaon hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an. Sanglit nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Tana, pahirayo kita han mga tawo, ngadto hin mamingaw nga dapit, basi makapahuway anay kamo.”

en: And he came forth and saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
war: Sanglit sinmakay hira hin sakayan ngadto hin dapit nga mamingaw.

en: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, The place is desert, and the day is now far spent;
war: Kundi damo nga mga tawo an kinmita han ira paggikan ngan nahibaro dayon hira kon hin-o an mga sakay. Sanglit, linmanat hira tikang han mga kaburubungtohan. Tungod nga darodalagan man an ira pagbaktas, nahiuna hira pag-abot kanda Jesus ngan han iya mga tinun-an.

en: send them away, that they may go into the country and villages round about, and buy themselves somewhat to eat.
war: Han paghaw-as ni Jesus han sakayan hinkit-an niya ini nga kadam-an nga mga tawo ngan nalooy hiya ha ira kay sugad hira hin mga karnero nga waray magmarangno. Ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtutdo ha ira hin damo nga mga butang.

en: But he answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred shillings’ worth of bread, and give them to eat?
war: Han kulopay na, dinmaop an iya mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring, “Tikagab-i na, ngan tay-aw ini nga dapit.

en: And he saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
war: Palakta na an mga tawo ngan pakadtoa na la hira ha mga higrani nga kaumhan ngan kabaryohan, basi makapalit hira hin sadang makaon.”

en: And he commanded them that all should sit down by companies upon the green grass.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Kamo ngahaw in hatag ha ira hin pagkaon.”

en: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
war: Nagpakiana hira, “Karuyag ba nimo nga lumakat kami pagpalit hin kanan 400.00 nga tinapay ngan ipakaon ha ira?”

en: And he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake the loaves; and he gave to the disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
war: Pinmakiana hi Jesus ha ira, “Pipira la an iyo tinapay? Panginanoa daw niyo.”

en: And they all ate, and were filled.
war: Han kasayod na nira, ginsumatan hiya, “Lima la ka bug-os ngan duha nga isda.”

en: And they took up broken pieces, twelve basketfuls, and also of the fishes.
war: Ginsugo ni Jesus an iya mga tinun-an nga pagpurupundokon hira hin pagkalingkod dida han kabanwaan.

en: And they that ate the loaves were five thousand men.
war: Sanglit nagpurupundok an mga tawo hin tinag 100 ngan tinag 50.

en: And straightway he constrained his disciples to enter into the boat, and to go before him unto the other side to Bethsaida, while he himself sendeth the multitude away.
war: Niyan kinuha ni Jesus an lima ka bug-os nga tinapay ngan an duha nga isda, hinmangad hiya ha langit, ngan nagpasalamat sa Dyos. Ginpinitpinit niya an tinapay ngan iginhatag ha iya mga tinun-an basi igdurot ha mga tawo. Iya liwat ginbahinbahin an duha nga isda ha ira ngatanan.

en: And after he had taken leave of them, he departed into the mountain to pray.
war: Nanngaon an ngatanan ngan nagkabubusog.

en: And when even was come, the boat was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
war: Kahuman, nakatirok pa an mga tinun-an hin dose ka alat han nahisalin nga mga tinapay ngan isda.

en: And seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary unto them, about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them:
war: Lima ka yukot nga kalalaken-an an nangaon han tinapay.

en: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;
war: Samtang ginpapaoli ni Jesus an mga tawo, ginpasakay dayon niya an iya mga tinun-an basi mag-una ha iya ngadto ha Betsaida, ha tabok han lanaw.

en: for they all saw him, and were troubled. But he straightway spake with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
war: Kahuman niya manamilit han iya mga tinun-an, kinmadto hiya hin usa nga pungtod basi hiya mag-ampo.

en: And he went up unto them into the boat; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves;
war: Han pagkagab-i na, nakadto na an sakayan ha butnga han lanaw, samtang nag-uusaan la hi Jesus didto ha sagka.

en: for they understood not concerning the loaves, but their heart was hardened.
war: Nakita niya nga nagkukuri an iya mga tinun-an pagginaod kay songsong hira kaupay han hangin. Sanglit, ha mga alas tres ngadto ha alas seis na an kaagahon, kinmadto hi Jesus ha ira nga naglalakat ha bawbaw han tubig. Nakahunahuna la hiya hin paglabay ha ira.

en: And when they had crossed over, they came to the land unto Gennesaret, and moored to the shore.
war: Kundi kinmita hira nga naglalakat hiya ha bawbaw han tubig. Hunahuna nira nga murto adto, sanglit ginmoliat hira

en: And when they were come out of the boat, straightway the people knew him,
war: hin kahadlok han pakakita nira ngatanan ha iya.

en: and ran round about that whole region, and began to carry about on their beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
war: Nagyakan dayon hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok! Hi ako ini!”

en: And there are gathered together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, who had come from Jerusalem,
war: Nag-alirong kan Jesus an mga Parisiyo ngan in pira han mga magturutdo han Balaod nga nagkaabot tikang ha Jerusalem.

en: and had seen that some of his disciples ate their bread with defiled, that is, unwashen, hands.
war: Kinita nira nga nangangaon an iba han iya mga tinun-an nga mahugaw an ira mga kamot—karuyag sidngon nga waray hira manhunaw sugad han paagi nga igintutdo han mga Parisiyo nga angay buhaton han mga tawo.

en: (For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands diligently, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders;
war: Nagsusunod an mga Parisiyo, sugad man an iba nga mga Judiyo han pagturon-an nga nababatasan han ira mga kaapoy-apoyan. Diri hira nakaon kon diri anay manhunaw han amo nga paagi,

en: and when they come from the marketplace, except they bathe themselves, they eat not; and many other things there are, which they have received to hold, washings of cups, and pots, and brasen vessels.)
war: ngan diri liwat nira kinakaon an bisan ano nga tikang ha taboan kon diri anay nahuhugasan. Ngan ginsusunod nira in damo pa nga mga sugo nga ira nababatasan sugad han mga irimnan, mga lutoan, mga surudlan nga tumbaga, ngan mga higdaan.

en: And the Pharisees and the scribes ask him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with defiled hands?
war: Sanglit, nagpakiana kan Jesus an mga Parisiyo ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod, “Kay ano nga diri nagsusunod an imo mga tinun-an han pagturon-an han aton mga ginikanan, kundi nangangaon bisan kon mahugaw an ira mga kamot?”

en: And he said unto them, Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written,
war: Binaton hira ni Jesus, “Waray gud magsayop hi Isaias han iya ginpanagna mahitungod ha iyo! Mga salingkapaw kamo, sugad gud han iya iginsurat:

en: This people honoreth me with their lips,
war: ‘Nagdadayaw ha akon ha ira mga pulong ini nga mga tawo, nasiring an Dyos,

en: But their heart is far from me.
war: kundi ha pagkamatuod, hirayo ha akon an ira mga kasingkasing.

en: But in vain do they worship me,
war: Kawang la an ira pagsingba ha akon,

en: Teaching as their doctrines the precepts of men.
war: kay gintututdo nira an kanan tawo kasugoanan nga daw sugad hin kanan Dyos mga lagda!’

en: Ye leave the commandment of God, and hold fast the tradition of men.
war: “Sinasalikway niyo an sugo han Dyos ngan asay niyo gintutuman an mga pagturon-an han mga tawo.”

en: And he said unto them, Full well do ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your tradition.
war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus pagsiring ha ira, “Listo gud kamo lumikay han kanan Dyos balaod basi la igpadayon niyo an iyo kalugaringon nga pagturon-an.

en: For Moses said, Honor thy father and thy mother; and, He that speaketh evil of father or mother, let him die the death:
war: Kay hi Moises nagsugo, ‘Tahoron mo an amay ngan iroy nimo ngan kinahanglan patayon adton magpapakaraot han amay ngan iroy niya.’

en: but ye say, If a man shall say to his father or his mother, That wherewith thou mightest have been profited by me is Corban, that is to say, Given to God ;
war: Kundi nagtututdo kamo nga kon may-ada sadang ikabulig in tawo han amay ngan iroy niya, kundi kon sumiring hiya, ‘Corban ini’ (karuyag sidngon, kanan Dyos ito),

en: ye no longer suffer him to do aught for his father or his mother;
war: waray na niya labot pagbulig han amay o iroy niya.

en: making void the word of God by your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things ye do.
war: Kon sugad, gindidiwara niyo an pulong han Dyos pinaagi han pagturon-an nga igintututdo niyo ha iba nga mga tawo. Ngan ginbubuhat niyo in damo pa nga mga butang nga alid-agid hini.”

en: And he called to him the multitude again, and said unto them, Hear me all of you, and understand:
war: Gintawag ngahaw ni Jesus an kadam-an ngada ha iya ngan ginsiring hira, “Pamati kamo ngatanan ngan sabta niyo.

en: there is nothing from without the man, that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
war: Waray bisan ano nga nasulod ha tawo tikang ha gawas nga nakakapahugaw ha iya, kundi adton nagawas tikang han tawo amo lugod an nakakapahugaw ha iya. [
Sanglit, mamati an may-ada durunggan.”]

en: And when he was entered into the house from the multitude, his disciples asked of him the parable.
war: Han pagbaya na niya han kadam-an ngan pagsulod na niya han balay, nagpakiana an iya mga tinun-an ha iya mahitungod hini nga pananglitan.

en: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Perceive ye not, that whatsoever from without goeth into the man, it cannot defile him;
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Sugad la kamo han iba hin kamahinay makasabot! Diri ba kamo nasabot nga waray bisan ano nga nasulod ha tawo tikang ha gawas nga nakakapahugaw ha iya?

en: because it goeth not into his heart, but into his belly, and goeth out into the draught? This he said , making all meats clean.
war: Kay diri ito nasulod ha iya kasingkasing kundi ha iya tiyan, ngan onina, iginuguwa.” (Dida hini iginpahayag ni Jesus nga mahihimo kaonon an ngatanan nga pagkaon.)

en: And he said, That which proceedeth out of the man, that defileth the man.
war: Ngan nagpadayon hiya pagsiring, “An naguwa tikang ha tawo amo an nakakapahugaw ha iya.

en: For from within, out of the heart of men, evil thoughts proceed, fornications, thefts, murders, adulteries,
war: Kay tikang ha sakob, tikang ha kasingkasing, naguwa an magraot nga mga panhunahuna nga nakakaaghat hin panikas, pamatay,

en: covetings, wickednesses, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, railing, pride, foolishness:
war: pakighilawas, kaipa han kanan iba butang, paglimbong, kamalaw-ay, pangabugho, pakaraot, pagparayaw ngan tinuyaw nga buhat.

en: all these evil things proceed from within, and defile the man.
war: Natikang ha sakob han tawo ini ngatanan ngan amo an nakakapahugaw ha iya.”

en: And from thence he arose, and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. And he entered into a house, and would have no man know it; and he could not be hid.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus ngan kinmadto han tuna hirani han syudad han Tiro. Sinmulod hiya hin balay, ngan diri niya karuyag nga may mahibaro nga nakadto hiya; kundi diri gud hiya natatago.

en: But straightway a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
war: Nahibaroan an iya pag-abot hin usa nga babaye, kanay anak nga babayehay may maraot nga espiritu. Kinmadto dayon hiya kan Jesus ngan hinmapa ha iya tiilan.

en: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. And she besought him that he would cast forth the demon out of her daughter.
war: Langyaw ini nga babaye nga natawo ha Fenicia, didto ha Siria. Nakimalooy hiya kan Jesus nga pagawson an yawa tikang han iya anak.

en: And he said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children’s bread and cast it to the dogs.
war: Kundi nagbaton hi Jesus, “Pakaona ta anay an mga anak; diri maupay nga kuhaon an pagkaon han mga anak, ngan ilabog ngadto han mga ayam.”

en: But she answered and saith unto him, Yea, Lord; even the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs.
war: “Matuod gad ini,” binmaton an babaye, “kundi bisan an mga ayam ha sirong han lamesa ngangangaon man han mga salin han mga anak!”

en: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the demon is gone out of thy daughter.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Tungod hini nga imo baton, makakaoli ka na. Ginmawas na an yawa tikang han imo anak!”

en: And she went away unto her house, and found the child laid upon the bed, and the demon gone out.
war: Inmoli an babaye ngan hin-agian niya an iya anak nga nahigda ngan ginmawas na tikang ha iya an yawa.

en: And again he went out from the borders of Tyre, and came through Sidon unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the borders of Decapolis.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus han tuna nga hirani ha Tiro ngan inmagi ha Sidon ngadto han lanaw han Galilea, ngan naglatas han mga tuna han Decapolis.

en: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to lay his hand upon him.
war: Gindara ha iya in tawo nga bungol ngan makuri makayakan, ngan nakimalooy kan Jesus an mga nagdara nga dun-an niya ini nga tawo.

en: And he took him aside from the multitude privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spat, and touched his tongue;
war: Ibinulag hiya anay ni Jesus han kadam-an, ngan ibinutang ni Jesus an iya mga tudlo dida han kanan tawo nga talinga. Linmura hiya ngan iya kinamkam an dila han tawo.

en: and looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
war: Hinmangad hi Jesus ha langit ngan nangaraba ngan ginsiring an tawo, “ Ephphatha” , karuyag sidngon, “Mabuksan ka!”

en: And his ears were opened, and the bond of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
war: Nakabati dayon an tawo, nawara na an iya kangula, ngan maupay na an iya pagyakan.

en: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it.
war: Gindid-an hira ni Jesus pagsumat hini bisan kan kanay; kundi dinmugang lugod hira hin pagsinumat.

en: In those days, when there was again a great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them,
war: Waray pag-iha nagkatirok na liwat in kadam-an nga mga tawo. Han waray na nira pagkaon, gintawag ni Jesus an iya mga tinun-an ngan ginsiring hira,

en: I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat:
war: “Nalolooy ako hini nga mga tawo kay upod hira nakon sulod hin tulo na ka adlaw, ngan waray na nira pagkaon.

en: and if I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way; and some of them are come from far.
war: Kon paolion ko hira nga mga gutom, manhihiraptay hira ha dalan kay hirayo an oolian an iba ha ira.”

en: And his disciples answered him, Whence shall one be able to fill these men with bread here in a desert place?
war: Nagpakiana ha iya an iya mga tinun-an, “Hain man kita pakakaagi dinhe hini nga kamingawan hin igo kadamo nga pagkaon nga igdudurot hini ngatanan nga mga tawo?”

en: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
