war: “Pipira pa man an iyo tinapay?” nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira.

en: And he commandeth the multitude to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and having given thanks, he brake, and gave to his disciples, to set before them; and they set them before the multitude.
war: “Pipito na la,” binmaton hira.

en: And they had a few small fishes: and having blessed them, he commanded to set these also before them.
war: Pinapanlingkod ni Jesus ha tuna an mga tawo. Kinuha niya an pito nga tinapay ngan nagpasalamat sa Dyos. Iya ginpinitpinit an tinapay ngan ipanhatag ngadto han iya mga tinun-an basi igdurot ngadto han mga tawo. Ngan ipinanhatag ini han iya mga tinun-an.

en: And they ate, and were filled: and they took up, of broken pieces that remained over, seven baskets.
war: May-ada liwat nira pira ka bug-os nga gudtiay nga mga isda. Nagpasalamat ngahaw hi Jesus tungod hini ngan nagsugo hiya han iya mga tinun-an nga ipanhatag liwat.

en: And they were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
war: Nangaon ngan nagkabubusog an ngatanan—may mga upat ka yukot adto nga mga tawo.

en: And straightway he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
war: Gintirok han mga tinun-an an mga nanhisalin, ngan nakapuno pa hira hin pito ka alat. Pinapangoli ni Jesus an mga tawo,

en: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, trying him.
war: ngan sinmakay dayon hiya han sakayan upod an iya mga tinun-an, ngan kinmadto hira han tuna han Dalmanuta.

en: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
war: Nagkaabot in mga Parisiyo ngan nagtikang pakiglantugi kan Jesus. Karuyag nira pagbitik ha iya sanglit nangaro hira nga magbuhat hiya hin milagro nga magpapakita nga uyon ha iya an Dyos.

en: And he left them, and again entering into the boat departed to the other side.
war: Baga ginminhawa hin hilawig hi Jesus ngan nagsiring, “Kay ano nga nangangaro hin milagro an mga tawo hini nga katulinan? Diri, nasiring ako ha iyo! Waray milagro nga ipakikita hini nga mga tawo!”

en: And they forgot to take bread; and they had not in the boat with them more than one loaf.
war: Binayaan niya hira, sinmakay hiya han sakayan, ngan tinmabok han lanaw.

en: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod.
war: Nanhingalimot an mga tinun-an pagdara hin igo kadamo nga tinapay, ngan usa la ka bug-os an ira balon ha sakayan.

en: And they reasoned one with another, saying, We have no bread.
war: “Panginano ngan pagbantay kamo han patubo han mga Parisiyo ngan han patubo ni Herodes,” nagpahimangno hi Jesus ha ira.

en: And Jesus perceiving it saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? do ye not yet perceive, neither understand? have ye your heart hardened?
war: Naghirohimangraw an mga tinun-an ha ira la ngahaw: “Nasiring hiya hini kay waray man kita dara nga tinapay.”

en: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
war: Nakasabot hi Jesus han ira ginkakarokayakan, sanglit nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “Kay ano nga naghihirohimangraw man kamo mahitungod han kawaray niyo dara nga tinapay? Diri pa ba kamo maaram o nakakasabot? Makuri ba masabot ini han iyo mga hunahuna?

en: When I brake the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
war: May-ada niyo mga mata—diri ba kamo nakita? May-ada niyo mga talinga—diri ba kamo nabati? Hinngalimtan na ba niyo

en: And when the seven among the four thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces took ye up? And they say unto him, Seven.
war: an pagpinitpinit ko han lima nga mga tinapay para han lima ka yukot ngan mga tawo? Pira ka alat an natirok niyo han nanhisalin pa nga mga tinapay?”

en: And he said unto them, Do ye not yet understand?
war: “Dose,” nagbaton hira.

en: And they come unto Bethsaida. And they bring to him a blind man, and beseech him to touch him.
war: “Ngan han pagpinitpinit ko han pito nga tinapay para han upat ka yukot nga mga tawo, pira man ka alat an natirok niyo han nanhisalin pa nga mga tinapay?” nagpakiana hi Jesus.

en: And he took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village; and when he had spit on his eyes, and laid his hands upon him, he asked him, Seest thou aught?
war: “Pito,” binmaton hira.

en: And he looked up, and said, I see men; for I behold them as trees, walking.
war: “Diri la kamo gihapon nakakasabot?” nagpakiana hiya ha ira.

en: Then again he laid his hands upon his eyes; and he looked stedfastly, and was restored, and saw all things clearly.
war: Inmabot hira ha Betsaida. Gindara hin pira nga mga tawo ngadto kan Jesus in buta, ngan nakimalooy hira nga kaptan hiya ni Jesus.

en: And he sent him away to his home, saying, Do not even enter into the village.
war: Ginkaptan ni Jesus an kamot han buta ngan iya gintugwayan ngadto ha gawas han baryo. Kahuman niya pagbutangi hin laway an mga mata han tawo, gindun-an niya ngan ginpakianhan, “May nakikita mo na ba?”

en: And Jesus went forth, and his disciples, into the villages of Cæsarea Philippi: and on the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Who do men say that I am?
war: Hinmangad an tawo ngan binmaton, “Oo, nakita ako hin mga tawo, kundi sugad hira hin mga kahoy nga nagkakalakat.”

en: And they told him, saying, John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; but others, One of the prophets.
war: Idinuon liwat ni Jesus an iya mga kamot dida han mga mata han tawo. Tinmutok hin maupay an buta; nahibalik an iya pagkita, ngan klaro na gud an iya pagkita han ngatanan.

en: And he asked them, But who say ye that I am? Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
war: Ginpaoli hiya ni Jesus ngan ginsiring, “Ayaw na pagbalik ngadto ha baryo.”

en: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
war: Niyan kinmadto hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an ha mga baryo han Cesarea Filipo. Ginpakianhan niya hira dida ha dalan, “Pagsumati daw ako niyo; hin-o man kuno ako sumala han siring han mga tawo?”

en: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, and the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
war: Binmaton hira, “May nasiring nga ikaw amo hi Juan nga Parabunyag. Nasiring an iba, hi Elias ka; samtang nasiring naman an iba, usa ka han mga manaragna.”

en: And he spake the saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
war: “Hi kamo—ano man an isisiring niyo? Hin-o gud ako?” nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira.

en: But he turning about, and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and saith, Get thee behind me, Satan; for thou mindest not the things of God, but the things of men.
war: Binmaton hi Pedro, “Ikaw an Mesiyas.”

en: And he called unto him the multitude with his disciples, and said unto them, If any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
war: Ngan nagsugo hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo pagsumat bisan kan kanay mahitungod ha akon.”

en: For whosoever would save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s shall save it.
war: Niyan nagtikang hi Jesus pagtutdo han iya mga tinun-an, “Kinahanglan mag-antos an Anak han Tawo, ngan igsalikway hiya han katigurangan ngan han mga puno han kapadian ngan han mga magturutdo han Balaod. Pagpapatayon hiya, kundi mababanhaw hiya katapos hin tulo ka adlaw.”

en: For what doth it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
war: Iginsumat niya ini hin waray lipodlipod ha ira. Ibinulag anay ni Pedro hi Jesus ngan nakiglantugi ha iya.

en: For what should a man give in exchange for his life?
war: Kundi linmingi hi Jesus, sinmiplat ha iya mga tinun-an, ngan ginbusaan hi Pedro, “Iwas ha akon, Satanas! Kanan tawo la an imo panhunahuna, diri kanan Dyos!”

en: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of man also shall be ashamed of him, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
war: Ngan gintawag ni Jesus an mga tawo, pati an iya mga tinun-an, ngan ginsiring hira, “Kon hin-o an karuyag bumunyog ha akon, kinahanglan limoton niya an iya kalugaringon, magpas-an han iya kros, ngan sumunod ha akon.

en: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There are some here of them that stand by , who shall in no wise taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God come with power.
war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring ha ira, “Tigamni ini niyo: May-ada pipira dinhe nga diri pa mapatay ngada han pakakita nira han pag-abot han Ginhadian han Dyos nga puno hin gahom.”

en: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and bringeth them up into a high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them;
war: Paglabay hin unom ka adlaw, sinmagka hi Jesus hin hitaas nga bukid. Waray iba nga igin-upod niya labot kanda Pedro, Santiago ug Juan. Samtang nagkikinita hira, nabalhin an panagway ni Jesus.

en: and his garments became glistering, exceeding white, so as no fuller on earth can whiten them.
war: Nagsilaw an iya panapton ngan nagmabusag hin duro. Waray bisan hin-o dinhe ha tuna in makakapabusag hin sugad hini.

en: And there appeared unto them Elijah with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
war: Hinkit-an han tulo nga mga tinun-an nga nakikighimangraw kan Jesus hira Elias ug Moises.

en: And Peter answereth and saith to Jesus, Rabbi, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro kan Jesus, “Magturutdo, maupay nga hahani na la kita. Maghihimo kami hin tulo nga tulda: usa ha imo, usa kan Moises, ngan usa kan Elias.”

en: For he knew not what to answer; for they became sore afraid.
war: Tungod han kahadlok ni Pedro ngan han iba nga mga tinun-an, waray hira sabot han iya iginyakan.

en: And there came a cloud overshadowing them: and there came a voice out of the cloud, This is my beloved Son: hear ye him.
war: Linambongan hira hin dampog ngan hinbatian nira in tingog tikang ha dampog, “Amo ini an hinigugma ko nga Anak. Pamatii niyo hiya!”

en: And suddenly looking round about, they saw no one any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
war: Nanginano hira dayon, kundi waray nira hinkit-an nga iba labot kan Jesus nga kaupod nira.

en: And as they were coming down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, save when the Son of man should have risen again from the dead.
war: Han pagkalugsong nira han bukid nagtugon hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo pagsumat bisan kan kanay han nakita niyo ngada han kabanhaw han Anak han Tawo.”

en: And they kept the saying, questioning among themselves what the rising again from the dead should mean.
war: Gintuman nira an iya tugon, kundi naggiparopakiana hira kon ano an karuyag sidngon han pagkabanhaw han mga minatay.

en: And they asked him, saying, How is it that the scribes say that Elijah must first come?
war: Nagpakiana hira kan Jesus, “Kay ano nga nasiring an mga magturutdo han Balaod nga kinahanglan kumanhi anay hi Elias?”

en: And he said unto them, Elijah indeed cometh first, and restoreth all things: and how is it written of the Son of man, that he should suffer many things and be set at nought?
war: Binmaton hiya, “Makanhi man ngani anay hi Elias basi mag-andam han ngatanan nga mga butang. Kundi kay ano nga nasiring an Kasuratan nga mag-aantos hin duro an Anak han Tawo ngan igsasalikway?

en: But I say unto you, that Elijah is come, and they have also done unto him whatsoever they would, even as it is written of him.
war: Nasiring ako ha iyo nga kinmanhi na hi Elias, ngan ginbuhat han mga tawo an ira karuyag buhaton ha iya, sumala han iginsiring han Kasuratan mahitungod ha iya.”

en: And when they came to the disciples, they saw a great multitude about them, and scribes questioning with them.
war: Han paghitampo nira han iba nga mga tinun-an, hinkit-an nira in damo nga mga tawo. May mga magturutdo han Balaod nga nakiglantugi han mga tinun-an.

en: And straightway all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
war: Dako an paghipausa han mga tawo han pakakita nira kan Jesus, ngan nagdadlagan hira hin pagsugat ha iya.

en: And he asked them, What question ye with them?
war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus han iya mga tinun-an, “Ano ba an iyo ginkalantugian ha ira?”

en: And one of the multitude answered him, Teacher, I brought unto thee my son, who hath a dumb spirit;
war: Binmaton in usa ka tawo dida han kadam-an, “Magturutdo, gindara ko an akon anak nganhi ha imo, kay sinasangkayan hiya hin yawa, ngan diri hiya nakakayakan.

en: and wheresoever it taketh him, it dasheth him down: and he foameth, and grindeth his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast it out; and they were not able.
war: Kon tinutulos hiya, binubuntog hiya ha tuna, nagbubura an iya baba, nangingigot an iya mga ngipon, ngan natikig an bug-os niya nga lawas. Pinangaro ko han imo nga tinun-an nga pagawson an espiritu, kundi waray man hira pakahimo.”

en: And he answereth them and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I bear with you? bring him unto me.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Hin kawaray pagtoo niyo nga mga tawo! Tubtob san-o an akon pakigtampo ha iyo? Tubtob san-o an pag-ilob ko ha iyo? Dad-a ngadi ha akon an bata!”

en: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him grievously; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
war: Ngan gindara nira an bata ngadto kan Jesus.

en: And he asked his father, How long time is it since this hath come unto him? And he said, From a child.
war: Han pakakita la kan Jesus han maraot nga espiritu, ginbuntog dayon an bata. Natumba ini ha tuna ngan nagpulilid nga nagbubura an baba.

en: And oft-times it hath cast him both into the fire and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do anything, have compassion on us, and help us.
war: “Kakan-o pa masugad hiya hini?” nagpakiana hi Jesus han amay.

en: And Jesus said unto him, If thou canst! All things are possible to him that believeth.
war: “Tikang pa han iya pagkabata,” binmaton hiya.

en: Straightway the father of the child cried out, and said, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
war: “Makadamo na pag-iparataya hiya han espiritu pinaagi hin paglabogan ha iya ngadto ha kalayo ngan ha tubig. Kalooyi intawon kami ngan buligi kami kon makakahimo ka!”

en: And when Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I command thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
war: “Oo, kon ikaw ngahaw makakahimo!” nagsiring hi Jesus. “Nahihimo an ngatanan hin tawo nga may-ada pagtoo!”

en: And having cried out, and torn him much, he came out: and the boy became as one dead; insomuch that the more part said, He is dead.
war: Binmaton dayon an amay han bata, “Natoo ako, kundi kulang pa an akon pagtoo. Dugangi an akon pagtoo!”

en: But Jesus took him by the hand, and raised him up; and he arose.
war: Nakita ni Jesus nga nagtitikaharani ha ira an kadam-an, sanglit ginsugo niya an maraot nga espiritu, “Nakakapabungol ngan nakakapangula nga espiritu, nagsusugo ako ha imo, gumawas ka tikang han bata ngan ayaw na gud pagsulod ha iya!”

en: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, How is it that we could not cast it out?
war: Ginmoliat an espiritu, ginbuntog an bata, ngan ginmawas an espiritu. Daw patay na an bata, sanglit nagsiring an ngatanan, “Patay na hiya!”

en: And he said unto them, This kind can come out by nothing, save by prayer.
war: Kundi kinaptan ni Jesus an kamot han bata ngan ginbangon hiya, ngan tinmindog an bata.

en: And they went forth from thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
war: Pagsulod ni Jesus han balay, ginhilit hiya hin pagpakianhi han iya mga tinun-an, “Kay ano nga waray kami makapaguwa han espiritu?”

en: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered up into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and when he is killed, after three days he shall rise again.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Makakapagawas kamo hin sugad nga espiritu pinaagi la hin pag-ampo, waray na iba.”

en: But they understood not the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
war: Binmaya hira hadto nga dapit ngan naglatas ha Galilea. Diri karuyag ni Jesus nga may mahibaro kon hain hiya,

en: And they came to Capernaum: and when he was in the house he asked them, What were ye reasoning on the way?
war: kay nagtututdo hiya han iya mga tinun-an. Nagsiring hiya, “Igtutubyan an Anak han Tawo ngadto han mga tawo nga magpapatay ha iya, kundi mababanhaw hiya katapos hin tulo ka adlaw.”

en: But they held their peace: for they had disputed one with another on the way, who was the greatest.
war: Waray hira makasabot hini nga igintutdo niya, kundi nahadlok hira hin pagpakiana ha iya.

en: And he sat down, and called the twelve; and he saith unto them, If any man would be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.
war: Inmabot hira ha Capernaum. Pagsulod nira han balay nagpakiana hi Jesus han iya mga tinun-an, “Ano an ginkalantugian niyo dida ha dalan?”

en: And he took a little child, and set him in the midst of them: and taking him in his arms, he said unto them,
war: Kundi waray hira mag-aringasa, kay ginkalantugian nira kon hin-o ha ira an gilalabawi.

en: Whosoever shall receive one of such little children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever receiveth me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
war: Linmingkod hi Jesus, gintawag niya an dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Kon hin-o an karuyag magin syahan, kinahanglan magpaorhe hiya han ngatanan ngan magin surugoon han ngatanan.

en: John said unto him, Teacher, we saw one casting out demons in thy name; and we forbade him, because he followed not us.
war: Kinmuha hiya hin gutiay nga bata ngan ginpatukdaw ha atubangan nira. Inagbayan niya an bata ngan nagsiring ha ira.

en: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man who shall do a mighty work in my name, and be able quickly to speak evil of me.
war: An bisan hin-o nga nakarawat han sugad hini nga gutiay nga bata ha akon ngaran nakarawat ha akon, ngan an bisan hin-o nga nakarawat ha akon nakarawat diri la ha akon, kundi han nagsugo liwat ha akon.”

en: For he that is not against us is for us.
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Juan, “Magturutdo, hinkit-an namon in tawo nga nagpapagawas hin mga yawa ha imo ngaran. Ginsaway namon hiya kay diri man hiya kaupod naton.”

en: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink, because ye are Christ’s, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus, “Ayaw niyo pagdid-i hiya. Kay waray nagbubuhat hin milagro ha akon ngaran nga onina magpapakaraot ha akon.

en: And whosoever shall cause one of these little ones that believe on me to stumble, it were better for him if a great millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
war: Kay naugop ha aton an diri nasupak ha aton.

en: And if thy hand cause thee to stumble, cut it off: it is good for thee to enter into life maimed, rather than having thy two hands to go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.
war: Tigamni niyo ini: An magpainom ha iyo hin tubig tungod kay akon kamo, waray ruhaduha, makarawat hiya han iya balos.
“Kon in usa ka tawo matinikangan hin kawad-i hin pagtoo ha akon hini nga gutiay nga kabataan, maupay pa nga higtan hiya hin bato ha liog ngan tunuron hiya ha dagat.

en: And if thy foot cause thee to stumble, cut it off: it is good for thee to enter into life halt, rather than having thy two feet to be cast into hell.
war: Sanglit kon an imo kamot an maginhinungdan han imo diri pagtoo ha akon, gabay nimo utdon ito. Maupay pa nga makadto ka ha langit nga pungkol kay nga sangkap ka hin duha nga kamot ngan mahulog ka ha impyerno, ngadto han diri napaparong nga kalayo. (
Diri napatay an ira mga ulod didto, ngan diri napaparong an kalayo.)

en: And if thine eye cause thee to stumble, cast it out: it is good for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell;
war: Kon an imo mga tiil an maginhinungdan han imo diri pagtoo ha akon, gabay nimo utdon ito! Maupay pa nga makadto ka ha langit nga utod an usa nimo nga tiil kay nga sangkap ka hin duha nga mga tiil ngan ilabog ha impyerno. (

en: where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
war: Diri napatay an ira mga ulod didto, ngan diri napaparong an kalayo.)

en: For every one shall be salted with fire.
war: Ngan kon an imo mga mata an maginhinungdan han imo diri pagtoo ha akon, gabay nimo lukaton ito! Maupay pa nga masulod ka ha ginhadian han Dyos nga usa la an mata kay nga sangkap ka hin duha nga mga mata ngan ilabog ha impyerno.

en: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost its saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace one with another.
war: Diri napatay an ira mga ulod didto, ngan diri napaparong an kalayo.

en: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the borders of Judæa and beyond the Jordan: and multitudes come together unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus hadto nga dapit, kinmadto ha tuna han Judea, ngan tinmabok han Salog han Jordan. Kinmadto ngan nag-alirong ha iya in damo nga mga tawo, ngan gintutdoan niya hira sugad han iya nababatasan.

en: And there came unto him Pharisees, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? trying him.
war: Hinmarani ha iya in mga Parisiyo ngan nagtalingoha hin pagbitik ha iya. Nagpakiana hira, “Itinutugot ba han aton Balaod an pakigbulag han lalake han iya asawa?”

en: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Ano an sugo ni Moises ha iyo?”

en: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
war: Binmaton hira, “Tinmugot hi Moises nga mabaya an lalake han iya asawa pinaagi hin pagsurat ha pagpasabot nga mabulag hiya.”

en: But Jesus said unto them, For your hardness of heart he wrote you this commandment.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Iginsurat ini nga sugo tungod ha iyo kay makuri man kamo pagtutdoan.

en: But from the beginning of the creation, Male and female made he them.
war: Kundi tikang ha tinikangan han paghimoa han kalibutan, daan na iginsiring, ‘Naghimo ha ira an Dyos nga lalake ngan babaye.

en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife;
war: Tungod hini mabaya an lalake han amay ug iroy niya ngan makikigtampo han iya asawa.

en: and the two shall become one flesh: so that they are no more two, but one flesh.
war: Ngan an duha mauusa na la.’ Sanglit diri na hira duduha, kundi uusa na la.

en: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
war: Kinahanglan diri pagbulagon hin tawo an gin-usa han Dyos.”

en: And in the house the disciples asked him again of this matter.
war: Han pagbalik nira ngadto han balay, nagpakiana an mga tinun-an kan Jesus mahitungod hini nga mga butang.

en: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her:
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “An lalake nga mabulag han iya asawa ngan mangasawa hin iba nga babaye, nakakasala hin panlibog kontra han iya asawa.

en: and if she herself shall put away her husband, and marry another, she committeth adultery.
war: Ha amo man nga paagi, an babaye nga mabulag han iya bana ngan pumaasawa hin iba nga lalake, nakakasala hin panlibog liwat.”

en: And they were bringing unto him little children, that he should touch them: and the disciples rebuked them.
war: May nagdara hin kabataan ngadto kan Jesus basi agbayan ini hira niya, kundi ginsaway han mga tinun-an adto nga mga tawo.

en: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me; forbid them not: for to such belongeth the kingdom of God.
war: Han pakakita ni Jesus hini, nasina hiya ngan nagsiring ha iya mga tinun-an, “Pabay-i niyo nga dumaop ha akon an kabataan! Ayaw niyo pagdid-i hira, kay sugad ha ira la an makakaangkon han Ginhadian han Dyos.

en: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall in no wise enter therein.
war: Tigamni ini niyo: an bisan hin-o nga diri nakarawat han Ginhadian han Dyos sugad hin gutiay nga bata, diri gud makakasulod ngadto.”

en: And he took them in his arms, and blessed them, laying his hands upon them.
war: Ngan ginkugos ni Jesus an kabataan, gin-agbayan niya, ngan ginbendisyonan niya hira.

en: And as he was going forth into the way, there ran one to him, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
war: Han tilakat na hi Jesus, may tawo nga nagdalagan tipakadto ha iya, linmuhod ha iya atubangan ngan nagpakiana, “Maupay nga Magturutdo, ano an kinahanglan ko buhaton basi makarawat ko an kinabuhi nga dayon?”

en: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good save one, even God.
war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus, “Kay ano nga tinatawag mo ako nga maupay? Waray iba nga maupay kundi an Dyos la.

en: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not kill, Do not commit adultery, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Do not defraud, Honor thy father and mother.
war: Maaram ka man han mga sugo: ‘Diri ka magpatay; diri ka manlibog; tumahod ka han amay ug iroy nimo.’”

en: And he said unto him, Teacher, all these things have I observed from my youth.
war: Binmaton an tawo, “Magturutdo, gintuman ko ini ngatanan nga mga sugo tikang pa han akon kabata.”

en: And Jesus looking upon him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
war: Tinutokan hiya ni Jesus inopdan hin gugma ngan ginsiring, “Usa na la nga butang an kinahanglan mo. Kadto na, igbaligya an ngatanan nga imo hiagi, ngan ipanhatag an kwarta ha mga pobre, ngan magkakamay-ada ka mga bahandi ha langit. Katapos, balik ngan sunod ha akon.”

en: But his countenance fell at the saying, and he went away sorrowful: for he was one that had great possessions.
war: Nagmasulob-on an nawong han tawo han pakabati niya hini, ngan linmakat hiya nga mabidoon, kay riko hiya hin duro.

en: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
war: Sinmiplat hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Makuri gud para han mga riko hin pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos!”

en: And the disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
war: Nanhipausa an mga tinun-an hini nga mga pulong. Kundi nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring, “Mga anak ko, makuri gud an pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos!

en: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
war: Masarusayon pa para hin kamelyo hin pagsuhot ha taranogan hin dagom kay hin riko hin pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos.”

en: And they were astonished exceedingly, saying unto him, Then who can be saved?
war: Dinmugang hin paghipausa an mga tinun-an, sanglit may hin pakiana ha ira, “Hin-o man ngay-an an matatalwas?”

en: Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for all things are possible with God.
war: Tinutokan hira hin maupay ni Jesus ngan binmaton, “Diri ini nahihimo hin tawo, kundi diri ini makuri para han Dyos. Nahihimo han Dyos an ngatanan nga mga butang.”

en: Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
war: Niyan nagyakan hi Pedro, “Kitaa, ginbayaan namon an ngatanan, ngan sinmunod kami ha imo.”

en: Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or mother, or father, or children, or lands, for my sake, and for the gospel’s sake,
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Nasiring ako ha iyo, bisan hin-o nga nabaya hin balay o kabugtoan, iroy, amay, mga anak, o mga uma, tungod ha akon ngan han Maupay nga Sumat,

en: but he shall receive a hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
war: makarawat hiya hin labaw pa kadamo nga balos dinhe hini nga kinabuhi. Makarawat hiya hin kapin usa ka gatos ka pilo nga mga balay, kabugtoan, mga iroy, mga anak, ngan mga uma—ngan upod manliwat in mga pagtimaraot. Ngan makarawat hiya han kinabuhi nga dayon ha umarabot nga panahon.

en: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
war: Kundi damo an mga nahiuna yana nga mauorhe, ngan damo an mga naorhe yana nga mauuna.”

en: And they were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going before them: and they were amazed; and they that followed were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were to happen unto him,
war: Nakada na hira ha dalan nga tipasagka ngadto ha Jerusalem. Nag-una hi Jesus han mga tinun-an nga pinagungulba ngan ginsusunod liwat han mga tawo nga puno hin kahadlok. Iginlain na liwat ni Jesus an dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan naghimangraw han mga butang nga mahinanabo ha iya.

en: saying , Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests and the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him unto the Gentiles:
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Pamati, makadto kita yana ha Jerusalem. Igtutubyan an Anak han Tawo ngadto han mga puno han kapadian ngan mga magturutdo han Balaod. Paghuhukman hiya nira nga patayon ngan igtutubyan ha mga Hentil.

en: and they shall mock him, and shall spit upon him, and shall scourge him, and shall kill him; and after three days he shall rise again.
war: Pagbibiaybiayon hiya nira, paglulud-an, paglalatobon ngan pagpapatayon, ngan mababanhaw hiya katapos hin tulo ka adlaw.”

en: And there come near unto him James and John, the sons of Zebedee, saying unto him, Teacher, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall ask of thee.
war: Hinmarani kan Jesus hira Santiago ug Juan nga mga anak ni Sebedeo, ngan naghangyo, “Magturutdo, may-ada namon hinahangyo ha imo.”

en: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
war: “Ano an karuyag niyo nga buhaton ko ha iyo?” nagpakiana hi Jesus.

en: And they said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and one on thy left hand, in thy glory.
war: Binmaton hira, “Kon lumingkod ka na ha imo trono didto han imo harangdon nga Ginhadian, tugoti kami hin paglingkod upod ha imo, usa ha tuo ngan usa ha wala.”

en: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink the cup that I drink? or to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
war: “Diri kamo maaram han pinangangaro niyo,” nagbaton hi Jesus. “Makakainom ba kamo han kupa nga kinahanglan imnon ko? Makakagpabunyag ba kamo sugad han paagi nga kinahanglan ibunyag ha akon?”

en: And they said unto him, We are able. And Jesus said unto them, The cup that I drink ye shall drink; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
war: “Oo, makakahimo kami,” binmaton hira.

en: but to sit on my right hand or on my left hand is not mine to give; but it is for them for whom it hath been prepared.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Mainom gudman kamo han kinahanglan imnon ko, ngan pagbubunyagan kamo sugad han paagi nga kinahanglan ibunyag ha akon.

en: And when the ten heard it, they began to be moved with indignation concerning James and John.
war: Kundi waray ako katungod hin pagpili han malingkod ha akon tuo ngan ha akon wala. An Dyos la an mahatag hini nga mga lingkoran ngadto han iya gin-aandaman hito nga mga lingkoran.”

en: And Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they who are accounted to rule over the Gentiles lord it over them; and their great ones exercise authority over them.
war: Han pakabati la hini han napulo nga mga tinun-an, nagkasisina hira kanda Santiago ug Juan.

en: But it is not so among you: but whosoever would become great among you, shall be your minister;
war: Sanglit gintawag hira ngatanan ni Jesus ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Maaram kamo nga may gahom ha mga tawo an kinikilala nga mga punoan han mga Hentil, ngan naghahadi ha ira an ira mga pangulo.

en: and whosoever would be first among you, shall be servant of all.
war: Kundi diri ini amo an angay ha iyo. Kon may-ada ha iyo karuyag magin gamhanan, kinahanglan magin surugoon hiya han iba.

en: For the Son of man also came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
war: Ngan kon may-ada ha iyo karuyag magin syahan, kinahanglan magin oripon hiya han ngatanan.

en: And they come to Jericho: and as he went out from Jericho, with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timæus, Bartimæus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the way side.
war: Kay bisan ngani an Anak han Tawo waray kumanhi hin pagpasirbe, kundi kinmanhi hiya hin pagsirbe ngan hin paghatag han iya kinabuhi hin pagtubos hin damo nga mga tawo.”

en: And when he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.
war: Inmabot hi Jesus ha Jerico upod an iya mga tinun-an ngan hin damo nga mga tawo. Han nagtitigawas na hira han bungto, may buta nga ginngangaranan kan Bartimeo, anak ni Timeo, nga nalingkod hin pakilimos didto ha ligid han dalan.

en: And many rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried out the more a great deal, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.
war: Han paghibaro niya nga hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret an nalabay, ginmoliat hiya, “Jesus, Anak ni David, kalooyi gad ako!”

en: And Jesus stood still, and said, Call ye him. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good cheer: rise, he calleth thee.
war: Ginsaway hiya hin damo nga mga tawo ngan ginpahilom hiya. Kundi dinmugang lugod hiya hin paggoliat, “Anak ni David, kalooyi gad ako!”

en: And he, casting away his garment, sprang up, and came to Jesus.
war: Inmukoy hi Jesus ngan iginpatawag hiya.

en: And Jesus answered him, and said, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? And the blind man said unto him, Rabboni, that I may receive my sight.
war: Sanglit gintawag nira an buta. “Paglipay!” nagsiring hira. “Buhat, ginpapakadto ka niya.”

en: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And straightway he received his sight, and followed him in the way.
war: Ilinabog niya an iya kurugpos, binmuhat hin tigda, ngan kinmadto kan Jesus.

en: And when they draw nigh unto Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth two of his disciples,
war: Han hirani na hira ha Jerusalem; ngan han pag-abot nira ha mga bungto han Betfage ug Betania, kinmadto hira ha Bukid han mga Olibo. Ginpauna ni Jesus in duha han iya mga tinun-an

en: and saith unto them, Go your way into the village that is over against you: and straightway as ye enter into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon no man ever yet sat; loose him, and bring him.
war: upod ini nga mga tugon: “Kadto kamo ha baryo nga inaatubang niyo, ngan ha pag-abot niyo didto, hiaagian niyo in hinigot nga nati nga asno nga waray pa sakyi. Hubara ngan dad-a niyo nganhi.

en: And if any one say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye, The Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him back hither.
war: Kon may magpakiana ha iyo, ‘Kay ano nga ginbubuhat ini niyo,’ sidnga niyo, ‘Ginkikinahanglan ini han Ginoo, ngan ibabalik ini dayon nganhi.’”

en: And they went away, and found a colt tied at the door without in the open street; and they loose him.
war: Linmakat hira ngan nakaagi dida ha dalan hin nati nga asno nga ihinihigot ha porta hin balay. Han ginhuhubad na nira an hayop,

en: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
war: nagpakiana ha ira in mga tawo nga nagkakatukdaw didto, “Kay ano nga ginhuhubaran niyo an nati?”

en: And they said unto them even as Jesus had said: and they let them go.
war: Ginbaton nira sumala han tugon ha ira ni Jesus, ngan gintugotan hira han mga tawo.

en: And they bring the colt unto Jesus, and cast on him their garments; and he sat upon him.
war: Gindara nira ngadto kan Jesus an nati nga asno, ngan ginhapinan han ira mga kurugpos an hayop, ngan sinmakay hi Jesus.

en: And many spread their garments upon the way; and others branches, which they had cut from the fields.
war: Nagbitad han ira mga kurugpos dida ha dalan in damo nga mga tawo; nangutod an iba hin mga dahonan nga sanga ngan iginkatag ha dalan.

en: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
war: Naggoliat an mga tawo nga naguuna ngan an mga nasunod ha iya, “Dayawon an Dyos! Dayawon han Dyos hiya nga nakanhi ha ngaran han Ginoo!

en: Blessed is the kingdom that cometh, the kingdom of our father David: Hosanna in the highest.
war: Bendisyonan han Dyos an tiarabot nga Ginhadian ni David nga aton amay! Dayawon an Dyos!”

en: And he entered into Jerusalem, into the temple; and when he had looked round about upon all things, it being now eventide, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
war: Inmabot hi Jesus ha Jerusalem ngan sinmulod hiya ha Templo. Katapos niya manginano han ngatanan nga mga butang didto, ginmawas hiya ngadto ha Betania upod an dose nga mga tinun-an kay tikagab-i na.

en: And on the morrow, when they were come out from Bethany, he hungered.
war: Han pagkabuwas, samtang nabalik na hira tikang ha Betania, ginutom hi Jesus.

en: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find anything thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for it was not the season of figs.
war: Hinkit-an niya ha antaw in marampag nga kahoy nga igos, ngan ginkadto niya panginano kon may-ada ba bunga. Han pag-abot niya didto, mga dahon la an iya nakita, kay diri pa man panahon hin panmunga.

en: And he answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit from thee henceforward for ever. And his disciples heard it.
war: Ginsiring niya an kahoy, “Waray na gud makakakaon han imo bunga!”

en: And they come to Jerusalem: and he entered into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and them that bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money-changers, and the seats of them that sold the doves;
war: Ngan hinbatian ini han iya mga tinun-an.

en: and he would not suffer that any man should carry a vessel through the temple.
war: Han pag-abot nira ha Jerusalem, sinmulod hi Jesus han Templo ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtabog han ngatanan nga namamalit ngan nagbabaligya didto ha Templo. Pinamalintong niya an mga lamesa han mga magbaralyo hin kwarta ngan an mga bangkilyo han mga magbaraligya hin sarapati.

en: And he taught, and said unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called a house of prayer for all the nations? but ye have made it a den of robbers.
war: Waray hiya tumugot nga sumulod ha ruwang han Templo an hin-o man nga nagdadara hin bisan ano.

en: And the chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, for all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.
war: Gintutdoan niya an mga tawo, “Nahisurat ha Kasuratan nga nagsiring an Dyos, ‘Tatawgon an akon balay nga balay hin pag-ampo han ngatanan nga mga tawo.’ Kundi ginhimo niyo nga tagoan hin mga tikasan!”

en: And every evening he went forth out of the city.
war: Nakabati hini an mga puno han kapadian ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod, sanglit namiling hira hin paagi hin pagiparatay kan Jesus. Nahalok hira ha iya, kay nahitingala gud an ngatanan nga mga tawo han iya pagturon-an.

en: And as they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
war: Han pagkagab-i na, ginmawas han syudad hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an.

en: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Rabbi, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
war: Timprano pa han aga han sunod nga adlaw, samtang naglalakat hira ha dalan, nakita nira nga patay na an kahoy nga igos upod an iya mga gamot.

en: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
war: Nahinumdom hi Pedro han nahinabo ngan nagsiring hiya kan Jesus, “Magturutdo, kitaa daw! Patay na an kahoy nga imo ginpanhimaraot!”

en: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou taken up and cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that what he saith cometh to pass; he shall have it.
war: Binmaton ha ira hi Jesus, “Tigamni niyo ini: kon may pagtoo kamo han Dyos,

en: Therefore I say unto you, All things whatsoever ye pray and ask for, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
war: makakasiring kamo ngada hini nga bukid, ‘Mabalhin ka, ngan mapatinhulog ini ngadto ha dagat!’ Kon diri kamo magruhaduha, kundi sumarig gud nga mahinanabo an ginsiring niyo, tutumanon ito tungod ha iyo.

en: And whensoever ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have aught against any one; that your Father also who is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
war: Tungod hini nasiring ako ha iyo, ‘Bisan ano an pangaroon niyo dida ha pag-ampo, tuohi nga nakarawat na niyo, ngan tatagan kamo han bisan ano nga pangaroon niyo.
Ngan kon mag-ampo kamo, pasayloa anay niyo an bisan hin-o nga nakasala ha iyo, basi magpasaylo man han iyo mga sala an Amay niyo ha langit. (

en: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders;
war: Kon diri kamo magpasaylo, diri man liwat magpapasaylo han iyo mga sala an Amay niyo ha langit.’”)

en: and they said unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? or who gave thee this authority to do these things?
war: Binmalik ngahaw hira ngadto ha Jerusalem. Samtang naglalakat hi Jesus didto ha Templo, hinmarani ha iya an mga puno han kapadian, an mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan an katigurangan han mga tawo,

en: And Jesus said unto them, I will ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
war: ngan nagpakiana ha iya, “Ano an imo katungod hin pagbuhat hini nga mga butang? Hin-o an naghatag ha imo hini nga katungod hin pagbuhat?”

en: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men? answer me.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Mapakiana ako ha iyo hin makausa gud la, ngan kon makabaton kamo, pagsusumatan ko kamo han akon katungod hin pagbuhat hini nga mga butang.

en: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
war: Sumati ako, diin man tikang an katungod ni Juan hin pagbunyag: sa Dyos ba o ha mga tawo la?”

en: But should we say, From men—they feared the people: for all verily held John to be a prophet.
war: Ngan nagtikang hira hin paggilarolantugi, “Ano man an ibabaton ta? Kon sumiring kita, ‘Tikang sa Dyos!’ masiring hiya, ‘kay ano man nga waray kamo tumoo ha iya?’

en: And they answered Jesus and say, We know not. And Jesus saith unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
war: Kundi kon magsiring kita, ‘Tikang ha mga tawo…’” (Nahadlok hira han mga tawo kay natoo gud an ngatanan nga matuod nga manaragna hi Juan.)

en: And he began to speak unto them in parables. A man planted a vineyard, and set a hedge about it, and digged a pit for the winepress, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into another country.
war: Ngan naghimangraw hi Jesus ha ira pinaagi hin mga pananglitan: “May-ada hadto tawo nga nag-uma hin ubas. Gin-alad niya ini nga uma, gin-ukaban para hin molino hin pagpii hin ubas, ngan gintindogan hin hitaas nga lantawan. Ginpaagsahan ini niya hin mga saop, ngan linmakat hiya ngadto hin hirayo nga dapit.

en: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruits of the vineyard.
war: Han pag-abot na han panahon hin panguha han ubas, ginpakadto niya han mga saop in usa nga oripon hin pagkuha han iya bahin.

en: And they took him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
war: Kundi gindakop ngan ginbalbag han mga saop an oripon, ngan ginpaoli nga waray dara.

en: And again he sent unto them another servant; and him they wounded in the head, and handled shamefully.
war: Ngan nagsugo an tag-iya hin lain nga oripon, kundi ginbalbag hiya ha ulo, ngan gipakaalohan pa han mga saop.

en: And he sent another; and him they killed: and many others; beating some, and killing some.
war: Nagsugo an tag-iya hin lain pa nga oripon, ngan ginpatay hiya nira. Amo gihapon an ginbuhat nira han iba pa nga mga oripon nga ginpadara han tag-iya; may ha ira ginbalbag, ngan may ginpatay.

en: He had yet one, a beloved son: he sent him last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
war: An pinaura nga anak han tag-iya amo na la an nahibilin nga angay masugo. Sanglit ha kataposan, ginpakadto niya han mga saop an iya anak, kay naghunahuna hiya nga tatahoron gud nira.

en: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
war: Kundi nagsarabot an mga saop ngan nagsiring, ‘Amo ini an anak han tag-iya. Tana, pataya ta hiya, basi maaton an uma!’

en: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him forth out of the vineyard.
war: Sanglit gindakop nira an anak, ginpatay, ngan ginlabog ha gawas han urubasan.

en: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
war: “Niyan, ano man an bubuhaton han tag-iya han uma?” nagpakiana hi Jesus. “Makadto hiya ngan pamamatayon adto nga mga tawo, ngan itatapod niya an uma ha iba nga mga saop.

en: Have ye not read even this scripture:
war: Waray ba niyo mabasa ini nga kasuratan?

en: The stone which the builders rejected,
war: ‘An bato nga ginsalikway

en: The same was made the head of the corner;
war: han mga magtirindog nga waray gamit,

en: This was from the Lord,
war: amo lugod an importante kaupay nga bato.

en: And it is marvellous in our eyes?
war: Ginbuhat ini han Ginoo;

en: And they sought to lay hold on him; and they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spake the parable against them: and they left him, and went away.
war: pagkaorosahon gud hini nga buhat!’”

en: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, that they might catch him in talk.
war: Nagtinguha pagdakop kan Jesus an mga pangulo han mga Judiyo, kay nakasabot hira nga hira an gintatadong hini nga pananglitan. Kundi, tungod han kahadlok nira han kadam-an, ginpabay-an na la hiya ngan nagkalakat hira.

en: And when they were come, they say unto him, Teacher, we know that thou art true, and carest not for any one; for thou regardest not the person of men, but of a truth teachest the way of God: Is it lawful to give tribute unto Cæsar, or not?
war: May ginsugo nga mga Parisiyo ngan mga sakop ni Herodes hin pagkadto kan Jesus hin pagbitik ha iya pinaagi hin mga pakiana.

en: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why make ye trial of me? bring me a denarius, that I may see it.
war: Dinmaop hira ha iya ngan nagsiring, “Magturutdo, maaram kami nga tangkod ka hin pagtutdo han kamatuoran. Diri ka nagtatagad han ginhuhunahuna han mga tawo, kay waray mo pinalabi ha ira. Kundi nagtututdo ka la han kamaturoan mahitungod han kaburot-on han Dyos para han tawo. Sumati daw kami: supak ba ha aton Balaod an pagbayad hin buhis ngadto han Emperador han Roma? Mabayad ba kami o diri?”

en: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Cæsar’s.
war: Kundi hinsabtan ni Jesus an ira tuyo hin pagbitik ha iya, ngan binmaton hiya, “Kay ano nga ginbibitik ako niyo? Ikadi in usa nga kwarta nga salapi ngan pakitaa ako.”

en: And Jesus said unto them, Render unto Cæsar the things that are Cæsar’s, and unto God the things that are God’s. And they marvelled greatly at him.
war: Gindad-an hiya nira hin usa ka salapi, ngan nagpakiana hi Jesus, “Kanay ini bayhon ngan ngaran nga napapatik dida hini nga kwarta?”

en: And there come unto him Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
war: “Kanan Emperador,” binmaton hira.

en: Teacher, Moses wrote unto us, If a man’s brother die, and leave a wife behind him, and leave no child, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kon amo ito, ihatag ha Emperador an kanan Emperador, ngan ihatag man sa Dyos an kanan Dyos.”

en: There were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed;
war: Ngan duro gud an paghipausa nira ha iya.

en: and the second took her, and died, leaving no seed behind him; and the third likewise:
war: May mga Sadusiyo nga dinmaop kan Jesus. (Amo ini hira an nasiring nga waray pagkabanhaw.)

en: and the seven left no seed. Last of all the woman also died.
war: Nagsiring hira, “Magturutdo, nagsurat hi Moises hini nga balaod tungod ha amon: ‘Kon mamatay in bana nga waray anak, kinahanglan asawahon han iya manghod an nabalo nga babaye, basi hira manganak ha ngaran han namatay.’

en: In the resurrection whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
war: Niyan, may-ada hadto pito nga magburugto nga kalalaken-an. Nangasawa an gimamagurangi, kundi namatay hiya nga waray anak.

en: Jesus said unto them, Is it not for this cause that ye err, that ye know not the scriptures, nor the power of God?
war: Pinangasawa han sunod niya nga manghod an nabalo, kundi namatay liwat ini nga manghod nga waray anak gihapon. Amo liwat an nahinabo han ikatulo nga bugto,

en: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as angels in heaven.
war: ngan han ngatanan nga kabugtoan. Nakaasawa hadto nga usa nga babaye an pito nga magburugto, ngan nagkamatay nga waray anak. Ha kataposan namatay man an babaye.

en: But as touching the dead, that they are raised; have ye not read in the book of Moses, in the place concerning the Bush, how God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
war: Niyan, ha adlaw han pagkabanhaw, kon buhi na liwat hira ngatanan, hin-o man ha ira an magigin asawa hadto nga babaye, kay nakaasawa man hira ngatanan ha iya?”

en: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living: ye do greatly err.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Pagkasayop niyo! Maaram ba kamo kay ano? Tungod kay waray kamo makasabot han Kasuratan o han gahom han Dyos.

en: And one of the scribes came, and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, What commandment is the first of all?
war: Waray na pangasawa ha panahon han pagkabanhaw, kay masusugad na han mga anghel ha langit an mga tawo.

en: Jesus answered, The first is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God, the Lord is one:
war: Niyan, mahitungod han pagkabanhaw: waray ba niyo mabasa ha basahan ni Moises an bahin mahitungod han naglalaga nga tanom? Iginsurat didto nga nagsiring an Dyos kan Moises, ‘Amo ako an Dyos ni Abraham, Dyos ni Isaac, ngan an Dyos ni Jacob.’

en: and thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength.
war: Karuyag sidngon hini nga amo hiya an Dyos han mga buhi, diri han mga minatay. Pagkasayop gud niyo!”

en: The second is this, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
war: Nakadto in magturutdo han Balaod nga nakabati han ira hirohimangraw. Nakita niya nga maupay an kabaton ni Jesus han mga Sadusiyo, sanglit dinmaop hiya hin pagpakiana, “Ano nga sugo an gidadakoi han ngatanan?”

en: And the scribe said unto him, Of a truth, Teacher, thou hast well said that he is one; and there is none other but he:
war: Ngan nagbaton hi Jesus, “Amo ini an gidadakoi han ngatanan: ‘Pamati, Israel! An Ginoo nga aton Dyos amo gud la hiya an Ginoo.

en: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is much more than all whole burnt-offerings and sacrifices.
war: Kinahanglan higugmaon mo an Ginoo nga imo Dyos ha bug-os mo nga kasingkasing, ha bug-os mo nga kalag, ha bug-os mo nga kusog.’

en: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
war: Ngan amo ini an sunod nga gidadakoi: ‘Kinahanglan higugmaon mo an imo igkasi-tawo sugad ha imo ngahaw.’ Waray na iba nga sugo nga malabaw hini nga duha.”

en: And Jesus answered and said, as he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that the Christ is the son of David?
war: Nagsiring kan Jesus an magturutdo han Balaod, “Maupay nga imo kaasoy, Magturutdo. Matuod gud, sumala han imo siring, nga an Ginoo gud la an Dyos, ngan waray na iba labot ha iya.

en: David himself said in the Holy Spirit,
war: Sanglit kinahanglan humigugma han Dyos an tawo ha bug-os niya nga kasingkasing, ha bug-os niya nga hunahuna, ngan ha bug-os niya nga kusog, ngan kinahanglan humigugma hiya han iya igkasi-tawo sugad ha iya kalugaringon. Labaw hin kamapulsanon an pagtuman hini nga duha nga mga sugo kay hin paghalad hin mga hayop ngan hin iba nga mga halad ngadto sa Dyos dida ha altar.”

en: The Lord said unto my Lord,
war: Nasabtan ni Jesus an kamaupay han iya baton, sanglit ginsiring ini hiya niya, “Diri ka na hirayo han Ginhadian han Dyos.”

en: Sit thou on my right hand,
war: Katapos hini waray na may nagpasipara hin pagpakiana kan Jesus.

en: Till I make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet.
war: Samtang nagtututdo hi Jesus didto ha Templo, nagpakiana hiya, “Ano hin pakasiring han mga magturutdo han Balaod nga tulin ni David an Mesiyas?

en: David himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
war: Gin-aghat hi David han Espiritu Santo hin pagsiring:

en: And in his teaching he said, Beware of the scribes, who desire to walk in long robes, and to have salutations in the marketplaces,
war: ‘Nagsiring an Ginoo ngadto han akon Ginoo:

en: and chief seats in the synagogues, and chief places at feasts:
war: Lingkod dinhe ha akon tuo,

en: they that devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers; these shall receive greater condemnation.
war: tubtob nga mahibutang ko an imo mga kaaway ha ilarom han imo mga tiil.’

en: And he sat down over against the treasury, and beheld how the multitude cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
war: Nagtawag ha iya nga ‘Ginoo’ hi David ngahaw; sanglit uunanhon man nga magin tulin ni David an Mesiyas?”

en: And there came a poor widow, and she cast in two mites, which make a farthing.
war: Namati kan Jesus nga malipayon an kadam-an nga mga tawo.

en: And he called unto him his disciples, and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, This poor widow cast in more than all they that are casting into the treasury:
war: Samtang nagtututdo hiya ha ira, nagsiring hiya, “Pag-ikmat kamo han mga magturutdo han Balaod nga karuyag magsudoysudoy nga higlawig an ira mga bado, ngan karuyag nga yukboan hira hin pagtahod didto ha taboan.

en: And as he went forth out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Teacher, behold, what manner of stones and what manner of buildings!
war: Han nagawas na hi Jesus han Templo, nagsiring an usa han iya mga tinun-an, “Tan-awa, Magturutdo, pagkamaupay pagkit-on hini nga kabalayan ngan mga bato!”

en: And Jesus said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left here one stone upon another, which shall not be thrown down.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Nakikita niyo ini nga dagko nga mga balay? Waray dinhe usa nga bato nga mahibibilin dida han hinmumutangan niya. Titimpagon ini ngatanan.”

en: And as he sat on the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
war: Nalingkod hi Jesus didto ha Bukid han mga Olibo, nga tugbang han Templo, nga daopon hiya hin hilit nira Pedro, Santiago, Juan ug Andres,

en: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when these things are all about to be accomplished?
war: ngan sidngon hiya, “Sumati kamo kon san-o ini mahinanabo, ngan sumati kami kon ano an tigaman nga magpapahibaro ha amon han panahon nga mahinanabo ini ngatanan nga mga butang.”

en: And Jesus began to say unto them, Take heed that no man lead you astray.
war: Nagtikang pagtutdo ha ira hi Jesus: “Pagbantay kamo basi diri kamo mauwat hin tawo.

en: Many shall come in my name, saying, I am he ; and shall lead many astray.
war: Kay maabot ha akon ngaran in damo nga mga tawo nga masiring; ‘Ako amo an Mesiyas!’ ngan malilimbongan in damo nga mga tawo.

en: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumors of wars, be not troubled: these things must needs come to pass; but the end is not yet.
war: Ngan ayaw kamo kalisang kon makabati kamo hin aringasa hin mga araway ha hirani o mga sumat hin mga araway ha kahigrayoan. Kinahanglan mahinabo in sugad nga mga butang, kundi diri karuyag sidngon nga inmabot na an kataposan.

en: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; there shall be earthquakes in divers places; there shall be famines: these things are the beginning of travail.
war: Mag-aaruaraway an mga nasod, ngan magpapadurodasmag an mga ginhadian. Magkakaada mga linog ha magkalainlain nga mga dapit, ngan magkakaada kagutom. Sugad ini nga mga butang han syahan nga mga kakurian hin pag-anak.

en: But take ye heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in synagogues shall ye be beaten; and before governors and kings shall ye stand for my sake, for a testimony unto them.
war: “Kinahanglan magbantay kamo ngahaw, kay pagdadakpon kamo han mga tawo ngan pagdadad-on kamo ha hukmanan. Paglalatobon kamo nira ha mga sinagoga. Matindog kamo ha atubangan han mga pangulo ngan kahadian tungod ha akon ngaran, pagsumat ha ira han Maupay nga Sumat.

en: And the gospel must first be preached unto all the nations.
war: Kinahanglan igsangyaw anay an Maupay nga Sumat ha ngatanan nga katawhan.

en: And when they lead you to judgment , and deliver you up, be not anxious beforehand what ye shall speak: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye; for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Spirit.
war: Ngan kon dakpon ngan dad-on na kamo ha hukmanan, ayaw kamo kabaraka kon ano an iyo igyayakan. Igyakan niyo kon ano an igpapayakan ha iyo hito nga takna, kay diri iyo kalugaringon an iyo ighihimangraw, kundi tikang han Espiritu Santo.

en: And brother shall deliver up brother to death, and the father his child; and children shall rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
war: Itutubyan han mga tawo pagpapatay an ira kalugaringon nga kabugtoan, ngan amo man an bubuhaton han mga amay ha ira mga anak. Maato han ira mga kag-anak an mga anak ngan ipapapatay hira.

en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved.
war: Pagdudumtan kamo han ngatanan tungod ha akon, kundi matatalwas adton makaantos hini ngatanan tubtob ha kataposan.

en: But when ye see the abomination of desolation standing where he ought not (let him that readeth understand), then let them that are in Judæa flee unto the mountains:
war: “Makikita niyo nga natindog an “Makaharadlok nga Taran-awon” ha dapit nga diri angay ha iya. (Ngadto han magbabasa: sabta an karuyag sidngon hini!) Kon mahinabo na ini, kinahanglan kumalagiw dayon ngadto ha kabukiran an aada ha Judea.

en: and let him that is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house:
war: Diri na maglangan an aadto ha atop han iya balay hin paglusad ngan pagkuha pa hin bisan ano tikang ha sakob ha iya balay.

en: and let him that is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
war: Sugad man an aadto ha uma diri na gud umoli hin pagkuha han iya kurugpos.

en: But woe unto them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days!
war: Kamakaharadlok hadto nga mga adlaw para han mga burod ngan han mga iroy nga may mga minasus-an!

en: And pray ye that it be not in the winter.
war: Pag-ampo kamo sa Dyos nga diri unta mahinabo ini nga mga butang ha panahon hin kathagkot!

en: For those days shall be tribulation, such as there hath not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never shall be.
war: Kay an kagul-anan hadto nga mga adlaw malabaw pa gud hin kamapait kay hin bisan ano nga hinabo ha kalibutan, tikang pa han paghimoa han Dyos han kalibutan ngada yana. Waray na mahinanabo nga malabaw pa hini hin kamapait.

en: And except the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the elect’s sake, whom he chose, he shortened the days.
war: Kundi ginpahalipot han Ginoo ito nga panahon; kay kon diri pa, waray gud mabubuhi. Tungod han iya mga pinili, ginpahilipot niya ito nga panahon.

en: And then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is the Christ; or, Lo, there; believe it not:
war: “Kon may magsiring ha iyo, ‘Kitaa, iini na an Mesiyas!’ o ‘Tan-awa, aadto hiya!’ ayaw gud kamo tuod ha iya.

en: for there shall arise false Christs and false prophets, and shall show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, the elect.
war: Kay maabot in buwaon nga mga Mesiyas ngan buwaon nga mga manaragna. Magpapakita hira hin mga tigaman ngan mga orosahon hin paglimbong, kon mahihimo, bisan pa han mga pinili han Dyos.

en: But take ye heed: behold, I have told you all things beforehand.
war: Daan ko kamo ginsusumatan hini; sanglit pagbantay gud kamo.

en: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
war: “Katapos hadto nga panahon hin kakurian, magmamasirom an adlaw, ngan diri na masanag an bulan.

en: and the stars shall be falling from heaven, and the powers that are in the heavens shall be shaken.
war: Magkakataktak an kabiton-an ha langit, ngan masimang han ira dalan an mga kagamhanan ha kalangitan.

en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
war: Ngan mapakita an Anak han Tawo tikang ha mga dampog, inupdan hin dako nga gahom ngan himaya.

en: And then shall he send forth the angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
war: Susugoon niya an mga anghel ngadto ha ngatanan nga mga sidsid han tuna hin pagtirok han mga pinili han Dyos tikang ha usa ngadto ha luyo nga sidsid han kalibutan.

en: Now from the fig tree learn her parable: when her branch is now become tender, and putteth forth its leaves, ye know that the summer is nigh;
war: “Pag-aram kamo tikang han kahoy nga igos. Kon lapyo pa an iya mga sanga ngan magtikang na an panaringsing, maaram kamo nga hiraniay na an kathuraw.

en: even so ye also, when ye see these things coming to pass, know ye that he is nigh, even at the doors.
war: Ha amo nga kaagi, kon makita na niyo nga mahinanabo na ini nga mga butang, masabot kamo nga hiraniay na an iya pag-abot; ngan maabot na gud.

en: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, until all these things be accomplished.
war: Tigamni ini: mahinanabo ini nga mga butang nga diri pa mauubos hin pagkamatay an mga tawo nga buhi yana.

en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
war: Magpapapas pa an langit ngan an tuna, kundi magpapabilin gud an akon mga pulong.

en: But of that day or that hour knoweth no one, not even the angels in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
war: “Kundi waray maaram kon san-o maabot ito nga adlaw o takna—bisan an mga anghel ha langit, o bisan an Anak; an Amay la an maaram hini.

en: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
war: Pagbantay ngan pag-ikmat kamo kay diri kamo maaram kon san-o ini mahinanabo.

en: It is as when a man, sojourning in another country, having left his house, and given authority to his servants, to each one his work, commanded also the porter to watch.
war: Sugad ini hin tawo nga binmaya han iya panimalay ngan linmakat ha kahigrayoan. Igintapod niya an pagdumara han iya panimalay ha iya mga surugoon, an tagsa ha iya kalugaringon nga buruhaton; ngan gintugon niya an bantay han portahan nga dayuday mag-ikmat hiya.

en: Watch therefore: for ye know not when the lord of the house cometh, whether at even, or at midnight, or at cockcrowing, or in the morning;
war: Sanglit pagbantay man kamo kay diri kamo maaram kon san-o aabot an agaron han balay—kon ha kagab-ihon o ha katutnga ba, kon ha panugaok han manok o ha kaagahon na ba.

en: lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
war: Kon umabot hiya hin tigda, kinahanglan diri kamo hiabotan nga nangangaturog.

en: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
war: Sanglit kon ano an igsisiring ko ha iyo, igsisiring ko liwat ha ngatanan: pagbantay kamo!”

en: Now after two days was the feast of the passover and the unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him with subtlety, and kill him:
war: Duha na la ka adlaw san-o an Pyesta han Pagbalay ngan han Waray Patubo nga Tinapay. Nagpangita hin paagi an mga puno han kapadian ngan an magturutdo han Balaod hin pagdakop kan Jesus ngan pagpatay ha iya.

en: for they said, Not during the feast, lest haply there shall be a tumult of the people.
war: Nagsiring hira, “Kinahanglan diri ta ini buhaton ha panahon han pyesta kay bangin maribok an mga tawo.”

en: And while he was in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster cruse of ointment of pure nard very costly; and she brake the cruse, and poured it over his head.
war: Nakadto hi Jesus ha Betania, ha balay ni Simon nga sanlahon. Samtang nakaon hiya, sinmulod in babaye nga may dara nga tibod nga alabastro, nga puno hin labi ka mahal nga pahamot, nga hinimo tikang hin puraw nga nardo. Ginbuong niya an tibod, ngan gin-ipis niya an sulod ngada han ulo ni Jesus.

en: But there were some that had indignation among themselves, saying , To what purpose hath this waste of the ointment been made?
war: Nasina an iba nga mga tawo nga nakadto, ngan may hin siring ha ira, “Kay ano nga ginkaragan man an pahamot?

en: For this ointment might have been sold for above three hundred shillings, and given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
war: Mababaligya unta ito hin kapin P600.00 ngan an kwarta ihatag ngadto han mga kablas.” Ngan ginsusnan gud nira an babaye.

en: But Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus, “Pabay-i niyo hiya. Kay ano nga ginsasamok hiya niyo? Ginbuhat niya ha akon in makaruruyag ngan mahusay nga butang.

en: For ye have the poor always with you, and whensoever ye will ye can do them good: but me ye have not always.
war: Dayuday, magigin kaupod niyo an mga kablas, ngan makakabulig kamo ha ira bisan san-o nga karuyag niyo hin pagbulig. Kundi diri dayuday ako magigin kaupod niyo.

en: She hath done what she could; she hath anointed my body beforehand for the burying.
war: Ginbuhat niya an iya sadang mahimo: ginhirogan niya nga daan hin pahamot an akon lawas, pag-una hin pag-andam han paglubong ha akon.

en: And verily I say unto you, Wheresoever the gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, that also which this woman hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
war: Yana tigamni ini: bisan diin igwali an Maupay nga Sumat ha bug-os nga kalibutan, hinnanabihan liwat an nabuhat hini nga babaye, usa nga hinumdoman ha iya.”

en: And Judas Iscariot, he that was one of the twelve, went away unto the chief priests, that he might deliver him unto them.
war: Ngan kinmadto han mga puno han kapadian ni Judas Iscariote, usa han dose nga mga tinun-an, pagtubyan kan Jesus ha ira.

en: And they, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently deliver him unto them .
war: Duro an ira kalipay han pakabati nira han iya iginsiring, ngan nagsaad hira hin paghatag ha iya hin kwarta. Sanglit nagtikang hi Judas pangita hin maupay nga higayon hin paglingo kan Jesus.

en: And on the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the passover, his disciples say unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and make ready that thou mayest eat the passover?
war: Ha syahan nga adlaw han Pyesta han Waray Patubo nga Tinapay, ha adlaw han pag-ihaw han mga nati nga karnero, nagpakiana an mga tinun-an kan Jesus, “Ngain mo kami pakakadtoa para hin pag-andam han imo panihapon han Paglabay?”

en: And he sendeth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him;
war: Ngan ginsugo ni Jesus in duha ha ira, upod ini nga mga tugon: “Pakadto kamo ha syudad, ngan matapo ha iyo in tawo nga nakakadara hin tibod hin tubig.

en: and wheresoever he shall enter in, say to the master of the house, The Teacher saith, Where is my guest-chamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
war: Sunda hiya ngadto han balay nga iya susudlan, ngan sidnga an tagbalay: ‘Napakiana an Magturutdo kon hain an iya ruwang nga kakaonan niya ngan han iya mga tinun-an han panihapon han paglabay?’

en: And he will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready: and there make ready for us.
war: Ngan ipakikita niya ha iyo in dako nga ruwang ha igbaw, nga inayad ngan hinusay na; andama didto an mga butang para ha aton.”

en: And the disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
war: Nagkalakat an mga tinun-an ngadto ha syudad, ngan nakita nira an ngatanan sugad gud han iginsiring ha ira ni Jesus; ngan gin-andam nira an panihapon han Paglabay.

en: And when it was evening he cometh with the twelve.
war: Han pagkagab-i na, inmabot hi Jesus, upod an iya dose nga mga tinun-an.

en: And as they sat and were eating, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you shall betray me, even he that eateth with me.
war: Samtang nangangaon hira ha lamesa, nagsiring hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo hini: maglilingo ha akon in usa ha iyo—usa nga kasaro ko yana.”

en: They began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I?
war: Nabido an mga tinun-an ngan an tagsatagsa may hin pakiana ha iya, “Ako ba?”

en: And he said unto them, It is one of the twelve, he that dippeth with me in the dish.
war: Ngan binmaton hi Jesus, “Usa hiya ha iyo nga dose, an madungan ha akon hin pagtunlob han iya tinapay dida ha plato.

en: For the Son of man goeth, even as it is written of him: but woe unto that man through whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had not been born.
war: Mapatay an Anak han Tawo sumala han siring han Kasuratan; kundi kamakaharadlok para han tawo nga maglilingo han Anak han Tawo! Mauruupay pa kon waray na la hiya matawo!”

en: And as they were eating, he took bread, and when he had blessed, he brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take ye: this is my body.
war: Samtang nangangaon hira kinmuha hi Jesus hin tinapay, nagpasalamat, ginpinitpinit niya, ngan iginhatag niya ha iya mga tinun-an upod an pagsiring, “Kaon kamo; amo ini an akon lawas.”

en: And he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them: and they all drank of it.
war: Ngan kinuha niya an irimnan, nagpasalamat hiya sa Dyos, ihinatag ha ira, ngan nanginom hira ngatanan.

en: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Amo ini an akon dugo ngan gin-ipis tungod han kadam-an, an akon dugo nga nagpapadig-on han ginsaaran han Dyos.

en: Verily I say unto you, I shall no more drink of the fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
war: Susumatan ko kamo: diri na gud ako mainom hini nga bino tubtob han adlaw han akon pag-inom han bag-o nga bino didto han Ginhadian han Dyos.”

en: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out unto the mount of Olives.
war: Ngan nagkanta hira hin usa nga imno ngan napasingadto hira ha Bukid han mga Olibo.

en: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered abroad.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Mapalagiw kamo ngatanan, ngan babayaan ako niyo, kay nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Papatayon han Dyos an magmarangno, ngan magsasarang an mga karnero.’

en: Howbeit, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.
war: Kundi mag-uuna ako ha iyo ngadto ha Galilea kon mabanhaw na ako.”

en: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
war: Binmaton hi Pedro, “Diri gud ako mabulag ha imo, bisan kon bumaya hira ngatanan ha imo.”

en: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, that thou to-day, even this night, before the cock crow twice, shalt deny me thrice.
war: “Tigamni ini!” nagsiring hi Jesus kan Pedro. “Diri pa matugaok an manok makaduha yana nga gab-i, iglilirong mo na ako hin makatulo.”

en: But he spake exceeding vehemently, If I must die with thee, I will not deny thee. And in like manner also said they all.
war: Ngan gindig-onan gud ni Pedro an iya pagbaton, “Diri gud ako maglilirong ha imo bisan pa ako patayon upod ha imo!”

en: And they come unto a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith unto his disciples, Sit ye here, while I pray.
war: Ngan amo man an siring han iba nga mga tinun-an.

en: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be greatly amazed, and sore troubled.
war: Inmabot hira ha dapit nga ginngangaranan nga Getsemane, ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Pagkalingkod kamo dinhe samtang mag-aampo ako.”

en: And he saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful even unto death: abide ye here, and watch.
war: Ngan igin-upod niya hira Pedro, Santiago ug Juan, ngan inalpan hiya hin dako nga kasakit ngan kabido.

en: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Haros ikamatay inin akon duro nga kabidoan. Pabilin kamo dinhe ngan pagbantay.”

en: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; remove this cup from me: howbeit not what I will, but what thou wilt.
war: Linmakat hiya ha uruunhan ngan hinmapa ha tuna ngan nag-ampo nga kon mahimo, palabyon unta ini nga takna hin pag-antos.

en: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest thou not watch one hour?
war: Ngan nag-ampo hiya, “Amay ko, nahihimo mo an ngatanan; kuhaa gad ini nga irimnon ha akon. Kundi an imo kaburot-on an matuman, diri an akon.”

en: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
war: Ngan binmalik hiya ngan hin-agian niya nga nangangaturog na an tulo nga mga tinun-an. Nagsiring hiya kan Pedro, “Simon, nakaturog ka ba? Diri ka ba makakailob hin pag-agma bisan la usa ka oras?”

en: And again he went away, and prayed, saying the same words.
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Pagbantay kamo ngan pag-ampo, basi diri kamo masulay. Andam an espiritu, kundi maluya an lawas.”

en: And again he came, and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they knew not what to answer him.
war: Ngan kinmadto na liwat hiya pag-ampo hin amo gihapon nga mga pulong.

en: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough; the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
war: Katapos, binmalik hiya ha iya mga tinun-an, ngan hin-abtan niya nga nangangaturog na liwat, kay mabug-at na gud an ira mga mata. Ngan waray hira sabot kon ano an ira igbabaton ha iya.

en: Arise, let us be going: behold, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
war: Ha ikatulo niya nga pagbalik, nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Nangangaturog ngan namamahuway pa ba kamo? Igo na ito! Inmabot na an takna! Kitaa, igtutubyan na yana an Anak han Tawo ngadto ha gahom han mga makasasala.

en: And straightway, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
war: Buhat, tana kalakat kita; kitaa, iini na an maglilingo ha akon!”

en: Now he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
war: Samtang nagyayakan pa hi Jesus, inmabot ni Judas nga usa han dose nga mga tinun-an. Upod niya in kadam-an nga may mga espada ngan mga balbag, mga sinugo han mga puno han kapadian, han mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan han mga katigurangan.

en: And when he was come, straightway he came to him, and saith, Rabbi; and kissed him.
war: Gintagan hira han malingo hin tigaman nga nasiring, “Kon hin-o an akon hadkan, amo hiya an ginbibiling niyo. Dakpa niyo hiya ngan bantayi gud hin maupay.”

en: And they laid hands on him, and took him.
war: Han pag-abot manggud ni Judas, dinmaop hiya dayon kan Jesus, ngan nagsiring, “Magturutdo!” ngan hadkan niya.

en: But a certain one of them that stood by drew his sword, and smote the servant of the high priest, and struck off his ear.
war: Sanglit gindakop ngan gintalo nira hi Jesus.

en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a robber, with swords and staves to seize me?
war: Kundi, hinmulbot han iya espada in usa han mga nakada ha hirani, ngan gintigbas niya an oripon han Labaw nga Padi, ngan napalong an talinga.

en: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but this is done that the scriptures might be fulfilled.
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Kinmanhi ba kamo dara in mga espada ngan mga balbag hin pagdakop ha akon nga daw sugad nga ako usa nga tikasan?

en: And they all left him, and fled.
war: Ikinaadlaw kaupod ako niyo, nagtutdo ako didto ha Templo, kay ano nga waray man ako pagdakpa niyo? Kundi kinahanglan matuman an Kasuratan.”

en: And a certain young man followed with him, having a linen cloth cast about him, over his naked body : and they lay hold on him;
war: Nangalagiw an ngatanan nga mga tinun-an, ngan binayaan nira hi Jesus.

en: but he left the linen cloth, and fled naked.
war: May nagsisinunod kan Jesus nga ulitawohay nga nakakurugpos hin busag nga panapton, ngan gin-idarakop liwat hiya nira.

en: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and there come together with him all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
war: Kundi binul-iwan na la niya an iya kurugpos ngan pinmalagiw hiya nga lubas.

en: And Peter had followed him afar off, even within, into the court of the high priest; and he was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire .
war: Ngan gindara nira hi Jesus ngadto han balay han Labaw nga Padi, diin nagkatirok an mga puno han kapadian, an katigurangan, ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod.

en: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found it not.
