war: Inmantaw hi Pedro hin pagsunod kan Jesus ngan sinmulod hiya ha bungsaran han balay han Labaw nga Padi. Didto linmingkod hiya tampo han mga bantay, ngan nagdangdang ha iya ngahaw hirani han kalayo.

en: For many bare false witness against him, and their witness agreed not together.
war: An mga puno han kapadian ngan an bug-os nga Labaw nga Hukmanan nagtalinguha hin pagpangita hin sumbong supak kan Jesus basi patayon hiya, kundi waray gud nira hin-agian.

en: And there stood up certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
war: Nagsumat hin mga buwa supak kan Jesus in damo nga mga saksi, kundi waray pagkauroyon an ira mga sumbong.

en: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.
war: Ngan tinmindog in pira ka tawo ngan nagsumat hini nga buwa supak kan Jesus.

en: And not even so did their witness agree together.
war: “Hinbatian namon hiya nga nagsiring, ‘Gugub-on ko ini nga Templo nga hinimo hin tawo, ngan sulod hin tulo ka adlaw, titindogon ko in usa nga diri hinimo hin mga tawo.’”

en: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
war: Kundi bisan ngani hira waray gihapon magkauroyon han ira mga sumat.

en: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and saith unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
war: Ngan tinmindog an Labaw nga Padi ha atubangan nira ngatanan ngan nagpakiana kan Jesus, “Waray ka ba sadang ibaton han mga sumbong nga ira gindara supak ha imo?”

en: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of heaven.
war: Kundi hinmilom la hi Jesus ngan waray gud magyakan hin bisan usa ka pulong. Nagpakiana na liwat kan Jesus an Labaw nga Padi, “Amo ka ba an Mesiyas nga Anak han Mahimayaon nga Dyos?”

en: And the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What further need have we of witnesses?
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Amo ako, ngan makikita niyo ngatanan an Anak han Tawo nga malingkod ha tuo han Makagarahum nga Dyos, ngan maabot hiya nga aada ha mga dampog han langit.”

en: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be worthy of death.
war: Ngan gin-gisi han Labaw nga Padi an iya panapton ngan sinmiring, “Diri na kita kinahanglan hin ano pa nga saksi!

en: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the officers received him with blows of their hands.
war: Hinbatian na niyo an iya mga pagpanamastamas han Dyos. Ano na man an iyo sadang ighukom ha iya?”

en: And as Peter was beneath in the court, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest;
war: Ngan nagkauroyon hira ngatanan hin paghukom nga salaan hiya, ngan kinahanglan patayon hiya.

en: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and saith, Thou also wast with the Nazarene, even Jesus.
war: Ngan nagtikang hin pagtupra kan Jesus an iba ha ira. Gintahoban nira an iya mga mata ngan pagsuntokon, ngan sidngon, “Tigoha kon hin-o an nagsuntok ha imo!” Ngan gindaop hiya han mga bantay ngan gintampalo hiya.

en: But he denied, saying, I neither know, nor understand what thou sayest: and he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
war: Nakadto pa hi Pedro ha bungsaran han pag-abot han usa han mga surugoon nga babaye han Labaw nga Padi.

en: And the maid saw him, and began again to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
war: Han pakakita niya kan Pedro nga nagdadangdang ha kalayo, gintutokan niya ngan ginsiring, “Kaupod ka liwat ni Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.”

en: But he again denied it. And after a little while again they that stood by said to Peter, Of a truth thou art one of them; for thou art a Galilæan.
war: Kundi naglirong hi Pedro, “Ambot, diri ako nasabot han imo ginyayakan,” ngan ginmawas hiya ngadto ha may aragian. Ha gilayon may tinmugaok nga manok.

en: But he began to curse, and to swear, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
war: Han paghikit-i ha iya didto han surugoon nga babaye, ginsumatan an mga tawo nga nakada, “Kausa ini hiya nira!”

en: And straightway the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word, how that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
war: Ngan naglirong liwat hi Pedro.

en: And straightway in the morning the chief priests with the elders and scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.
war: Han timprano pa han aga, nagdagmit pakigkita an mga puno han kapadian, han katigurangan, han mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan han bug-os nga Labaw nga Hukmanan, ngan nagsarabot hira. Ginggapos nira hi Jesus, gindara nira ha gawas, ngan igintubyan hiya ngadto kan Pilato.

en: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering saith unto him, Thou sayest.
war: Nagpakiana hi Pilato ha iya, “Amo ka ba an hadi han mga Judiyo?”

en: And the chief priests accused him of many things.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Imo ito ginyakan.”

en: And Pilate again asked him, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they accuse thee of.
war: Nagpasaka hin damo nga mga sumbong an mga puno han kapadian.

en: But Jesus no more answered anything; insomuch that Pilate marvelled.
war: Sanglit nagpakiana liwat hi Pilato kan Jesus, “Waray ka ba ibabaton? Kadamo hini nga mga sumbong nira kontra ha imo!”

en: Now at the feast he used to release unto them one prisoner, whom they asked of him.
war: Kundi waray gud magyakan hi Jesus; sanglit nahipausa hi Pilato.

en: And there was one called Barabbas, lying bound with them that had made insurrection, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
war: Ha kada Pyesta han Paglabay nababatasan ni Pilato hin pagbuhi hin priso nga ungaraon han mga tawo.

en: And the multitude went up and began to ask him to do as he was wont to do unto them.
war: Ngan hadto nga panahon may nabilanggo nga lalake nga Barabas an ngaran. Kaupod ini hiya han mga inmato han kagamhanan, nga nanmatay ha panahon han karibok.

en: And Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
war: Han katirok na han mga tawo ngan pagtikang nira hin paghangyo kan Pilato nga buhaton na niya para ha ira an iya nababatasan,

en: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.
war: nagpakiana hi Pilato ha ira, “Karuyag ba niyo nga buhian ko para ha iyo an hadi han mga Judiyo?”

en: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
war: Nasantop niya nga tungod la han ira kaawa, igintubyan hi Jesus ha iya han mga puno han kapadian.

en: And Pilate again answered and said unto them, What then shall I do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
war: Kundi gin-aghat han mga puno han kapadian an mga tawo nga asay nira pabuhian kan Pilato hi Barabas.

en: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
war: Sanglit nagpakiana liwat hi Pilato ha mga tawo, “Ano man an bubuhaton ko han tawo nga iyo gintatawag nga hadi han mga Judiyo?”

en: And Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out exceedingly, Crucify him.
war: Nanggogliat hira hin pagbaton, “Igraysang hiya ha kros!”

en: And Pilate, wishing to content the multitude, released unto them Barabbas, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
war: “Kundi, ano nga sala an iya nabuhat?” nagpakiana hi Pilato.

en: And the soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Prætorium; and they call together the whole band.
war: Dinmuggang la hira paggoliat, “Igraysang hiya ha kros!”

en: And they clothe him with purple, and platting a crown of thorns, they put it on him;
war: Tungod nga karuyag man ni Pilato paglipay han kadam-an, ginbuhian niya tungod ha ira hi Barabas, ngan katapos niya ipalatob hi Jesus, igintubyan hiya ha mga tawo basi igraysang ha kros.

en: and they began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
war: Gindara hi Jesus han mga sondalo ngadto ha bungsaran han palasyo han gobernador, ngan gintirok nira an iba pa nga hugpo han mga sondalo.

en: And they smote his head with a reed, and spat upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
war: Ginsul-otan nira hi Jesus hin pula nga bado. Naghimo hira hin korona tikang hin tunokon nga mga sanga, ngan iginbutang ha iya ulo.

en: And when they had mocked him, they took off from him the purple, and put on him his garments. And they lead him out to crucify him.
war: Ngan nagtikang hira hin pagyuroyukbo ngan pagsiring ha iya: “Mabuhi an Hadi han mga Judiyo!”

en: And they compel one passing by, Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them , that he might bear his cross.
war: Ginbalbag hiya ha ulo, gintuprahan hiya, ginluhodluhoran ngan ginyuroyukboan pa hiya nira.

en: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
war: Katapos nira pagduyagi kan Jesus, ginlubasan hiya nira han pula nga bado ngan ginbalik nira hin pagsul-ot an iya kalugaringon nga bado. Ngan iginggawas hiya basi igraysang ha kros.

en: And they offered him wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
war: Ginkasugat nira ha dalan in tawo nga Simon an ngaran, nga tikang pa la ha huron, ngan ginpirit nira hin pagpas-an han kros ni Jesus. (Amo ini an Simon nga taga-Cirene, nga amay nira Alejandro ug Rufo.)

en: And they crucify him, and part his garments among them, casting lots upon them, what each should take.
war: Gindara nira hi Jesus ngadto hin dapit nga Golgota an ngaran, nga “An Dapit han Klabera” an kahulogan.

en: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
war: Gintalinguha nira hin paghatag ha iya hin bino nga sinaktan hin mira, kundi waray uminom hi Jesus.

en: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
war: Sanglit iginraysang hiya ha kros, ngan ginbahinbahin nira an iya mga panapton pinaagi hin ripa, basi masabtan kon hin-o ha ira an makakadara han ginbahin nga bado.

en: And with him they crucify two robbers; one on his right hand, and one on his left.
war: Alas nuybe na han aga nga igraysang hiya ha kros.
Iginpaskin an sumbong ha iya nga nasiring, “An Hadi han mga Judiyo.”

en: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ha! thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
war: Iginraysang liwat nira upod kan Jesus in duha nga mga tikasan, an usa ha iya tuo ngan an usa ha iya wala. [

en: save thyself, and come down from the cross.
war: Tungod hini natuman an Kasuratan nga nasiring, “Nahiupod hiya han mga salaan.”]

en: In like manner also the chief priests mocking him among themselves with the scribes said, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
war: Ginyubitan hi Jesus han mga lumalabay nga nagpipilingpiling ngadto ha iya ngan nasiring “Aha! gugub-on mo an Templo, ngan titindogon mo liwat sakob hin tulo la ka adlaw!

en: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reproached him.
war: Lusad na yana ha imo kros ngan talwasa an imo kalugaringon.”

en: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
war: Ha amo nga paagi ginbiaybiay liwat hiya han mga puno han kapadian ngan han mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan may hin siring ha ira, “Nagtalwas hiya han iba, kundi diri nakakatalwas ha iya ngahaw.

en: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
war: Kitaa ta kon malusad ha kros an Mesiyas, an hadi han Israel, ngan matuo kita ha iya.”

en: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elijah.
war: Ngan nagyubit liwat kan Jesus bisan an duha nga iginraysang kaupod niya.

en: And one ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let be; let us see whether Elijah cometh to take him down.
war: Han pagkaudto na nagsirom an bug-os nga tuna sulod hin tulo ka oras.

en: And Jesus uttered a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
war: Han pagka alas tres ginmoliat hi Jesus, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani,” kon ha aton pa, “Dyos ko, Dyos ko, kay ano nga ginbaya-an mo ako?”

en: And the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top to the bottom.
war: Nakabati an iba nga nakada ha hirani ngan nagsiring, “Pamati daw, nagtatawag hiya kan Elias!”

en: And when the centurion, who stood by over against him, saw that he so gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
war: Nagdalagan in usa ha ira nga may dara nga espongha, ginhumog hin maaslom nga bino, igintaod ha kataposan hin kahoy, ngan idinuhol kan Jesus. Nagsiring hiya, “Hulat, kitaa daw naton kon umabot manggud hi Elias hin pagtanggal ha iya ha kros.”

en: And there were also women beholding from afar: among whom were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
war: Upod in dako nga goliat, namatay hi Jesus.

en: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him; and many other women that came up with him unto Jerusalem.
war: Ngan napikas an biray han Templo tikang ha igbaw ngadto ha ubos.

en: And when even was now come, because it was the Preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
war: Kinmita an kapitan han mga sondalo nga natindog ha atubangan han kros, han kamatay ni Jesus. Nagsiring hiya, “Matuod gudman nga ini nga tawo amo an Anak han Dyos!”

en: there came Joseph of Arimathæa, a councillor of honorable estate, who also himself was looking for the kingdom of God; and he boldly went in unto Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus.
war: May nakadto nga kababayen-an nga nagkikinita tikang ha hirayo. Kaupod nira hira Maria Magdalena, Maria nga iroy han barobata nga Santiago ngan ni Jose, ug Salome.

en: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
war: Nagsunodsunod hira kan Jesus ngan binmulig ha iya han nakadto pa hiya ha Galilea. Damo liwat didto in kababayen-an nga inmupod kan Jesus ngadto ha Jerusalem.

en: And when he learned it of the centurion, he granted the corpse to Joseph.
war: 42-43 Tipagsisirom na han pag-abot ni Jose nga taga-Arimatea. Tinahod hiya nga kaapi han Labaw nga Hukmanan, nga naghuhulat han pag-abot han Ginhadian han Dyos. Adlaw han Pagpangandam adto (karuyag sidngon, bisperas san-o han Adlaw nga Iparahuway); sanglit nanlimbasog hi Jose hin pakigkita kan Pilato ngan pag-aro han lawas ni Jesus.

en: And he bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been hewn out of a rock; and he rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
war: Nahipausa hi Pilato han iya pakabati nga patay na hi Jesus. Ginpatawag niya an kapitan han mga sondalo, ngan nagpakiana ha iya kon maiha na ba nga namatay hi Jesus.

en: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
war: Pakabati niya han sumat han kapitan, itinugot ni Pilato kan Jose hin pagkuha han lawas ni Jesus.

en: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
war: Paglabay han Adlaw nga Iparahuway, nanmalit hin mga pahamot hira Maria Magdalena, Maria nga iroy ni Santiago, ug Salome, basi igbanyos nira han lawas ni Jesus.

en: And very early on the first day of the week, they come to the tomb when the sun was risen.
war: Timprano pa gud han Domingo, ha pagsidlit pa la han adlaw, napakadto hira ha lubnganan.

en: And they were saying among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the tomb?
war: Han dida pa hira ha dalan, may hin pakiana ha ira, “Hin-o man in magwawaring para ha aton han bato nga sada ha lubnganan?”

en: and looking up, they see that the stone is rolled back: for it was exceeding great.
war: (Kay dako hin duro adto nga bato.) Han pagsiplat nira, ira nakita nga winaring na an bato.

en: And entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, arrayed in a white robe; and they were amazed.
war: Sanglit sinmulod hira ha lubnganan, diin ira nakita in olitawohay nga mabusag an bado, nga nalingkod ha may tuo; ngan inalpan hira hin kakulba.

en: And he saith unto them, Be not amazed: ye seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who hath been crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold, the place where they laid him!
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok; maaram ako nga nagbibiling kamo kan Jesus nga taga-Nazaret, nga iginraysang ha kros. Waray hiya dinhe kay nabanhaw na hiya! Kitaa, amo ini an dapit nga ginhayaran ha iya.

en: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, He goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
war: Kadto na, ngan igsumat niyo ini ha iya mga tinun-an, ngan kan Pedro: ‘Mag-uuna hiya ha iyo ngadto ha Galilea; didto makita kamo ha iya sumala han iginsiring niya ha iyo.’”

en: And they went out, and fled from the tomb; for trembling and astonishment had come upon them: and they said nothing to any one; for they were afraid.
war: Sanglit nagkaguwa ngan nagdadlagan hira tikang ha lubnganan, kay inalpan hira hin kahadlok ngan kakulba. Ngan tungod han ira kahadlok, waray hira pagsumat bisan kan kanay.

en: Now when he was risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
She went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
war: Katapos mabanhaw hi Jesus, ha aga pa han Domingo, nagpakita hiya syahan kan Maria Magdalena nga ginpagawasan niya hin pito nga mga yawa.

en: And they, when they heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, disbelieved.
war: Linmakat hiya ngan nagsumat han mga tinun-an ni Jesus. Mga masulob-on ngan mabidoon hira;

en: And after these things he was manifested in another form unto two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.
war: ngan han pakabati nira han sumat niya nga buhi na hi Jesus ngan hinkit-an niya hi Jesus, waray hira tumuod ha iya.

en: And they went away and told it unto the rest: neither believed they them.
war: Katapos hini, nagpakita hi Jesus, hin lain nga paagi, ngadto hin duha han mga tinun-an, samtang nakada hira ha dalan tipakadto ha huron.

en: And afterward he was manifested unto the eleven themselves as they sat at meat; and he upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them that had seen him after he was risen.
war: Binmalik hira ngan nagsumat han iba, kundi waray hira tuora.

en: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to the whole creation.
war: Ha kataposan, nagpakita hi Jesus han onse nga mga tinun-an, samtang nangangaon hira. Gin-isgan hira niya tungod han kawaray nira pagtoo ngan tungod han kamatig-a nira tumuod hadton mga nakakita ha iya nga buhi na.

en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that disbelieveth shall be condemned.
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kadto kamo ha bug-os nga kalibutan ngan igwali niyo an Maupay nga Sumat ha ngatanan nga katawhan.

en: And these signs shall accompany them that believe: in my name shall they cast out demons; they shall speak with new tongues;
war: Matatalwas an bisan hin-o nga natoo ngan kabunyagan; kundi an diri natoo, paghuhukman.

en: they shall take up serpents, and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall in no wise hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
war: Tatagan an mga natoo hini nga mga pangilal-an hin gahom: paiiwason nira, ha akon ngaran, an mga yawa; magyayakan hira hin iba nga mga pinulongan;

en: So then the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken unto them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.
war: diri hira maaano kon kumapot hira hin mga halas o uminom hin makahihilo; ngan magkakaupay an mga magsakit nga dadapatan ha ira mga kamot.”

en: And they went forth, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
war: Katapos ni Jesus makighimangraw ha ira, ginbayaw hiya ngadto ha langit, ngan linmingkod ha tuo han Dyos.
